data.en: Your baseline scores suspiciously well. You check: {roll:200-400} test examples also appear in the training set, some with different capitalization.
data.zh: 你的 baseline 分数高得可疑。一查：有 {roll:200-400} 条测试样本也出现在训练集里，有些只是大小写不同。

data.en: Deduplicate and rerun everything
data.zh: 去重，全部重跑

data.en: Scores drop four points. Now they mean something, and you can say so.
data.zh: 分数掉了四个点。现在它们有意义了，你也能理直气壮地这么说。

data.en: Report both splits
data.zh: 两种划分都报告

data.en: Every table gets two columns, original and deduplicated, and reviewers can see you were careful.
data.zh: 每张表都有两列：原始和去重后。审稿人看得出你很严谨。

data.en: Mention it in a footnote
data.zh: 在脚注里提一句

data.en: It goes in footnote 7. Someone will find it eventually, probably in a blog post.
data.zh: 它被塞进了脚注 7。迟早会有人发现，八成是在某篇知乎回答里。

data.en: A Standard Benchmark
data.zh: 公认基准

data.en: Three new papers this month report results on your dataset, and one calls it "the standard benchmark".
data.zh: 这个月有三篇新论文在你的数据集上报告结果，其中一篇称它为“公认基准”。

data.en: Host an official leaderboard
data.zh: 搞个官方排行榜

data.en: Submissions arrive at 3 am from every time zone. You're a maintainer now, and people cite you for it.
data.zh: 刷榜的提交从各个时区涌来，凌晨 3 点也不停。你成了榜单维护者，引用也跟着来了。

data.en: Start a harder version 2
data.zh: 着手做更难的第 2 版

data.en: Your plan for v2 is ready before anyone gets close to beating v1.
data.zh: 还没人接近攻破 v1，你的 v2 计划就已经准备好了。

data.en: Just enjoy it
data.zh: 享受就好

data.en: You screenshot the sentence that says "standard benchmark". Then you screenshot it again.
data.zh: 你把写着“公认基准”的那句话截了图。然后又截了一张。

data.en: Worse Than Coin Flips
data.zh: 不如抛硬币

data.en: Agreement is fine on every label except "sarcastic", where kappa is -0.08. On that one, your annotators agree less often than if they flipped coins.
data.zh: 除了“讽刺”，其他标签的一致性都还行。“讽刺”的 kappa 是 -0.08，在这个标签上，标注员们还不如抛硬币来得一致。

data.en: Drop the label
data.zh: 删掉这个标签

data.en: You're down to six labels, with cleaner data and one less argument at lab meeting.
data.zh: 只剩六个标签了，数据更干净，组会上也少了一场争论。

data.en: Redefine it, with examples
data.zh: 配上示例，重新定义

data.en: With twelve examples and one decision rule, agreement climbs to 0.52. For sarcasm, that counts as a party.
data.zh: 加了十二个示例和一条判定规则，一致性涨到 0.52。对讽刺来说，这已经值得开香槟了。

data.en: Study the disagreement itself
data.zh: 研究分歧本身

data.en: The annotators disagree in patterns, by background. The label is subjective, and now you can show it.
data.zh: 标注员的分歧是有规律的，和各自的背景有关。这个标签本身就是主观的，现在你能证明这一点了。

data.en: You look for a pattern in the disagreement and find only noise.
data.zh: 你想从分歧中找规律，结果只找到了噪声。

data.en: The Shortcut
data.zh: 捷径

data.en: Your crowdworkers found a shortcut: almost every "false" statement they wrote contains the word "not". A model that only looks for "not" scores {roll:84-92}%.
data.zh: 你的众包工作者找到了一条捷径：他们写的“错误”陈述里几乎都有“not”这个词。一个只看有没有“not”的模型能拿到 {roll:84-92}%。

data.en: Filter out the easy examples
data.zh: 过滤掉简单样本

data.en: You remove everything the shortcut can solve. The dataset shrinks by a third and gets much harder.
data.zh: 你删掉了所有能靠捷径解决的样本。数据集缩水三分之一，难度大增。

data.en: Re-collect with new instructions
data.zh: 改写说明，重新收集

data.en: "Please avoid the word not." Round two uses "never" instead, and round three is a little better.
data.zh: “请避免使用 not。”上有政策下有对策，第二轮全换成了“never”。第三轮才稍好一点。

data.en: Publish the shortcut as analysis
data.zh: 把捷径写成分析发表

data.en: You add a section on how the shortcut happened and how to avoid it. A reviewer calls it "refreshingly honest".
data.zh: 你加了一节，讲这条捷径是怎么出现的、怎么避免。一位审稿人评价它“坦诚得令人耳目一新”。

data.en: It reads as "the dataset is broken". Honestly, it reads that way to you too.
data.zh: 读起来像在说“这个数据集坏了”。说实话，你自己读着也是这个意思。

data.en: Three Pages, Numbered
data.zh: 三页纸，带编号

data.en: An annotator sends you a three-page email, with numbered sections, about the ambiguities in your guidelines. You read it twice. They're right about all of it.
data.zh: 一位标注员给你发了一封三页长的邮件，分节编号，专门讲你指南里的歧义。你读了两遍，一条都反驳不了。

data.en: Rewrite the guidelines with their notes
data.zh: 照对方的意见重写指南

data.en: The new version is mostly their email. Agreement jumps, and they get a line in the acknowledgments.
data.zh: 新版指南基本就是那封邮件。一致性大涨，这位标注员也在致谢里有了一行。

data.en: Invite them to co-design the guidelines
data.zh: 邀请对方一起设计指南

data.en: They say yes, and they're brilliant. You gain a collaborator who reads more carefully than you do.
data.zh: 对方答应了，而且非常出色。你多了一位读得比你还仔细的合作者。

data.en: They're flattered but busy. You do get a fourth page, though.
data.zh: 对方受宠若惊，但实在太忙。不过你倒是收到了第四页。

data.en: Fix only the top three issues
data.zh: 只改最要紧的三处

data.en: The worst ambiguities are gone. The email stays starred in your inbox, judging you.
data.zh: 最严重的歧义解决了。那封邮件一直标着星躺在你的收件箱里，默默审视着你。

data.en: The Data Wins
data.zh: 数据赢了

data.en: Your dataset paper has {roll:3-6} times the citations of your method paper. People love your data, and your method less so.
data.zh: 你的数据集论文引用量是方法论文的 {roll:3-6} 倍。大家爱你的数据，对你的方法就没那么爱了。

data.en: Lean in: plan the next dataset
data.zh: 顺势而为，规划下一个数据集

data.en: If the field wants data, you'll give it data. You sketch version 2 on the bus home.
data.zh: 领域要数据，那就给它数据。你在回家的公交上画出了第 2 版的草图。

data.en: Give the method paper a push
data.zh: 给方法论文推一把

data.en: You post a thread and give a talk. The method paper gets a small bump, and you get a small headache.
data.zh: 你发了条长推，又做了一场报告。方法论文的引用小涨了一点，你也小小头疼了一下。

data.en: Be happy either way
data.zh: 怎样都开心

data.en: You update your CV and buy a fancy coffee.
data.zh: 你更新了简历，奖励了自己一杯贵价咖啡。

data.en: Table 7
data.zh: 表 7

data.en: The technical report for {model} uses your dataset, by name, in Table 7. Your paper is not in the references. The report has 400 authors and room for 1,200 citations.
data.zh: {model} 的技术报告在表 7 里点名用了你的数据集。参考文献里却没有你的论文。这份报告有 400 位作者，参考文献塞得下 1200 条。

data.en: Email the report's authors
data.zh: 给报告作者发邮件

data.en: A reply within a day: "Our mistake, fixed in v2." Version 2 cites you, and so do the people who read it.
data.zh: 一天内就收到回复：“是我们疏忽了，v2 已修正。”第 2 版引用了你，读过它的人也跟着引用了你。

data.en: An auto-reply from a shared inbox. Version 2 comes out, still without you.
data.zh: 收到一封公共邮箱的自动回复。第 2 版发布了，依然没有你。

data.en: Post about it, politely
data.zh: 礼貌地发个帖子

data.en: You write a short, polite post with a screenshot. It travels far, and a lot of people learn your dataset's name.
data.zh: 你写了一条简短、礼貌的帖子，附上截图。帖子小火了一把，很多人记住了你数据集的名字。

data.en: Let it go
data.zh: 算了

data.en: Your dataset is in a famous report. That's a kind of citation, if you squint.
data.zh: 你的数据集上了一份知名报告。眯着眼看，也算是一种引用。

data.en: Issue: Mislabeled
data.zh: Issue：标错了

data.en: A new GitHub issue on your dataset's repo: "Example 3,412 is mislabeled." It has a screenshot and {roll:6-15} thumbs-up.
data.zh: 你数据集的 GitHub 仓库里来了一条新 issue：“第 3412 条样本标错了。”附有截图，还有 {roll:6-15} 个点赞。

data.en: Fix it and release v1.1
data.zh: 修好，发布 v1.1

data.en: You fix it and thank the reporter in the changelog. Oddly, the dataset now looks more trustworthy.
data.zh: 你修好了它，还在更新日志里感谢了提出者。奇怪的是，数据集反而显得更可信了。

data.en: Audit the whole label
data.zh: 把这个标签全部复查一遍

data.en: You find 40 more, and version 1.1 becomes a careful version 2.
data.zh: 你又找出了 40 条，v1.1 变成了一个认真的第 2 版。

data.en: Reply "Thanks, will fix soon"
data.zh: 回复“感谢，尽快修复”

data.en: True, technically. The issue gains three more thumbs-up while you get around to it.
data.zh: 严格来说，没毛病。在你抽空处理之前，这条 issue 又多了三个赞。

data.en: No Redistribution
data.zh: 禁止再分发

data.en: You finally read your source data's license closely. It says no redistribution, so your dataset can't be released as it is.
data.zh: 你终于仔细读了源数据的许可协议。上面写着禁止再分发，所以你的数据集不能原样发布。

data.en: Rebuild it from open sources
data.zh: 用开放数据重建

data.en: After weeks of re-collecting and re-annotating, the new dataset is fully releasable, and slightly better.
data.zh: 经过几周的重新收集和重新标注，新数据集完全可以发布了，质量还略有提升。

data.en: Release a script that rebuilds it
data.zh: 发布一个重建脚本

data.en: Users download the source themselves, and your script does the rest. It's legal, if slightly fragile.
data.zh: 用户自己下载源数据，剩下的交给你的脚本。合法，就是有点脆弱。

data.en: The script works on your machine. The first three issues on your repo say it doesn't work on theirs.
data.zh: 脚本在你的电脑上明明能跑。仓库里的前三条 issue 都说在他们那儿跑不了。

data.en: Ask the source for permission
data.zh: 向数据源申请授权

data.en: The maintainers say yes in a day, delighted that anyone read the license. You frame the email.
data.zh: 维护者一天之内就同意了，还很高兴居然有人读了许可协议。你把那封邮件裱了起来。

data.en: Their lawyer replies six weeks later: no.
data.zh: 六周后，对方律师回复：不行。

exits.en: Is This Worth It?
exits.zh: 读博图啥？

exits.en: It's 2 am and you're asking the question everyone asks eventually: is this worth it?
exits.zh: 凌晨 2 点，你问出了那个人人迟早会问的问题：读博到底图啥？

exits.en: You catch yourself browsing job listings during a seminar, and not for the first time.
exits.zh: 讲座听到一半，你发现自己在刷招聘信息。这不是第一次了。

exits.en: Take a semester of leave
exits.zh: 休学一学期

exits.en: You file the paperwork and feel better right away.
exits.zh: 表一交上去，你整个人立刻轻松了。

exits.en: Talk to your advisor about it
exits.zh: 找导师谈谈心

exits.en: Your advisor listens, then helps you cut your plan in half. It helps more than you expected.
exits.zh: 导师听完，帮你把计划砍掉了一半。比你想的管用多了。

exits.en: The conversation is awkward. At least it's said out loud now.
exits.zh: 聊得有点尴尬。但至少，话说出口了。

exits.en: Leave with a Master's
exits.zh: 拿个硕士学位走人

exits.en: Deciding feels like putting down something heavy.
exits.zh: 决定一做，肩上一下子轻了。

exits.en: Sleep on it and keep going
exits.zh: 睡一觉，接着干

exits.en: Things look a little better in the morning, as they usually do.
exits.zh: 一觉醒来，你觉得自己又能再战了。一向如此。

exits.en: The Usual?
exits.zh: 还是老样子？

exits.en: The bubble tea shop owner knows your order and your thesis topic. Today she mentions she's thinking of selling the shop.
exits.zh: 奶茶店老板娘记得你常点什么，连你的论文题目都知道。今天她随口提起，想把店转出去。

exits.en: Ask what it would cost, out of curiosity
exits.zh: 随口问问转让费

exits.en: It's more than a stipend and less than you'd think. You save the number in your notes app.
exits.zh: 比博士工资多，又比你想的少。你默默记进了备忘录。

exits.en: Wish her luck and get back to work
exits.zh: 祝她顺利，回去搬砖

exits.en: Your tea is perfect, as always.
exits.zh: 还是原来的配方，还是熟悉的味道。

exits.en: The Family Business
exits.zh: 家里的买卖

exits.en: Over holiday dinner, your uncle asks, again, when you'll come home and help run the family business. This year he has a spreadsheet.
exits.zh: 过节的饭桌上，叔叔照例问你什么时候回家帮忙打理生意。今年他有备而来：带了一张 Excel 表。

exits.en: Look at the spreadsheet
exits.zh: 看看那张表

exits.en: It's a terrible spreadsheet. The dangerous part is that you could fix it in an afternoon.
exits.zh: 这表惨不忍睹，合并单元格满天飞。危险的是，你一下午就能理顺。

exits.en: Change the subject to dessert
exits.zh: 把话题岔到红烧肉上

exits.en: Everyone is happy to talk about dessert instead.
exits.zh: 大家都很乐意改聊红烧肉。

exits.en: You'd Make a Good Doctor
exits.zh: 有人劝你学医

exits.en: After another study session, a clinician you work with says, half-joking: "You understand our workflow better than our residents. Ever thought about med school?"
exits.zh: 又做完一轮研究，合作的临床医生半开玩笑地说：“你比我们的住院医还懂我们的流程。没想过学医吗？”

exits.en: Laugh, then look up the requirements
exits.zh: 笑笑，转头就去查申请条件

exits.en: You bookmark the page. Then you bookmark it again in a different browser.
exits.zh: 你把网页加进了收藏夹。然后又在另一个浏览器里收藏了一遍。

exits.en: Laugh it off
exits.zh: 一笑置之

exits.en: You're flattered. You're also very happy not to work night shifts.
exits.zh: 你被夸得有点飘。但一想到夜班，又觉得现在挺好。

exits.en: For Sale
exits.zh: 旺铺转让

exits.en: The sign in the bubble tea shop window says FOR SALE. The owner sees you staring and waves you in.
exits.zh: 奶茶店橱窗上贴出了“旺铺转让”。老板娘见你盯着看，招手让你进去。

exits.en: Buy the shop
exits.zh: 盘下这家店

exits.en: You hand in your keycard and tie on an apron.
exits.zh: 你交还门禁卡，系上围裙。从此调的不是参，是甜度。

exits.en: Not yet. Maybe after the defense
exits.zh: 先不了，答辩完再说

exits.en: You order the usual. She gives you an extra topping, on the house.
exits.zh: 你点了老样子。老板娘免费给你多加了份小料。

exits.en: A Recruiter Calls
exits.zh: 猎头来电

exits.en: A recruiter from a trading firm messages you: "Your statistics skills are wasted on papers. Want to talk?" The salary range in the message has a lot of digits.
exits.zh: 一家量化交易公司的猎头给你发消息：“你的统计功底拿来写论文太浪费了。聊聊？”消息里的薪资范围，你数了两遍零。

exits.en: Take the call, out of curiosity
exits.zh: 好奇接个电话

exits.en: They talk market microstructure for forty minutes. You follow about half of it, and you're intrigued.
exits.zh: 对方讲了四十分钟市场微观结构。你听懂一半，但已经心动了。

exits.en: Ignore it and get back to work
exits.zh: 已读不回，继续干活

exits.en: You archive the message but don't delete it.
exits.zh: 你把消息归档了，但没舍得删。

exits.en: Brief the Staffers
exits.zh: 去做政策简报

exits.en: A policy institute invites you to brief a room of government staffers on how AI systems get evaluated. They want it short and free of jargon.
exits.zh: 一家政策研究机构请你给一屋子政府工作人员讲讲 AI 系统是怎么评测的。要求：简短，说人话。

exits.en: Say yes and write a one-pager
exits.zh: 答应下来，写一页纸摘要

exits.en: Explaining your field without jargon is hard and good practice. They ask you to stay in touch.
exits.zh: 不用黑话讲清楚自己的领域，很难，也很练人。对方希望以后常联系。

exits.en: Decline politely
exits.zh: 礼貌婉拒

exits.en: Your advisor says there will be other invitations.
exits.zh: 导师说，以后机会多的是。

exits.en: Your Video Took Off
exits.zh: 你的视频火了

exits.en: The five-minute explainer you made for your paper has 50,000 views. The comments are mostly kind, and one of them is from a researcher you admire.
exits.zh: 你给论文做的五分钟讲解视频在 B站有了 5 万播放。评论区大多很友善，其中一条来自你崇拜的大佬。

exits.en: Make another one
exits.zh: 再做一期

exits.en: You buy a better microphone. The second video does even better.
exits.zh: 你换了个好点的麦。第二期数据更好。

exits.en: Enjoy it and get back to research
exits.zh: 开心一下，回去做研究

exits.en: You screenshot the nice comment and keep going.
exits.zh: 你默默截图存下那条评论，继续干活。

exits.en: Write It for Everyone
exits.zh: 写篇科普

exits.en: A science magazine asks if you'd write 1,200 words about your research for a general audience, with no equations and no hedging in every sentence.
exits.zh: 一家科普杂志问你愿不愿意写 1200 字，给大众介绍你的研究。不要公式，也别每句话都加上“在一定程度上”。

exits.en: Write it
exits.zh: 写

exits.en: Your editor cuts every second qualifier. The piece is clearer than anything you've written, and your aunt shares it.
exits.zh: 编辑砍掉了一半限定词。这是你写过最清楚的文章，还被姑姑转进了家族群。

exits.en: Decline, there's a deadline
exits.zh: 婉拒，DDL 要紧

exits.en: You'll do the next one, after this deadline and the one after it.
exits.zh: 下次一定。等这个截稿过了，再等下一个截稿过了。

exits.en: An Envelope
exits.zh: 一封信

exits.en: You applied to a medical school on a whim last fall. Today there's an acceptance letter in your inbox, and a deadline to reply.
exits.zh: 去年秋天你脑子一热，申请了医学院。今天收件箱里躺着一封录取信，回复还有截止日期。

exits.en: Go to med school
exits.zh: 转行学医

exits.en: You tell your advisor, who says the clinicians always knew. You start in August.
exits.zh: 你跟导师说了，导师说合作的医生们早就看出你是学医的料。你 8 月入学。

exits.en: Stay and finish the PhD
exits.zh: 留下，读完博士

exits.en: You decline, carefully. It's good to know the door was open.
exits.zh: 你斟酌着措辞回绝了。知道自己有条退路，心里踏实。

exits.en: The Offer from Home
exits.zh: 家里喊你接班

exits.en: Your uncle calls. He's ready to retire, and he wants you to take over the family business. "You can bring your laptop," he adds, as if that settles it.
exits.zh: 叔叔打来电话：他准备退休了，想让你回来接班。“你也能带着电脑回来干的嘛。”他补了一句，仿佛这样就没什么好犹豫的了。

exits.en: Go home and run it
exits.zh: 回家接班

exits.en: You pack your office into two boxes. The spreadsheet never stood a chance.
exits.zh: 你把办公室收进两个箱子。那张 Excel 表在劫难逃。

exits.en: Not yet
exits.zh: 先不了

exits.en: He says the offer stands, and he probably means it.
exits.zh: 他说这个位置一直给你留着，多半是真心的。

lab.en: The Codebase Inheritance
lab.zh: 祖传代码

lab.en: {senior} is graduating and leaves you their entire codebase. There's no README, just 40 scripts called run.py and a folder named DO_NOT_DELETE.
lab.zh: {senior} 要毕业了，把整个代码库传给了你。没有 README，只有 40 个叫 run.py 的脚本，外加一个名叫 DO_NOT_DELETE 的文件夹。

lab.en: Document it as you go
lab.zh: 边看边写文档

lab.en: By the end you understand every script, and you've written the README they never did.
lab.zh: 最后你搞懂了每一个脚本，还补上了前任从没写过的 README。

lab.en: Book an hour with {senior} first
lab.zh: 先约 {senior} 讲一小时

lab.en: {senior} walks you through all of it and even records the call for you.
lab.zh: {senior} 带你从头过了一遍，还把通话录了下来给你。

lab.en: {senior} is already packing. You get a four-minute voice memo.
lab.zh: {senior} 已经在打包行李了，只甩给你一条四分钟的语音。

lab.en: Rewrite it from scratch
lab.zh: 推倒重写

lab.en: Your version is cleaner and half as long. It also takes a week and a half.
lab.zh: 你的版本更干净，长度只有一半。代价是花了一周半。

lab.en: Better Than the Reviewers
lab.zh: 比审稿人还强

lab.en: You ask {labmate} for a quick read of {project}. Their comments are sharper than any review you've ever received, and much nicer.
lab.zh: 你请 {labmate} 帮忙快速看一眼 {project}。得到的意见比你收到过的任何审稿意见都犀利，还温柔得多。

lab.en: Fix everything they found
lab.zh: 照单全改

lab.en: The paper gets clearer. You owe them a coffee, or several.
lab.zh: 论文清楚多了。你欠人家一杯奶茶，或者好几杯。

lab.en: Offer to read theirs in return
lab.zh: 投桃报李，帮对方看稿

lab.en: You trade drafts. Both papers improve, and you learn how they write.
lab.zh: 你们交换了草稿。两篇论文都有进步，你也学到了对方的写法。

lab.en: Ask them to join as co-author
lab.zh: 邀请对方当合作者

lab.en: "Sure!" They join and go over the whole paper again, carefully.
lab.zh: “好啊！”对方加入了，又把整篇论文仔仔细细过了一遍。

lab.en: "It was just comments, really." They mean it kindly.
lab.zh: “就是提了点意见而已啦。”对方是好意推辞。

lab.en: Lab Retreat
lab.zh: 实验室团建

lab.en: At the lab retreat you hike in the morning and fill a whiteboard in the afternoon. By dinner there are {roll:23-41} new project ideas.
lab.zh: 团建这天，上午爬山，下午写满一整块白板。到晚饭时，已经画出了 {roll:23-41} 个新项目的饼。

lab.en: Pick one and actually start it
lab.zh: 挑一个，真的开干

lab.en: You pick one with {labmate}. It survives the drive home, which is rare.
lab.zh: 你和 {labmate} 挑了一个。这张饼居然撑过了回程，实属难得。

lab.en: Lead the hike, skip the whiteboard
lab.zh: 带队爬山，不写白板

lab.en: You find the best view. Half the good ideas happen on the trail anyway.
lab.zh: 你找到了最好的观景点。反正一半的好想法都是在山路上冒出来的。

lab.en: Photograph the whiteboard
lab.zh: 给白板拍张照

lab.en: Every few months you look at the photo, and one more idea makes sense.
lab.zh: 每隔几个月你翻出照片看看，就又有一个想法能看懂了。

lab.en: Why, Though?
lab.zh: 灵魂拷问

lab.en: {mentee}, a new student, asks why the lab uses this metric and why anyone cares about it. You realize you don't actually know.
lab.zh: 新来的 {mentee} 问：组里为什么用这个指标？为什么有人在乎它？你发现自己其实并不知道。

lab.en: Look it up together
lab.zh: 一起查查

lab.en: The answer is in a 2016 paper, and now you both know it.
lab.zh: 答案在一篇 2016 年的论文里，现在你们俩都知道了。

lab.en: Give a confident answer
lab.zh: 一本正经地回答

lab.en: You check later. You were half right, and {mentee} believes the wrong half.
lab.zh: 你事后查了查。你说对了一半，而 {mentee} 记住的恰好是错的那一半。

lab.en: Send them to {senior}
lab.zh: 把问题甩给 {senior}

lab.en: {senior} doesn't know either, so the lab keeps using it out of tradition.
lab.zh: {senior} 也不知道。于是组里继续用着，美其名曰“传统”。

lab.en: It Worked on the First Try
lab.zh: 一次就跑通了

lab.en: {mentee}'s code runs on the first try, and the numbers look great. You have never been more suspicious in your life.
lab.zh: {mentee} 的代码一次就跑通了，结果还特别漂亮。事出反常必有妖，你从没这么警惕过。

lab.en: Check the data split
lab.zh: 检查数据划分

lab.en: There's test data in the training set, and you catch it before any reviewer could.
lab.zh: 训练集里混进了测试数据，你赶在所有审稿人之前抓到了。

lab.en: You find nothing. A week later {mentee} finds the leak and is very proud.
lab.zh: 你什么也没发现。一周后 {mentee} 自己找到了数据泄漏，非常骄傲。

lab.en: Walk through it line by line
lab.zh: 逐行过一遍

lab.en: Line 48 explains everything. {mentee} learns more from this than from any paper.
lab.zh: 第 48 行解释了一切。{mentee} 从这次学到的，比读任何论文都多。

lab.en: Trust them and celebrate
lab.zh: 相信对方，庆祝一下

lab.en: It really did work. {mentee} is very good, and you are a little jealous.
lab.zh: 真的跑通了。{mentee} 是真的强，你有点酸。

lab.en: #paper-discussion
lab.zh: #论文讨论

lab.en: The lab Slack's paper-discussion channel is now only memes. The last real message is from {roll:3-9} months ago.
lab.zh: 实验室 Slack 的论文讨论频道现在只剩梗图了。上一条正经消息还是 {roll:3-9} 个月前的。

lab.en: Post a better meme
lab.zh: 发张更绝的梗图

lab.en: It gets forty reactions. For one afternoon, you are the most important person in the lab.
lab.zh: 收到了四十个表情回应。整整一个下午，你是组里最重要的人。

lab.en: After a long silence, {labmate} reacts with a single skull.
lab.zh: 沉默良久，{labmate} 回了一个骷髅表情。

lab.en: Post an actual paper
lab.zh: 发一篇正经论文

lab.en: It gets three meme replies and one thoughtful one, from {senior}.
lab.zh: 收到三条梗图回复，和一条认真的回复，来自 {senior}。

lab.en: Start a new channel for papers
lab.zh: 再开一个论文频道

lab.en: Within a month it's half memes too, but the other half is good.
lab.zh: 不到一个月，这里也有一半是梗图了。好在另一半还挺有营养。

lab.en: Great Minds
lab.zh: 英雄所见略同

lab.en: At lab meeting, {labmate} presents their new project. It's {project}. You started it two weeks ago.
lab.zh: 组会上，{labmate} 介绍了自己的新项目想法：{project}。巧了，你两周前就开始做了。

lab.en: Merge into one joint project
lab.zh: 合二为一，一起做

lab.en: You merge your notes and then argue about the title for a week, happily.
lab.zh: 你们合并了笔记，然后开开心心地为标题吵了一周。

lab.en: Split it into two angles
lab.zh: 拆成两个角度

lab.en: You take the modeling and they take the user study, so the two papers never overlap.
lab.zh: 你负责建模，对方负责用户研究，两篇论文互不重叠。

lab.en: The angles keep overlapping. Lab meeting gets a little awkward.
lab.zh: 两个角度总是撞车。组会气氛有点尴尬。

lab.en: Let them have it
lab.zh: 拱手相让

lab.en: You hand over your notes. {labmate} thanks you in the acknowledgments, in bold.
lab.zh: 你把笔记交了出去。{labmate} 在致谢里感谢了你，还加了粗。

lab.en: The Summer Visitor
lab.zh: 暑期访问生

lab.en: The visiting summer student finishes in six weeks what the lab planned for the whole summer. They also fixed the printer.
lab.zh: 暑期访问学生用六周干完了组里整个夏天的计划，顺手还修好了打印机。

lab.en: Ask how they work
lab.zh: 请教效率秘诀

lab.en: Their secret is one task at a time and no open tabs. You try it, and annoyingly, it works.
lab.zh: 秘诀是一次只做一件事，不开多余的标签页。你试了一下，气人的是，真管用。

lab.en: Invite them to collaborate
lab.zh: 邀请对方合作

lab.en: They agree to keep working with you after they go home. You now have a collaborator abroad.
lab.zh: 对方答应回去后继续跟你合作。你现在有了一位海外合作者。

lab.en: Three labmates got there first.
lab.zh: 已经有三个同门先下手为强了。

lab.en: Take them to lunch instead
lab.zh: 改请对方吃午饭

lab.en: They're as nice as they are fast. You trade emails and promise to stay in touch.
lab.zh: 对方干活快，人也好。你们互留了邮箱，约好保持联系。

lab.en: You're Presenting Today
lab.zh: 今天你主讲

lab.en: Reading group starts in ten minutes, and you're presenting. You've read the abstract, probably.
lab.zh: 读书会十分钟后开始，今天你主讲。摘要你大概是读过的。

lab.en: Read it in ten minutes
lab.zh: 十分钟临时抱佛脚

lab.en: You present the key idea clearly, and nobody can tell you read it ten minutes ago.
lab.zh: 你把核心思想讲得很清楚，没人看得出你十分钟前才读。

lab.en: Someone asks about Table 3. You all learn about Table 3 together.
lab.zh: 有人问起表 3。于是大家一起认识了表 3。

lab.en: Admit it and lead a discussion
lab.zh: 坦白，然后带大家讨论

lab.en: "Let's read section 3 together." It's the best reading group in months.
lab.zh: “我们一起读第 3 节吧。”这是几个月来最好的一次读书会。

lab.en: Swap weeks with {labmate}
lab.zh: 和 {labmate} 换周

lab.en: {labmate} presents today and you take next week, so now you owe them one.
lab.zh: 今天 {labmate} 讲，你换到下周，这下欠了人家一次。

lab.en: {labmate} hasn't read theirs either. You bond over it.
lab.zh: {labmate} 也没读自己那篇。你们因此惺惺相惜。

lab.en: Now You're the Senior One
lab.zh: 你成老艺术家了！

lab.en: {senior}, who gave you all your best advice in Year 1, is graduating. Looking around lab meeting, you realize the senior student is now you.
lab.zh: 博一时给过你所有最好建议的 {senior} 要毕业了。组会上环顾四周，你发现组里辈分最高的学生，已经是你了。

lab.en: Write down what they taught you
lab.zh: 把学到的写下来

lab.en: You fit ten rules on one page, pin it above your desk and send it to the new students.
lab.zh: 你把十条心得浓缩成一页纸，钉在桌子上方，又发进了新生群。

lab.en: Take the new students to lunch
lab.zh: 请新生吃午饭

lab.en: Three new students bring eleven questions to a very long lunch. You answer most of them.
lab.zh: 三个新生带着十一个问题，吃了一顿很长的午饭。大部分你都答上了。

lab.en: Ask {senior} for one last tip
lab.zh: 向 {senior} 讨最后一条建议

lab.en: "Take your weekends." Then they hand you the lab's spare monitor.
lab.zh: “周末要休息。”说完，把组里那台备用显示器交给了你。

lab.en: Same Bug, Same Whiteboard
lab.zh: 同一个 bug，同一块白板

lab.en: {labmate} stops by with the same bug you've been fighting all week. Two hours later you've fixed both, and the whiteboard has a joint paper on it.
lab.zh: {labmate} 来找你，遇到的正是折磨了你一整周的那个 bug。两小时后，两边的 bug 都修好了，白板上还多了一篇合作论文。

lab.en: Start the joint paper
lab.zh: 开写合作论文

lab.en: You open a shared doc called "paper (real)". {labmate} has already made the figure template.
lab.zh: 你新建了一个共享文档，叫“论文（这次是真的）”。{labmate} 已经把图表模板做好了。

lab.en: Pair up on {project} instead
lab.zh: 改为一起做 {project}

lab.en: {labmate} takes the evaluation off your hands. You work well together, suspiciously well.
lab.zh: {labmate} 接手了评测部分。你们配合得很好，好得可疑。

lab.en: {labmate} is swamped this month. "Next project, for sure."
lab.zh: {labmate} 这个月忙疯了。“下个项目，下次一定！”

lab.en: Keep it to lunch chats
lab.zh: 只当饭搭子

lab.en: You keep the good lunches and the shared bugs, and skip the paper.
lab.zh: 好吃的午饭和共同的 bug 都留着，论文就算了。

lab.en: Paper One, Together
lab.zh: 合作第一篇

lab.en: The joint paper with your favorite co-author is accepted. The shared doc for the next one is already called "paper 2 (real)".
lab.zh: 你和最佳拍档合作的论文中稿了。下一篇的共享文档已经叫“论文 2（这次是真的）”了。

lab.en: Start paper two right away
lab.zh: 马上开写第二篇

lab.en: You celebrate with dumplings and a new outline.
lab.zh: 你们吃火锅庆祝，顺便列了个新大纲。

lab.en: Swap roles for paper two
lab.zh: 第二篇互换分工

lab.en: This time you write and they code. You both get better at the other half.
lab.zh: 这次你写论文，对方写代码。你们在另一半上都有了长进。

lab.en: Take a break after this one
lab.zh: 这篇之后歇一歇

lab.en: You stop at one great paper, stay lunch friends and promise each other "someday".
lab.zh: 你们在一篇好论文上收手，继续当饭搭子，约好“改天一定”。

lab.en: Paper Two, Together
lab.zh: 合作第二篇

lab.en: Paper two with your co-author is accepted. One reviewer notes that the two halves of the paper "fit unusually well".
lab.zh: 和合作者的第二篇也中了。一位审稿人评价论文的两半“契合得出奇”。

lab.en: Go for the trilogy
lab.zh: 冲三部曲

lab.en: Paper three has an outline before the camera-ready is even done.
lab.zh: 终稿还没交，第三篇的大纲已经有了。

lab.en: Ask them to read your thesis plan
lab.zh: 请对方看你的博士论文计划

lab.en: Their notes on your thesis plan are better than your committee's will be. Paper three can wait a little.
lab.zh: 对方给的意见，比你答辩委员会将来给的还好。第三篇可以稍等。

lab.en: Call it a perfect pair
lab.zh: 凑成一对，就此收手

lab.en: Two papers in, you still haven't argued about author order, so you quit while you're ahead.
lab.zh: 合作了两篇，你们还没为作者顺序吵过架，于是见好就收。

lab.en: That Duo
lab.zh: 黄金搭档

lab.en: Your third paper together comes out. At a conference, someone points at the two of you and says "Oh, that duo."
lab.zh: 你们合作的第三篇论文发表了。开会时，有人指着你们俩说：“哦，就是那对黄金搭档。”

lab.en: Lean into being that duo
lab.zh: 坐实搭档名号

lab.en: You give the talk together, finishing each other's slides.
lab.zh: 你们一起做报告，默契到能接上对方的幻灯片。

lab.en: Make a pact for after graduation
lab.zh: 约定毕业以后

lab.en: "If I ever start a company, you're employee number four." They mean it.
lab.zh: “要是我哪天开公司，你就是 4 号员工。”对方是认真的。

lab.en: Thank them in your thesis draft
lab.zh: 写进博士论文的致谢

lab.en: You write the acknowledgments page years early, just to write this one paragraph.
lab.zh: 你提前好几年写好了致谢页，只为了写下这一段。

lab.en: Show Them the Ropes
lab.zh: 带新人

lab.en: A rotation student joins the lab for six weeks, and {advisor} asks you to get them started on the codebase.
lab.zh: 一位轮转学生来组里待六周，{advisor}让你带对方熟悉代码库。

lab.en: Pair with them for a few days
lab.zh: 手把手带几天

lab.en: They're fast, and they find two bugs you'd stopped seeing.
lab.zh: 对方上手很快，还找出了两个你早已视而不见的 bug。

lab.en: Write them a setup guide
lab.zh: 写一份上手指南

lab.en: The guide takes an afternoon. Every new student uses it for the next three years.
lab.zh: 指南花了一个下午。之后三年，它都是组里新生的入门圣经。

lab.en: Point them to the README
lab.zh: 让对方去看 README

lab.en: The README was last updated in 2021. They figure it out eventually and remember who pointed.
lab.zh: README 最后一次更新是 2021 年。对方最后还是自己摸索出来了，也记住了是谁指的路。

lab.en: Helpful Discussions
lab.zh: 有益的讨论

lab.en: {labmate} asks to be an author on {project}. In their words, they contributed "helpful discussions". You remember one discussion, and it was about lunch.
lab.zh: {labmate} 想在 {project} 上挂个名，理由是贡献了“有益的讨论”。你只记得一次讨论，主题是中午吃啥。

lab.en: Add them anyway
lab.zh: 还是加上对方

lab.en: Their name goes on near the end. To earn it, they proofread the whole paper, carefully.
lab.zh: 对方的名字排在了靠后的位置。为了对得起这个署名，对方把整篇论文仔细校对了一遍。

lab.en: Offer an acknowledgment instead
lab.zh: 改为写进致谢

lab.en: "Totally fair." They seem relieved, and the acknowledgment is warm and specific.
lab.zh: “完全合理。”对方似乎松了口气，致谢也写得具体又真诚。

lab.en: "Sure. No problem." Lab lunch is a little quiet this week.
lab.zh: “行，没问题。”这周组里吃午饭时有点安静。

lab.en: Give them a real task to earn it
lab.zh: 给对方派个正经活

lab.en: They run the error analysis you'd been avoiding. Now it's a real authorship, and a better paper.
lab.zh: 对方做完了你一直在逃避的错误分析。现在这个署名名副其实，论文也更好了。

lab.en: Second-Author Standoff
lab.zh: 二作之争

lab.en: {labmate} and {labmate2} both worked on {project}, and both expect to be second author. The author line in the draft has changed eleven times today. You haven't touched it once.
lab.zh: {labmate} 和 {labmate2} 都参与了 {project}，也都觉得自己该是二作。今天草稿里的作者栏已经改了十一次，你一次都没动过。

lab.en: Ask each for a contribution list
lab.zh: 让两人各列贡献清单

lab.en: Two lists are due Friday. By Wednesday, both are color-coded.
lab.zh: 两份清单周五交。到了周三，两边已经卷到了按颜色分类。

lab.en: Go alphabetical and move on
lab.zh: 按字母排序，翻篇

lab.en: Alphabetical it is. Both grumble, equally, which is the point.
lab.zh: 那就按字母顺序。两人抱怨得一样多，要的就是这个效果。

lab.en: The one who comes second in the alphabet has opinions about the alphabet.
lab.zh: 字母排在后面的那位，对字母表很有意见。

lab.en: Ask {advisor} to rule on it
lab.zh: 请 {advisor}拍板

lab.en: {advisor} settles it in one sentence and thanks both of them in the next.
lab.zh: {advisor}一句话就定了下来，下一句就感谢了两个人。

lab.en: {advisor} says it's your paper, so it's your call, which is flattering and no help at all.
lab.zh: {advisor}说这是你的论文，你说了算。听着很受用，但毫无帮助。

lab.en: 140 Percent
Both contribution lists arrive. Added together, your two co-authors did 140% of the work on your paper. Both lists include "moral support".
lab.zh: 两份贡献清单都交上来了。加起来，两位合作者完成了你这篇论文 140% 的工作量。两份清单里都有“精神支持”。

lab.en: Make them equal, with a footnote
lab.zh: 并列二作，加个脚注

lab.en: A day of diplomacy later, both get a small dagger and a footnote. Both CVs say "co-second author" by evening.
lab.zh: 斡旋了一整天，两人名字旁各加了一个 † 和一条脚注。当晚，两份简历上都写上了“共同第二作者”。

lab.en: Go by who ran the experiments
lab.zh: 按谁跑了实验来定

lab.en: One of them is thrilled. The other is gracious in public and very quiet at lunch.
lab.zh: 一个乐开了花。另一个当众很大度，吃午饭时却格外安静。

lab.en: Settle it at board game night
lab.zh: 桌游之夜一决胜负

lab.en: Four hours of a strategy game. The winner gets second author; the loser gets to name the next lab snack.
lab.zh: 一局策略游戏打了四个小时。赢家拿二作，输家负责决定组里下一批零食。

lab.en: The game ends in a dispute about the rules. You go alphabetical, out of sheer exhaustion.
lab.zh: 游戏以一场规则之争告终。你们精疲力尽，最后还是按字母排了。

lab.en: The Favor Returned
lab.zh: 还人情

lab.en: The co-author who ended up third on your paper starts a new project and asks you to join. "You owe me a second-author slot," they say, mostly smiling.
lab.zh: 在你论文上最终排第三的那位合作者开了个新项目，邀你加入。“你欠我一个二作。”说这话时，对方基本是笑着的。

lab.en: Join and do real work
lab.zh: 加入，干实事

lab.en: You run their baselines and fix their plots. By the end, the second-author slot is earned twice over.
lab.zh: 你帮对方跑 baseline、改图。到最后，这个二作你挣了两倍都不止。

lab.en: Offer a careful proofread instead
lab.zh: 改为仔细校对一遍

lab.en: Your comments are sharp and kind. They call it even, and it mostly is.
lab.zh: 你的意见犀利又友善。对方说这下两清了，基本也确实如此。

lab.en: 2,000 Likes
{paper} was rejected from {venue} this morning. By lunch, {labmate}'s acceptance post has 2,000 likes, and the lab chat is nothing but party emojis.
lab.zh: 今天上午，{paper} 被 {venue} 拒了。到午饭时，{labmate} 晒中稿的帖子已经有 2000 个赞，组群里全是撒花表情。

lab.en: Congratulate them, sincerely
lab.zh: 真心祝贺对方

lab.en: You mean it, mostly. Later {labmate} messages you: "Yours is next. I read it. It's good."
lab.zh: 你九成是真心的。后来 {labmate} 私信你：“下一个就是你。我读过了，写得很好。”

lab.en: Log off for a week
lab.zh: 下线一周

lab.en: You spend a week offline and come back to 2,400 likes and a much calmer head.
lab.zh: 你离线了一周，回来时帖子已经 2400 个赞，你的心态也平和多了。

lab.en: Ask {labmate} to read your reviews
lab.zh: 请 {labmate} 看看你的审稿意见

lab.en: They spot the two fixes that matter. It turns out their paper was rejected twice before this.
lab.zh: 对方一眼看出了最关键的两处修改。原来那篇论文在这之前也被拒过两次。

lab.en: They're too swamped with messages from strangers to look this week.
lab.zh: 这周对方被陌生人的消息淹没了，抽不出空看。

lab.en: Minute 100
lab.zh: 第 100 分钟

lab.en: Lab meeting was booked for an hour. It's now minute 100. The agenda had one item, and nobody can remember what it was.
lab.zh: 组会原定一小时，现在已经开到第 100 分钟了。议程只有一项，可没人记得是什么。

lab.en: Lab meeting is in its second hour. The discussion has drifted from your results to whether a hot dog is a sandwich, and {advisor} has strong views.
lab.zh: 组会开进了第二个小时。话题已经从你的结果飘到了粽子该吃甜的还是咸的，{advisor}对此立场鲜明。

lab.en: Stay to the end
lab.zh: 坚持到最后

lab.en: It ends with a decision nobody will remember, but everyone was there for it.
lab.zh: 会议以一个谁都不会记得的决定收场，但大家都在场见证了。

lab.en: Slip out early
lab.zh: 提前溜走

lab.en: You get an hour of real work done. Later you learn you were volunteered for something while you were gone.
lab.zh: 你干了一小时正经活。后来才知道，你不在的时候被“自愿”报名了某件事。

lab.en: Propose a hard stop
lab.zh: 提议准时散会

lab.en: Everyone agrees at once. Next week ends on time, and someone brings a kitchen timer.
lab.zh: 大家立刻同意。下周的组会准时结束，还有人带来了一个厨房计时器。

lab.en: The discussion about having a hard stop runs another 20 minutes.
lab.zh: 关于要不要准时散会的讨论，又开了 20 分钟。

lab.en: Come With Me?
lab.zh: 一起跑路吗？

lab.en: {labmate} is leaving the PhD to join a startup. Their farewell message ends: "We're hiring, by the way. Come with me?" Their desk plant also needs a new home.
lab.zh: {labmate} 决定不读博了，要去一家创业公司。告别消息的最后一句是：“对了，我们在招人。跟我走吗？”桌上那盆绿植也需要一个新家。

lab.en: Say "Ask me again after I graduate"
lab.zh: 说“等我毕业再问我”

lab.en: "Deal. I'll hold you to it." They actually write it down.
lab.zh: “一言为定，我记着了。”对方真的写了下来。

lab.en: Interview for a summer role there
lab.zh: 去面个暑期岗位

lab.en: Three hours of interviews and a take-home task. They like you, and you learn what industry interviews feel like.
lab.zh: 三小时面试，外加一道 take-home 题。对方很喜欢你，你也体验了一把业界面试。

lab.en: Adopt the plant
lab.zh: 收养那盆绿植

lab.en: The plant thrives on your desk. {labmate} asks for a photo of it every month.
lab.zh: 绿植在你桌上长得很旺。{labmate} 每个月都要你拍张照片过去。

lab.en: Just for an Hour
lab.zh: 就一小时

lab.en: {labmate} asks to borrow your GPU reservation "just for an hour" on Tuesday. It is now Thursday.
lab.zh: 周二，{labmate} 找你借用预约好的显卡集群，说“就用一小时”。现在已经周四了。

lab.en: Ask for it back, nicely
lab.zh: 客气地要回来

lab.en: It's back in ten minutes, with an apology and a cookie.
lab.zh: 十分钟就还回来了，附带一句道歉和一块饼干。

lab.en: "Just one more hour?" Your run starts on Saturday.
lab.zh: “再用一小时行吗？”你的实验拖到周六才开跑。

lab.en: Let them finish
lab.zh: 让对方用完

lab.en: Their paper makes the deadline. The acknowledgments thank you for "heroic GPU generosity".
lab.zh: 对方的论文赶上了截稿。致谢里专门感谢你“英勇无私地让卡”。

lab.en: Learn the booking system's secrets
lab.zh: 摸透预约系统的门道

lab.en: You find an overflow queue nobody uses. Your run starts tonight, and now everyone asks you about it.
lab.zh: 你发现了一个没人用的备用队列。今晚实验就开跑了，现在大家都来找你打听奇技淫巧。

lab.en: The Only Empty Dish
lab.zh: 唯一的空盘

lab.en: The lab potluck has eleven dishes. By 9 pm, yours is the only one scraped clean, and three people have asked for the recipe.
lab.zh: 组里搞百家饭聚餐，一共十一道菜。到晚上 9 点，只有你那盘被刮得干干净净，已经有三个人来要菜谱了。

lab.en: Share the recipe with everyone
lab.zh: 把菜谱分享给大家

lab.en: At the next potluck there are four versions of your dish. Yours is still the best, though you'd never say so.
lab.zh: 下次聚餐上出现了四个版本的你的菜。你的还是最好吃的，不过你绝不会说出口。

lab.en: Keep it a family secret
lab.zh: 保密，祖传秘方

lab.en: The mystery does wonders for your reputation. Friends start inviting you to dinners, hopefully.
lab.zh: 神秘感让你名声大振。朋友们开始请你吃饭，眼里满是期待。

lab.en: Volunteer to cook next time too
lab.zh: 下次也主动掌勺

lab.en: Next time you cook for fourteen. It takes a whole Saturday, and everyone loves you a little more.
lab.zh: 下次你给十四个人做饭，花了一整个周六，大家都更爱你了一点。

lab.en: Admit it took two days
lab.zh: 坦白做了两天

lab.en: Foodie
lab.zh: 吃货

lab.en: You explain the three markets and the secret ingredient, and the lab looks at you with new respect.
lab.zh: 你讲了跑过的三个市场和那味秘密配料，组里人看你的眼神都多了几分敬意。

lab.en: Nothing Compiles
lab.zh: 全都编译不过

lab.en: Someone updated one package in the lab's shared paper template. Now nobody's paper compiles, and three labmates have deadlines next week.
lab.zh: 有人更新了组里共用论文模板中的一个宏包。现在谁的论文都编译不过了，而三个同门下周就要截稿。

lab.en: Fix it for everyone
lab.zh: 帮大家修好

lab.en: You find the one-line culprit in an hour. You are a hero in the lab chat for a whole day.
lab.zh: 你花一小时揪出了那一行罪魁祸首。整整一天，你都是组群里的英雄。

lab.en: You fix it for yourself. Everyone else now gets a different error.
lab.zh: 你只修好了自己的。其他人现在换了一种报错。

lab.en: Roll back to last month's copy
lab.zh: 回退到上个月的版本

lab.en: Your paper compiles again, minus this month's fixes. Two figures land on the wrong page, and you leave them.
lab.zh: 论文又能编译了，只是这个月的修改都没了。有两张图跑到了错的页面，你也懒得管了。

lab.en: Wait for {senior} to fix it
lab.zh: 等 {senior} 来修

lab.en: {senior} fixes it at 1 am and posts "DO NOT TOUCH THE TEMPLATE" in every channel.
lab.zh: {senior} 凌晨 1 点修好了，在每个频道都发了一句：“不许再动模板！”

lab.en: Holding the Clicker
lab.zh: 手握翻页笔

lab.en: At {senior}'s defense, you're in charge of the clicker and the bag of adapters. {senior} is nervous, so now you are too.
lab.zh: {senior} 答辩那天，你负责翻页笔和一袋转接头。{senior} 很紧张，于是你也紧张了。

lab.en: Rehearse the handoff the night before
lab.zh: 提前一晚彩排配合

lab.en: Every slide comes up on cue. {senior} thanks you on the acknowledgments slide.
lab.zh: 每张幻灯片都准时出现。{senior} 在致谢页上感谢了你。

lab.en: Wing it
lab.zh: 临场发挥

lab.en: Nobody notices you at all, which is exactly the job.
lab.zh: 全程没人注意到你。合格的工具人就该这样。

lab.en: You skip slide 31, and {senior} improvises around it. Neither of you will ever mention it.
lab.zh: 你跳过了第 31 页，{senior} 临场圆了过去。这件事你们俩谁都不会再提。

lab.en: Note every question between clicks
lab.zh: 翻页间隙记下每个问题

lab.en: Your notes become {senior}'s revision list, and the start of your own defense prep.
lab.zh: 你的笔记成了 {senior} 的修改清单，也成了你自己答辩准备的开端。

legion.en: Ten Minutes at Gate B12
legion.zh: B12 登机口的十分钟

legion.en: Your first meeting with {advisor} in months is ten minutes long, on video, at an airport gate. Boarding starts in eight.
legion.zh: 你和 {advisor}几个月来的第一次会面：视频通话，十分钟，背景是机场登机口。八分钟后开始登机。

legion.en: Ask the one question that matters
legion.zh: 只问那个最关键的问题

legion.en: Their answer, given while they board, saves you a month.
legion.zh: 导师边登机边给的回答，帮你省下了一个月。

legion.en: They answer a different question. Then the call drops.
legion.zh: 导师答非所问。然后，信号断了。

legion.en: Give a three-minute update
legion.zh: 做个三分钟进展汇报

legion.en: They nod a lot and say "great, keep going" just before the gate closes.
legion.zh: 导师一直点头，在登机口关闭前说了句“很好，继续”。

legion.en: Ask for an intro to someone useful
legion.zh: 请导师帮忙搭个线

legion.en: Between announcements, they forward your email to two famous people, and one of them replies.
legion.zh: 趁着两次广播的间隙，导师把你的邮件转给了两位大牛，其中一位还真回了。

legion.en: Doors You Didn't Know Existed
legion.zh: 原来还有这些门路

legion.en: You asked {advisor} for a short letter for a summer program. Since then, three people you've never met have emailed to say they "heard great things".
legion.zh: 你申请暑期项目时，请 {advisor}写了封简短的推荐信。从那以后，已经有三个素不相识的人发邮件来，说“久仰大名”。

legion.en: Reply to all three
legion.zh: 三封都回

legion.en: One becomes a mentor, one a collaborator, and one wants you on their workshop committee.
legion.zh: 一位成了你的引路人，一位成了合作者，还有一位想拉你进自己 workshop 的组委会。

legion.en: Pick the one closest to your work
legion.zh: 挑和你研究最接近的那位

legion.en: One long call with someone in exactly your area is worth ten networking dinners.
legion.zh: 跟正好做你这个方向的人长聊一次，抵得上十顿社交饭局。

legion.en: Thank {advisor} properly
legion.zh: 好好谢谢 {advisor}

legion.en: You send a real thank-you note. The reply comes within the hour, from another continent.
legion.zh: 你认真写了一封感谢信。不到一小时，回复就从地球另一端发了过来。

legion.en: Daily Stand-Ups
legion.zh: 每日站会

legion.en: {advisor} announces daily stand-ups: fifteen minutes at 9 am, every day. "Weekends included. Just a quick check-in."
legion.zh: {advisor}宣布以后每天开站会：早上 9 点，十五分钟。“周末也开，就简单碰一下。”

legion.en: Show up every day
legion.zh: 天天打卡

legion.en: You're never stuck for long. You're also never not in a meeting.
legion.zh: 卡壳的时间是短了，可你好像永远都在开会。

legion.en: Negotiate weekdays only
legion.zh: 争取只在工作日开

legion.en: "Fine. Weekdays." Your Saturdays survive.
legion.zh: “行吧，那就只开工作日。”你的周六保住了。

legion.en: "Weekends are when real work happens." The stand-ups stay.
legion.zh: “周末才是真正干活的时候。”站会照开。

legion.en: Send a written stand-up each morning
legion.zh: 每天早上发条文字汇报

legion.en: You type three bullet points from bed each morning. {advisor} replies with a thumbs-up every time.
legion.zh: 你每天早上躺在床上敲三条要点。{advisor}每次都回一个大拇指。

legion.en: Figure, Version Four
legion.zh: 图_最终版_v4

legion.en: {advisor} rewrites your figure captions, again. Overnight, they also rewrite the figure. The colors are now their favorite colors.
legion.zh: {advisor}又改了一遍你的图注，还连夜把图也重画了。现在的配色，全是导师最喜欢的颜色。

legion.en: Accept the changes
legion.zh: 接受修改

legion.en: It is a slightly better figure. You are slightly annoyed that it's better.
legion.zh: 图确实好看了一点。你有点不爽，可又不得不承认。

legion.en: Explain your original choices
legion.zh: 解释你当初的设计

legion.en: You keep your layout, and they keep their caption.
legion.zh: 各退一步：布局留你的，图注留导师的。

legion.en: They listen carefully, then send version five.
legion.zh: 导师认真听完，转头发来了第五版。

legion.en: Let them own the figures
legion.zh: 把图全交给导师

legion.en: You get a day back and lose a little ownership. The figures are very orange.
legion.zh: 你省下了一天，只是少了点参与感。所有图都变得很橙。

legion.en: All Very Doable
legion.zh: 问题不大

legion.en: {advisor} sends a calendar invite titled "Submission month!": three deadlines in four weeks. "All very doable."
legion.zh: {advisor}发来一个日历邀请，标题是“投稿月！”：四周内三个截稿。“问题不大。”

legion.en: Go for all three
legion.zh: 三个都冲

legion.en: You push hard on all three, and one of them will probably be good. {advisor} is thrilled.
legion.zh: 三篇你都拼了老命，大概能有一篇像样。{advisor}乐开了花。

legion.en: Pick the strongest one
legion.zh: 挑最有把握的那篇

legion.en: "Fine. One great paper beats three okay ones." They mean it, mostly.
legion.zh: “行吧。一篇好论文顶三篇凑合的。”导师这话大概有八成是真心的。

legion.en: They agree, then add a workshop paper "on the side".
legion.zh: 导师同意了，转手又“顺便”加了一篇 workshop 论文。

legion.en: Take two, give one to {labmate}
legion.zh: 接两个，分一个给 {labmate}

legion.en: {labmate} takes the third deadline and thanks you for it.
legion.zh: {labmate} 接下了第三篇，还反过来谢了你。

legion.en: {labmate} is drowning too. You split the misery evenly.
legion.zh: {labmate} 自己也焦头烂额。你俩有难同当，痛苦平分。

legion.en: Out of Pocket
legion.zh: 自掏腰包

legion.en: The lab's travel budget is empty, so {advisor} pays your conference registration with their own card. "Don't mention it. Really."
legion.zh: 组里的差旅经费见底了，{advisor}刷自己的卡帮你交了会议注册费。“小事，别放在心上。真的。”

legion.en: Accept, and say thank you
legion.zh: 收下，说声谢谢

legion.en: You write a thank-you note. It ends up pinned to their office door.
legion.zh: 你写了一张感谢卡，后来导师把它钉在了办公室门上。

legion.en: Apply for a student travel grant
legion.zh: 申请学生差旅资助

legion.en: You win the grant and pay them back. They pretend to be annoyed.
legion.zh: 你拿到了资助，把钱还给了导师。导师还假装不高兴。

legion.en: You don't get the grant, and {advisor} kindly insists on paying.
legion.zh: 资助没申请下来，{advisor}说什么也不让你还钱。

legion.en: Volunteer at the conference
legion.zh: 去会议当志愿者

legion.en: Six hours at the badge desk get you free registration, and you meet everyone.
legion.zh: 在签到台站了六小时，换来免费注册，还跟全场混了个脸熟。

legion.en: TA, Again
legion.zh: 又当助教

legion.en: You're a TA again this semester. {advisor} apologizes, sincerely, for the third time, and promises to protect the rest of your week.
legion.zh: 这学期你又得当助教。{advisor}已经第三次诚恳地向你道歉了，还保证这周剩下的时间都留给你自己。

legion.en: Say it's fine, really
legion.zh: 说没关系，真的

legion.en: It is mostly fine. The grading is less fine.
legion.zh: 大部分时候确实没事。改作业的时候就有事了。

legion.en: Ask to TA a course you like
legion.zh: 申请给喜欢的课当助教

legion.en: They make two calls. You get the HCI course, which you'd have audited anyway.
legion.zh: 导师打了两个电话，你就分到了 HCI 那门课，正好是你本来就打算去蹭的。

legion.en: The only opening is intro programming, with 300 students.
legion.zh: 唯一有空缺的是编程入门课，足足 300 个学生。

legion.en: Apply for a fellowship together
legion.zh: 一起申请奖学金

legion.en: {advisor} goes through your application line by line. It's the best draft you've written.
legion.zh: {advisor}逐行帮你过了一遍申请材料。这是你写过最好的一版。

legion.en: Progress Toward Aim 2
legion.zh: 目标 2 的进展

legion.en: Annual grant report season. {advisor} assigns you Section 4.2, "Progress Toward Aim 2". You are not sure what Aim 2 is.
legion.zh: 一年一度的基金年报季又到了。{advisor}把第 4.2 节“目标 2 的进展”分给了你，可你连目标 2 是啥都不太确定。

legion.en: Read the grant, then write it
legion.zh: 先读基金申请书，再动笔

legion.en: Aim 2 turns out to be your project. You finally know why you're funded.
legion.zh: 原来目标 2 就是你的项目。你终于知道自己的工资是从哪来的了。

legion.en: Recycle your last paper's intro
legion.zh: 拿上篇论文的引言缝缝补补

legion.en: It fits Aim 2 perfectly, and you're done in an afternoon.
legion.zh: 缝得天衣无缝，完美契合目标 2，一下午搞定。

legion.en: {advisor} notices right away: "This is about Aim 3."
legion.zh: {advisor}一眼就看出来了：“这写的是目标 3。”

legion.en: Ask {senior} how they did theirs
legion.zh: 问 {senior} 去年是怎么写的

legion.en: {senior} sends last year's section and a warning about Table 3.
legion.zh: {senior} 发来了去年那一节，还提醒你小心表 3。

legion.en: The Lab Handbook
legion.zh: 组规手册

legion.en: A 40-page lab handbook arrives, with a procedure for everything, including how to name your files.
legion.zh: 一本 40 页的组规手册发了下来，凡事都有流程，连文件怎么命名都有规定。

legion.en: Read it cover to cover
legion.zh: 从头读到尾

legion.en: Your files now follow the naming rules. Your code feels less fragile already.
legion.zh: 你的文件再也不叫“新建文件夹（3）”了，连代码都显得靠谱了些。

legion.en: Suggest a one-page summary
legion.zh: 建议做个一页纸的摘要

legion.en: {advisor} loves it. Your summary becomes the first page of the handbook.
legion.zh: {advisor}非常喜欢。你的摘要成了手册的第一页。

legion.en: {advisor} adds your summary as a new three-page section.
legion.zh: {advisor}把你的摘要收进了手册，扩成新的一节，足足三页。

legion.en: Skim it and keep working
legion.zh: 扫一眼，继续干活

legion.en: You skip straight to the file names. Later you learn there's a short quiz.
legion.zh: 你直接跳到了文件命名那部分。后来才知道，读完还有小测。

legion.en: A 2 am Email
legion.zh: 凌晨 2 点的邮件

legion.en: A 2:03 am email from {advisor}: "New idea. Let's pivot the whole project." Attached is one blurry photo of a whiteboard.
legion.zh: 凌晨 2:03，{advisor}发来邮件：“有个新想法，整个项目转方向吧。”附件是一张拍糊了的白板照片。

legion.en: Pivot {project}
legion.zh: 给 {project} 转方向

legion.en: You're back at the idea stage, and the whiteboard photo is now your research plan.
legion.zh: 项目退回了想法阶段，那张拍糊的白板照片就是你现在的研究计划。

legion.en: Ask what it would look like
legion.zh: 问问具体要怎么做

legion.en: You find the part of the idea that fits {project}. It adds novelty without throwing anything away.
legion.zh: 你找到了这个想法里和 {project} 契合的部分。新意多了，也不用推倒重来。

legion.en: The more they explain, the bigger it gets.
legion.zh: 导师越讲，这张饼画得越大。

legion.en: Say "Love it! After the deadline."
legion.zh: 说“好主意！截稿后再说。”

legion.en: By the deadline there's a newer idea, and nobody mentions this one again.
legion.zh: 等到截稿，导师早有了更新的想法，这一个再也没人提过。

legion.en: The Field Catches Up
legion.zh: 领域终于跟上了

legion.en: Remember {advisor}'s wild idea from last year, the one everyone politely ignored? A big lab just published it. Now everyone wants to talk about it.
legion.zh: 还记得 {advisor}去年那个异想天开、大家都客气地当没听见的想法吗？一个大实验室刚把它发了出来，现在人人都在聊。

legion.en: Write a quick position paper
legion.zh: 赶一篇立场论文

legion.en: You post it within a week. People start citing it as "the early one".
legion.zh: 一周内你就挂上了 arXiv。大家引用时都说这是“最早的那篇”。

legion.en: Tell the lab "We called it"
legion.zh: 告诉组里“我们早就说过”

legion.en: Lab meeting turns into a small party, and {advisor} brings cake.
legion.zh: 组会变成了一场小派对，{advisor}还带了蛋糕。

legion.en: Point to the pivot you already made
legion.zh: 亮出你早就转好的方向

legion.en: Pivoted
legion.zh: 已转向

legion.en: Your project has been about this for a year. Suddenly you're early, not weird.
legion.zh: 你的项目一年前就在做这个了。你一下子从“奇怪”变成了“超前”。

legion.en: The Hallway One-on-One
legion.zh: 走廊里的单独会面

legion.en: {advisor} has company meetings back to back, so your one-on-one happens while walking between buildings. You have four minutes and one staircase.
legion.zh: {advisor}在公司的会一个接一个，你们的单独会面只能在楼与楼之间边走边谈。你只有四分钟，外加一段楼梯。

legion.en: Lead with the decision you need
legion.zh: 开门见山，只问要拍板的事

legion.en: "Yes, do the second option." You have your answer before the bottom of the stairs.
legion.zh: “行，就用第二个方案。”还没走到楼梯底，你就拿到了答案。

legion.en: You start with background. They reach their meeting before you reach the point.
legion.zh: 你从背景讲起。导师都走到会议室了，你还没讲到重点。

legion.en: Ask for compute instead of advice
legion.zh: 不要建议，只要卡

legion.en: "Sure, use some company GPUs." Your jobs fly through the queue.
legion.zh: “行，用公司的卡吧。”你的任务在队列里一路狂飙。

legion.en: Walk them to their next meeting
legion.zh: 陪导师走去下一个会

legion.en: You end up in the meeting, then in a conversation about a summer internship.
legion.zh: 结果你跟着进了会议室，散会时已经聊到了暑期实习。

legion.en: Two or Three Years
legion.zh: 再干两三年

legion.en: {advisor} mentions retiring "in two or three years". You do the math on your own timeline, and it's close.
legion.zh: {advisor}提到自己“再过两三年”就退休。你掰着手指算了算自己还要读几年，挺悬的。

legion.en: Ask about a co-advisor
legion.zh: 问问能不能加个联合导师

legion.en: {advisor} sets you up with a younger, well-funded co-advisor, just in case.
legion.zh: {advisor}给你介绍了一位更年轻、经费充足的联合导师，以防万一。

legion.en: "Oh, you'll be done long before then!" You hope so.
legion.zh: “噢，你肯定早就毕业了！”但愿如此。

legion.en: Tighten your plan
legion.zh: 压缩计划

legion.en: Your five-year plan becomes a four-year plan. The spreadsheet looks brave.
legion.zh: 五年计划压成了四年。那张表格看上去勇气可嘉。

legion.en: Trust it will work out
legion.zh: 相信船到桥头自然直

legion.en: A labmate mentions {advisor} has said "two or three years" for a decade.
legion.zh: 有位同门告诉你，{advisor}这句“再过两三年”已经说了十年了。

legion.en: Back in the 1990s
legion.zh: 想当年，90 年代

legion.en: {advisor} tells another story about how the field did things in the 1990s. Halfway through, you realize it solves your problem.
legion.zh: {advisor}又讲起 90 年代这个领域是怎么做研究的。讲到一半，你发现这正好能解决你的问题。

legion.en: Ask for the old paper
legion.zh: 要来那篇老论文

legion.en: They find it in a filing cabinet. It has no related work section and is exactly right.
legion.zh: 导师从档案柜里翻出了那篇论文。连相关工作都没有，却正好对路。

legion.en: Try the old method
legion.zh: 试试老方法

legion.en: It works, and it's twenty times cheaper than your current approach.
legion.zh: 居然管用，成本还只有你现在方法的二十分之一。

legion.en: It worked in 1997. It does not work now, but you learn why.
legion.zh: 1997 年它确实管用，现在不行了，好在你搞懂了为什么。

legion.en: Start a lab history hour
legion.zh: 办个组史分享会

legion.en: {advisor} tells one story a month, and attendance is suspiciously high.
legion.zh: {advisor}每月讲一个故事，出席率高得可疑。

legion.en: Just a Quick Prototype
legion.zh: 就做个简单原型

legion.en: {advisor} has a new startup idea. "Could you just build a quick prototype? A weekend, tops." It is not a weekend, tops.
legion.zh: {advisor}又有了新的创业点子。“你能不能先做个简单原型？顶多一个周末。”事实证明，远不止一个周末。

legion.en: Build it
legion.zh: 开干

legion.en: It takes two weeks. It's the cleanest code you've written, and now you know how startups work.
legion.zh: 花了两周。这是你写过最干净的代码，你也终于知道创业公司是怎么运转的了。

legion.en: Build a demo, not a product
legion.zh: 只做 demo，不做产品

legion.en: You have a slick demo in two days, and {advisor} pitches it on Monday.
legion.zh: 两天你就做出一个很炫的 demo，{advisor}周一就拿去路演了。

legion.en: The demo crashes mid-pitch. {advisor} says investors love authenticity.
legion.zh: 路演到一半 demo 翻车了。{advisor}说投资人就爱看真实的。

legion.en: Point them to {labmate}
legion.zh: 推荐 {labmate} 来做

legion.en: {labmate} has wanted exactly this for years and takes it gladly.
legion.zh: {labmate} 想做这个想了好几年，高高兴兴地接了。

legion.en: Item 3 on the Roadmap
legion.zh: 路线图第 3 项

legion.en: A slide from one of {advisor}'s startups shows up in lab meeting. Item 3 on the product roadmap is {project}, your thesis project.
legion.zh: {advisor}旗下某家创业公司的一页 PPT 出现在了组会上。产品路线图第 3 项就是 {project}，你的博士论文项目。

legion.en: Ask for credit, politely
legion.zh: 礼貌地讨个名分

legion.en: "Of course! You're on the advisory board." You're not sure what that means yet.
legion.zh: “没问题！你已经是顾问委员会成员了。”你还没搞懂这具体意味着什么。

legion.en: "It's just a slide." The slide stays.
legion.zh: “就一页 PPT 而已。”那页 PPT 照样留着。

legion.en: Publish it first
legion.zh: 抢先发表

legion.en: You start writing faster, so the paper with your name on it comes out first.
legion.zh: 你加紧赶稿，好让署着你名字的论文先发出来。

legion.en: Take it as a compliment
legion.zh: 就当是夸你

legion.en: At least somebody thinks your research could be a product.
legion.zh: 至少有人觉得你的研究能落地。

legion.en: A Power Analysis for the Pilot
legion.zh: 给预实验做功效分析

legion.en: {advisor} reads your plan for a five-person pilot study and asks for a power analysis. "For the pilot."
legion.zh: {advisor}看完你五个人的预实验计划，要你先做个统计功效分析。“对，预实验也要做。”

legion.en: Run the power analysis
legion.zh: 做功效分析

legion.en: It says the pilot needs 34 people. You negotiate down to 12.
legion.zh: 算出来预实验要 34 个人。你讨价还价，砍到了 12 个。

legion.en: Explain what pilots are for
legion.zh: 解释预实验是干什么用的

legion.en: "Fair. But write down your expected effect size."
legion.zh: “有道理。不过预期效应量还是要写下来。”

legion.en: You receive a twenty-minute lecture on what pilots are for.
legion.zh: 导师反过来给你讲了二十分钟：预实验到底是干什么用的。

legion.en: Borrow {labmate}'s stats script
legion.zh: 借 {labmate} 的统计脚本

legion.en: {labmate}'s script runs the analysis in five minutes.
legion.zh: {labmate} 的脚本五分钟就跑完了分析。

legion.en: Their script is in a language you don't know, so you learn it.
legion.zh: 那份脚本用的是你不会的语言，于是你现学了一门。

legion.en: Ten Seeds and a Test
legion.zh: 十个种子加一次检验

legion.en: Your new method beats the baseline by 1.2 points. {advisor} won't believe it until you run ten seeds and a significance test.
legion.zh: 你的新方法比 baseline 高了 1.2 分。{advisor}不信，除非你跑十个随机种子，再做显著性检验。

legion.en: Run ten seeds
legion.zh: 跑十个种子

legion.en: Seven seeds agree with you. The claim gets smaller, and the paper gets much stronger.
legion.zh: 七个种子站在你这边。结论只好往小了说，论文却扎实多了。

legion.en: Run three seeds and a bootstrap
legion.zh: 跑三个种子加 bootstrap

legion.en: {advisor} accepts it with a rare nod.
legion.zh: {advisor}难得点了头，算是认了。

legion.en: "Three is not ten." You run ten anyway.
legion.zh: “三个不是十个。”最后你还是跑了十个。

legion.en: Report it as a trend, not a win
legion.zh: 只说是趋势，不说赢了

legion.en: You write "suggests" instead of "shows". {advisor} approves of the verb.
legion.zh: 你把“表明”改成了“提示”。{advisor}对这个动词很满意。

legion.en: Show the test you already ran
legion.zh: 亮出早就做好的检验

legion.en: Stats Nerd
legion.zh: 统计控

legion.en: You ran it last week, with ten seeds. {advisor} looks at you like a proud parent.
legion.zh: 你上周就做过了，十个种子一个不少。{advisor}看你的眼神，像在看自家争气的孩子。

legion.en: The Ten Questions
legion.zh: 十个问题

legion.en: Before {project} starts, {advisor} pulls up a list: ten questions every project should answer. "Let's see which ones you can answer today."
legion.zh: {project} 开始之前，{advisor}调出一份清单：每个项目都应该回答的十个问题。“看看今天你能答上几个。”

legion.en: Answer all ten, right now
legion.zh: 现在就把十个都答了

legion.en: Ten for ten. {advisor} is quiet for a moment, then says: "Okay. This one is ready."
legion.zh: 十问全过。{advisor}沉默了片刻：“好，这个项目可以开始了。”

legion.en: You give six good answers and stumble on four, so now you know what to read next.
legion.zh: 六个答得不错，四个卡了壳，于是你知道接下来该读什么了。

legion.en: Answer the ones you know
legion.zh: 先答你会的

legion.en: You answer seven well, and the other three become your reading list.
legion.zh: 你答好了七个，剩下三个成了你的阅读清单。

legion.en: You manage four answers and a lot of "it depends". {advisor} helps you write down the rest.
legion.zh: 你勉强答了四个，外加一堆“看情况”。{advisor}帮你把没答上的记了下来。

legion.en: Ask for a week to prepare
legion.zh: 要一周时间准备

legion.en: You come back with all ten answered, a few of them shakily.
legion.zh: 一周后你带着十个答案回来，有几个答得有点虚。

legion.en: 87 Comments
legion.zh: 87 条批注

legion.en: Your draft of {project} comes back with 87 comments. All of them are polite and right, and several are about a single comma.
legion.zh: {project} 的草稿发回来了，带着 87 条批注。每条都客气又在理，其中好几条都在说同一个逗号。

legion.en: Work through all 87
legion.zh: 87 条逐条处理

legion.en: Once all 87 are resolved, it reads like a much better paper.
legion.zh: 87 条全部改完，论文像是脱胎换骨了。

legion.en: Group them and fix the root causes
legion.zh: 归类，从根源上改

legion.en: Most comments trace back to five problems. You fix those, and 60 comments disappear.
legion.zh: 大部分批注归根结底就是五个问题。这五个一改，60 条批注就没了。

legion.en: You find the patterns but miss one. It brings back 20 comments in round two.
legion.zh: 你找到了规律，但漏了一个。第二轮又冒出来 20 条批注。

legion.en: Sleep on it before reading
legion.zh: 睡一觉再看

legion.en: After a night's sleep the comments read like help, and you fix them calmly.
legion.zh: 睡了一觉，这些批注读起来都像是在帮你了，你心平气和地改完了。

legion.en: Push back on a few
legion.zh: 反驳其中几条

legion.en: You make your case on three. {advisor} agrees on two, and is glad you argued.
legion.zh: 你为三条据理力争。{advisor}同意了两条，还很高兴你敢争。

legion.en: Your argument is weaker than the comment. You both know it, and you both smile.
legion.zh: 你的理由不如那条批注有说服力。你俩都心知肚明，相视一笑。

legion.en: Not Borderline
legion.zh: 不止 borderline

legion.en: {advisor} reads the draft of {project} and says: "We could submit this. But it's a borderline paper, and you can do better than borderline."
legion.zh: {advisor}读完 {project} 的草稿说：“能投是能投。但这是篇 borderline 的论文，你能做得比 borderline 更好。”

legion.en: Wait for the next cycle
legion.zh: 等下一轮截稿

legion.en: You let this deadline go. The next version has the experiment reviewers would have asked for.
legion.zh: 你决定不赶这次截稿。下一版补上了审稿人肯定会要的那个实验。

legion.en: Ask what would make it strong
legion.zh: 问问怎样才能更扎实

legion.en: They name one experiment. It takes four days, and it fits before the deadline.
legion.zh: 导师点出了一个实验。要做四天，截稿前来得及。

legion.en: The honest answer is a month of work. You plan it for the next cycle.
legion.zh: 说实话，还得再干一个月。你把它排到了下一轮截稿。

legion.en: Submit anyway
legion.zh: 照投不误

legion.en: {advisor} still helps you polish it, and wishes you luck.
legion.zh: {advisor}还是帮你打磨了一遍，祝你好运。

legion.en: Close the Laptop
legion.zh: 合上电脑

legion.en: It's Saturday, and {advisor} spots you in the lab again. "Close the laptop. The paper will still be here on Monday, and so will I."
legion.zh: 周六，{advisor}又在实验室撞见了你。“合上电脑吧。论文周一还在，我也在。”

legion.en: Close the laptop
legion.zh: 合上电脑

legion.en: You sleep and spend Sunday outside. On Monday you fix in an hour what took all of Friday.
legion.zh: 你睡了个饱觉，周日出门晒了一天太阳。周五卡了一整天的问题，周一只用一小时就搞定了。

legion.en: Get bubble tea together first
legion.zh: 先一起去喝杯奶茶

legion.en: You share a drink and talk about anything but work. Then you go home.
legion.zh: 你们喝着奶茶天南地北地聊，就是不聊工作。喝完你就回家了。

legion.en: Finish just this one section
legion.zh: 写完这一节就走

legion.en: One section becomes three, and you get home at 9 pm, a little sheepish.
legion.zh: 一节写成了三节，晚上 9 点你才到家，有点心虚。

legion.en: Your Direction, Not Mine
legion.zh: 是你的方向，不是我的

legion.en: You pitch an idea that competes with {advisor}'s plan for {project}. They think for a long moment. "Let's do yours. You care about it more, and that matters."
legion.zh: 你提了一个想法，和 {advisor}对 {project} 的规划正好冲突。导师想了好一会儿：“做你的吧。你更在乎它，这一点很重要。”

legion.en: Go with your idea
legion.zh: 做你自己的想法

legion.en: You leave the meeting already writing. It feels like your project now.
legion.zh: 还没走出会议室，你就已经动笔了。这回它真成了你自己的项目。

legion.en: Do theirs, it's safer
legion.zh: 做导师的，更稳妥

legion.en: Theirs is a fine project. You still think about yours in the shower.
legion.zh: 导师那个项目也不错。可你洗澡时还在想自己那个。

legion.en: Merge the two ideas
legion.zh: 把两个想法合起来

legion.en: The merged idea is better than both. {advisor} says so first.
legion.zh: 合起来的想法比两个都好，而且是 {advisor}先说出来的。

legion.en: The merged idea has two heads and no body. You go back to yours.
legion.zh: 合出来的想法成了个四不像。你还是回到了自己那个。

legion.en: Meeting Canceled: Rest
legion.zh: 会议取消：休息

legion.en: You haven't taken a day off in a month. {advisor} cancels your Monday meeting: "Nothing is due. Take the day off. That's the whole agenda."
legion.zh: 你已经一个月没休过一天了。{advisor}取消了你们周一的会：“这周没东西要交。休息一天吧，这就是全部议程。”

legion.en: Take the day off
legion.zh: 休一天

legion.en: You sleep in and take a long walk. Tuesday goes noticeably better.
legion.zh: 你睡到自然醒，又散了很久的步。周二明显顺多了。

legion.en: Keep it, but make it ten minutes
legion.zh: 照开，但只开十分钟

legion.en: You ask your one question and head home. {advisor} approves of the compromise.
legion.zh: 你问完那一个问题就回家了。{advisor}觉得这个折中挺好。

legion.en: Use the slot to catch up
legion.zh: 趁机补进度

legion.en: Your Monday is productive. Your Tuesday is not.
legion.zh: 周一效率很高，周二就不行了。

legion.en: Read the Same Day
legion.zh: 当天就看完

legion.en: You send {advisor} your draft at 2 pm, expecting comments next week. At 6 pm it's back, read end to end, with a summary on page 1.
legion.zh: 下午 2 点你把草稿发给 {advisor}，以为下周才会有意见。结果晚上 6 点就发回来了：从头到尾都看过，第 1 页还附了总结。

legion.en: Turn the comments around fast
legion.zh: 趁热赶紧改

legion.en: You get through two rounds in one week, and the draft starts to look like a paper.
legion.zh: 你一周就过了两轮，草稿开始有点论文的样子了。

legion.en: Read them twice before editing
legion.zh: 读两遍再改

legion.en: On the second read you see the pattern, and fix the cause instead of the symptoms.
legion.zh: 读第二遍时你看出了规律，改的是病根而不是症状。

legion.en: Ask to talk through the big ones
legion.zh: 约个电话聊聊大问题

legion.en: Fifteen minutes on a call saves three rounds of email.
legion.zh: 打十五分钟电话，省掉了三轮邮件。

legion.en: Who Cares?
legion.zh: 谁会在乎？

legion.en: {advisor} listens to your pitch for {project}, then asks, kindly: "Who cares?" Then they wait, for as long as it takes.
legion.zh: {advisor}听你讲完 {project}，温和地问：“谁会在乎这个？”然后就静静地等着，等多久都行。

legion.en: Name the people who would use it
legion.zh: 说出谁会用它

legion.en: You name three groups and what changes for each. {advisor} smiles: "Write that down first."
legion.zh: 你说出了三类人，还讲清了每类人会因此有什么变化。{advisor}笑了：“先把这个写下来。”

legion.en: You say "the community". {advisor} keeps waiting, kindly.
legion.zh: 你说“整个领域”。{advisor}还在温和地等着。

legion.en: Admit you don't know yet
legion.zh: 承认你还不知道

legion.en: "Good. Go find out." You spend two days talking to people who might care.
legion.zh: “很好，那就去弄清楚。”你花了两天，去找可能在乎的人聊了聊。

legion.en: Answer with the benchmark gain
legion.zh: 拿刷榜涨的分来回答

legion.en: "That's who cares about the number. Who cares about the problem?"
legion.zh: “那是在乎这个数字的人。谁在乎这个问题本身？”

legion.en: Dinner Is On Me
legion.zh: 这顿我请

legion.en: {paper} is accepted at {venue}. {advisor} books a table for the whole lab: "Dinner is on me. Order dessert."
legion.zh: {paper} 中了 {venue}。{advisor}给全组订了一桌：“这顿我请，甜点一定要点。”

legion.en: Order dessert, as instructed
legion.zh: 遵命点甜点

legion.en: Eleven people share three desserts, and nobody leaves early.
legion.zh: 十一个人分三份甜点，没有一个人提前走。

legion.en: Give a short toast
legion.zh: 举杯说两句

legion.en: You thank everyone who ever read a draft. The lab cheers, a little too loudly.
legion.zh: 你感谢了每一个读过草稿的人。全组欢呼，嗓门大得有点过了头。

legion.en: The toast runs long, but the lab claps anyway.
legion.zh: 两句变成了二十句，但大家还是鼓了掌。

legion.en: Bring {mentee} along
legion.zh: 带上 {mentee}

legion.en: {mentee} has never been to a lab dinner. They talk about it for weeks.
legion.zh: {mentee} 从没参加过组里的聚餐，之后念叨了好几周。

legion.en: One Circled Word
legion.zh: 圈出来的一个词

legion.en: Your draft comes back with a single comment: a circled orphan word at the end of the abstract.
legion.zh: 你的草稿发回来了，只有一条批注：圈出了摘要末尾单独占一行的那个词。

legion.en: Fix the orphan
legion.zh: 把孤词挪上去

legion.en: One word moves up a line. The abstract looks finished.
legion.zh: 那个词挪上了一行，摘要终于像是写完了。

legion.en: Tighten the whole abstract
legion.zh: 精简整段摘要

legion.en: To move one word, you rewrite four sentences. The abstract is better for it.
legion.zh: 为了挪一个词，你重写了四句话，摘要倒是因此更好了。

legion.en: Ask if that's the only comment
legion.zh: 问问是不是只有这一条

legion.en: It is. The rest of the draft is fine. You read that sentence three times.
legion.zh: “是的，其他部分都没问题。”这句话你读了三遍。

legion.en: Title Case or Sentence Case
legion.zh: Title Case 还是 Sentence case

legion.en: Half your section headings are in Title Case and half are in Sentence case. {advisor} would like them consistent before the meeting.
legion.zh: 你的小节标题一半是 Title Case，一半是 Sentence case。{advisor}希望你开会前统一一下。

legion.en: Fix them by hand
legion.zh: 手动改

legion.en: Fixing fourteen headings takes longer than it should.
legion.zh: 改十四个标题，花的时间比想象中长。

legion.en: Write a macro for it
legion.zh: 写个宏来改

legion.en: It fixes every heading in one go, and now lives in the lab template.
legion.zh: 宏一次就改好了所有标题，如今还住进了组里的模板。

legion.en: The macro turns every heading into ALL CAPS. You fix them by hand.
legion.zh: 宏把所有标题都变成了全大写。你只好手动改。

legion.en: Ask which case they prefer
legion.zh: 问导师喜欢哪种

legion.en: "Pick one, and use it everywhere." You pick sentence case and write it down.
legion.zh: “选一种，全文统一。”你选了 Sentence case，还专门记了下来。

legion.en: Round Four
legion.zh: 第四轮

legion.en: The axis labels in Figure 2 are 6 pt, so the figure goes back for its fourth round.
legion.zh: 图 2 的坐标轴标签只有 6 pt，于是这张图第四次被打了回来。

legion.en: Remake it at a readable size
legion.zh: 换个看得清的字号重做

legion.en: Figure 2 is now legible from across the room. {advisor} replies: "Better."
legion.zh: 现在隔着整个房间都能看清图 2 了。{advisor}回复：“好多了。”

legion.en: Fix every figure while you're there
legion.zh: 顺手把所有图都改了

legion.en: Every figure now uses the same fonts and colors, and the paper suddenly looks professional.
legion.zh: 所有图统一了字体和配色，论文一下子显得专业了。

legion.en: Ask for the font rules in writing
legion.zh: 请导师把字体规范写下来

legion.en: You get a three-line style guide and tape it above your monitor.
legion.zh: 你拿到一份只有三行的格式规范，贴在了显示器上方。

legion.en: One Question
legion.zh: 一个问题

legion.en: At your practice talk, your advisor asks one quiet question from the back, and the whole argument wobbles.
legion.zh: 试讲时，导师在后排轻轻问了一个问题，整个论证就站不稳了。

legion.en: Answer it on the spot
legion.zh: 当场回答

legion.en: You find the answer mid-sentence. {advisor} nods: "Put that on a slide."
legion.zh: 话说到一半，你想到了答案。{advisor}点点头：“把这个加进 PPT。”

legion.en: You don't have an answer yet, but now you know before the real talk.
legion.zh: 你暂时还答不上来，但好在是在正式报告之前发现的。

legion.en: Rebuild the middle of the talk
legion.zh: 重做报告中间那段

legion.en: Two days later the argument holds, and that question has its own slide.
legion.zh: 两天后，论证终于圆上了，那个问题还单独占了一页 PPT。

legion.en: Add a backup slide
legion.zh: 加一页备用 PPT

legion.en: You add one slide in case anyone asks, and hope nobody does.
legion.zh: 你加了一页以防万一，然后祈祷没人问到。

legion.en: Saw It Coming
legion.zh: 未卜先知

legion.en: Reviews for {paper} are in. Reviewer 2 asks exactly the question {advisor} asked before you submitted, and you already fixed it.
legion.zh: {paper} 的审稿意见出来了。2 号审稿人问的，正是投稿前 {advisor}问过的那个问题，而你早就改好了。

legion.en: Point to the section, calmly
legion.zh: 淡定地指出对应章节

legion.en: Your reply is one sentence and a section number. It is deeply satisfying.
legion.zh: 你的回复只有一句话外加一个章节号。爽极了。

legion.en: Forward the review to {advisor}
legion.zh: 把审稿意见转给 {advisor}

legion.en: You write one word: "Wow." The reply: "Good thing you fixed it. Now write the rebuttal."
legion.zh: 你只附了一个字：“哇。”导师回：“幸好提前改了。去写 rebuttal 吧。”

legion.en: You send a draft at 11:50 pm. At 12:07 am, 30 comments arrive, ending with: "No need to reply until Monday."
legion.zh: 你晚上 11:50 发出一份草稿。凌晨 0:07，30 条批注就到了，末尾还有一句：“周一前不用回。”

legion.en: Believe them and go to bed
legion.zh: 信导师的，去睡觉

legion.en: On Monday you read all 30 with a clear head. They take one morning.
legion.zh: 周一你头脑清醒地过完了 30 条，一个上午就搞定了。

legion.en: Fix the easy ones now
legion.zh: 先把简单的改了

legion.en: You fix six before 1 am. The other 24 are still there on Monday, as promised.
legion.zh: 凌晨 1 点前你改了六条。剩下的 24 条果然等到了周一，一条没少。

legion.en: The Midnight Thread
legion.zh: 午夜邮件串

legion.en: At 12:30 am you send {advisor} a half-formed idea. They reply in four minutes. By 2 am the thread is 31 messages long, and it's your best idea of the year.
legion.zh: 凌晨 0:30，你把一个还没成形的想法发给了 {advisor}。四分钟后导师就回了。到 2 点，邮件已经来回了 31 封，这成了你今年最好的想法。

legion.en: Keep the thread going
legion.zh: 继续聊下去

legion.en: By 3 am you have a title and a first figure, sketched in an email.
legion.zh: 到凌晨 3 点，标题有了，第一张图的草稿也在邮件里画好了。

legion.en: Save it and sleep
legion.zh: 先存着，去睡觉

legion.en: {advisor}'s last message: "Sleep. This will still be good on Monday." It is.
legion.zh: {advisor}的最后一条消息：“去睡吧。到周一它还是个好想法。”果然还是。

legion.en: Zoom or Bubble Tea
legion.zh: Zoom 还是奶茶

legion.en: You're tired, and you could join lab meeting on Zoom from your couch. But there's bubble tea in the room.
legion.zh: 你很累，本可以窝在沙发上用 Zoom 参加组会。但会议室里有奶茶。

legion.en: Go in for the bubble tea
legion.zh: 为了奶茶去现场

legion.en: You arrive yawning. A cup with your name on it is already waiting.
legion.zh: 你打着哈欠到了。一杯写着你名字的奶茶已经在等你了。

legion.en: Join on Zoom, camera off
legion.zh: 上 Zoom，关摄像头

legion.en: You hear someone say "this one's {player}'s", followed by the sound of a straw.
legion.zh: 你听见有人说“这杯是 {player} 的”，接着是吸管戳进去的声音。

legion.en: Less Ice, Half Sugar
legion.zh: 少冰，半糖

legion.en: {advisor} hands you a bubble tea before you can order: "Less ice, half sugar, right?"
legion.zh: 你还没开口点单，{advisor}就递给你一杯奶茶：“少冰半糖，对吧？”

legion.en: Ask "How did you remember?"
legion.zh: 问“怎么记得这么清楚？”

legion.en: "You've ordered it eleven times." It turns out they remember everyone's.
legion.zh: “你点过十一次了。”原来导师记得每个人的口味。

legion.en: Admit you switched to no sugar
legion.zh: 坦白你改喝无糖了

legion.en: "Noted." Next week it's no sugar, and it is never wrong again.
legion.zh: “记住了。”下周递来的就是无糖，之后再没错过。

legion.en: Order something wild to test them
legion.zh: 点个奇葩的考考导师

legion.en: Taro, extra pudding, 30% sugar. Two weeks later they order it for you without asking.
legion.zh: 香芋加双份布丁，三分糖。两周后，导师没问一句就帮你点了这杯。

legion.en: Fourteen Sugar Levels
legion.zh: 十四种甜度

legion.en: You're sent to pick up the lab-meeting order: 14 drinks at 14 different sugar levels, plus one person who "doesn't mind".
legion.zh: 你被派去取组会的饮料：14 杯，14 种不同的甜度，外加一位说“随便”的。

legion.en: Build a quick order form
legion.zh: 快速做个点单表

legion.en: Every drink is right. Your form is now official lab infrastructure.
legion.zh: 一杯都没拿错。你的表单从此成了组里的正式基础设施。

legion.en: The form works perfectly. The shop's printer does not.
legion.zh: 表单一点问题没有，店里的打印机却罢工了。

legion.en: Write it all on a receipt
legion.zh: 全记在一张小票上

legion.en: Two drinks get swapped. Nobody can taste the difference between 25% and 30% anyway.
legion.zh: 有两杯拿错了。反正谁也尝不出 25% 和 30% 糖的区别。

legion.en: Bring {labmate} as backup
legion.zh: 带上 {labmate} 当帮手

legion.en: You carry seven drinks each and chat the whole way back.
legion.zh: 你们一人提七杯，一路聊着回来。

legion.en: Zero Orphans
legion.zh: 零孤词

legion.en: Camera-ready time for {paper}. One last pass for orphan words before {advisor} sees it.
legion.zh: {paper} 要交终稿了。趁 {advisor}还没看，最后再查一遍孤词。

legion.en: Do one last orphan sweep
legion.zh: 最后排查一遍孤词

legion.en: Zero orphan words. {advisor}'s reply is a single word: "Beautiful."
legion.zh: 零孤词。{advisor}的回复只有两个字：“漂亮。”

legion.en: One orphan survives, on page 7. {advisor} circles it, kindly.
legion.zh: 有个孤词躲过了排查，藏在第 7 页。{advisor}温和地把它圈了出来。

legion.en: Rewrite until every line fits
legion.zh: 改到每一行都排得刚好

legion.en: After two days of tiny edits there are zero orphans, and the reply is "Beautiful."
legion.zh: 抠了两天细节，孤词终于清零，导师回了两个字：“漂亮。”

legion.en: Send it as is
legion.zh: 直接发

legion.en: {advisor} fixes two orphans without mentioning it. You notice anyway.
legion.zh: {advisor}一声没吭，顺手改掉了两个孤词。但你还是发现了。

legion.en: Easier Than Lab Meeting
legion.zh: 比组会轻松

legion.en: Defense day. {advisor} catches you outside the room: "Nothing they ask today will be harder than lab meeting."
legion.zh: 答辩当天，{advisor}在门口拦住你：“今天他们问的问题，没有一个会比组会上的难。”

legion.en: Remember every lab meeting
legion.zh: 回想每一次组会

legion.en: Five years of hard questions come back to you at once. Your heart rate drops.
legion.zh: 五年来的刁钻问题一下子全涌了回来。你的心跳反而慢了下来。

legion.en: Skim your list of hard questions
legion.zh: 翻翻你的难题清单

legion.en: You kept a list of every tough lab-meeting question. Most of today's are on it.
legion.zh: 组会上每个刁钻问题你都记在了清单上。今天被问到的，大多都在里面。

legion.en: Three Time Zones
legion.zh: 三个时区

legion.en: This week {advisor} answered your emails from three time zones, one of them over an ocean. Each reply is one line long.
legion.zh: 这周 {advisor}从三个时区给你回了邮件，其中一封是在大洋上空回的。每封都只有一行。

legion.en: Batch everything into one email
legion.zh: 把问题攒成一封邮件

legion.en: You send five yes-or-no questions, and five answers come back from an airport lounge.
legion.zh: 你发了五个是非题，五个答案从机场贵宾厅发了回来。

legion.en: They answer question 1 in detail. Questions 2 to 5 get "let's discuss".
legion.zh: 导师详细回答了第 1 题。第 2 到 5 题统一回复：“再议。”

legion.en: Grab a call in their morning
legion.zh: 趁导师早上约个电话

legion.en: Their morning is your 5:30 am. You're half asleep, but the call is useful.
legion.zh: 导师那边的早上，是你这边的凌晨 5:30。你半睡半醒，但电话打得很值。

legion.en: Ask {senior} instead
legion.zh: 改问 {senior}

legion.en: {senior} has decoded one-line replies for four years. You get a real answer, plus a translation guide.
legion.zh: {senior} 破译导师的一行回复已经四年了。你拿到了真正的答案，外加一份“导师语”翻译指南。

legion.en: Thirty Seconds at Your Poster
legion.zh: 海报前的三十秒

legion.en: For the first time this conference, {advisor} appears at your poster for {paper}, with a very famous friend in tow. "You have thirty seconds. Go."
legion.zh: 这次开会，{advisor}第一次在你 {paper} 的海报前露面，还带着一位大牛朋友。“给你三十秒，开始。”

legion.en: Give the 30-second pitch
legion.zh: 做 30 秒电梯演讲

legion.en: You finish at second 29. The famous friend asks for your email, then for your paper.
legion.zh: 你在第 29 秒讲完。那位大牛先要了你的邮箱，又要了论文链接。

legion.en: You're still on the motivation when they're pulled away to a reception.
legion.zh: 你还在讲研究动机，他们就被拉去参加招待会了。

legion.en: Ask the friend about their work
legion.zh: 问问大牛在做什么

legion.en: They talk for ten minutes while {advisor} waves from across the hall. You learn a lot, and they remember you.
legion.zh: 对方聊了十分钟，{advisor}在大厅另一头朝你挥手。你学到了很多，对方也记住了你。

legion.en: Hand them each a printout
legion.zh: 给两人各递一份打印版

legion.en: Two printouts vanish into two bags. Months later, one of them turns up as a citation.
legion.zh: 两份打印版各自消失在两个包里。几个月后，其中一份变成了一条引用。

legion.en: To Understand How You Work
legion.zh: “只是想了解一下”

legion.en: {advisor} asks for the full edit history of your draft of {project}, "just to understand how you work". It shows every 2 am session, and every hour of nothing.
legion.zh: {advisor}要你把 {project} 草稿的完整编辑历史发过去，“只是想了解一下你的工作方式”。上面记着每一次凌晨 2 点的奋战，也记着每一个摸鱼的小时。

legion.en: Share all of it
legion.zh: 全部发过去

legion.en: They study it closely, then suggest you write in the mornings. Annoyingly, it helps.
legion.zh: 导师仔细研究了一番，建议你早上写作。气人的是，确实有用。

legion.en: Offer a weekly summary instead
legion.zh: 改成每周发个总结

legion.en: "Fine. Fridays." Your 2 am sessions stay between you and the draft.
legion.zh: “行吧，每周五发。”你凌晨 2 点的奋战，只有你和草稿知道。

legion.en: They'd like the summary and the history. Now you write about your writing every Friday.
legion.zh: 导师总结也要，编辑历史也要。于是你每周五都得写一篇“关于写作的写作”。

legion.en: Draft in a private file first
legion.zh: 先在私人文件里写

legion.en: Your real writing moves to a file called notes_old.tex. {advisor} notices the history has gone very quiet.
legion.zh: 你真正的写作都转移到了一个叫 notes_old.tex 的文件里。{advisor}发现编辑历史突然安静得出奇。

legion.en: A Comment on Every Sentence
legion.zh: 每句都有批注

legion.en: Your draft of {project} comes back with a comment on every sentence. The references have comments too. Reference 14 has three.
legion.zh: 你的 {project} 草稿发回来了，每句话都有批注。参考文献也没能幸免，第 14 条有三条。

legion.en: Address every single one
legion.zh: 每一条都处理

legion.en: Four days and 212 replies later, the draft is much better, and {advisor} is pleased.
legion.zh: 四天里你回复了 212 条，草稿好了很多，{advisor}很满意。

legion.en: Fix what matters, resolve the rest
legion.zh: 改重要的，其余点“已解决”

legion.en: You fix forty comments and resolve the rest. {advisor} reopens only two.
legion.zh: 你改了四十条，其余的都点了“已解决”。{advisor}只重新打开了两条。

legion.en: {advisor} reopens every resolved comment, each with a new comment attached.
legion.zh: {advisor}把每条“已解决”的批注都重新打开了，每条还附上一条新批注。

legion.en: Go through them together
legion.zh: 一起逐条过

legion.en: You spend three hours in their office. Half the comments turn out to mean "ok".
legion.zh: 你在导师办公室坐了三个小时。结果一半的批注，意思就是“行”。

legion.en: The Paper the Case Needs
legion.zh: 终身教职就差这一篇

legion.en: {advisor}'s tenure case goes out this year, and they've done the math: {project} is the paper the case needs. "No pressure. Well. Some pressure."
legion.zh: {advisor}今年评终身教职，非升即走。导师算过账了：{project} 就是材料里缺的那篇。“没压力。好吧，有点压力。”

legion.en: Go all in on {project}
legion.zh: 全力投入 {project}

legion.en: You work nights and weekends and make a lot of progress. {advisor} starts bringing you coffee without being asked.
legion.zh: 你熬夜加周末连轴转，进展很大。{advisor}开始主动给你带咖啡了。

legion.en: Promise strong, not fast
legion.zh: 承诺做扎实，不求快

legion.en: "You're right. A strong paper helps the case more than a quick one."
legion.zh: “你说得对。评终身教职，一篇扎实的论文比一篇赶出来的更管用。”

legion.en: They agree, then check in on {project} every morning at 9.
legion.zh: 导师嘴上同意了，之后每天早上 9 点都来问 {project} 的进展。

legion.en: Bring {labmate} onto the project
legion.zh: 拉 {labmate} 加入项目

legion.en: Two people work twice as fast, and the paper gets a second name. {advisor} likes the plan.
legion.zh: 两个人干活快了一倍，论文也多了一个作者。{advisor}很喜欢这个安排。

legion.en: Four New Projects
legion.zh: 四个新项目

legion.en: {advisor} kicks off four new projects this semester. You open the planning doc. Your name is on all four, in bold.
legion.zh: {advisor}这学期一口气开了四个新项目。你打开规划文档一看，四个项目上都有你的名字，还加粗了。

legion.en: Stay on all four
legion.zh: 四个全接

legion.en: You now have four literatures to read and four meetings a week. You learn a lot, very quickly.
legion.zh: 现在你要读四个方向的文献，每周开四个会。你学到了很多，而且学得飞快。

legion.en: Pick the one nearest your thesis
legion.zh: 只留离博士论文最近的那个

legion.en: "Smart. Focus." Your name comes off three projects, and your week comes back.
legion.zh: “聪明，就该专注。”你的名字从三个项目上撤了下来，时间也回来了。

legion.en: You negotiate down to two. Negotiating, it turns out, is a skill you're still building.
legion.zh: 你只谈到了两个。看来谈判这门手艺，你还得再练练。

legion.en: Hand one to {mentee}, with support
legion.zh: 分一个给 {mentee}，带着做

legion.en: {mentee} is thrilled. You spend an hour a week guiding them, and they do the rest.
legion.zh: {mentee} 高兴坏了。你每周花一小时指导，剩下的都交给对方。

legion.en: Same Deadline, Two Papers
legion.zh: 同一个截稿，两篇论文

legion.en: {advisor} is submitting their own paper to the same deadline as {project}. "Could you run a few experiments on mine too? You're so fast."
legion.zh: {advisor}自己也有篇论文，要和 {project} 赶同一个截稿。“能顺便帮我那篇也跑几个实验吗？你手快。”

legion.en: Help with both papers
legion.zh: 两篇一起扛

legion.en: Both papers get submitted, and you sleep through most of the following weekend.
legion.zh: 两篇都投出去了。接下来的周末，你睡得昏天黑地。

legion.en: Trade experiments for writing help
legion.zh: 用跑实验换写作指导

legion.en: They rewrite your introduction in one evening, and it's much better.
legion.zh: 导师一个晚上就重写了你的引言，好了很多。

legion.en: You run their experiments. Their notes on your intro arrive an hour after the deadline.
legion.zh: 你跑完了导师的实验。导师对你引言的修改意见，截稿一小时后才到。

legion.en: Protect your own paper
legion.zh: 先顾好自己的论文

legion.en: You say no, kindly, and give your own paper your full attention. {advisor} pulls an all-nighter and is a little cool all week.
legion.zh: 你客气地拒绝了，把全部精力放在自己的论文上。{advisor}熬了个通宵，一整周对你都有点冷淡。

legion.en: The Sign-Up Sheet
legion.zh: GPU 预约表

legion.en: The lab shares one GPU, booked through a sheet taped to the server room door. Your three-day run for {project} would take every slot until Thursday.
legion.zh: 组里只有一块 GPU，全靠贴在机房门上的预约表排队。你给 {project} 跑的三天实验，会把到周四的时段全占满。

legion.en: Book the whole week
legion.zh: 一口气约满一周

legion.en: Your run finishes. Next to your name on the sheet, someone has drawn a very small frowning face.
legion.zh: 实验跑完了。预约表上你的名字旁边，有人画了一个小小的皱眉表情。

legion.en: Take the night slots nobody wants
legion.zh: 专挑没人要的夜间时段

legion.en: Midnight to 6 am, five nights running. The run finishes, and you learn every sound the server makes.
legion.zh: 午夜到早上 6 点，连续五晚。实验跑完了，服务器发出的每一种声音你都认得了。

legion.en: Shrink the experiment to fit
legion.zh: 缩小实验规模

legion.en: With a smaller model and a smarter sample, it runs in one afternoon and still answers your question.
legion.zh: 换了个小模型，样本也挑得更聪明，一个下午就跑完了，照样回答了你的问题。

legion.en: The small run tells you nothing, so you add your name to the bottom of the sheet.
legion.zh: 小规模实验什么也说明不了，你只好在预约表最下面写上自己的名字。

legion.en: The Warmest Letter
legion.zh: 最暖的推荐信

legion.en: {advisor} sends you a copy of the recommendation letter they wrote for you. It's two pages long and specific about everything. You read it twice.
