legion.zh: {advisor}把替你写的推荐信也发了你一份。整整两页，每一点都写得很具体。你读了两遍。

legion.en: Thank them in person
legion.zh: 当面道谢

legion.en: They wave it off: "I only wrote down what's true." You both pretend not to be moved.
legion.zh: 导师摆摆手：“我只是照实写。”你俩都假装没被感动。

legion.en: Use it for three more applications
legion.zh: 再拿去投三份申请

legion.en: You spend a long evening on three sets of forms. Each one goes out with a great letter behind it.
legion.zh: 你花了一整晚填完三套表格。每份申请背后，都有那封推荐信撑腰。

legion.en: Save it for the hard weeks
legion.zh: 留着难熬的时候看

legion.en: You put it in a folder called "read this". You'll open it more often than you expect.
legion.zh: 你把它放进一个叫“看这个”的文件夹。之后你打开它的次数，会比预想的多。

legion.en: How Does This Fit Aim 2?
legion.zh: 这和目标 2 有什么关系？

legion.en: Your meeting opens the way every meeting opens: "Before we start, how does this fit Aim 2?" Today, honestly, {project} doesn't.
legion.zh: 你们的会照例这样开场：“开始之前，这跟目标 2 有什么关系？”说实话，今天的 {project} 跟它八竿子打不着。

legion.en: Reframe {project} around Aim 2
legion.zh: 按目标 2 重新包装 {project}

legion.en: Two slides later, your project fits Aim 2 perfectly. It is also slightly less interesting.
legion.zh: 改了两页 PPT，你的项目就完美契合了目标 2，只是也没那么有意思了。

legion.en: Pitch it as a future Aim 4
legion.zh: 包装成未来的目标 4

legion.en: "Aim 4. For the renewal. I like it." Your project is now in next year's grant.
legion.zh: “目标 4，留着续期用。不错。”你的项目就这样写进了明年的基金申请。

legion.en: There is no Aim 4. There are three aims, and by the end of the meeting you know all of them by heart.
legion.zh: 根本没有目标 4。一共就三个目标，散会时你已经倒背如流了。

legion.en: Keep going and hope it passes
legion.zh: 继续做，希望能混过去

legion.en: It doesn't pass. The same question opens next week's meeting, and the one after that.
legion.zh: 没混过去。下周的会还是以这个问题开场，下下周也是。

legion.en: Renewal Week
legion.zh: 基金续期周

legion.en: Grant renewal week. The whole lab pauses research to write progress summaries. The shared document is 61 pages long and has a table of contents for its table of contents.
legion.zh: 基金续期周到了，全组暂停研究，集体写进展总结。共享文档足足 61 页，连目录都有自己的目录。

legion.en: Write your summary carefully
legion.zh: 认真写自己那部分

legion.en: You write two pages on your year. On paper, it was a better year than it felt.
legion.zh: 你把这一年写成了两页。落到纸面上一看，这一年其实比感觉中要好。

legion.en: Volunteer to edit the whole thing
legion.zh: 主动请缨统稿

legion.en: Sixty-one pages become forty. {advisor} calls it the cleanest renewal in years, and remembers who did it.
legion.zh: 61 页砍到了 40 页。{advisor}说这是这些年最清爽的一份续期材料，也记住了是谁统的稿。

legion.en: Write yours in an hour
legion.zh: 一小时写完自己那部分

legion.en: You write one tight page before lunch and are back to research by 1 pm.
legion.zh: 午饭前你写完一页紧凑的总结，下午 1 点就回去做研究了。

legion.en: It comes back with one note: "More on Aim 2, please." The hour becomes two days.
legion.zh: 发回来时附了一句：“目标 2 请多写一点。”一小时变成了两天。

legion.en: "thoughts?"
legion.zh: “怎么看？”

legion.en: Over the weekend, {advisor} sends you 14 papers, one email each. Every subject line says "thoughts?". Your meeting is Monday at 10.
legion.zh: 周末，{advisor}给你连发了 14 封邮件，一封一篇论文，主题全是“怎么看？”而你们周一上午 10 点就要开会。

legion.en: Read all 14 by Monday
legion.zh: 周一前读完 14 篇

legion.en: You arrive with notes on every paper. {advisor} has moved on to a 15th, but is clearly impressed.
legion.zh: 你带着 14 篇的笔记去开会。{advisor}已经转头去看第 15 篇了，不过显然对你刮目相看。

legion.en: Skim for the common thread
legion.zh: 快速扫读，找共同点

legion.en: It's one idea in 14 disguises. You name it in one sentence, and {advisor} lights up.
legion.zh: 原来是一个想法换了 14 层马甲。你用一句话把它点了出来，{advisor}眼睛一亮。

legion.en: You find a common thread. It isn't the one they meant.
legion.zh: 你倒是找到了一个共同点，只不过不是导师想的那个。

legion.en: Read two properly, ask about the rest
legion.zh: 精读两篇，其余的当面问

legion.en: "Oh, those were just for fun." Luckily, your two were the important ones.
legion.zh: “哦，那些就是随便看看的。”幸好你读的那两篇正是重要的。

legion.en: Best Paper, Other Lab
legion.zh: 最佳论文，别人家的

legion.en: A best paper award goes to another lab, for the idea {advisor} emailed you at 2 am eight months ago. You still have the email. It was three lines long.
legion.zh: 最佳论文奖颁给了别的实验室，获奖的想法正是八个月前 {advisor}凌晨 2 点发给你的那个。那封邮件你还留着，就三行字。

legion.en: Forward the email to {advisor}
legion.zh: 把那封邮件转给 {advisor}

legion.en: "Ha! Told you." They're delighted, and their next idea arrives at 2 am.
legion.zh: “哈！我就说吧。”导师很开心，下一个想法凌晨 2 点准时到达。

legion.en: Build on their result, fast
legion.zh: 趁热在获奖工作上接着做

legion.en: You spot the follow-up the winners missed. Your short paper is online within two weeks, and people read it.
legion.zh: 你发现了获奖者漏掉的后续方向。两周内你就把短论文挂了出来，还真有人读。

legion.en: Eleven other labs had the same follow-up idea that week.
legion.zh: 那一周，还有十一个实验室跟你撞了车。

legion.en: Start a folder for 2 am ideas
legion.zh: 建个“凌晨 2 点想法”文件夹

legion.en: Every late-night idea now gets a real read the next morning. Most are wild, but one might not be.
legion.zh: 从此每个深夜想法，第二天早上你都会认真读一遍。大多数很离谱，但万一有一个靠谱呢。

legion.en: Unlimited Compute, Limited Lawyers
legion.zh: 算力无限，律师有限

legion.en: Thanks to {advisor}'s company, your compute for {project} was unlimited. Now every result needs legal review before you can submit. Legal estimates six to eight weeks.
legion.zh: 多亏 {advisor}的公司，你做 {project} 的算力是无限的。可现在每个结果投稿前都得过法务审核，法务说要六到八周。

legion.en: Submit it for review and wait
legion.zh: 提交审核，慢慢等

legion.en: Legal approves, with one change: "outperforms" becomes "compares favorably to", everywhere.
legion.zh: 法务批准了，只改了一处：全文的“优于”都改成了“与之相比颇具竞争力”。

legion.en: Ask {advisor} to fast-track it
legion.zh: 请 {advisor}走加急

legion.en: {advisor} sends one email to the right person. Approval arrives in three days.
legion.zh: {advisor}给关键的人发了封邮件，三天就批下来了。

legion.en: They try. Legal now has two questions instead of one.
legion.zh: 导师试了，结果法务的问题从一个变成了两个。

legion.en: Rerun the key results on campus
legion.zh: 回学校重跑关键结果

legion.en: The university cluster is slow, but its results need no lawyer. Your paper is a little smaller now.
legion.zh: 学校集群慢得像蜗牛，但跑出的结果不用过法务。论文因此缩水了一点。

legion.en: A Product Manager Joins
legion.zh: 产品经理来了

legion.en: {advisor} brings a product manager from the company to your research meeting. Ten minutes in, they ask about the roadmap for {project}, and its "go-to-market".
legion.zh: {advisor}把公司的一位产品经理带进了你们的研究会议。才过十分钟，对方就问起了 {project} 的路线图，还有打算怎么“推向市场”。

legion.en: Pitch {project} as a product
legion.zh: 把 {project} 包装成产品

legion.en: They love it and ask for a demo next month. You've never had a customer before.
legion.zh: 对方很喜欢，约你下个月看 demo。你人生第一次有了客户。

legion.en: They ask about daily active users. You have twelve participants and a consent form.
legion.zh: 对方问日活是多少。你只有十二个参与者和一张知情同意书。

legion.en: Ask what their users struggle with
legion.zh: 问问他们的用户有什么痛点

legion.en: They talk for 40 minutes. It's the best user research you've done all year, and the meeting runs long.
legion.zh: 对方一口气讲了 40 分钟，会开超时了，但这是你今年做过最好的一次用户研究。

legion.en: Steer back to the research
legion.zh: 把话题拉回研究

legion.en: The product manager checks their phone. Your meeting stays a research meeting, and {advisor} looks a little disappointed.
legion.zh: 产品经理低头看起了手机。会议总算还是研究会议，只是 {advisor}看起来有点失望。

legion.en: Already Arranged
legion.zh: 早就安排好了

legion.en: You've barely sent out your internship applications when {advisor} mentions, between meetings, that they've "already talked to the team" at {company}. "You'll probably start in May."
legion.zh: 你实习申请才刚发出去，{advisor}就在两个会之间随口提到，已经和 {company} 的团队“打过招呼了”。“你大概 5 月入职。”

legion.en: Thank them and stop worrying
legion.zh: 谢过导师，躺平等入职

legion.en: You cancel two interviews and relax. {advisor} seems pleased that you trust them.
legion.zh: 你推掉了两场面试，安心等着。见你这么放心，{advisor}似乎挺高兴。

legion.en: Keep your other options going
legion.zh: 其他面试照常推进

legion.en: You keep interviewing anyway, which is more work but keeps your options open.
legion.zh: 你照样继续面试，累是累了点，但给自己留了后路。

legion.en: Ask for the research team instead
legion.zh: 争取去研究团队

legion.en: "Good call." One more email, and you're on the research team.
legion.zh: “有道理。”导师又发了一封邮件，你就进了研究团队。

legion.en: "Research is full this year. The product team is great, though."
legion.zh: “研究团队今年没名额了，不过产品团队也很不错。”

legion.en: Old Classmates
legion.zh: 老同学

legion.en: Your committee meeting opens with {advisor} and {committee} remembering grad school together, decades ago. Two more committee members were there too. Your slides wait patiently.
legion.zh: 委员会会议一开场，{advisor}和 {committee}就聊起了几十年前一起读研的日子。另外两位委员当年也在。你的 PPT 在一旁耐心等着。

legion.en: Let the stories run
legion.zh: 让他们接着忆当年

legion.en: Forty minutes of stories leave five minutes for questions, all of them easy. Everyone leaves in a great mood.
legion.zh: 故事讲了四十分钟，提问只剩五分钟，问的还都很简单。大家心情大好地散了会。

legion.en: Ask them to settle an old debate
legion.zh: 请他们了结一场老争论

legion.en: The old debate turns out to be about your topic. They argue happily, and your thesis comes out sharper.
legion.zh: 那场老争论原来正好和你的课题有关。他们吵得不亦乐乎，你的博士论文反倒被吵得更犀利了。

legion.en: They argue happily for the full hour. Your slides go unshown.
legion.zh: 他们开开心心吵了整整一小时。你的 PPT 一页都没放成。

legion.en: Steer them to your slides
legion.zh: 把话题拉回你的 PPT

legion.en: You get real, tough feedback. {advisor} looks mildly sorry to miss the end of the story.
legion.zh: 你拿到了实打实的尖锐意见。{advisor}看起来有点遗憾，故事没听到结尾。

legion.en: Back, With a Term Sheet
legion.zh: 带着投资条款书回来了

legion.en: {advisor} has been unreachable for two weeks. Today they walk into lab meeting, tanned, holding a term sheet. "Big news! Also, how's everyone's research?"
legion.zh: {advisor}失联了两周。今天晒得黝黑地走进组会，手里拿着一份投资条款书。“大新闻！对了，大家研究做得怎么样？”

legion.en: Ask about the startup
legion.zh: 问问创业的事

legion.en: They talk about funding rounds for forty minutes. You follow about a third of it, and it's a fascinating third.
legion.zh: 导师讲了四十分钟融资的事。你大概听懂了三分之一，不过这三分之一相当精彩。

legion.en: Ask for two weeks of feedback, now
legion.zh: 趁机把两周的反馈要回来

legion.en: They read everything you sent while they were gone, in one sitting. The feedback is excellent.
legion.zh: 导师一口气看完了你这段时间发的所有东西。反馈非常到位。

legion.en: "Can you resend those? My inbox is a disaster." You resend all six.
legion.zh: “你能重发一下吗？我邮箱已经炸了。”你把六封全重发了。

legion.en: Report the calls you made alone
legion.zh: 汇报你自己拍板的事

legion.en: You made three decisions while they were gone. {advisor} approves two and reverses the third without comment.
legion.zh: 导师不在的时候你做了三个决定。{advisor}批准了两个，第三个一句话没说就推翻了。

legion.en: The CTO Down the Hall
legion.zh: 走廊那头的 CTO

legion.en: A launch announcement reveals that {labmate} is the CTO of {advisor}'s newest startup. That explains the second laptop, and all the 4 pm "dentist appointments".
legion.zh: 一条产品发布公告让真相大白：{labmate} 就是 {advisor}最新那家创业公司的 CTO。难怪对方总带着两台笔记本，下午 4 点还老去“看牙医”。

legion.en: Ask {labmate} how it all works
legion.zh: 问 {labmate} 这都是怎么回事

legion.en: Over coffee they explain how equity works, and why they never sleep.
legion.zh: 喝咖啡时，对方给你讲了期权是怎么回事，顺便解释了自己为什么从来不睡觉。

legion.en: Ask if they're hiring
legion.zh: 问问招不招人

legion.en: "After you graduate? Absolutely. Employee number four is yours."
legion.zh: “等你毕业？必须的。4 号员工的位置给你留着。”

legion.en: "Not yet. Maybe after the next round." They say it nicely.
legion.zh: “暂时不招，等下一轮融资之后吧。”话说得很客气。

legion.en: Keep your head down
legion.zh: 埋头干自己的

legion.en: One founder per lab is plenty. You inherit the whiteboard they no longer have time for.
legion.zh: 一个组出一位创始人就够了。对方再也没空用的那块白板，归你了。

legion.en: Page 13 of the Appendix
legion.zh: 附录第 13 页

legion.en: The four-page short paper on {project} now has a twelve-page statistics appendix. {advisor} is drafting page 13.
legion.zh: {project} 那篇短论文，正文四页，统计附录十二页。{advisor}还在写第 13 页。

legion.en: Keep every page
legion.zh: 一页不删

legion.en: No reviewer will read all twelve pages. No reviewer will find anything to complain about, either.
legion.zh: 没有哪个审稿人会读完这十二页。也没有哪个审稿人能挑出毛病。

legion.en: Cut it to the two tests that matter
legion.zh: 只留最关键的两个检验

legion.en: The appendix shrinks to one page, and {advisor} gives a rare nod: "Fine. These are the right two."
legion.zh: 附录缩到了一页，{advisor}难得地点了头：“行，这两个选得对。”

legion.en: {advisor} restores the other ten pages, with tracked changes and a reading list.
legion.zh: {advisor}把另外十页全恢复了，开着修订模式，还附上一份阅读清单。

legion.en: Turn it into a lab stats guide
legion.zh: 改成组里的统计指南

legion.en: The appendix becomes the lab's statistics handbook. Everyone uses it, and {advisor} proudly adds page 14.
legion.zh: 这份附录成了组里的统计手册。大家都在用，{advisor}还自豪地加上了第 14 页。

legion.en: Significant, or Just Exciting?
legion.zh: 是显著，还是只是激动人心？

legion.en: You show a 2.1-point gain on {project}, and lab meeting cheers. {advisor} waits for the cheering to stop. "Is it significant, or just exciting?"
legion.zh: 你在组会上汇报：{project} 提升了 2.1 分，全场欢呼。{advisor}等大家安静下来才开口：“这是显著，还是只是激动人心？”

legion.en: Run the test right there
legion.zh: 当场做检验

legion.en: p = 0.003. {advisor} allows themselves a very small smile. The lab cheers again, carefully.
legion.zh: p = 0.003。{advisor}破天荒地露出一丝微笑。组里又欢呼了一次，这回小心翼翼。

legion.en: p = 0.21. It was only exciting, and now you know what to fix.
legion.zh: p = 0.21。只是激动人心而已，不过现在你知道该改什么了。

legion.en: Say "Both, I hope"
legion.zh: 说“希望都是吧”

legion.en: {advisor} laughs once, which is rare, then asks for the test by Friday.
legion.zh: {advisor}难得笑了一声，然后让你周五前把检验做完。

legion.en: Admit it's just exciting so far
legion.zh: 承认目前只是激动人心

legion.en: "Good. Now make it significant." Your honesty earns a week of goodwill, and a list of seeds to run.
legion.zh: “很好。那现在去让它显著。”你的诚实换来了导师一周的好感，外加一张要跑的种子清单。

legion.en: The Folder
legion.zh: 那个文件夹

legion.en: A year in, {advisor} opens a folder of ideas they've collected for years and never shared. "Take one, if any of them speak to you. Or tell me why they're wrong."
legion.zh: 入组一年后，{advisor}给你打开了一个文件夹，里面是攒了好多年、从没给别人看过的想法。“哪个打动你，就拿去做。或者告诉我它们错在哪。”

legion.en: Pick the one that excites you
legion.zh: 挑最让你心动的那个

legion.en: You pick the fourth one. {advisor} smiles: it was their favorite too, and they never found the time.
legion.zh: 你挑了第四个。{advisor}笑了，说那也是自己最喜欢的一个，只是一直没腾出时间做。

legion.en: Find the flaw in one
legion.zh: 挑一个找漏洞

legion.en: You find the problem with idea three. {advisor} nods: "Good. That's why it's still in the folder."
legion.zh: 你找出了第三个想法的问题。{advisor}点点头：“没错，所以它到现在还在文件夹里。”

legion.en: They show you a note from years ago that answers your "flaw". You learn a lot from it.
legion.zh: 导师翻出一张多年前的笔记，早就回答了你说的这个“漏洞”。你从中学到了很多。

legion.en: Say you'd rather follow your own
legion.zh: 说你更想做自己的

legion.en: "Even better." They close the folder and ask to hear yours.
legion.zh: “那更好。”导师合上文件夹，让你讲讲自己的想法。

legion.en: Arrive With Answers
legion.zh: 带着答案来

legion.en: You bring {advisor} three questions about {project}. They listen, then say kindly: "Next time, bring your best guess for each. It's easier to improve an answer than to start from a question."
legion.zh: 你带着 {project} 的三个问题去找 {advisor}。导师听完，温和地说：“下次每个问题先带上你自己的猜测。改一个答案，比从零开始想要容易。”

legion.en: Guess now, out loud
legion.zh: 当场说出你的猜测

legion.en: Two of your three guesses are right. You realize you didn't need the meeting for those two.
legion.zh: 三个猜对了两个。你这才意识到，这两个问题根本不用开会。

legion.en: All three guesses are wrong, but now you both know why.
legion.zh: 三个全猜错了，不过现在你们都知道错在哪了。

legion.en: Come back tomorrow with answers
legion.zh: 明天带着答案再来

legion.en: You return with three answers and one better question. The meeting takes ten minutes.
legion.zh: 你带着三个答案和一个更好的问题回来了。会只开了十分钟。

legion.en: Ask how they would find out
legion.zh: 问导师会怎么查

legion.en: They walk you through how they'd look into each one. Halfway through, you see you could have done it yourself.
legion.zh: 导师一步步讲了每个问题该怎么查。讲到一半，你就发现这些你自己完全能搞定。

legion.en: The Regular Visitor
legion.zh: 神秘常客

legion.en: A student from another department has come to the last four lab meetings and always orders taro. Nobody remembers inviting them.
legion.zh: 有个别的系的学生，最近四次组会都来了，每次都点香芋。可没人记得邀请过这位同学。

legion.en: Ask what they work on
legion.zh: 问问对方做什么研究

legion.en: They study crowds in train stations. Over taro, you find an idea that needs both your fields.
legion.zh: 对方研究的是火车站里的人流。一杯香芋下肚，你们聊出了一个得两个领域合作才能做的想法。

legion.en: Add them to the order sheet
legion.zh: 把对方加进点单表

legion.en: {advisor} adds a fifteenth drink without a word. The visitor looks very grateful.
legion.zh: {advisor}一声不吭地加了第十五杯。那位同学一脸感激。

legion.en: Ask them to present, as the price of tea
legion.zh: 让对方讲个报告抵奶茶钱

legion.en: Their talk on soil chemistry is the best of the semester. Lab meeting runs 30 minutes over, and nobody minds.
legion.zh: 对方讲了一场土壤化学，是这学期最精彩的报告。组会拖堂 30 分钟，没人有意见。

legion.en: Perfect Attendance
legion.zh: 全勤

legion.en: {advisor} notes that you haven't missed an in-person lab meeting in months. "That's real dedication." The bubble tea in your hand may be a factor.
legion.zh: {advisor}注意到你好几个月没缺席过线下组会。“这才是真正的投入。”你手里的奶茶，可能也功不可没。

legion.en: Credit your dedication
legion.zh: 说是自己够投入

legion.en: {advisor} nods solemnly. Every labmate in the room looks at your cup.
legion.zh: {advisor}郑重地点了点头。在场的同门齐刷刷看向你的杯子。

legion.en: Confess it's the bubble tea
legion.zh: 坦白是为了奶茶

legion.en: "I know. That's why I buy it." The whole lab laughs, and someone raises a cup.
legion.zh: “我知道，所以我才买啊。”全组都笑了，有人举起了奶茶。

legion.en: Volunteer to present next week
legion.zh: 主动申请下周做报告

legion.en: To earn your perfect record, you present. Your drink that week comes with extra pudding.
legion.zh: 为了对得起这份全勤记录，你做了报告。那周你的奶茶多加了布丁。

life.en: Lease Renewal
life.zh: 续租

life.en: Your lease renewal arrives. The rent goes up again, by an amount your stipend has never heard of.
life.zh: 续租合同来了，房租又涨了。这个涨幅，你的补助做梦都不敢想。

life.en: Lease renewal season. Your landlord's letter calls the rent increase "a modest adjustment".
life.zh: 又到续租季。房东在信里管这次涨租叫“小幅调整”。

life.en: Sign it and sigh
life.zh: 含泪签字

life.en: You sign. Your budget spreadsheet gets a new row called "fewer takeout nights".
life.zh: 你签了字。记账表里多了一行：“奶茶外卖，能省则省”。

life.en: Negotiate with the landlord
life.zh: 找房东砍价

life.en: You point out the broken heater and the mystery leak. The increase gets cut in half.
life.zh: 你把坏掉的暖气和来历不明的漏水一条条摆出来，涨幅最后砍掉了一半。

life.en: Your landlord listens kindly and changes nothing.
life.zh: 房东虚心听取了你的意见，坚决不改。

life.en: Move somewhere cheaper
life.zh: 搬去便宜点的地方

life.en: Three viewings and a rented van later, you have a cheaper place and a longer commute.
life.zh: 看了三套房，叫了一趟货车。房租降了，通勤长了。

life.en: The Drummer
life.zh: 鼓手室友

life.en: Your roommate's new hobby is drums. They practice every evening from 8 to 10, which used to be your writing time.
life.zh: 室友最近入坑了架子鼓。每晚 8 点到 10 点准时开练，正好是你写论文的黄金时段。

life.en: Buy noise-canceling headphones
life.zh: 买副降噪耳机

life.en: The drums become a distant thud. You can almost think again.
life.zh: 鼓声变成了远处隐约的闷响，你的脑子总算勉强能转了。

life.en: Work late at the lab instead
life.zh: 改去实验室熬夜

life.en: The lab is quiet at night. You start seeing your labmates more than your friends.
life.zh: 夜里的实验室很安静。渐渐地，你见同门比见朋友还勤。

life.en: Ask for a practice schedule
life.zh: 跟室友约法三章

life.en: They agree to weekends only. In return, you agree to come to their first gig.
life.zh: 室友同意只在周末练，但条件是首场演出你得去捧场。

life.en: They agree, and by Wednesday the drums are back.
life.zh: 室友满口答应，结果到了周三，鼓声又准时响起了。

life.en: Join in on bass
life.zh: 抄起贝斯一起玩

life.en: Musician
life.zh: 音乐人

life.en: Your roommate is thrilled. Within a week you have a band and a terrible name for it.
life.zh: 室友乐坏了。不到一周，你们就组了个乐队，还起了个土到掉渣的队名。

life.en: Moving Week
life.zh: 搬家周

life.en: Your lease ends the same week as your deadline for {project}. The boxes are packed, and the paper is not.
life.zh: 租约到期和 {project} 的截稿撞在了同一周。箱子都打包好了，论文可还没写完。

life.en: Move everything in one weekend
life.zh: 周末速通搬家

life.en: Two days of stairs and tape. On Monday your back hurts, and so does the draft.
life.zh: 爬了两天楼梯，缠了两天胶带。周一你腰酸背痛，草稿也伤得不轻。

life.en: Ask the lab to help, buy pizza
life.zh: 摇同门帮忙，披萨管够

life.en: Four labmates and six pizzas get you moved in one afternoon. You owe everyone a favor.
life.zh: 四个同门加六个披萨，一个下午就搬完了。代价是你欠了一圈人情。

life.en: Live out of boxes until the deadline
life.zh: 在箱子堆里熬到截稿

life.en: You write the paper sitting on a box labeled KITCHEN, with your laptop on one labeled BOOKS.
life.zh: 你坐在标着“厨房”的箱子上写论文，电脑架在标着“书”的箱子上。

life.en: First Snow
life.zh: 初雪

life.en: The first snow of the year. Your walk to the lab takes twice as long, and you arrive looking like a snowman.
life.zh: 今年的第一场雪。走到实验室花了平时两倍的时间，到的时候你活像个雪人。

life.en: Work from home today
life.zh: 今天在家办公

life.en: You write all day in warm socks, and it goes surprisingly well.
life.zh: 你穿着厚袜子在家写了一整天，效率高得离谱。

life.en: Trudge in anyway
life.zh: 还是踩着雪去

life.en: You arrive soaked. The lab is empty except for {labmate}, who also trudged in.
life.zh: 你到实验室时浑身湿透，里面空空荡荡，只有同样头铁赶来的 {labmate}。

life.en: Build a snowman with the lab
life.zh: 和同门堆雪人

life.en: It wears a lab badge and holds a sign that says REVIEWER 2. Everyone takes a photo.
life.zh: 雪人戴着实验室工牌，举着牌子：2 号审稿人。全组排队跟它合影。

life.en: First Warm Day
life.zh: 开春第一个好天

life.en: The first warm day of spring. You walk into the lab at 10 am and nobody is there. Everyone is outside on the grass.
life.zh: 开春第一个大晴天。你上午 10 点走进实验室，一个人都没有，原来全组都跑到外面草坪上晒太阳了。

life.en: Join them outside
life.zh: 出去一起晒太阳

life.en: The whole lab lies in the sun, talking about anything but work. It's the best lab meeting of the year.
life.zh: 全组人躺在太阳底下，天南海北什么都聊，就是不聊科研。这是今年开得最好的一次组会。

life.en: Enjoy the empty lab
life.zh: 独占空实验室

life.en: You have the lab to yourself and get a lot done. It gets a little lonely by lunch.
life.zh: 整个实验室归你一个人，效率拉满。只是到了饭点，有点寂寞。

life.en: Read papers on the grass
life.zh: 去草坪上读论文

life.en: You read two papers in the sun. You remember both of them better than usual.
life.zh: 阳光下读了两篇论文。大概是光合作用，两篇都记得比平时牢。

life.en: Lab Thanksgiving
life.zh: 感恩节聚餐

life.en: {senior} hosts a Thanksgiving potluck for everyone in the lab who can't fly home.
life.zh: {senior} 张罗了一顿感恩节百家饭：每人带一道菜，收留组里所有回不了家的人。

life.en: Bring a dish you can actually cook
life.zh: 带一道拿手菜

life.en: Your dish is gone in ten minutes. Several people ask for the recipe.
life.zh: 你的菜十分钟就光盘了。好几个人追着你要菜谱。

life.en: Bring a store-bought pie
life.zh: 带个超市买的派

life.en: Nobody judges the pie, and it's the first dish to run out.
life.zh: 没人嫌弃超市买的派，它反而是最先被吃光的。

life.en: Stay home and write
life.zh: 待在家写论文

life.en: You get a good writing day. The group chat fills with photos of food.
life.zh: 你这天写得很顺。群里美食照片刷屏，你隔着屏幕咽口水。

life.en: Cook something ambitious
life.zh: 露一手硬菜

life.en: Foodie
life.zh: 吃货

life.en: Your dish is the talk of the evening. People from two other labs show up just to try it.
life.zh: 你的菜成了当晚的顶流。隔壁两个组的人闻着味就来了。

life.en: Lunar New Year
life.zh: 春节

life.en: {labmate} invites the lab over to make dumplings for Lunar New Year.
life.zh: {labmate} 喊全组去家里包饺子，一起过年。

life.en: Fold dumplings until midnight
life.zh: 包饺子包到半夜

life.en: Your first dumplings look like modern art. By the fortieth, they look like dumplings.
life.zh: 你包的头几个饺子很抽象。包到第四十个，终于有了饺子的样子。

life.en: Come for dinner, leave early
life.zh: 吃顿饭就撤

life.en: You eat a lot of dumplings and are home by nine.
life.zh: 你吃饺子吃到扶墙，九点就到家了。

life.en: Send wishes and keep working
life.zh: 发个祝福，接着干活

life.en: You send a red envelope emoji to the group chat, then watch the dumpling photos roll in.
life.zh: 你在群里发了个红包表情，真的只是表情。然后就看着大家的饺子照片一张张刷屏。

life.en: Home for the Holidays
life.zh: 寒假回家

life.en: Home for winter break. Over dinner, a relative asks when you'll graduate. Everyone stops eating to hear the answer.
life.zh: 寒假回家。饭桌上，二姨终于问出了那句：“什么时候毕业啊？”全桌人齐刷刷放下了筷子。

life.en: Give a confident date
life.zh: 斩钉截铁地报个日子

life.en: "Two more years." Everyone is pleased. You will hear this date again next year.
life.zh: “还有两年。”全桌都很满意。明年寒假，这句话会原样重播。

life.en: Explain how a PhD works
life.zh: 给亲戚科普读博

life.en: Your explanation lands. An aunt says it sounds like a startup with no money, which is fair.
life.zh: 你讲明白了。小姨一句话总结：“不就是个没钱的创业公司嘛。”精辟。

life.en: Ten minutes in, someone asks if you could just finish early.
life.zh: 讲了十分钟，有人问：“那你就不能努努力，提前毕业吗？”

life.en: Ask about your cousin's new job
life.zh: 问表亲新工作，转移火力

life.en: The table turns to your cousin. You get a quiet second helping of dessert.
life.zh: 全桌火力转向了表亲。你悄悄又添了一份甜点。

life.en: The Printer
life.zh: 打印机

life.en: You explain your research to your relatives over the holidays. They listen carefully, then ask if you can fix their printer.
life.zh: 过节时你给亲戚们讲自己的研究。大家听得很认真，听完问：“那你能修下家里的打印机吗？”

life.en: Fix the printer
life.zh: 修打印机

life.en: You fix it in five minutes. You are now the family's AI expert and IT department.
life.zh: 五分钟搞定。从此你就是全家的 AI 专家，兼修电脑的。

life.en: Two hours later, the printer prints one page and stops forever. Nobody blames you, out loud.
life.zh: 两小时后，打印机打出一页纸，然后彻底罢工。没人怪你，至少嘴上没有。

life.en: Explain your research again
life.zh: 再讲一遍你的研究

life.en: Second try: "I help computers understand people." That one sticks.
life.zh: 第二版：“我教电脑听懂人话。”这回大家终于记住了。

life.en: Recommend a new printer
life.zh: 劝他们换台新的

life.en: They buy a new one online, and you end up setting it up anyway.
life.zh: 他们网购了一台新的，最后还是你来装。

life.en: A Cat Named Baseline
life.zh: 一只叫 Baseline 的猫

life.en: A shelter near campus posts a photo of a grumpy gray cat named Baseline. Baseline needs a quiet home with someone who works from home a lot.
life.zh: 学校附近的救助站发了条领养帖：一只臭脸灰猫，名叫 Baseline。要求家里安静，主人最好经常居家办公。

life.en: Adopt Baseline
life.zh: 领养 Baseline

life.en: Baseline inspects the apartment and moves in by sitting on your printed draft.
life.zh: Baseline 把公寓巡视了一圈，往你打印出来的草稿上一坐，就算入住了。

life.en: Foster for a month first
life.zh: 先试养一个月

life.en: Baseline arrives on a trial basis. Baseline does not seem to know it's a trial.
life.zh: Baseline 来试住了，只是它显然没把“试”字当回事。

life.en: Not with these deadlines
life.zh: 算了，截稿太多

life.en: You close the tab. Baseline finds a home with fewer deadlines a week later.
life.zh: 你关掉了网页。一周后，Baseline 找到了一户截稿没那么多的人家。

life.en: The Trial Ends
life.zh: 试养结束

life.en: The foster month is over. Baseline has claimed your desk chair and your favorite sweater.
life.zh: 一个月的试养期到了。Baseline 已经霸占了你的椅子，还有你最喜欢的那件毛衣。

life.en: Make it official
life.zh: 给它转正

life.en: You sign the papers. Baseline celebrates by knocking a pen off your desk.
life.zh: 你签了领养协议。Baseline 转正后的第一件事，是把你桌上的一支笔拍到地上庆祝。

life.en: Return Baseline to the shelter
life.zh: 把 Baseline 送回救助站

life.en: The shelter finds Baseline a family within a week. Your chair is yours again, and a little too empty.
life.zh: 不到一周，救助站就给 Baseline 找到了新家。椅子又归你了，只是空得有点过分。

life.en: Guest Speaker
life.zh: 特邀嘉宾

life.en: Halfway through your video update at lab meeting, Baseline sits on your keyboard and blocks the camera. After that, nobody asks about your results, only the cat's name.
life.zh: 线上组会你汇报到一半，Baseline 一屁股坐上键盘，挡住了摄像头。之后没人再关心你的结果，只关心猫叫什么。

life.en: Introduce Baseline properly
life.zh: 隆重介绍 Baseline

life.en: Baseline gets a round of applause. Your results get a follow-up meeting.
life.zh: 全组集体云吸猫，Baseline 收获一片掌声。你的结果改天单独再聊。

life.en: Close the door and carry on
life.zh: 关上门继续讲

life.en: Baseline meows through the rest of your update. Your slides have never had a louder audience.
life.zh: 后半段汇报，Baseline 一直在门外喵喵叫。你讲 PPT 还从没遇到过这么热烈的观众。

life.en: Make Baseline the lab mascot
life.zh: 封 Baseline 为实验室吉祥物

life.en: By Friday, Baseline is the lab's Slack icon, and {labmate} is printing stickers.
life.zh: 到了周五，Baseline 已经成了实验室 Slack 的头像，{labmate} 正在赶制周边贴纸。

life.en: Submitted by Baseline
life.zh: 由 Baseline 提交

life.en: You leave a half-written peer review open and go make tea. Baseline walks across the keyboard. The review is now submitted, with a score of 1 and the comment "jjjjjjjjjjjjjjj;".
life.zh: 你开着写了一半的审稿意见去泡茶，Baseline 正好从键盘上踩了过去。于是审稿意见提交了：1 分，评语是“jjjjjjjjjjjjjjj;”。

life.en: Email the area chair and confess
life.zh: 给领域主席发邮件自首

life.en: The area chair reopens it and writes back, "Please thank the cat for its time."
life.zh: 领域主席重新开放了审稿，回信说：“请替我们谢谢这位猫审稿人的宝贵时间。”

life.en: The area chair reopens it three days later. You rewrite the whole review over the weekend.
life.zh: 领域主席三天后才重新开放审稿，你只好花一个周末把整篇意见重写一遍。

life.en: Edit the review before the deadline
life.zh: 赶在截止前改掉

life.en: The system still allows edits. Baseline's version stays in the history log forever.
life.zh: 好在系统还能修改。只是 Baseline 那一版永远留在了历史记录里，成了黑历史。

life.en: Leave it. Baseline has a point.
life.zh: 不改了，Baseline 言之有理

life.en: Somewhere, an author gets the shortest review of their life. You and Baseline sleep well.
life.zh: 不知哪位作者收到了这辈子最短的审稿意见。你和 Baseline 倒是都睡得很香。

life.en: Where You Work
life.zh: 你工作的地方

life.en: Your parents visit for a week and want to see "where you work". You think about your desk and its collection of empty coffee cups.
life.zh: 爸妈来住一周，想参观一下“你上班的地方”。你想起自己的工位，和上面那一排空咖啡杯。

life.en: Give them the full lab tour
life.zh: 带他们把实验室逛个遍

life.en: They meet your labmates and take a photo of your name on the door.
life.zh: 他们见了你的同门，拍下门牌上你的名字，当场发了朋友圈。

life.en: Show them the nice library
life.zh: 带他们看漂亮的图书馆

life.en: The library is beautiful and dignified. Your parents assume your desk looks like this.
life.zh: 图书馆宽敞又气派。爸妈以为你的工位也长这样。

life.en: Skip campus, show them the city
life.zh: 不去学校，带他们逛城里

life.en: You spend the week on good food and long walks. They still don't know what you do, and nobody minds.
life.zh: 这一周你们逛吃逛吃，走了很多路。爸妈还是不知道你具体做什么，但谁也不在意。

life.en: "So What Do You Do?"
life.zh: “那你是做什么的？”

life.en: A dating-app match asks what you do. You type "PhD student", and the conversation ends there.
life.zh: 交友软件上配对的人问你是做什么的。你打了“博士生”三个字，对话就此结束。

life.en: Your dating-app match asks what you do. You say "PhD." They reply "oh" and are never heard from again.
life.zh: 交友软件上的配对对象问你做什么。你说：“读博。”对方回了个“哦”，此后已读不回。

life.en: Try "I teach computers to read"
life.zh: 试试“我教电脑认字”

life.en: A new match asks a follow-up question, then another. You have a coffee date on Saturday.
life.zh: 新配对的人追问了一句，又追问了一句。于是周六你们约了咖啡。

life.en: "So you're the reason my phone autocorrects everything?" That one ends too.
life.zh: “所以我输入法老是乱联想，就怪你咯？”这段也没了下文。

life.en: Delete the app, go to trivia night
life.zh: 删掉软件，去参加知识竞赛

life.en: Your friends' team wins on a history-of-computing question that you answered.
life.zh: 朋友们的队靠一道计算机史的题赢了，那题是你答的。

life.en: Put the phone down and work
life.zh: 放下手机去干活

life.en: You get some work done. The paper, at least, never asks what you do.
life.zh: 你干了点活。至少论文从来不问你是做什么的。

life.en: Twelve Hours Apart
life.zh: 相隔十二小时

life.en: Your family is twelve time zones away. When you wake up, they're going to bed. When they wake up, you're debugging.
life.zh: 家人和你隔着十二个时区。你起床时，他们正要睡觉；他们起床时，你还在 debug。

life.en: Call at 7 am before the lab
life.zh: 趁早上 7 点打个电话

life.en: A sleepy, happy call. Your mom asks if you're eating. You say yes, which is mostly true.
life.zh: 电话两头都迷迷糊糊的，但聊得很开心。妈妈照例问你有没有好好吃饭，你说有，基本属实。

life.en: Call at midnight after work
life.zh: 忙完了半夜再打

life.en: Their breakfast is your midnight dinner, and the call runs long.
life.zh: 他们吃早饭，你吃半夜的晚饭，电话一聊就停不下来。

life.en: Trade voice messages
life.zh: 互发 60 秒语音

life.en: The conversation stretches over a whole day, one message at a time. It's nearly as good as a call.
life.zh: 一条接一条的 60 秒语音，把一次聊天拉长成了一整天，感觉跟打电话也差不多。

life.en: Same Day
life.zh: 同一天

life.en: The same day {paper} is rejected from {venue}, your undergrad friend posts about their second promotion this year.
life.zh: {paper} 被 {venue} 拒稿的同一天，你的本科同学发朋友圈说自己今年第二次升职了。

life.en: Send a sincere congratulations
life.zh: 真心祝贺

life.en: You mean it, mostly. They write back, "Your stuff is way cooler though."
life.zh: 你九成是真心的。同学回复：“不过你做的东西酷多了。”

life.en: Mute the group chat for a day
life.zh: 屏蔽朋友圈一天

life.en: You take a day off from everyone's good news. Tomorrow you'll be happy for them.
life.zh: 你给自己放一天假，不看任何人的喜讯。明天再替他们高兴。

life.en: Congratulate them, invite them to dinner
life.zh: 祝贺一下，再约顿饭

life.en: They pay, to celebrate, and you talk about everything except reviews.
life.zh: 同学说要庆祝，抢着买了单。你们什么都聊，就是不聊审稿意见。

life.en: The Wedding Weekend
life.zh: 婚礼周末

life.en: Your close friend's wedding is the same weekend as your submission deadline for {project}. The invitation has been on your fridge for months.
life.zh: 好朋友的婚礼和 {project} 的截稿撞在了同一个周末。请柬已经在你冰箱上贴了好几个月。

life.en: Go and enjoy every minute
life.zh: 去参加，玩个尽兴

life.en: You dance badly and toast well. On Monday you are behind and happy about it.
life.zh: 你舞跳得稀烂，祝酒词倒是说得漂亮。周一进度落后了，但你心情好得很。

life.en: Go to the ceremony, skip the party
life.zh: 只去观礼，不去派对

life.en: You hug the couple after the vows and catch the last train home to write.
life.zh: 仪式一结束，你抱了抱新人，赶末班车回家写论文。

life.en: Send a gift and a video toast
life.zh: 寄份礼物，录段祝福视频

life.en: Your video toast plays between dinner and dessert. You watch the replay at 2 am, still writing.
life.zh: 你的祝福视频在正餐和甜点之间放了出来。凌晨 2 点，你一边写论文一边看了回放。

life.en: Black Screen
life.zh: 黑屏

life.en: The week before your deadline for {project}, your laptop makes a soft clicking noise and never turns on again.
life.zh: {project} 截稿前一周，你的笔记本轻轻咔哒了几声，就再也没开过机。

life.en: Restore from your backup
life.zh: 从备份恢复

life.en: Your nightly backup has everything up to last night. You lose one paragraph and zero sleep.
life.zh: 每晚的自动备份一直存到了昨晚。你只丢了一段文字，觉也一分钟没少睡。

life.en: Your last backup is from March, when the paper was still an outline.
life.zh: 你最近一次备份还停在 3 月，那时论文还只是个大纲。你当场破防。

life.en: Rebuild from Git and Overleaf
life.zh: 用 Git 和 Overleaf 重建

life.en: The code is on Git and the paper is on Overleaf. The figures were only on your desktop.
life.zh: 代码在 Git 上，论文在 Overleaf 上，可那些图只存在电脑桌面上。

life.en: Borrow {labmate}'s old laptop
life.zh: 借 {labmate} 的旧电脑

life.en: {labmate} hands over a slow laptop covered in stickers. It runs, and you owe them big.
life.zh: {labmate} 递来一台贴满贴纸的老爷机。能跑就行，这份人情你欠大了。

life.en: {labmate}'s laptop is from 2015 and needs updates for a day before it does anything.
life.zh: {labmate} 的电脑是 2015 年的，得先更新一整天才能干活。

life.en: Cracked
life.zh: 碎屏

life.en: On the first morning in {city}, your phone slips out of your hand on the convention center stairs. The screen is now a spider web.
life.zh: 到{city}的第一个早上，你在会展中心的楼梯上手一滑，手机摔了，屏幕碎成了蜘蛛网。

life.en: Tape it and carry on
life.zh: 贴上胶带接着用

life.en: The tape covers the cracks and half the conference app. You navigate by asking strangers.
life.zh: 胶带盖住了裂缝，也盖住了半个会议 app。你只好靠问陌生人找路。

life.en: Find a repair shop in {city}
life.zh: 在{city}找店修手机

life.en: The repair shop is two hours across town. You get a new screen and miss the morning session.
life.zh: 维修店在城的另一头，单程就要两小时。屏是换好了，上午的报告也错过了。

life.en: Go phone-free for the trip
life.zh: 整趟出差戒手机

life.en: Without a phone, you talk to everyone at the coffee breaks. It's the best conference you've had.
life.zh: 没了手机，茶歇时你只能找人聊天，结果跟每个人都聊上了。这是你开过最好的一次会。

life.en: Free Pizza
life.zh: 蹭披萨

life.en: A seminar on medieval tax records is offering free pizza. You have no interest in medieval tax records, and you go anyway.
life.zh: 一场关于中世纪税务档案的讲座提供免费披萨。你对中世纪税务毫无兴趣，对免费披萨毫无抵抗力。你去了。

life.en: There's free pizza at a seminar on bridge corrosion, a topic you know nothing about. You get there early.
life.zh: 桥梁腐蚀讲座有免费披萨，这个领域你一窍不通，但你还是提前到了。

life.en: A poster in the elevator says "Soil Acoustics Seminar, Free Pizza". You only read the second half.
life.zh: 电梯里的海报写着“土壤声学讲座，免费披萨”。你只看到了后半句。

life.en: Take two slices and slip out
life.zh: 拿两块就溜

life.en: That's lunch sorted, and you're fairly sure nobody saw you leave.
life.zh: 午饭解决了，而且你基本确定没人看见你溜走。

life.en: Stay for the whole talk
life.zh: 把讲座听完

life.en: The speaker uses a method you've never seen. It might work on your data, too.
life.zh: 讲者用了一个你从没见过的方法，说不定在你的数据上也管用。

life.en: Stay and ask a question
life.zh: 留下来提个问题

life.en: Your question is good. The speaker asks to grab coffee, and now you know someone in a whole other field.
life.zh: 你的问题问到了点子上。讲者约你喝咖啡，从此你在一个八竿子打不着的领域也有了熟人。

life.en: Your question was answered on slide 4. You eat a third slice in silence.
life.zh: 你问的问题，第 4 页幻灯片就讲过了。你默默吃起了第三块，化尴尬为食欲。

life.en: Still Alive
life.zh: 还活着

life.en: The desk plant you bought during orientation has survived a whole year, including a heat wave and your idea of a watering schedule.
life.zh: 入学报到时买的那盆桌面绿植活过了整整一年，熬过了一场热浪，也熬过了你所谓的浇水计划。

life.en: Repot it into something bigger
life.zh: 换个大点的盆

life.en: It grows a new leaf in its new pot the following week.
life.zh: 换盆后的第二周，它长出了一片新叶。

life.en: Buy it some friends
life.zh: 给它找几个搭子

life.en: You buy three more plants, and the lab starts calling your desk the greenhouse.
life.zh: 你又买了三盆，组里开始管你的工位叫“大棚”。

life.en: Add it to your acknowledgments draft
life.zh: 把它写进致谢草稿

life.en: It goes on the list, between your parents and the GPU cluster.
life.zh: 它上了名单，排在你爸妈和 GPU 集群之间。

life.en: Just a Short Run
life.zh: 就跑一小会儿

life.en: A run to clear your head works better than any meeting this month. {labmate} mentions a half-marathon in three months, with a beginner training plan that is "very gentle".
life.zh: 这个月你发现，出去跑一圈清空大脑，比开什么会都管用。{labmate} 顺口提了句三个月后有场半马，还附带一份“非常温和”的新手训练计划。

life.en: Sign up for the half-marathon
life.zh: 报名半马

life.en: You pay the entry fee before you can change your mind. The plan says Tuesday is "easy 5k".
life.zh: 趁自己还没反悔，你交了报名费。计划上写着周二是“轻松 5 公里”。

life.en: Run when you feel like it
life.zh: 想跑就跑

life.en: You run a loop by the river whenever the week gets loud.
life.zh: 每当一周过得太闹腾，你就去河边跑一圈。

life.en: One run was plenty
life.zh: 跑一次就够了

life.en: Your shoes go back in the closet. Your legs thank you, and so does your calendar.
life.zh: 跑鞋回到柜子里吃灰。你的腿很感激，日程表也是。

life.en: The Long Run
life.zh: 长距离拉练

life.en: Week six of the training plan says "long run, 16 km, Sunday morning". Your legs have opinions about this, and so does your inbox.
life.zh: 训练计划第六周写着：“长距离，16 公里，周日上午”。你的腿表示有意见，收件箱也是。

life.en: Do the long run
life.zh: 跑完长距离

life.en: Sixteen kilometers. You think through a whole paper on the way and forget it by the shower.
life.zh: 16 公里。你一路构思完了一整篇论文，冲完澡就全忘了。

life.en: Swap it for two short runs
life.zh: 拆成两次短距离跑

life.en: Two short runs are less heroic, but they still count, more or less.
life.zh: 两次短距离跑没那么英勇，但四舍五入也算跑过了。

life.en: Defer the race to next year
life.zh: 把比赛推到明年

life.en: You email the organizers. The training plan goes in a drawer, and your Sundays come back.
life.zh: 你给主办方发了邮件。训练计划被塞进抽屉，周日又是你的了。

life.en: Race Day
life.zh: 比赛日

life.en: Race day: 21 kilometers and a crowd with handmade signs. At kilometer 15, {labmate} holds one up: "REVIEWER 2 IS RIGHT BEHIND YOU."
life.zh: 比赛日：21 公里，沿途都是举着手写牌子的观众。到第 15 公里，{labmate} 举起一块：“2 号审稿人就在你身后！”

life.en: Go for a fast time
life.zh: 冲个好成绩

life.en: You finish strong and a little teary. The medal goes on your monitor, where visitors can't miss it.
life.zh: 你最后几公里越跑越猛，冲线时眼眶有点湿。奖牌挂在了显示器上，谁来都看得见，非常凡尔赛。

life.en: You start too fast and walk kilometers 17 to 19. You still finish, and you still get the medal.
life.zh: 你起步太快，第 17 到 19 公里是走完的。但你还是完赛了，奖牌照拿。

life.en: Run easy and enjoy it
life.zh: 轻松跑，享受过程

life.en: You high-five every kid on the course and finish in your slowest time, grinning.
life.zh: 你跟沿途每个小孩都击了掌，跑出了个人最慢成绩，笑着冲了线。

life.en: Run the last 5 km with {labmate}
life.zh: 和 {labmate} 一起跑最后 5 公里

life.en: {labmate} jumps in at kilometer 16, in jeans. You cross the line together, and the photo goes in the lab chat.
life.zh: {labmate} 在第 16 公里穿着牛仔裤冲进来陪跑。你们一起冲线，照片被发进了组群。

life.en: The Kitchen at the Party
life.zh: 厨房夜谈

life.en: At a friend's party, you end up talking to someone in the kitchen for an hour. They ask good questions about your research and don't flinch at the word "PhD".
life.zh: 朋友的派对上，你和一个人在厨房聊了一个小时。对方问起你的研究来很在行，听到“博士”两个字也面不改色。

life.en: Ask for their number
life.zh: 加个微信

life.en: They type it into your phone themselves, with a dinosaur emoji. You walk home slower than usual.
life.zh: 对方接过你的手机，自己扫码加上好友，还给自己的备注加了个恐龙表情。回家路上你走得比平时慢。

life.en: Keep talking about your research
life.zh: 接着聊你的研究

life.en: At midnight they're still interested, so you swap numbers on the way out.
life.zh: 到了半夜，对方还是很感兴趣，于是临走前你们互加了微信。

life.en: Somewhere around inter-annotator agreement, they spot a friend across the room.
life.zh: 大概聊到标注一致性那里，对方突然“看到了”屋子那头的朋友。

life.en: Head home early, deadline tomorrow
life.zh: 明天截稿，早点回家

life.en: You go home and write, and the draft gets better. You think about the kitchen conversation all week.
life.zh: 你回家写论文，草稿改好了不少。只是厨房里那场聊天，你想了一整周。

life.en: Saturday Dinner?
life.zh: 周六吃饭吗？

life.en: The person from the party texts: dinner on Saturday? Saturday is also when you'd planned to finish your related-work section.
life.zh: 派对上那个人发来微信：周六一起吃饭？可你本打算周六写完相关工作那一节。

life.en: Say yes to dinner
life.zh: 答应吃饭

life.en: Dinner turns into a long walk, then a second date. Related work can wait, and it does.
life.zh: 晚饭吃成了长长的散步，散步又变成了第二次约会。相关工作嘛，可以等，也确实等了。

life.en: Suggest coffee on Sunday instead
life.zh: 改约周日喝咖啡

life.en: Coffee turns into lunch. You're taking it slow, and that suits you both.
life.zh: 咖啡喝成了午饭。你们不急，慢慢来，这个节奏两个人都喜欢。

life.en: Say you're swamped this month
life.zh: 说这个月太忙

life.en: They say "good luck with it" and mean it. You finish related work on Saturday, alone with a citation manager.
life.zh: 对方说“祝顺利”，也是真心的。周六你写完了相关工作，陪着你的只有文献管理软件。

life.en: Meal Prep Era
life.zh: 做饭上头期

life.en: You're in a cooking phase. Sunday is meal-prep day now: 14 identical containers and a spreadsheet of macros you'll never open.
life.zh: 你最近沉迷做饭，每个周日都是备餐日：14 个一模一样的饭盒，外加一张你永远不会打开的营养素表格。

life.en: Keep the streak going
life.zh: 继续保持

life.en: Lentils on Monday, lentils on Friday. You've never had more energy, or more lentils.
life.zh: 周一鸡胸肉，周五还是鸡胸肉。你从没这么有精力过，也从没吃过这么多鸡胸肉。

life.en: Cook for the lab on Wednesdays
life.zh: 每周三给组里做饭

life.en: Your curry becomes a lab tradition. {labmate} starts bringing a fork from home.
life.zh: 你的咖喱成了组里的传统。{labmate} 开始自带碗筷。

life.en: Let the phase end gracefully
life.zh: 让这阵热情体面退场

life.en: Sunday is yours again. By Thursday, dinner is cereal, eaten standing up.
life.zh: 周日又是你的了。到了周四，晚饭变成了站着吃的泡面。

life.en: Go full chef
life.zh: 彻底化身大厨

life.en: Your containers have garnishes. People from other labs ask whether you take orders.
life.zh: 你的饭盒里甚至有了摆盘装饰，别的组都有人来问你接不接单。

life.en: An Idea and a Sunburn
life.zh: 一个想法和一身晒伤

life.en: You go hiking with friends and leave the laptop at home. Near the top, the fix for {project} arrives fully formed, along with a sunburn.
life.zh: 你和朋友去爬山，电脑留在了家里。快到山顶时，{project} 的解法突然完整地蹦了出来，脸也顺便晒伤了。

life.en: Type it into your phone right there
life.zh: 当场记在手机上

life.en: You write it at the summit with one bar of signal and a red nose. On Monday, it still makes sense.
life.zh: 你顶着红鼻子，在山顶靠一格信号把它记了下来。到了周一再看，依然说得通。

life.en: Call {labmate} from the trail
life.zh: 边下山边给 {labmate} 打电话

life.en: {labmate} picks up on the third try and tests half of it by Monday. Your friends roll their eyes all the way down.
life.zh: 打到第三次 {labmate} 才接，周一前就验证了一半。朋友们一路下山都在翻白眼。

life.en: Enjoy the view and trust your memory
life.zh: 看风景，相信记性

life.en: On Monday the idea is still there, and the rest has made it better.
life.zh: 到了周一，想法还在，歇了这一阵，反而想得更清楚了。

life.en: On Monday you remember the view and the sunburn, but not the idea.
life.zh: 到了周一，你记得风景，记得晒伤，就是不记得那个想法了。

life.en: The PhD League
life.zh: 博士联赛

life.en: You join an intramural soccer team. Every single player is a PhD student. Half-time talk is about p-values, and the captain picks the lineup with a script.
life.zh: 你加入了一支校内足球队，队员全是博士生。中场休息聊的是 p 值，队长用脚本排首发。

life.en: Play every Thursday
life.zh: 每周四都上场

life.en: You lose every game by at least four goals. It's the best part of your week.
life.zh: 你们每场都至少输四个球，颇有国足风范。但这是你一周里最开心的时候。

life.en: In the second game, you sprain an ankle chasing a ball you were never going to reach. The team signs your brace.
life.zh: 第二场比赛，你去追一个根本追不上的球，扭伤了脚踝。队友们在你的护具上签了名。

life.en: Cheer from the sideline
life.zh: 去场边加油

life.en: You hold the snacks and shout encouragement. The team votes you most valuable non-player.
life.zh: 你负责拿零食和喊加油，全队投票选你当“最有价值场外队员”。

life.en: Model the team's win probability
life.zh: 给球队的胜率建模

life.en: Stats Nerd
life.zh: 统计控

life.en: Your model gives the team a 2% chance. They win anyway, and you update your priors in front of everyone.
life.zh: 你的模型算出胜率只有 2%，结果球队照样赢了。你只好当着所有人的面更新先验。

life.en: Reviewer 2, Times Six
life.zh: 六个 2 号审稿人

life.en: Halloween at the lab. Six people show up as Reviewer 2, each with a red pen and a sign that says "The novelty is limited." Nobody coordinated.
life.zh: 实验室过万圣节，六个人不约而同扮成了 2 号审稿人，人手一支红笔，还举着一块牌子：“创新性有限。”

life.en: Go as Reviewer 2 as well
life.zh: 也扮成 2 号审稿人

life.en: Seven Reviewer 2s. The group photo looks like a very harsh program committee.
life.zh: 集齐七个 2 号审稿人，合影活像一个史上最严苛的程序委员会。

life.en: Go as the area chair
life.zh: 扮成领域主席

life.en: You overrule all six of them with one sticky note. Best costume is yours.
life.zh: 你用一张便利贴推翻了他们六个人的意见。最佳装扮奖归你。

life.en: Nobody knows what an area chair looks like. Several people think you're a delivery driver.
life.zh: 没人知道领域主席长什么样。好几个人以为你是送外卖的。

life.en: Skip the party, finish a draft
life.zh: 不去派对，写完草稿

life.en: You hear the laughter through the wall. The draft gets a page longer and a little grumpier.
life.zh: 笑声隔着墙传过来。草稿长了一页，也多了几分怨气。

milestones.en: Required, Apparently
milestones.zh: 据说是必修

milestones.en: A required course on a topic you will never use again assigns a 40-page problem set every week. Your research sits untouched in another tab.
milestones.zh: 一门这辈子都用不上的必修课，每周布置 40 页习题。你的研究在另一个标签页里吃灰。

milestones.en: Do the minimum, protect research time
milestones.zh: 水过去就行，保住科研时间

milestones.en: You get a solid B-plus. Your project barely noticed the course existed.
milestones.zh: 你稳稳拿了个 B+，项目那边几乎没察觉这门课的存在。

milestones.en: Take it seriously anyway
milestones.zh: 还是认真学

milestones.en: You learn more than you expected. You also sleep less than you expected.
milestones.zh: 你学到的比预想的多，睡得也比预想的少。

milestones.en: Find an angle that connects to your work
milestones.zh: 找个角度和研究挂钩

milestones.en: One lecture hands you a framing your project has been missing, which makes up for the problem sets.
milestones.zh: 有一节课正好给了你项目一直缺的那个切入角度，这些习题总算没白做。

milestones.en: You try very hard to make it relevant. It stays very irrelevant.
milestones.zh: 你硬往研究上蹭，它就是死活蹭不上。

milestones.en: This Could Be a Paper
milestones.zh: 这能发论文

milestones.en: Your course project comes back with one comment from the instructor: "This could be a paper." It overlaps a lot with {project}.
milestones.zh: 课程项目发回来了，老师只批了一句：“这个可以写成论文。”内容和 {project} 重合得厉害，查重都得标红。

milestones.en: Fold it into {project}
milestones.zh: 把它并进 {project}

milestones.en: Half your pilot is now done, and you got a grade for it too.
milestones.zh: 预实验一下子完成了一半，还顺手拿了个成绩，一鱼两吃。

milestones.en: Ask {advisor} if it's worth pursuing
milestones.zh: 问 {advisor}值不值得做

milestones.en: {advisor} reads it that week and suggests a sharper framing. You both leave the meeting excited.
milestones.zh: {advisor}当周就读完了，还建议换个更犀利的切入角度。散会时你们俩都很兴奋。

milestones.en: {advisor} says "interesting" in the tone that means "later". The report goes into a folder.
milestones.zh: {advisor}说了句“有意思”，那语气分明是“以后再说”。报告就此躺进了某个文件夹。

milestones.en: Keep it as a course project
milestones.zh: 就当课程项目

milestones.en: You take the A and move on. Your evenings stay free, at least for now.
milestones.zh: 你拿了 A 就收手了。晚上还是你自己的，至少暂时如此。

milestones.en: Finals, Meet Deadline
milestones.zh: 期末撞上 DDL

milestones.en: Your final exam and the deadline for {project} land in the same week. Both insist they are the priority.
milestones.zh: 期末考试和 {project} 的截稿撞在了同一周，两边都觉得自己才是头等大事。

milestones.en: Prioritize the paper
milestones.zh: 先保论文

milestones.en: The paper goes in and the exam goes okay-ish. You look up your program's minimum passing grade.
milestones.zh: 论文交上了，考试考得马马虎虎。你默默去查了系里的及格线。

milestones.en: Prioritize the exam
milestones.zh: 先保考试

milestones.en: You ace the final. The paper goes in rougher than you would like.
milestones.zh: 期末考得漂漂亮亮，论文却是带着毛边交上去的。

milestones.en: Do both by giving up sleep
milestones.zh: 不睡了，两头都顾

milestones.en: You survive both. You will not remember this week, but your body will.
milestones.zh: 两头你都扛过来了。这一周你会忘掉，但身体会替你记着。

milestones.en: 80 Papers, Two Weeks
milestones.zh: 两周读 80 篇

milestones.en: The quals reading list arrives: 80 papers, two weeks. Several are 40 pages long. One is a scanned PDF from the 1990s, slightly crooked.
milestones.zh: 资格考试的阅读清单来了：80 篇论文，两周。好几篇 40 页起步，还有一篇是上世纪 90 年代的扫描版 PDF，扫歪了。

milestones.en: Read every single one
milestones.zh: 一篇不落全读完

milestones.en: You read all 80, and your notes are beautiful. Your eyes are not.
milestones.zh: 80 篇全读完了，笔记漂亮得能发小红书，眼睛就没法看了。

milestones.en: Split the list with your cohort
milestones.zh: 拉上同届分工读

milestones.en: Five of you each summarize 16 papers. Your shared notes get passed down to the next three cohorts.
milestones.zh: 你们五个人每人总结 16 篇。这份笔记成了传家宝，往下传了三届。

milestones.en: Two people never send their summaries. You read their 32 papers the night before.
milestones.zh: 有两个人一直没交，消息已读不回。考前一晚，那 32 篇只能你自己啃了。

milestones.en: Read the core 20 deeply, skim the rest
milestones.zh: 精读核心 20 篇，其余略读

milestones.en: You know 20 papers cold and the other 60 by their figures. That's about how your committee read them, too.
milestones.zh: 20 篇你烂熟于心，另外 60 篇只认得图。委员会的老师们当年大概也是这么读的。

milestones.en: The Classic You Never Read
milestones.zh: 那篇你从没读过的经典

milestones.en: {senior} warns you: {committee} always asks about one classic paper from before you were born. You have cited it twice. You have never read it.
milestones.zh: {senior} 提醒你：{committee}每次都会问一篇比你年纪还大的经典论文。你引用过它两次，却一次也没读过，标准的引而不读。

milestones.en: Read it, plus what it builds on
milestones.zh: 读原文，再读它的前作

milestones.en: Half of modern NLP turns out to be this paper with more GPUs.
milestones.zh: 读完你发现，现代 NLP 有一半就是这篇论文加更多卡。

milestones.en: Ask {senior} what they were asked
milestones.zh: 问 {senior} 当年被问了什么

milestones.en: {senior} still has their notes, including the exact question. You prepare a crisp answer.
milestones.zh: {senior} 还留着当年的笔记，连真题都有。你照着备了一个干脆利落的回答。

milestones.en: "Something about the second figure?" That is all {senior} remembers.
milestones.zh: “好像是关于第二张图的？”{senior} 就记得这么多。

milestones.en: Read a blog post about it
milestones.zh: 刷篇知乎解读了事

milestones.en: The blog post is confident and slightly wrong. Now you are confident and slightly wrong.
milestones.zh: 那篇解读自信满满，还错了一点。现在你也自信满满，也错了一点。

milestones.en: You Passed. Now What?
milestones.zh: 考过了，然后呢？

milestones.en: You pass quals. Someone produces a cake, and by 9 pm the lab chat is back to talking about the next deadline.
milestones.zh: 你通过了资格考试。有人变出一个蛋糕，可到了晚上 9 点，组里微信群又聊起了下一个截稿。

milestones.en: Take the whole weekend off
milestones.zh: 休息一整个周末

milestones.en: You spend two days without a laptop and remember what your apartment looks like in daylight.
milestones.zh: 你两天没碰电脑，终于想起自己的公寓在白天长什么样。

milestones.en: Celebrate tonight, work tomorrow
milestones.zh: 今晚庆祝，明天干活

milestones.en: You have one good evening with the lab and are back at your desk by morning, a little lighter.
milestones.zh: 你和组里的人痛快玩了一晚，第二天一早又坐回了工位，只是心里轻快了一点。

milestones.en: Call home with the news
milestones.zh: 打电话回家报喜

milestones.en: Your family asks if this means you are a doctor now. Not yet, but they are proud anyway.
milestones.zh: 家里人问，这是不是就算博士了。还不算，但他们已经骄傲地在家族群里报了喜。

milestones.en: Not a Product
milestones.zh: 这不是产品

milestones.en: At your practice proposal talk, {labmate} raises a hand: "Honest question. Why is this a PhD and not a product?" The room goes quiet.
milestones.zh: 开题预演上，{labmate} 举手：“真诚发问：这为什么算博士课题，而不是做个产品？”全场瞬间安静。

milestones.en: Rebuild the talk around the question
milestones.zh: 围绕这个问题重做报告

milestones.en: You rework the first five slides around what nobody knows yet. The talk gets sharper.
milestones.zh: 你把前五页改成围绕“还有什么是没人知道的”来讲，报告一下子有力多了。

milestones.en: Answer on the spot
milestones.zh: 当场回答

milestones.en: "A product helps one hospital. The findings explain why it helped, for everyone." {labmate} nods slowly.
milestones.zh: “产品只帮得了一家医院，研究却能讲清楚它为什么管用，对谁都适用。”{labmate} 缓缓点了点头。

milestones.en: You describe the product in great detail. Nobody is convinced, including you.
milestones.zh: 你声情并茂地讲了一遍产品，像在路演。没人被说服，包括你自己。

milestones.en: Write it down for later
milestones.zh: 先记下来，以后再想

milestones.en: It goes on your list of questions to think about. The list is getting long.
milestones.zh: 这个问题进了你的“以后再想”清单。这份清单越来越长了。

milestones.en: Assembling the Committee
milestones.zh: 凑齐答辩委员会

milestones.en: You need a committee. Your first choice is on sabbatical on another continent, and {committee} has not answered an email since March.
milestones.zh: 你得组个答辩委员会。可首选的那位正在另一个大洲学术休假，{committee}则从三月起就没回过一封邮件。

milestones.en: Ask the sabbatical one to join by video
milestones.zh: 请休假那位远程加入

milestones.en: They agree, from nine time zones away. Your dream committee is set.
milestones.zh: 对方隔着九个时区答应了。梦之队委员会，集齐。

milestones.en: They reply with a lovely photo of a mountain and a polite no.
milestones.zh: 对方回了一张很美的山景照，外加一句客气的拒绝。

milestones.en: Ask {advisor} to nudge {committee}
milestones.zh: 请 {advisor}催一催 {committee}

milestones.en: {advisor} walks down the hall. {committee} replies within the hour: "Happy to!"
milestones.zh: {advisor}去走廊那头走了一趟。不到一小时，{committee}就回信了：“非常乐意！”

milestones.en: Even {advisor} cannot get a reply. You start looking for a fourth option.
milestones.zh: 连 {advisor}出面都没有回音。你开始物色第四个人选。

milestones.en: Pick people who answer email
milestones.zh: 找会回邮件的人

milestones.en: Scheduling will be easy. The names on your committee are a little less famous.
milestones.zh: 排时间会很轻松。只是委员会里的名字没那么响亮了。

milestones.en: But Does It Scale?
milestones.zh: 但它能 scale 吗？

milestones.en: Your industry external member returns your proposal draft. Every section has the same comment: "Does this scale?" Including the section on interviewing 12 nurses.
milestones.zh: 业界来的校外委员把开题报告草稿发回来了。每一节都是同一条批注：“这能 scale 吗？”连访谈 12 位护士那一节也不例外。

milestones.en: Add a scalability section
milestones.zh: 加一节讲规模化

milestones.en: You add two pages on deploying to a million users. Your external member is delighted, and {advisor} is puzzled.
milestones.zh: 你加了两页，讲怎么部署给一百万用户。校外委员很满意，{advisor}一脸问号。

milestones.en: Explain why depth matters here
milestones.zh: 解释为什么这里深度更重要

milestones.en: "Twelve nurses tell us what a million logs can't." Your external member writes that down.
milestones.zh: “12 位护士能告诉我们一百万条日志说不出的东西。”校外委员把这句话记了下来。

milestones.en: They nod thoughtfully and ask, "Sure, but does it scale?"
milestones.zh: 对方若有所思地点点头：“懂了，但它能 scale 吗？”

milestones.en: Reply "Yes" and move on
milestones.zh: 回一句“能”，就此翻篇

milestones.en: It works for now. You have a feeling the question will be back on proposal day.
milestones.zh: 暂时糊弄过去了。你有种预感，开题那天这个问题还会杀回来。

milestones.en: Crossfire
milestones.zh: 神仙打架

milestones.en: Ten minutes into your committee meeting, {committee} and your external member start arguing about where your thesis should go. You are still on slide 3.
milestones.zh: 委员会会议才开了十分钟，{committee}和校外委员就为你的论文该往哪走吵了起来，而你还停在第 3 页。

milestones.en: Make the case for your own direction
milestones.zh: 为自己的方向据理力争

milestones.en: You lay out where you want to go and why. They both stop, then agree with you, which surprises everyone.
milestones.zh: 你讲清楚了自己想往哪走、为什么。两人都停了下来，居然都同意了你，全场都很意外。

milestones.en: You try. Now they are both arguing with you instead, which is at least unifying.
milestones.zh: 你试了，结果他们俩改成一起跟你吵，至少算是团结起来了。

milestones.en: Let them argue it out
milestones.zh: 坐等他们吵完

milestones.en: They go for 40 minutes. You take notes and leave with two theses' worth of feedback.
milestones.zh: 他们吵了 40 分钟。你一直记笔记，最后带走了够写两篇博士论文的意见。

milestones.en: Look to {advisor} for help
milestones.zh: 向 {advisor}求助

milestones.en: {advisor} steps in with a compromise, and the meeting gets back on track. You owe them one.
milestones.zh: {advisor}出面提了个折中方案，会议回到了正轨。你欠导师一个人情。

milestones.en: {advisor} joins the argument, on a third side.
milestones.zh: {advisor}也下场了，自成第三派。

milestones.en: Everything Connects
milestones.zh: 全都串起来了

milestones.en: Each of your papers made sense on its own. The proposal needs them to tell one story. Right now they tell three, plus an awkward silence.
milestones.zh: 你的每篇论文单独看都说得通，可开题需要它们讲成一个故事。眼下它们讲的是三个，外加一段尴尬的沉默。

milestones.en: Trace each paper back to one gap
milestones.zh: 找出每篇论文共同的缺口

milestones.en: You find the thread: each paper fixes a limitation the last one exposed. Chapter 1 almost writes itself.
milestones.zh: 你找到了那条线：每篇论文都在补上一篇暴露出的局限。第 1 章几乎一气呵成。

milestones.en: Draw one diagram that links them
milestones.zh: 画一张图把它们连起来

milestones.en: With three boxes and two arrows, it is suddenly obvious that this is one thesis.
milestones.zh: 三个方框，两个箭头，一下子就看得出这是一篇完整的博士论文了。

milestones.en: You end up with fourteen boxes and arrows in every direction. It looks like a subway map.
milestones.zh: 你最后画出了十四个方框，箭头指向四面八方，活像北京地铁线路图。

milestones.en: Leave the odd paper out
milestones.zh: 把不合群的那篇拿掉

milestones.en: Two papers tell a clean story; the third becomes an appendix. It stings a little.
milestones.zh: 两篇论文讲成了一个干净的故事，第三篇只好进了附录，有点心疼。

milestones.en: Five Calendars
milestones.zh: 五份日程表

milestones.en: You need one two-hour slot when five busy people are all free. The scheduling poll comes back with a single green cell: a Friday at 7:30 am.
milestones.zh: 你得找一个五位大忙人都有空的两小时。投票结果出来，只有一个绿格子：周五早上 7:30。

milestones.en: Book the 7:30 am slot
milestones.zh: 订下早上 7:30

milestones.en: You book it before anyone changes their mind. Everyone will arrive with coffee and low expectations.
milestones.zh: 你趁没人反悔赶紧订下。到时候每个人都会端着咖啡、带着早八的心情出现。

milestones.en: Ask one member to move a meeting
milestones.zh: 请一位委员挪个会

milestones.en: They move a meeting, and you get a civilized 2 pm slot.
milestones.zh: 对方挪开了一个会，你换到了一个正常人的下午 2 点。

milestones.en: They can't. Meanwhile someone else books Friday, and the poll now has zero green cells.
milestones.zh: 对方挪不开。更糟的是，周五那格也被别人占了，投票表上一个绿格子都不剩。

milestones.en: Ask {advisor} to wrangle them
milestones.zh: 请 {advisor}出面协调

milestones.en: {advisor} sends one email. Four replies arrive within the hour, all saying yes.
milestones.zh: {advisor}只发了一封邮件，一小时内就来了四封回复，全是“可以”。

milestones.en: {advisor} replies-all with their own availability, which is also only Friday at 7:30 am.
milestones.zh: {advisor}点了“全部回复”，附上自己的空闲时间：也只有周五早上 7:30。

milestones.en: Margins, Again
milestones.zh: 又是页边距

milestones.en: The graduate school rejects your thesis formatting for the fourth time. This round: page numbers on landscape pages are 0.1 inches too low.
milestones.zh: 研究生院第四次打回你的论文格式。这次的理由：横向页面的页码低了 0.1 英寸。

milestones.en: Fix exactly what they asked
milestones.zh: 照他们说的改

milestones.en: You move the page numbers. Approval comes back with a new note about table caption fonts.
milestones.zh: 你挪好了页码。批复回来了，又附赠一条关于表题字体的新意见。

milestones.en: Switch to the official template
milestones.zh: 换成官方模板

milestones.en: The template compiles on the first try. The office approves it the same day.
milestones.zh: 模板一次编译通过，办公室当天就批了。

milestones.en: The template breaks every figure. You spend two days putting them back.
milestones.zh: 模板把所有图都弄乱了，你花了两天才一张张挪回原位。

milestones.en: Visit the formatting office in person
milestones.zh: 亲自跑一趟格式审核办公室

milestones.en: The office is open Tuesdays from 10 to 11. The reviewer fixes everything with you in ten minutes, three rounds too late.
milestones.zh: 办公室每周二 10 点到 11 点开门。审核老师当面十分钟就帮你全改好了，可惜晚了三轮。

milestones.en: Just One More Chapter
milestones.zh: 就再加一章

milestones.en: {committee} reads your draft and suggests "just one more chapter" on future directions. Your defense is a few weeks away.
milestones.zh: {committee}读了你的草稿，建议“就再加一章”讲未来方向。可离答辩只剩几周了。

milestones.en: Write the chapter
milestones.zh: 写这一章

milestones.en: You write twenty pages in ten days. It is actually good, and you are actually tired.
milestones.zh: 你十天写了二十页。确实写得不错，你也确实累坏了。

milestones.en: Negotiate a shorter section
milestones.zh: 争取写短一点

milestones.en: You propose a focused five-page section instead. {committee} agrees and seems impressed by the pitch.
milestones.zh: 你提议改写一个五页、更聚焦的小节。{committee}同意了，似乎还挺欣赏你这番说辞。

milestones.en: {committee} agrees to something shorter. Their idea of shorter is 18 pages.
milestones.zh: {committee}同意写短一点，只不过委员会眼里的“短一点”是 18 页。

milestones.en: Ask {advisor} to weigh in
milestones.zh: 请 {advisor}表个态

milestones.en: {advisor} suggests a closing slide on future work instead, and {committee} agrees.
milestones.zh: {advisor}建议改成在答辩最后放一页讲未来工作，{committee}同意了。

milestones.en: {advisor} loves the idea. Now two people want the chapter.
milestones.zh: {advisor}一听就很喜欢。这下想要这一章的有两个人了。

milestones.en: Still Under Review
milestones.zh: 还在审着呢

milestones.en: {paper} is still under review at {venue}. The decision is due in the middle of your defense prep, and your defense date depends on it.
milestones.zh: {paper} 还在 {venue} 审着。结果要等到你准备答辩的半路才出，偏偏答辩日期又取决于它。

milestones.en: Refresh the portal every hour
milestones.zh: 每小时刷新一次投稿系统

milestones.en: The portal does not change. Your stress level does.
milestones.zh: 页面纹丝不动。你的压力值倒是动得很欢。

milestones.en: Write the thesis as if it's accepted
milestones.zh: 就当它中了，照写

milestones.en: The last chapter assumes the best. Writing it calms you more than refreshing ever did.
milestones.zh: 最后一章按最好的情况来写。比起刷页面，写东西反而让你平静多了。

milestones.en: Plan a backup with {advisor}
milestones.zh: 和 {advisor}商量备选方案

milestones.en: You map out what happens if it's rejected. It isn't fun, but you sleep better, and {advisor} seems reassured too.
milestones.zh: 你把被拒之后怎么办都列了出来。过程不太愉快，但你睡得踏实多了，{advisor}看起来也安心了。

milestones.en: Slide 2
milestones.zh: 第 2 页

milestones.en: Your defense begins. Slide 2 is on the big screen, and "Dissertation" is spelled "Dissertaiton". Everyone has seen it.
milestones.zh: 答辩开始。大屏幕上是第 2 页，“Dissertation”拼成了“Dissertaiton”。全场都看见了，大型社死现场。

milestones.en: Laugh it off and keep going
milestones.zh: 一笑而过，接着讲

milestones.en: "Clearly it needed one more revision." The room laughs, and the tension is gone.
milestones.zh: “看来这篇论文还得再改一轮。”全场都笑了，紧张感一扫而空。

milestones.en: Your joke lands in silence. You click to slide 3 a little too fast.
milestones.zh: 冷笑话冷了场。你翻到第 3 页的速度有点太快了。

milestones.en: Pause and fix it live
milestones.zh: 停下来当场改

milestones.en: Fifteen seconds of typing in front of five professors feels like an hour. {committee} says, "We've all done it."
milestones.zh: 当着五位教授打字十五秒，感觉像过了一小时。{committee}说：“这种错谁没犯过。”

milestones.en: Pretend you didn't notice
milestones.zh: 假装没看见

milestones.en: You forget about it by slide 4. Nobody mentions it, probably.
milestones.zh: 讲到第 4 页你就忘了这事。没人提起，大概吧。

milestones.en: You think about it for all 60 slides.
milestones.zh: 整整 60 页幻灯片，你满脑子都是这个错字。

milestones.en: The Question You Prepared For
milestones.zh: 押中的题

milestones.en: Ten minutes in, {committee} interrupts with exactly the question you spent all last week preparing for. You have a backup slide for it: slide 47.
milestones.zh: 开讲十分钟，{committee}就打断了你，问的正是你上周准备了一整周的那道题。你还专门备了一页幻灯片：第 47 页。

milestones.en: Jump to backup slide 47
milestones.zh: 跳到备用的第 47 页

milestones.en: The slide appears, perfectly labeled. {committee} raises an eyebrow, impressed.
milestones.zh: 幻灯片应声出现，标注得清清楚楚。{committee}挑了挑眉，颇为赞赏。

milestones.en: Answer it from memory
milestones.zh: 凭记忆回答

milestones.en: You answer without notes, point by point. The committee exchanges a look that means "ready".
milestones.zh: 你不看笔记，逐条作答。委员会的老师们交换了一个眼神，意思是“可以了”。

milestones.en: You forget the third point, the best one. It is on slide 47.
milestones.zh: 你偏偏忘了第三点，也是最精彩的一点。它就在第 47 页上。

milestones.en: "I'll come back to that at the end"
milestones.zh: “这个我最后再回答”

milestones.en: Now you have something to look forward to in the Q&A.
milestones.zh: 这下问答环节有个盼头了。

milestones.en: No Signal
milestones.zh: 无信号

milestones.en: Five minutes before your defense, the projector says "No Signal". You have tried three adapters. The committee is arriving.
milestones.zh: 离答辩还有五分钟，投影仪显示“无信号”。三个转接头都试过了，委员会的老师们正陆续进场。

milestones.en: Present from the room's computer
milestones.zh: 用教室的电脑讲

milestones.en: Your backup PDF on a USB stick works. The fonts are slightly off; everything else is fine.
milestones.zh: 还好 U 盘里有备份 PDF。字体有点走样，其他都没问题。

milestones.en: The room's computer wants to install 40 minutes of updates. You start late and flustered.
milestones.zh: 教室的电脑非要先装 40 分钟更新。等你开讲，时间已经晚了，人也慌了。

milestones.en: Send {labmate} for another adapter
milestones.zh: 让 {labmate} 再去找个转接头

milestones.en: {labmate} sprints across the building and returns, out of breath, with the right one. You owe them lunch.
milestones.zh: {labmate} 一路狂奔穿过整栋楼，气喘吁吁地拿回了对的那个。这顿火锅你欠定了。

milestones.en: Give the talk at the whiteboard
milestones.zh: 改在白板上讲

milestones.en: You explain five years of research with one marker. The committee calls it the clearest talk they've seen all year.
milestones.zh: 你用一支马克笔讲完了五年的研究。委员会说这是他们今年听过最清楚的报告。

milestones.en: You draw Figure 3 from memory. It is not Figure 3.
milestones.zh: 你凭记忆画了图 3，但画出来的不是图 3。

milestones.en: You're Frozen
milestones.zh: 你卡了

milestones.en: {committee} joins your defense by video from a conference hotel. Their picture freezes every few minutes, always mid-question, mouth open.
milestones.zh: {committee}在会议酒店里视频参加答辩。画面每隔几分钟就卡住，总卡在问到一半、嘴还张着，每一帧都能做表情包。

milestones.en: Repeat every answer twice
milestones.zh: 每个回答说两遍

milestones.en: They hear everything because you say everything twice. Your voice gives out right before the last slide.
milestones.zh: 你成了人肉复读机，对方一句没漏。就在最后一页之前，你的嗓子哑了。

milestones.en: Suggest they switch to audio only
milestones.zh: 建议对方只开音频

milestones.en: With audio only, everything works. {committee} thanks you for the fix.
milestones.zh: 改成纯音频后一切顺畅，{committee}还特意谢了你。

milestones.en: They turn off video and unmute a hotel lobby. Everyone hears a suitcase.
milestones.zh: 对方关了视频，一取消静音，酒店大堂的声音全涌了进来。所有人都听见了行李箱的轱辘声。

milestones.en: Let {advisor} relay their questions
milestones.zh: 让 {advisor}代为转述提问

milestones.en: {committee} types questions into the chat, and {advisor} reads them aloud. It's slow, but nothing freezes.
milestones.zh: {committee}把问题打在聊天框里，{advisor}再念出来。慢是慢了点，但再也没卡过。

milestones.en: Congratulations, Doctor
milestones.zh: 恭喜你，博士

milestones.en: Between "Congratulations, Doctor" and commencement sit 14 pages of minor revisions. The graduate school's filing deadline is this Friday.
milestones.zh: 从“恭喜你，博士”到毕业典礼之间，隔着 14 页小修意见。而研究生院的提交截止日就在这周五。

milestones.en: Address all 14 pages properly
milestones.zh: 认真改完全部 14 页

milestones.en: You answer every comment and fix every figure. The final thesis is the best version of your work.
milestones.zh: 你回复了每一条意见，改好了每一张图。定稿成了你这几年工作最好的版本。

milestones.en: Fix what matters, explain the rest
milestones.zh: 改要紧的，其余解释清楚

milestones.en: Your response letter is so clear that the committee signs off in a day.
milestones.zh: 你的回复信写得清清楚楚，委员会一天就签字了。

milestones.en: {committee} replies: "Please address all comments." All 14 pages it is.
milestones.zh: {committee}回复：“请回应所有意见。”行吧，14 页全改。

milestones.en: Recruit {labmate} to proofread with you
milestones.zh: 拉 {labmate} 一起校对

milestones.en: The two of you spend a weekend on it, with a lot of snacks. You file on Thursday, a day early.
milestones.zh: 你们俩靠一大堆零食续命，熬了一个周末。周四就交了，比截止早一天。

milestones.en: The Hood
milestones.zh: 垂布

milestones.en: Commencement. In line to cross the stage, you notice the person behind you trying not to laugh. Your doctoral hood is on backwards.
milestones.zh: 毕业典礼。排队上台时，你发现身后的人在憋笑。原来你的博士垂布戴反了。

milestones.en: Cross the stage as you are
milestones.zh: 就这样上台

milestones.en: Your family's favorite photo of the day, possibly of the decade. You wave like you meant it.
milestones.zh: 这张照片成了家里人当天的最爱，说不定还是这十年的最爱。你挥着手，主打一个“我故意的”。

milestones.en: Ask the person behind you to fix it
milestones.zh: 请身后的人帮忙弄好

milestones.en: They flip it around in five seconds. It turns out they did the same thing at their master's.
milestones.zh: 对方五秒钟就帮你翻了过来。原来人家硕士毕业时也犯过同样的错。

milestones.en: Get {labmate} to take a photo first
milestones.zh: 先让 {labmate} 拍张照

milestones.en: "For the lab chat," {labmate} says. It becomes the chat's icon for the next three years.
milestones.zh: “发组群用的。”{labmate} 说。接下来三年，这张照片一直是群头像。

milestones.en: The Title Fight
milestones.zh: 题目之争

milestones.en: You and {advisor} disagree about your thesis title. Yours is accurate and 19 words long. Theirs is four words, and one of them is "Towards".
milestones.zh: 你和 {advisor}在论文题目上意见不合。你的题目很准确，但长达 19 个词；导师的只有四个词，其中一个还是“Towards”。

milestones.en: Argue for your title
milestones.zh: 坚持自己的题目

milestones.en: You explain what each word is doing, and {advisor} reads it twice and concedes. The title is yours, colon and all.
milestones.zh: 你逐个解释每个词的作用，{advisor}读了两遍后让步了。题目归你，连冒号一起。

milestones.en: Forty minutes on one word. You win nothing except a strong opinion about colons.
milestones.zh: 为一个词争了四十分钟。你什么也没争到，倒是对冒号有了一套坚定的看法。

milestones.en: Take theirs: "Towards" it is
milestones.zh: 听老板的，就用“Towards”

milestones.en: {advisor} is pleased. You'll explain what it means at every talk for a year.
milestones.zh: {advisor}很满意。接下来一年，你每次做报告都得解释这个题目是什么意思。

milestones.en: Poll the lab with both titles
milestones.zh: 让组里投票选题目

milestones.en: The lab votes for a third title that nobody proposed. Somehow, you and {advisor} both like it.
milestones.zh: 组里投出了第三个题目，压根没人提过。神奇的是，你和 {advisor}都挺喜欢。

milestones.en: Satisfactory
milestones.zh: 合格

milestones.en: Your annual review letter arrives. Progress: "Satisfactory." Below it is one long paragraph that uses the word "encourage" four times.
milestones.zh: 年度考核信到了。进展一栏写着“合格”，下面跟着一大段话，“鼓励”用了四次。

milestones.en: The annual review letter is in. The box says "Satisfactory". The comment says "We encourage continued focus on publication", a sentence with layers.
milestones.zh: 年度考核信来了。勾的是“合格”，评语写着“鼓励继续专注于论文发表”，这话里有话。

milestones.en: Decode it with {senior}
milestones.zh: 找 {senior} 一起解读

milestones.en: {senior} has read dozens of these. "Encourage" means "submit something this year". You leave with a plan.
milestones.zh: {senior} 读过几十封这种信：“鼓励”翻译过来就是“今年得投点东西出去”。聊完你就有了计划。

milestones.en: {senior} reads it, frowns and says "Huh." Now two people are worried.
milestones.zh: {senior} 读完皱起眉：“啊这。”这下担心的人变成了两个。

milestones.en: Ask {advisor} what it really means
milestones.zh: 问 {advisor}到底什么意思

milestones.en: "Keep going, just faster." It's blunt and a little scary, but now you know what the paragraph meant.
milestones.zh: “继续做，只是要快一点。”话很直，也有点吓人，但你总算知道那段话什么意思了。

milestones.en: Decide Satisfactory is fine and file it
milestones.zh: 合格就行，归档了事

milestones.en: You file the letter and get back to work. The paragraph stays unread, and so does whatever it meant.
milestones.zh: 你把信一存，回去干活了。那段话始终没读，背后是什么意思也就没人知道了。

milestones.en: New Requirements
milestones.zh: 新规定

milestones.en: The program updates its course requirements. Students admitted before the change are "strongly encouraged" to take the new methods course. You read that sentence three times, looking for a loophole.
milestones.zh: 系里更新了课程要求：规定改之前入学的学生，也“强烈建议”选修新的方法课。你把这句话读了三遍，想找个空子钻。

milestones.en: Take the course
milestones.zh: 去上这门课

milestones.en: Ten weeks of problem sets. Week six exposes a flaw in your analysis that a reviewer would have found first.
milestones.zh: 十周的习题做下来，第六周的内容让你发现分析里有个漏洞，不然就得等审稿人来发现了。

milestones.en: Petition to keep the old rules
milestones.zh: 申请沿用旧规定

milestones.en: Your petition is polite and quotes the handbook's own page numbers. Approved in a week.
milestones.zh: 你的申请措辞客气，还引了手册的原文页码，一周就批了。

milestones.en: The petition goes to a committee that meets once a semester. You take the course while you wait.
milestones.zh: 申请被转给了一个每学期只开一次会的委员会。等结果的工夫，你先把课上了。

milestones.en: Ask {advisor} for an independent study
milestones.zh: 找 {advisor}开一门独立研究课

milestones.en: {advisor} sets up an independent study that is mostly your own project. The program accepts it.
milestones.zh: {advisor}开了一门独立研究课，内容基本就是你自己的项目。系里也认了。

milestones.en: {advisor} thinks the course would be good for you. Now the encouragement comes from two directions.
milestones.zh: {advisor}觉得这门课对你有好处。这下“鼓励”从两边一起来了。

milestones.en: The Acknowledgments
milestones.zh: 致谢

milestones.en: Chapter 3 took you a week. The acknowledgments have taken two, and you're on draft six. You keep remembering one more person who once fixed your code.
milestones.zh: 第 3 章你写了一周，致谢却写了两周，改到了第六稿：你总能再想起一个帮你修过代码的人。

milestones.en: Thank everyone, by name
milestones.zh: 挨个点名致谢

milestones.en: It runs to three pages. Your labmates find their names and pretend they didn't look, and your parents read it twice.
milestones.zh: 洋洋洒洒写了三页。同门找到自己的名字后装作没细看，你爸妈倒是读了两遍。

milestones.en: Keep it to one honest paragraph
milestones.zh: 只写一段真心话

milestones.en: It's done by lunch. You probably forgot someone, and they'll probably forgive you.
milestones.zh: 午饭前就写完了。你多半漏了谁，对方多半也会原谅你。

milestones.en: Add one joke for the lab
milestones.zh: 给组里埋一个梗

milestones.en: One line about the coffee machine. Your committee skips it; your labmates will quote it for years.
milestones.zh: 就一句关于咖啡机的话。委员会直接跳过，同门却会念叨好几年。

milestones.en: The joke needs a footnote to explain it. You delete it at 2 am, along with an hour of sleep.
milestones.zh: 这个梗得加个脚注才能看懂。凌晨 2 点你把它删了，顺带搭进去一小时睡眠。

research.en: Scooped?
research.zh: 撞车了？

research.en: An arXiv alert, two weeks before your deadline: a new paper from {biglab} does almost exactly what {project} does, with nicer figures.
research.zh: 截稿前两周，arXiv 推送了一篇 {biglab} 的新论文：做的几乎就是 {project}，图还比你的好看。

research.en: {labmate} drops a link in the lab chat: "isn't this yours??" It is. Someone else's version of {project}, posted two weeks before your deadline.
research.zh: {labmate} 往组群里甩了个链接：“这不是你的吗？？”还真是。别人家的 {project}，赶在你截稿前两周挂了出来。

research.en: Read it line by line tonight
research.zh: 今晚逐行精读

research.en: Page 7: they test on one benchmark and never ask whether people trust the outputs. That gap is yours, if you move fast.
research.zh: 第 7 页：他们只在一个基准上测了，也没问过人到底信不信模型的输出。这块空白归你了，前提是手速够快。

research.en: They use your datasets and even run your ablation. It really is your paper, only posted first.
research.zh: 数据集跟你一样，连消融实验都一模一样。这就是你的论文，平行宇宙版，还比你先挂。

research.en: Forward it to {advisor}: "???"
research.zh: 转发给 {advisor}：“？？？”

research.en: Ten minutes later, your advisor replies: "Breathe. They miss something important. Let's talk tomorrow." You breathe.
research.zh: 十分钟后老板回了：“深呼吸。他们漏了个关键的东西，明天聊。”你这才缓过一口气。

research.en: The reply comes the next afternoon: "Hm. That is close." Nothing else.
research.zh: 老板第二天下午才回：“嗯，确实很像。”然后就没有然后了。

research.en: Close the laptop, take a walk
research.zh: 合上电脑，出去走走

research.en: You walk for an hour. The paper is still there when you get back, but now you can read it without panicking.
research.zh: 你走了一个小时。回来一看，论文还在 arXiv 上挂着，但你已经能心平气和地读了。

research.en: Now What?
research.zh: 这下咋办？

research.en: Decision time for {project}. The other paper is already making the rounds, and your deadline hasn't moved.
research.zh: {project} 该拍板了。那篇论文已经在圈里传开，你的 DDL 可一天没挪。

research.en: Build the paper around the gap
research.zh: 围绕那个空白重写论文

research.en: Found the gap
research.zh: 找到了空白

research.en: You cite them in the first paragraph, then show what they missed. The paper ends up sharper than before.
research.zh: 第一段就引用他们，再点出他们漏了什么。论文反而比原来更犀利，这车撞得不亏。

research.en: Differentiate and cite them
research.zh: 划清界限，大方引用

research.en: You reframe the paper, compare fairly and cite them generously. Now it reads like a follow-up.
research.zh: 你重新定位论文，公平对比，大方引用。现在读起来像一篇顺理成章的后续工作。

research.en: Four rewrites of the intro later, it still reads as "like theirs, but later".
research.zh: 引言改了四版，读起来还是“他们那篇的迟到版”。

research.en: Rush to submit first
research.zh: 抢先投稿

research.en: You cancel everything. The plan: submit first, polish later.
research.zh: 你推掉所有安排。计划是：先投为敬，回头再打磨。

research.en: Pivot to a new angle
research.zh: 换个角度重来

research.en: You keep the code and the data and go back to the whiteboard. It stings for a while, then it starts to be fun.
research.zh: 代码和数据留着，你重新站回白板前。难受了一阵，后来居然觉得有点好玩。

research.en: Concurrent Work
research.zh: 同期工作

research.en: The sting has faded. Your related work now has a paragraph that begins "Concurrent with our work", and honestly, it reads well.
research.zh: 那阵难受劲儿过去了。相关工作里多了一段，开头是“与本文同期的工作”，说实话，读着还挺顺。

research.en: Email the other authors
research.zh: 给对方作者发邮件

research.en: The first author replies within the hour. They were just as worried about you. You agree to compare notes.
research.zh: 对方一作不到一小时就回了，原来人家也一直担心被你撞车。你们约了个时间对对答案。

research.en: They reply politely and promise to "keep in touch". Nobody does, and you don't mind.
research.zh: 对方客气地回了句“保持联系”，约等于“下次一定”。你倒也不在意。

research.en: Let it go
research.zh: 算了

research.en: Two groups had the same idea at the same time. You decide that means it was a good idea.
research.zh: 两个组同时想到一块儿去了。你决定这么理解：英雄所见略同。

research.en: Photo Finish
research.zh: 冲线

research.en: Your paper is in, rough edges and all. Now, for the first time, you read the other paper slowly.
research.zh: 论文投出去了，虽然还很粗糙。直到这时，你才第一次静下心来细读那篇论文。

research.en: Draft the comparison you skipped
research.zh: 补写之前跳过的对比

research.en: You write one careful page on how the two papers differ, so you're ready when reviewers ask.
research.zh: 你认真写了一页，讲清两篇论文的区别。审稿人问起来，手里有粮，心里不慌。

research.en: Sleep for most of a weekend
research.zh: 睡掉大半个周末

research.en: Eleven hours, then ten. The field did not move on without you.
research.zh: 先睡十一个小时，再睡十个。醒来一看，领域并没有趁你睡觉偷偷卷到前面去。

research.en: Post a preprint with a note
research.zh: 挂预印本，附上说明

research.en: Your preprint goes up with a line on concurrent work. People start citing the two papers together.
research.zh: 预印本挂上去了，附了一句同期工作的说明。大家开始把两篇捆绑引用，买一送一。

research.en: The New Angle
research.zh: 新赛道

research.en: A month after the pivot, {project} asks a question the other paper never did. You check arXiv twice a day, and so far nobody else has asked it.
research.zh: 换赛道一个月后，{project} 问出了那篇论文没问过的问题。你每天刷两遍 arXiv，暂时还没人撞上来。

research.en: Commit to the new angle
research.zh: 押注新方向

research.en: To your surprise, it's a better paper than the one you lost.
research.zh: 没想到，新论文比丢掉的那篇还强。这波血赚。

research.en: It's a different paper, about as good as the old one. At least nobody else has written it.
research.zh: 成了另一篇论文，水平跟原来那篇半斤八两。好在这篇还没人写过。

research.en: Reuse what survived
research.zh: 捡回还能用的部分

research.en: Half the old code still runs, and the data still works. The pivot costs less than it felt like.
research.zh: 旧代码一半还能跑，数据也照样能用。转向没有想象中那么伤筋动骨。

research.en: Beaten Zero-Shot
research.zh: 被零样本秒杀

research.en: {biglab} releases {model} the week before your deadline. Zero-shot, with no training at all, it beats the system you spent months fine-tuning.
research.zh: 截稿前一周，{biglab} 发布了 {model}。零样本，一点没训，就干翻了你炼了好几个月的系统。

research.en: Add it as a baseline
research.zh: 把它列为 baseline

research.en: Three days of API calls get you a new row in Table 2. Your system loses, but the comparison is honest.
research.zh: 调了三天 API，表 2 多了一行。你的系统输了，但输得光明磊落。

research.en: Reframe: where does it still fail?
research.zh: 换个问法：它还在哪儿翻车？

research.en: It still fails on the cases your paper cares about most, and those failures become your new contribution.
research.zh: 你论文最在意的那些情况，它照样翻车。翻车现场就是你的新贡献。

research.en: It fails less often than you hoped. The reframe eats a week and half your intro.
research.zh: 它翻车没你盼的那么多。重新定位搭进去一周，外加半个引言。

research.en: Pretend you didn't see it
research.zh: 假装没看见

research.en: Out of sight, out of Table 2. Reviewers, unfortunately, have also seen it.
research.zh: 眼不见为净，表 2 也清净。可惜审稿人也看到了。

research.en: No README
research.zh: 没有 README

research.en: The baseline you have to compare against won't reproduce. Its repo has no README, one script called run2_final.sh, and requirements from three years ago.
research.zh: 要对比的 baseline 复现不出来。仓库里没有 README，只有一个 run2_final.sh 和三年前的依赖，主打一个开盲盒。

research.en: Debug their code yourself
research.zh: 自己 debug 他们的代码

research.en: You find a missing flag buried in a shell script. The numbers now match within half a point.
research.zh: 你在 shell 脚本的犄角旮旯里挖出一个漏掉的参数。现在结果和论文只差不到半个点。

research.en: A week later you're still five points short. You report what you got and explain why.
research.zh: 一周过去，还差五个点。你如实报上跑出来的结果，再写一段解释原因。

research.en: Email the authors
research.zh: 给作者发邮件

research.en: You send a polite email with three specific questions and get no reply, not even an out-of-office. For now, you use their published numbers.
research.zh: 你礼貌地发邮件问了三个具体问题，石沉大海，连自动回复都没有。只好先用他们论文里报告的数字。

research.en: Report their published numbers
research.zh: 直接用论文报告的数字

research.en: You add a footnote: "numbers from the original paper." It's standard practice, and some reviewer will still ask.
