research.en: Your best result came from a notebook with 400 cells, run out of order over three weeks. Cell 212 depends on cell 388. You don't remember why.
research.zh: 你最好的结果出自一个 400 个单元格的 notebook，三周里东跑一格西跑一格。第 212 格依赖第 388 格，至于为什么，你已经不记得了。

research.en: Rewrite it as a clean script
research.zh: 重写成干净的脚本

research.en: After a day of untangling, the script runs top to bottom, and the result holds, minus half a point.
research.zh: 理了一整天，脚本终于能从头跑到尾，结果也还在，只少了半个点。

research.en: Rerun it top to bottom and hope
research.zh: 从头跑一遍，祈祷

research.en: It runs and gives the same number. You vow never to touch that notebook again.
research.zh: 跑通了，数字一样。你决定把这个 notebook 供起来，再也不碰。

research.en: Cell 17 throws an error that cell 388 was hiding. The best result is gone.
research.zh: 第 17 格报了个错，之前一直被第 388 格掩盖着。最好的结果就这么没了。

research.en: Report the result you can reproduce
research.zh: 报告能复现的结果

research.en: The number you can reproduce is two points lower. It goes in the paper, and you stop worrying about cell 212.
research.zh: 能复现的数字低了两个点。你把它写进论文，从此不用再为第 212 格提心吊胆。

research.en: 4 GB
research.zh: 整整 4 GB

research.en: You accidentally commit a 4 GB model checkpoint to the lab repo. Every labmate's next pull takes an hour. The lab chat has noticed.
research.zh: 你不小心把一个 4 GB 的模型 checkpoint 提交到了实验室的仓库。每个同门下次 pull 都要一小时。群里已经有人@你了。

research.en: Rewrite the history
research.zh: 改写提交历史

research.en: One careful force-push removes the checkpoint from history without losing anyone's work. The lab chat calls you a legend.
research.zh: 一次小心翼翼的 force-push，把 checkpoint 从历史里抹掉了，谁的工作都没丢。群里刷了一排“大佬”。

research.en: The rewrite works, and also eats {labmate}'s last two commits. They're recoverable, eventually.
research.zh: 改写成功了，顺带吃掉了 {labmate} 最近的两个 commit。好在费了番功夫，最后都找了回来。

research.en: Apologize in the lab chat, with donuts
research.zh: 在群里道歉，再发个红包

research.en: A dozen donuts and a sincere message. The pull still takes an hour, but now it comes with donuts.
research.zh: 一个大红包，外加一条真诚的道歉。pull 还是要一小时，但现在大家边等边抢红包。

research.en: Ask {senior} for help
research.zh: 找 {senior} 帮忙

research.en: {senior} fixes it in four minutes and admits the same thing happened to them in their first year.
research.zh: {senior} 四分钟就修好了，还坦白自己一年级时也干过同样的事。

research.en: {senior} fixes it, then tells the story at every lab meeting for a month.
research.zh: {senior} 修好了，然后把这事当成段子，在组会上讲了一个月。

reviews.en: Well Written. Score: 2.
reviews.zh: 写得很好，2 分

reviews.en: Reviewer 3: "The paper is well written, well motivated, and the experiments are thorough." Overall score: 2.
reviews.zh: 3 号审稿人：“论文写作清晰，动机充分，实验详尽。”总分：2。

reviews.en: One review praises your writing for a full paragraph, then gives {paper} a 2.
reviews.zh: 有份审稿意见花了一整段夸你文笔好，然后反手给了 {paper} 2 分。

reviews.en: Ask what would change their mind
reviews.zh: 问审稿人怎样才肯改分

reviews.en: Your question is short and polite. The reviewer admits they "expected more" and raises the score half a point.
reviews.zh: 你问得简短又客气。审稿人坦言自己“期望更高”，但还是把分数提了半分。

reviews.en: Your question gets no answer. The 2 stays a 2, mysterious and well written.
reviews.zh: 没人回你。2 分还是 2 分，依旧神秘，依旧写得很好。

reviews.en: Flag the mismatch to the area chair
reviews.zh: 向领域主席指出评语和分数不符

reviews.en: The area chair agrees that the review's text doesn't support its score, and weighs it less.
reviews.zh: 领域主席也觉得这份意见的评语和分数对不上，于是降低了它的权重。

reviews.en: The area chair reads your note as a complaint about a low score, which, to be fair, it is.
reviews.zh: 领域主席觉得你只是嫌分低在抱怨。说句公道话，确实也是。

reviews.en: Spend your effort on the others
reviews.zh: 把力气留给另外两份

reviews.en: You thank Reviewer 3 for the kind words and answer the other two carefully.
reviews.zh: 你谢过 3 号审稿人的美言，转头认真回复另外两位。

reviews.en: One Line Over
reviews.zh: 就多了一行

reviews.en: A week after you submit, the program chairs write: {paper} runs one line onto page 9, past the 8-page limit, so it is desk-rejected.
reviews.zh: 投稿一周后，程序主席来信：{paper} 有一行跑到了第 9 页，超出 8 页上限，因此直接拒稿。

reviews.en: Appeal, politely
reviews.zh: 礼貌地申诉

reviews.en: On a second look, the stray line is part of the Limitations section, which doesn't count. The chairs reinstate the paper and apologize.
reviews.zh: 程序主席复查后发现，多出来的那一行属于 Limitations 一节，本来就不计页数。于是恢复了你的论文，还道了歉。

reviews.en: The chairs reply, kindly and firmly, that the limit is the limit. You now know exactly how many lines fit on page 8.
reviews.zh: 程序主席回复得客气又坚定：上限就是上限。现在你对第 8 页能放几行了如指掌。

reviews.en: Tell the lab the whole story
reviews.zh: 把来龙去脉讲给组里听

reviews.en: The lab laughs with you, mostly. Two labmates go back to their desks and count their own pages.
reviews.zh: 大家都笑了，大多是陪你笑，不是笑你。两个同门回到工位，默默数起了自己论文的页数。

reviews.en: Fix it and move on
reviews.zh: 改好，翻篇

reviews.en: Two lines gone in five minutes, and a sticky note on your monitor: "COUNT THE PAGES." The paper waits for the next cycle.
reviews.zh: 五分钟删掉两行，显示器上多了张便利贴：“数！页！数！”论文只能等下一轮了。

reviews.en: Thanks, Everyone
reviews.zh: 感谢大家

reviews.en: Rereading the submitted PDF, you reach the last page. The acknowledgments, which you meant to delete, thank your lab by name and list your grant number.
reviews.zh: 你重读交上去的 PDF，翻到最后一页才发现，本该删掉的致谢还在：点名感谢了你们组，还附上了基金号。

reviews.en: Tell the chairs yourself
reviews.zh: 主动向程序主席自首

reviews.en: The chairs thank you for reporting it and let the paper through without the paragraph.
reviews.zh: 程序主席感谢你主动报告，删掉那一段后放行了论文。

reviews.en: The chairs thank you for your honesty and desk-reject the paper, since the policy has no honesty clause.
reviews.zh: 程序主席感谢你的诚实，然后直接拒稿。规定里可没有“坦白从宽”这一条。

reviews.en: Ask your advisor what to do
reviews.zh: 问问老板怎么办

reviews.en: Your advisor replies in four minutes: "Tell the chairs. Now." You do, and they let it through.
reviews.zh: 导师四分钟就回了：“马上告诉程序主席。”你照办了，论文顺利放行。

reviews.en: Your advisor is on a long flight. By the time they land, the chairs have found it and desk-rejected the paper.
reviews.zh: 导师正坐着长途航班。等飞机落地，程序主席已经发现了问题，直接拒稿。

reviews.en: Hope nobody reads acknowledgments
reviews.zh: 赌没人看致谢

reviews.en: You close the PDF. Surely nobody reads the acknowledgments. You check your email a lot this week.
reviews.zh: 你关掉 PDF。致谢嘛，谁会看呢。这一周你刷邮箱刷得格外勤。

reviews.en: Someone Read the Acknowledgments
reviews.zh: 还真有人看致谢

reviews.en: An email from the program chairs: they read the acknowledgments. {paper} is desk-rejected for breaking anonymity.
reviews.zh: 程序主席来信：致谢，他们看了。{paper} 因违反匿名要求被直接拒稿。

reviews.en: Start a pre-submission checklist
reviews.zh: 建一份投稿前检查清单

reviews.en: Item one: delete the acknowledgments. Item two: check item one.
reviews.zh: 第一条：删掉致谢。第二条：检查第一条。

reviews.en: Warn the lab
reviews.zh: 给组里提个醒

reviews.en: Three labmates open their own drafts and delete the acknowledgments. You may have saved someone else's paper.
reviews.zh: 三个同门赶紧打开自己的草稿，删掉了致谢。说不定你还救了别人一篇论文。

reviews.en: [TODO]
reviews.zh: [TODO]

reviews.en: Scrolling the submitted PDF, you find it on page 6, in red: "[TODO: rerun with new seeds - {labmate}]". That's a real name in an anonymous submission, and the portal closes in nine minutes.
reviews.zh: 翻着交上去的 PDF，你在第 6 页看到一行红字：“[TODO：换新的随机种子重跑 @{labmate}]”。匿名投稿，实名 TODO，而投稿系统九分钟后关闭。

reviews.en: Delete it and re-upload, fast
reviews.zh: 赶紧删掉重传

reviews.en: The new PDF lands with 40 seconds to spare. Your heart rate takes longer to recover.
reviews.zh: 新 PDF 赶在截止前 40 秒传了上去。你的心跳可没这么快缓过来。

reviews.en: The upload finishes at 12:00:07, and the portal keeps the old PDF. A week later, the paper is desk-rejected.
reviews.zh: 上传完成时已经是 12:00:07，系统里留着的还是旧 PDF。一周后，论文被直接拒稿。

reviews.en: Email the chairs and explain
reviews.zh: 写邮件向程序主席解释

reviews.en: The chairs accept a corrected PDF. They've seen worse, they say, and they list some.
reviews.zh: 程序主席接受了修正后的 PDF。他们说见过更离谱的，还举了几个例子。

reviews.en: The chairs are sympathetic and firm. The name was visible to reviewers, so the paper is desk-rejected.
reviews.zh: 程序主席表示同情，但态度坚决：名字已经被审稿人看到了，论文直接拒稿。

reviews.en: Accepted, Mid-Slide
reviews.zh: 组会开到一半，中了

reviews.en: Halfway through lab meeting, while {labmate} presents, your phone lights up: "{venue} decision: Accept."
reviews.zh: 组会开到一半，{labmate} 正在汇报，你的手机亮了：“{venue} 审稿结果：接收。”

reviews.en: Wait until {labmate} finishes
reviews.zh: 等 {labmate} 讲完

reviews.en: You sit on the news for 25 minutes. When you share it at the end, the room cheers, and {labmate} cheers loudest.
reviews.zh: 你把消息憋了 25 分钟。最后宣布时全场欢呼，{labmate} 喊得最响。

reviews.en: Announce it right now
reviews.zh: 当场官宣

reviews.en: The room cheers. {labmate}'s ablation slide never quite recovers.
reviews.zh: 全场欢呼。{labmate} 那页消融实验，再也没人认真听了。

reviews.en: Slide your phone to {advisor}
reviews.zh: 把手机推给 {advisor}

reviews.en: {advisor} reads it and keeps a straight face for nine more minutes before announcing it to the room.
reviews.zh: {advisor}看完，面不改色地又撑了九分钟，才向全场宣布。

reviews.en: Score Raised
reviews.zh: 涨分了

reviews.en: In the final reviews, Reviewer 3 has raised their score from 2.5 to 3.5, enough to tip the decision: "The new analysis addresses my concern."
reviews.zh: 最终审稿意见里，3 号审稿人把分数从 2.5 提到了 3.5，刚好扭转结果：“新的分析解决了我的疑虑。”

reviews.en: Write down what convinced them
reviews.zh: 记下审稿人为什么改分

reviews.en: Their concern was right, and fixing it made the paper better. You save the note for next time.
reviews.zh: 审稿人的疑虑是对的，改完论文确实更好了。你把这条记下来，留着下次用。

reviews.en: Screenshot it for the lab chat
reviews.zh: 截图发到组群

reviews.en: The lab chat fills with celebration emoji. {labmate} asks to see your response, for science.
reviews.zh: 组群里撒花刷屏。{labmate} 想看看你的回复，美其名曰“为了科学”。

reviews.en: Move the analysis into the main text
reviews.zh: 把新分析挪进正文

reviews.en: The new analysis becomes Figure 4. Readers will find it, and so will citations.
reviews.zh: 新分析成了正文的图 4。读者看得到，引用也会跟着来。

reviews.en: Promises, Promises
reviews.zh: 说好的呢

reviews.en: The camera-ready is due in two weeks. Your rebuttal promised a new baseline, an error analysis, and a clearer Figure 2.
reviews.zh: 终稿两周后截止。你在 rebuttal 里画了三张饼：新 baseline、错误分析，还有一张更清楚的图 2。

reviews.en: Deliver every promise
reviews.zh: 兑现全部承诺

reviews.en: Everything you promised is in. Reviewer 2 will never check. You did it anyway, and your advisor noticed.
reviews.zh: 承诺的全都加进去了。2 号审稿人根本不会来检查，但你还是做了，导师也看在眼里。

reviews.en: Deliver the main ones
reviews.zh: 兑现主要的几条

reviews.en: The baseline and the figure make it in. The error analysis becomes "future work".
reviews.zh: 新 baseline 和图都加上了，错误分析则成了“未来工作”。

reviews.en: Submit it as accepted
reviews.zh: 原样交终稿

reviews.en: Nobody stops you. Your advisor notices the missing error analysis and says nothing, which is worse.
reviews.zh: 没人拦你。导师发现错误分析没加，却什么也没说，这才最可怕。

reviews.en: Fourth Time
reviews.zh: 事不过四

reviews.en: {paper} has been rejected so many times it has its own folder of reviews. This time, all three reviews are positive. One calls it "timely".
reviews.zh: {paper} 被拒了太多次，审稿意见都单独建了个文件夹。这一次，三份意见全是正面的，有一份还说它“恰逢其时”。

reviews.en: Frame the acceptance email
reviews.zh: 把录用邮件裱起来

reviews.en: It goes on the wall by your desk, above a sticky note that says "resubmit".
reviews.zh: 录用邮件挂上了工位旁的墙，下面还贴着一张写着“重投”的便利贴。

reviews.en: Reread the first round of reviews
reviews.zh: 重读第一轮审稿意见

reviews.en: Round one said the paper wasn't ready, and round one was right. It's a much better paper now.
reviews.zh: 第一轮说论文还没准备好，回头看，确实没准备好。现在的版本好太多了。

reviews.en: Thank everyone who read all four
reviews.zh: 感谢四版都读过的人

reviews.en: Your advisor and {labmate} have read every version. You buy the first round, and they make you tell the whole story.
reviews.zh: 导师和 {labmate} 每一版都读过。你请大家喝奶茶，他们非要你把这段经历从头讲一遍。

reviews.en: Nominated
reviews.zh: 最佳论文陪跑

reviews.en: The acceptance comes with a Best Paper nomination. For two months you rehearse a 30-second thank-you. At the ceremony, another paper wins.
reviews.zh: 论文中了，还拿到最佳论文提名。一段 30 秒的感言你排练了两个月，结果颁奖典礼上，奖给了另一篇。

reviews.en: Clap, sincerely
reviews.zh: 真心鼓掌

reviews.en: The winning paper is very good. You clap, and someone behind you whispers that yours was their favorite.
reviews.zh: 获奖论文确实很好。你鼓着掌，身后有人小声说，最喜欢的其实是你那篇。

reviews.en: Add "nominee" to your CV
reviews.zh: 在简历上写“提名”

reviews.en: "Best Paper Nominee" goes on your CV, and you will argue with anyone who says it doesn't count.
reviews.zh: “最佳论文提名”写进了简历。谁说这不算数，你就跟谁急。

reviews.en: Read the winner on the flight home
reviews.zh: 回程飞机上读获奖论文

reviews.en: It's excellent. You fill two pages with ideas, and only one of them is "why not us".
reviews.zh: 确实精彩。你记了两页想法，其中只有一条是“凭什么不是我们”。

reviews.en: Outstanding Paper
reviews.zh: 杰出论文

reviews.en: A second email from the chairs, two weeks after the acceptance: {paper} has been selected for an Outstanding Paper Award at {venue}.
reviews.zh: 录用两周后，程序主席又来了一封邮件：{paper} 获评 {venue} 杰出论文奖。

reviews.en: Read it five times, then call home
reviews.zh: 读五遍，再给家里打电话

reviews.en: Your family doesn't know what the award is. They are prouder than anyone at the conference will be.
reviews.zh: 家里人不知道这是什么奖，但他们比会场上任何人都骄傲。

reviews.en: Rebuild the talk from scratch
reviews.zh: 从头重做报告

reviews.en: An award paper gets a full room. You rewrite the talk for it, and it's the best one you've ever given.
reviews.zh: 获奖论文的报告，台下肯定坐满人。你干脆把报告推倒重写，结果讲成了你讲过最好的一场。

reviews.en: Post the news
reviews.zh: 发帖报喜

reviews.en: Your post is shared by people you've only ever cited. Your inbox fills with invitations and one recruiter.
reviews.zh: 转发你帖子的，都是你只在参考文献里见过的人。邮箱里塞满了邀请，还有一位猎头。

reviews.en: Scores: 4, 4 and 2. The meta-review summarizes the 2, quotes the 2, and recommends rejection.
reviews.zh: 分数：4、4、2。元评审总结了那个 2，引用了那个 2，然后建议拒稿。

reviews.en: Write to the senior area chair
reviews.zh: 给高级领域主席写信

reviews.en: A thoughtful reply: the meta-review "could have engaged more with the positive reviews." The decision stands, but you feel heard.
reviews.zh: 回复很用心：元评审“本可以更多地回应正面意见”。结果不变，但总算有人听进去了。

reviews.en: A template reply thanks you for your feedback on the review process.
reviews.zh: 一封模板回复，感谢你对审稿流程的“宝贵反馈”。

reviews.en: Reread the 2 for anything real
reviews.zh: 重读那份 2 分找干货

reviews.en: Under the tone, one point is real. You fix it, and the next version is harder to reject.
reviews.zh: 抛开语气不谈，有一点确实说中了。改完之后，下一版更难被拒了。

reviews.en: Resubmit next cycle, same paper
reviews.zh: 原封不动投下一轮

reviews.en: You send the same paper to new reviewers and hope for two 4s and a quiet third.
reviews.zh: 你把同一篇论文投给新一批审稿人，盼着两个 4 分，第三位别出声就行。

reviews.en: Read by Nobody
reviews.zh: 石沉大海

reviews.en: You wrote a careful response with two new experiments. Not one reviewer replied, and the meta-review repeats the concerns you answered.
reviews.zh: 你认真写了回复，还补了两个新实验。结果没有一位审稿人回应，元评审还把你回答过的问题原样重复了一遍。

reviews.en: Put the new experiments in the paper
reviews.zh: 把新实验写进论文

reviews.en: The rebuttal experiments go into the next version. This time, someone has to read them.
reviews.zh: rebuttal 里的实验进了下一版。这次总该有人看了吧。

reviews.en: Report it to the chairs
reviews.zh: 向程序主席反映

reviews.en: The chairs agree that the reviewers didn't engage and make a note of it. Nothing changes, but you feel better.
reviews.zh: 程序主席也认为审稿人没有认真回应，并记录在案。结果没变，但你心里舒服了些。

reviews.en: An auto-reply, then nothing. You have now written two documents nobody read.
reviews.zh: 一封自动回复，然后就没有然后了。你已经写了两份没人看的东西。

reviews.en: Close the laptop for the evening
reviews.zh: 今晚合上电脑

reviews.en: You call a friend over for dinner and don't open the reviews again until Monday.
reviews.zh: 你约朋友来家里吃火锅，直到周一都没再打开审稿意见。

reviews.en: In Light of the Other Reviews
reviews.zh: 参考其他意见后

reviews.en: Reviewer 1 had given a 3.5. After reading Reviewer 2, they lowered it to 2.5: "I agree with R2's concerns." You had answered R2's concerns.
reviews.zh: 1 号审稿人原本给了 3.5。看完 2 号的意见后，降到了 2.5：“我同意 R2 的疑虑。”可 R2 的疑虑你明明已经回答过了。

reviews.en: File a review issue report
reviews.zh: 提交审稿问题报告

reviews.en: The area chair acknowledges the score change was never explained. The decision stands, but the note goes on record.
reviews.zh: 领域主席承认这次改分没有任何解释。结果不变，但这件事留了档。

reviews.en: Your report is filed. So, apparently, is everything else.
reviews.zh: 你的报告已归档。看样子，和其他所有东西一起吃灰去了。

reviews.en: Fix R2's concern anyway
reviews.zh: 还是改掉 R2 说的问题

reviews.en: Annoyingly, the fix makes the paper better. R2 was rude, but not entirely wrong.
reviews.zh: 气人的是，改完论文确实更好了。R2 说话难听，但也不全错。

reviews.en: Vent to {labmate}
reviews.zh: 找 {labmate} 吐槽

reviews.en: {labmate} once had a reviewer lower a score twice. You feel better, and slightly worse about science.
reviews.zh: {labmate} 说自己遇到过一位审稿人，连降了两次分。你心里好受了点，对科学却又多了点失望。

reviews.en: Shrug it off like a veteran
reviews.zh: 像老手一样一笑了之

reviews.en: Three rejections ago, this would have ruined your week. Today it ruins an afternoon, at most.
reviews.zh: 要是在三次被拒之前，这事能毁掉你一整周。如今，最多毁掉一个下午。

reviews.en: Decision at Dinner
reviews.zh: 饭吃到一半，论文挂了

reviews.en: Your phone buzzes halfway through dinner with your family. It's the {venue} decision, and it's a no. Everyone has already seen your face.
reviews.zh: 和家人吃饭吃到一半，手机一震：{venue} 出结果了，没中。你的脸色，全桌都看见了。

reviews.en: Tell them what happened
reviews.zh: 跟家里人实话实说

reviews.en: Nobody at the table knows what a meta-review is. They are outraged on your behalf anyway, and it helps.
reviews.zh: 饭桌上没人知道元评审是什么，但大家照样替你愤愤不平，这还真管用。

reviews.en: "Just work stuff."
reviews.zh: “没事，工作上的事。”

reviews.en: Nobody believes you. You skip dessert and reread the reviews under the table.
reviews.zh: 没人信。饭后水果你也没吃，在桌子底下又把审稿意见看了一遍。

reviews.en: Explain peer review, in full
reviews.zh: 把同行评审从头讲一遍

reviews.en: Twenty minutes later, your uncle has a theory about Reviewer 2, and it's annoyingly plausible.
reviews.zh: 二十分钟后，你舅舅对 2 号审稿人有了一套自己的理论，偏偏还挺有道理。

reviews.en: Revise and Resubmit
reviews.zh: 大修重投

reviews.en: {venue} says Revise and Resubmit. The reviewers' list of changes would rewrite half of {paper}, and the revision is due right after the holidays.
reviews.zh: {venue} 给了大修重投（R&R）。照审稿人的修改清单，{paper} 得重写一半，而修改稿节后就截止。

reviews.en: Rewrite half the paper
reviews.zh: 重写半篇论文

reviews.en: By the end you have a new framing and a new analysis. It's nearly a new paper, and a better one.
reviews.zh: 改完一看，框架是新的，分析也是新的，几乎算一篇新论文了，而且更好。

reviews.en: Fix only the must-fix list
reviews.zh: 只改必须改的

reviews.en: You make the required changes and politely explain the rest in the response letter.
reviews.zh: 你改完了必改项，其余的在回复信里客客气气地解释了一番。

reviews.en: Split the rewrite with {labmate}
reviews.zh: 和 {labmate} 分头重写

reviews.en: {labmate} takes the related work and the discussion, and somehow the paper still reads like one person wrote it.
reviews.zh: {labmate} 接下了相关工作和讨论部分。不知怎么的，整篇读起来还是像一个人写的。

reviews.en: {labmate}'s half is good, but in a completely different voice. The paper now has two personalities.
reviews.zh: {labmate} 写的那一半很好，但文风完全不同。论文读到一半，画风突变。

reviews.en: Ten Papers, Two Weeks
reviews.zh: 两周十篇

reviews.en: An area chair asks you to review ten papers. Reviews are due in two weeks.
reviews.zh: 一位领域主席请你审十篇论文，两周内交审稿意见。

reviews.en: Reviewing assignments are out: ten papers in two weeks. One of them is 40 pages with appendices.
reviews.zh: 审稿任务分下来了：两周十篇。其中一篇加上附录有 40 页。

reviews.en: Review all ten, properly
reviews.zh: 十篇都认真审

reviews.en: You write ten careful reviews. The area chair remembers your name, and you learn more about why papers get rejected than your own rejections ever taught you.
reviews.zh: 你认真写完了十份审稿意见。领域主席记住了你的名字，而你对“论文为什么会被拒”的理解，比自己被拒那么多次加起来还深。

reviews.en: Take three, decline seven
reviews.zh: 接三篇，推掉七篇

reviews.en: You send three thorough reviews on time, and the area chair thanks you for saying no early.
reviews.zh: 你按时交了三份详尽的审稿意见，领域主席还谢谢你拒绝得早。

reviews.en: Accept all ten and skim
reviews.zh: 全接下，草草看过

reviews.en: Your reviews are short, and the area chair notices. Somewhere, you've just become someone's Reviewer 2.
reviews.zh: 你的审稿意见很短，领域主席注意到了。屠龙少年终成恶龙：你成了别人的 2 号审稿人。

reviews.en: Would You Be Willing to Review?
reviews.zh: 能否拨冗审稿？

reviews.en: A journal editor writes: "Would you be willing to review this manuscript? We'd appreciate your comments within 21 days." It's 48 pages.
reviews.zh: 一位期刊编辑来信：“能否拨冗审阅这篇稿件？烦请在 21 天内反馈意见。”稿子有 48 页。

reviews.en: Your advisor forwards a review request with one line: "You'd be great for this." It's due in three weeks.
reviews.zh: 导师转发来一封审稿邀请，只附了一句：“你很适合审这篇。”三周后截止。

reviews.en: Accept and do it properly
reviews.zh: 接下并认真审

reviews.en: It takes three evenings, and you come out of it with a lot of respect for clear figures.
reviews.zh: 花了三个晚上。审完以后，你对图画得清楚的论文肃然起敬。

reviews.en: Accept, then forget until the reminder
reviews.zh: 先接下，等催了再说

reviews.en: You write it in one panicked night, after the second reminder.
reviews.zh: 第二封催审邮件到了，你才在一个兵荒马乱的晚上把它赶完。

reviews.en: Decline politely
reviews.zh: 礼貌婉拒

reviews.en: You suggest a labmate instead. The editor thanks you for the quick reply.
reviews.zh: 你转手推荐了一位同门。编辑感谢你回复得这么快。

reviews.en: Slight Delay
reviews.zh: 略有延迟

reviews.en: Reviews for {paper} were due Monday. A banner on the portal says "slight delay". By Thursday your lab refreshes it in shifts, and at 1 am they appear.
reviews.zh: {paper} 的审稿意见本该周一出来。系统横幅写着“略有延迟”。到了周四，组里轮班刷新，凌晨 1 点，意见终于出来了。

reviews.en: Read them right now
reviews.zh: 马上看

reviews.en: You read every word at 1 am and start the response by 2, with a headache.
reviews.zh: 你凌晨 1 点逐字读完，2 点就顶着头疼开始写回复。

reviews.en: Sleep first, read with coffee
reviews.zh: 先睡，明早就着咖啡看

reviews.en: Seven more hours of not knowing. The reviews are the same in the morning, and you're kinder to them.
reviews.zh: 又多忐忑了七个小时。早上再看，意见还是那些意见，你却心平气和多了。

reviews.en: Let {labmate} read them first
reviews.zh: 让 {labmate} 先看

reviews.en: {labmate} sends a summary: "Two fair, one weird, all fixable."
reviews.zh: {labmate} 发来总结：“两份公道，一份迷惑，都能改。”

reviews.en: {labmate}'s summary is one word long: "oof".
reviews.zh: {labmate} 的总结只有两个字：“啊这”。

reviews.en: Welcome Back, Reviewer
reviews.zh: 又见面了，审稿人

reviews.en: Reviewer 2's review of {paper} opens with the same sentence as last cycle's Reviewer 3, typo included.
reviews.zh: {paper} 的 2 号审稿人，开头第一句和上一轮的 3 号审稿人一模一样，连错别字都一样。

reviews.en: Show them you fixed what they asked
reviews.zh: 逐条说明上次的意见都改了

reviews.en: You go through their old concerns point by point, each one fixed. You can almost hear them nod.
reviews.zh: 你把上一轮的意见逐条过了一遍，每一条都改好了，仿佛能听见审稿人在点头。

reviews.en: They've moved on. This cycle's concerns are all new, and you spent your response on the old ones.
reviews.zh: 审稿人早就翻篇了。这一轮的问题全是新的，你的回复却都花在了旧问题上。

reviews.en: Treat it as a fresh review
reviews.zh: 当成全新的意见来回

reviews.en: You answer it like any other. They don't need to know that you know.
reviews.zh: 你照常回复。对方不必知道，你已经认出来了。

reviews.en: Tell the AC it's a repeat reviewer
reviews.zh: 告诉 AC 这是老审稿人

reviews.en: The area chair reads the old and new reviews side by side and notices how much the paper has changed.
reviews.zh: 领域主席把新旧两份意见放在一起对照，这才发现论文改了这么多。

reviews.en: The area chair replies, correctly, that reviewers are allowed to review a paper twice.
reviews.zh: 领域主席回复说，审稿人本来就可以审同一篇论文两次。这话还真没错。

reviews.en: Confidence: 5
reviews.zh: 置信度：5

reviews.en: Reviewer 3's review of {paper} is three sentences long, with a score of 1 and confidence 5. The third sentence is "Not convincing."
reviews.zh: {paper} 的 3 号审稿人只写了三句话，打 1 分，置信度 5。第三句是：“没有说服力。”

reviews.en: Ask the AC to weigh it lightly
reviews.zh: 请 AC 降低这份的权重

reviews.en: The area chair agrees that three sentences can't carry a 1, and says so in the meta-review.
reviews.zh: 领域主席也认为三句话撑不起 1 分，还在元评审里写明了。

reviews.en: The area chair replies that confidence 5 means confidence 5.
reviews.zh: 领域主席回复：置信度 5 就是置信度 5。

reviews.en: Answer it like a full review
reviews.zh: 当成完整意见认真回

reviews.en: Three sentences get three careful answers. Nobody will ever read that review as closely as you just did.
reviews.zh: 三句话换来三段认真的回复。这份意见，再也不会有人读得比你刚才更仔细了。

reviews.en: Spend the rebuttal on the other two
reviews.zh: 把 rebuttal 留给另外两位

reviews.en: You thank Reviewer 3 in one line and give your best work to the reviewers who gave theirs.
reviews.zh: 你用一行字感谢了 3 号审稿人，把最用心的回复留给了同样用心的另外两位。

reviews.en: More, Please. Fewer, Please.
reviews.zh: 多做点，少做点

reviews.en: Reviewer 1: "Too many experiments; the main story gets lost." Reviewer 3: "More experiments are needed." Both are about Section 5 of {paper}.
reviews.zh: 1 号审稿人：“实验太多，主线被淹没了。”3 号审稿人：“需要更多实验。”两人说的都是 {paper} 的第 5 节。

reviews.en: Side with one of them
reviews.zh: 选一边站

reviews.en: You side with the reviewer the area chair seems to agree with. It shows in the meta-review.
reviews.zh: 你站的正好是领域主席倾向的那一边，元评审里看得出来。

reviews.en: You side with the reviewer the area chair didn't. The other reviewer notices, too.
reviews.zh: 你站的那一边，偏偏不是领域主席认同的。被你冷落的那位审稿人也注意到了。

reviews.en: Find the careful middle
reviews.zh: 小心端平这碗水

reviews.en: You move some experiments to the appendix, so both reviewers can read it as a win.
reviews.zh: 你把一部分实验挪进附录，两位审稿人都可以当成自己赢了。

reviews.en: Your middle ground pleases neither. Both reply "partially addressed".
reviews.zh: 这碗水没端平，两边都不满意。两人都回复：“部分解决。”

reviews.en: Let the area chair sort it out
reviews.zh: 交给领域主席裁决

reviews.en: One neutral line points out the contradiction. Settling it is the area chair's job, and sometimes they do it.
reviews.zh: 你用一句中立的话点出两条意见互相矛盾。拍板本来就是领域主席的活儿，偶尔还真有人干。

reviews.en: Compare With Yourself
reviews.zh: 跟自己比

reviews.en: Reviewer 2 asks why {paper} doesn't compare against a paper from last year. That paper is yours. The review is anonymous, so you can't just say "that's us".
reviews.zh: 2 号审稿人问，{paper} 为什么不和去年的一篇论文比较。那篇正是你写的。可审稿是匿名的，你总不能直接说“那就是我们”。

reviews.en: Compare to it, politely
reviews.zh: 客客气气地比一下

reviews.en: You run your old method as a baseline, written up in the third person, and it loses gracefully.
reviews.zh: 你把自己的旧方法当 baseline 跑了一遍，用第三人称写进论文，旧方法输得很体面。

reviews.en: Flag it confidentially to the AC
reviews.zh: 私下向 AC 说明

reviews.en: The area chair sees the problem at once and tells Reviewer 2 the comparison is already in the paper, in spirit.
reviews.zh: 领域主席一眼看出问题所在，告诉 2 号审稿人：这个比较，论文本质上已经做过了。

reviews.en: The area chair writes back: "Please address the reviewer's concern in your response."
reviews.zh: 领域主席回信：“请在作者回复中回应审稿人的疑虑。”

reviews.en: Add the citation and sigh
reviews.zh: 加上引用，叹口气

reviews.en: Reviewer 2 asked you to cite yourself, so you do. Your citation count goes up by one.
reviews.zh: 2 号审稿人让你引用自己，那就引呗。引用数 +1。

reviews.en: The Fourth Review
reviews.zh: 半路杀出个程咬金

reviews.en: Two days into the rebuttal period, a fourth review of {paper} appears, marked "emergency". It's the shortest of the four, and the harshest.
reviews.zh: rebuttal 期进行到第二天，{paper} 冒出了第四份审稿意见，标着“紧急审稿”。四份里它最短，也最狠。

reviews.en: Answer it first
reviews.zh: 先回这份

reviews.en: It gets your best paragraph, right at the top. The other three get slightly shorter answers.
reviews.zh: 你把写得最好的一段给了它，放在最前面。另外三份的回复只好都短了一点。

reviews.en: Note that it came late
reviews.zh: 指出这份来得晚

reviews.en: You add one neutral sentence about the timing, and the area chair weighs the late review accordingly.
reviews.zh: 你加了一句中立的话，说明这份来得晚，领域主席也就调低了它的权重。

reviews.en: The note reads as a complaint. The area chair weighs it accordingly.
reviews.zh: 这句话读着像抱怨，领域主席也就按抱怨来掂量了。

reviews.en: Treat it like the others
reviews.zh: 跟其他几份一样回

reviews.en: All four reviews get calm answers. The late one doesn't get to set the tone.
reviews.zh: 四份意见你都心平气和地回了。迟到的那份，带不了节奏。

reviews.en: 2,500 Characters
The rebuttal limit is 2,500 characters. Your draft reply to Reviewer 2 alone is 6,000.
reviews.zh: rebuttal 上限是 2500 字符。光是你回 2 号审稿人的草稿就有 6000。

reviews.en: Cut to your three strongest points
reviews.zh: 砍到最有力的三点

reviews.en: Each point is one claim and one number. It's the best thing you've written all month.
reviews.zh: 每一点只有一个论断加一个数字。这是你这个月写得最好的东西。

reviews.en: You cut the numbers and keep the adjectives.
reviews.zh: 你砍掉了数字，留下了形容词。

reviews.en: Write it like a telegram
reviews.zh: 写成电报体

reviews.en: "Baseline added STOP Table 3 fixed STOP thank you STOP". It fits. The reviewers may not find it as funny as you do.
reviews.zh: “baseline 已补，完毕。表 3 已改，完毕。谢谢，完毕。”字数刚好。审稿人未必像你一样觉得好笑。

reviews.en: Answer only Reviewer 2
reviews.zh: 只回 2 号审稿人

reviews.en: Reviewer 2 gets 2,500 careful characters. Reviewers 1 and 3 get nothing, and they may notice.
reviews.zh: 2 号审稿人收到了满满 2500 字符的用心回复。1 号和 3 号一个字也没有，他们大概会注意到的。

reviews.en: Where's the Control?
reviews.zh: 对照组呢？

reviews.en: Reviewer 1 likes {paper} but wants a control condition. Without one, they can't tell whether your tool helped or your participants were just being nice.
reviews.zh: 1 号审稿人喜欢 {paper}，但想要一个对照条件。没有对照，就分不清是你的工具真有用，还是参与者只是给面子。

reviews.en: Defend the design
reviews.zh: 为研究设计辩护

reviews.en: You explain why a formative study doesn't need a control, with two citations. Reviewer 1 accepts it.
reviews.zh: 你引了两篇文献，解释为什么形成性研究不需要对照。1 号审稿人接受了。

reviews.en: Your defense is correct and a little defensive. Reviewer 1 is unmoved.
reviews.zh: 你的辩护句句在理，只是辩解的味道重了点。1 号审稿人不为所动。

reviews.en: Promise it as future work
reviews.zh: 承诺留作未来工作

reviews.en: You add a paragraph to the limitations and a promise to the response. Reviewers have heard it before, but it helps a little.
reviews.zh: 你在局限性部分加了一段，在回复里加了一句承诺。审稿人早听过这套，但多少有点用。

reviews.en: Run a quick online version in five days
reviews.zh: 五天内补一个线上快速版

reviews.en: Forty online participants and five short nights later, your tool beats the control. Your body files a complaint.
reviews.zh: 招了四十位线上参与者，熬了五个短短的夜，你的工具赢了对照组。你的身体开始投诉了。

reviews.en: Have You Considered LLMs?
reviews.zh: 考虑过大语言模型吗？

reviews.en: Reviewer 3's main suggestion: "The authors should consider using large language models." {paper} is entirely about large language models. It says so in the title.
reviews.zh: 3 号审稿人的主要建议：“作者应考虑使用大语言模型。”{paper} 通篇都在讲大语言模型，标题里就写着。

reviews.en: Point politely to the title
reviews.zh: 礼貌地指一指标题

reviews.en: "As the title suggests, our work uses large language models throughout." It's polite and only slightly smug.
reviews.zh: “正如标题所示，本文全程使用大语言模型。”很客气，只带了一点点得意。

reviews.en: It reads more pointed than you meant. Reviewer 3 does not reply.
reviews.zh: 读起来比你想的更带刺。3 号审稿人已读不回。

reviews.en: List Sections 1 through 6
reviews.zh: 列出第 1 到第 6 节

reviews.en: You list every section that uses one, with page numbers. It feels great, and the area chair can tell.
reviews.zh: 你把用到大语言模型的每一节都列了出来，附上页码。写得很爽，领域主席也看得出来。

reviews.en: Laugh, then answer it as a real question
reviews.zh: 笑完，再当真问题回答

reviews.en: Maybe they meant a different kind of model. You add a second model family, and the paper is better for it.
reviews.zh: 也许审稿人说的是另一类模型。你加了第二个模型家族，论文反而更好了。

reviews.en: A Different Paper
reviews.zh: 审的怕不是另一篇

reviews.en: Reviewer 2's summary of {paper} describes a method you didn't propose, tested on a dataset you didn't use. The weaknesses are about that paper, too.
reviews.zh: 2 号审稿人总结 {paper} 时，写的是一个你没提过的方法，用的是一个你没用过的数据集。列出的缺点，也都是那篇论文的。

reviews.en: Correct the summary gently
reviews.zh: 温和地纠正总结

reviews.en: One kind paragraph explains what the paper actually does. Whether Reviewer 2 reads it is up to Reviewer 2.
reviews.zh: 你用一段客气的话说明论文到底做了什么。2 号审稿人看不看，那是 2 号审稿人的事。

reviews.en: Write to the area chair
reviews.zh: 给领域主席写信

reviews.en: The area chair compares the summary to your abstract and sets the review aside.
reviews.zh: 领域主席把这段总结和你的摘要对照了一下，就把这份意见搁到了一边。

reviews.en: The area chair is on vacation. Their backup is also on vacation.
reviews.zh: 领域主席在休假。替补的人也在休假。

reviews.en: Answer it as if they'd read it
reviews.zh: 就当审稿人读过，照常回

reviews.en: You answer the concerns that could apply to your paper and skip the rest, which is oddly relaxing.
reviews.zh: 你只回答跟你论文沾得上边的问题，其余一概跳过，莫名地很解压。

reviews.en: Could Go Either Way
reviews.zh: 薛定谔的论文

reviews.en: All three reviews of {paper} give borderline scores, and all three say "I could go either way."
reviews.zh: {paper} 的三份审稿意见都给了临界分，三位都说：“接收拒稿两可。”

reviews.en: Write your strongest rebuttal
reviews.zh: 写出最强 rebuttal

reviews.en: You answer every concern with numbers and leave nothing on the table except your sleep.
reviews.zh: 你用数据回应了每一条意见，毫无保留，连觉都搭进去了。

reviews.en: Keep it short and polite
reviews.zh: 简短客气地回

reviews.en: You write five pleasant lines per reviewer. Borderline papers sometimes tip on tone.
reviews.zh: 你给每位审稿人写了五行客气话。临界的论文，有时就靠语气翻盘。

reviews.en: Write it off and aim higher next cycle
reviews.zh: 放下这轮，下轮冲更高

reviews.en: You send a minimal response and start a list for the next version. It's a relief to stop hoping.
reviews.zh: 你交了一份最简短的回复，开始为下一版列清单。不再抱希望，反而松了口气。

reviews.en: Rebuttal, Room 1214
reviews.zh: 1214 房间的 rebuttal

reviews.en: The rebuttal window for {paper} opens on the first morning of a conference you're attending, and it closes five days later.
reviews.zh: {paper} 的 rebuttal 期，偏偏从你参会第一天的早上开始，五天后结束。

reviews.en: Write it in the hotel at night
reviews.zh: 晚上在酒店写

reviews.en: You go to talks by day and write by night on hotel coffee. The response is good, and you look like the hotel coffee.
reviews.zh: 你白天听报告，晚上靠酒店咖啡续命写回复。回复写得不错，你的脸色也和酒店咖啡差不多了。

reviews.en: Skip a day of sessions
reviews.zh: 翘掉一天会议

reviews.en: You spend a day in your room with the rebuttal and miss the keynote everyone talks about at dinner.
reviews.zh: 你在房间里和 rebuttal 待了一整天，错过了那场晚饭时大家都在聊的主旨报告。

reviews.en: Split it with {labmate}
reviews.zh: 和 {labmate} 分工

reviews.en: {labmate}, at home and rested, takes two reviewers. You answer the third between sessions.
reviews.zh: {labmate} 在家养精蓄锐，接下了两位审稿人。你在会议间隙回复第三位。

reviews.en: {labmate} is at the same conference. You write it together in the hotel lobby at midnight.
reviews.zh: 原来 {labmate} 也在这个会上。你们半夜在酒店大堂一起写。

reviews.en: The Experiment, a Day Late
reviews.zh: 马后炮

reviews.en: At 6 am the morning after you submit {paper}, you wake up knowing the one experiment that would have made it airtight.
reviews.zh: 投完 {paper} 的第二天早上 6 点，你一睁眼，突然想到了那个能让论文无懈可击的实验。

reviews.en: Run it now, for the rebuttal
reviews.zh: 现在就跑，留给 rebuttal

reviews.en: By the time reviews arrive, the result is in a table, ready to paste. The post-deadline rest never happens.
reviews.zh: 审稿意见到的时候，结果已经整理成表，随时可以粘贴。截稿后说好的休息，压根没休成。

reviews.en: Save it for the next paper
reviews.zh: 留给下一篇论文

reviews.en: It goes in a file called next_paper.md. The file is getting long, which is a good sign.
reviews.zh: 你把它记进了一个叫 next_paper.md 的文件。这个文件越来越长，是个好兆头。

reviews.en: Write it down and go back to sleep
reviews.zh: 记下来，接着睡

reviews.en: You write it on a sticky note and sleep until noon, the best sleep since the deadline.
reviews.zh: 你把它写在便利贴上，一觉睡到中午，是截稿以来睡得最好的一觉。

reviews.en: Findings Counts
reviews.zh: Findings 也算数

reviews.en: {paper} is in {venue}, not the main conference. {advisor} and {labmate} both tell you Findings is a real publication, several times each.
reviews.zh: {paper} 中的是 {venue}，不是主会。{advisor}和 {labmate} 都跟你说 Findings 也是正式发表，各说了好几遍。

reviews.en: Call it a win and mean it
reviews.zh: 真心当成一场胜利

reviews.en: You update your CV and sleep well for the first time in a month.
reviews.zh: 你更新了简历，一个月来第一次睡了个好觉。

reviews.en: Ask whether Findings gets a poster
reviews.zh: 问问 Findings 有没有海报

reviews.en: It does, in a shared session. Three people stop by, and one of them becomes a collaborator.
reviews.zh: 有，和别的论文合在一个海报场。三个人停下来看，其中一位成了你的合作者。

reviews.en: Findings is virtual-only this year. You present to a poster board of avatars.
reviews.zh: 今年 Findings 只有线上展示。你对着一屏虚拟头像讲海报。

reviews.en: Start the main-track follow-up now
reviews.zh: 现在就开始写主会续作

reviews.en: You open a new document called "main track, for real".
reviews.zh: 你新建了一个文档，命名为“主会_这次是真的”。

reviews.en: The Paper You Reviewed
reviews.zh: 你审过的那篇

reviews.en: Decisions are out. {paper} is rejected, and the paper you gave a 2 as a reviewer for {venue} is accepted.
reviews.zh: 结果出来了。{paper} 被拒，而你给 {venue} 审稿时打了 2 分的那篇，中了。

reviews.en: Read their camera-ready
reviews.zh: 读读那篇的终稿

reviews.en: They fixed everything you asked for. It's a good paper now, partly thanks to you, and you're not sure how to feel about that.
reviews.zh: 你提的问题，作者全改了。现在它是篇好论文，一部分还得归功于你。心情有点复杂。

reviews.en: Tell {labmate}, without saying which
reviews.zh: 告诉 {labmate}，但不说是哪篇

reviews.en: {labmate} guesses the paper in four seconds. You neither confirm nor deny, and you both feel better.
reviews.zh: {labmate} 四秒就猜出了是哪篇。你不置可否，两个人心里都舒服了些。

reviews.en: Close the tab and get ice cream
reviews.zh: 关掉网页，去吃冰淇淋

reviews.en: Peer review is a lottery, and this week you bought a ticket for someone else.
reviews.zh: 同行评审就是买彩票，这周你帮别人买中了一张。

reviews.en: The One-Line Meta-Review
reviews.zh: 一句话元评审

reviews.en: The meta-review for {paper} is one sentence long: "The reviewers raised several concerns." It does not say which.
reviews.zh: {paper} 的元评审只有一句话：“审稿人提出了若干问题。”至于是哪些，没说。

reviews.en: Reread the reviews for clues
reviews.zh: 重读审稿意见找线索

reviews.en: Two concerns show up in more than one review. That's probably the sentence the area chair meant to write.
reviews.zh: 有两个问题在不止一份意见里出现过。领域主席原本想说的，八成就是这两条。

reviews.en: Email the area chair
reviews.zh: 给领域主席发邮件

reviews.en: The area chair replies with a real paragraph and an apology. It's the most useful part of the whole review.
reviews.zh: 领域主席回了一整段像样的话，还道了歉。这是整个审稿过程里最有用的部分。

reviews.en: The reply is also one sentence long.
reviews.zh: 回复也只有一句话。

reviews.en: Print it and pin it to the wall
reviews.zh: 打印出来钉在墙上

reviews.en: It goes up next to {labmate}'s "Thank you for your submission."
reviews.zh: 就钉在 {labmate} 那张“感谢投稿”旁边。

reviews.en: A Great Workshop Paper
reviews.zh: 很适合投 workshop

reviews.en: The meta-review for {paper}: "Not ready for {venue}, but this would make a great workshop paper." It's meant kindly, and it still stings.
reviews.zh: {paper} 的元评审写道：“尚未达到 {venue} 的水平，但会是一篇很棒的 workshop 论文。”本意是好的，可还是扎心。

reviews.en: Send a short version to a workshop
reviews.zh: 投个短版到 workshop

reviews.en: You send four non-archival pages. A few people hear about the work now, and the full paper stays free for a main venue.
reviews.zh: 你投了四页不进论文集（non-archival）的短文。这项工作先在小圈子里露了脸，完整版还能留着投主会。

reviews.en: Hold out for another main venue
reviews.zh: 坚持再投一个主会

reviews.en: You fix the core concerns and aim high again. They said "not ready", not "not good".
reviews.zh: 你改掉了核心问题，再次冲高。人家说的是“还没准备好”，不是“不好”。

reviews.en: Split it into two papers
reviews.zh: 拆成两篇，一鱼两吃

reviews.en: You cut it in two and keep the stronger half for now. It's clearer than the whole was, and a little smaller.
reviews.zh: 你把它一分为二，先留下更强的那一半。比原来整篇更清楚，也小了一点。

reviews.en: Next Deadline: Three Weeks
reviews.zh: 下个截稿：三周后

reviews.en: An hour after the rejection, {advisor} writes: "Let's turn {paper} around for the next deadline. It's in three weeks."
reviews.zh: 被拒一小时后，{advisor}发来消息：“{paper} 改一改，赶下一个截稿。还有三周。”

reviews.en: Turn it around fast
reviews.zh: 火速改完

reviews.en: For three weeks you do nothing else, and most concerns get answered. Sunlight becomes a rumor.
reviews.zh: 三周里你什么别的都没干，总算回应了大部分问题。阳光成了传说。

reviews.en: Ask for one more cycle to fix it
reviews.zh: 申请多等一轮，改扎实

reviews.en: "Fair. Better a strong paper later than a tired one now." The fixes go deeper than the reviews asked.
reviews.zh: “有道理。宁可以后交一篇扎实的，也别现在交一篇熬出来的。”你改得比审稿意见要求的还深。

reviews.en: "Three weeks is plenty." It isn't, but now you know the plan.
reviews.zh: “三周足够了。”其实并不够，但至少计划是明确了。

reviews.en: Fix only the top two concerns
reviews.zh: 只改最要紧的两条

reviews.en: You fix two concerns properly and acknowledge the rest, which fits in three weeks.
reviews.zh: 你认真改好两个问题，其余的在回复里坦白承认。三周刚好够。

reviews.en: Mostly Fair
reviews.zh: 大体公道

reviews.en: A week later, you reread the reviews of {paper} with fresh eyes. Annoyingly, they're mostly fair.
reviews.zh: 一周后，你换个心态重读 {paper} 的审稿意见。气人的是，说得大体挺公道。

reviews.en: Turn them into a fix list
reviews.zh: 整理成修改清单

reviews.en: You end up with eleven items, sorted by effort, which is much easier to look at than a rejection.
reviews.zh: 你最后列出十一条，按工作量排序。看着可比一封拒信顺眼多了。

reviews.en: Stay a little mad
reviews.zh: 再红温一会儿

reviews.en: You get a lot done this week, and you type very loudly.
reviews.zh: 这周你干了不少活，键盘敲得震天响。

reviews.en: Write one thank-you line in your notes
reviews.zh: 在笔记里写一句感谢

reviews.en: "Thanks, Reviewer 1, for the error analysis idea." Nobody will read it, and you feel better anyway.
reviews.zh: “谢谢 1 号审稿人提醒做错误分析。”没人会看到，但你心里还是舒服了些。

reviews.en: Was It Wasted?
reviews.zh: 白做了吗？

reviews.en: You have to tell your clinical collaborators that {paper} was rejected. Their first question: "So was the study wasted?"
reviews.zh: 你得去告诉临床合作者 {paper} 被拒了。他们第一句话就问：“那这个研究是不是白做了？”

reviews.en: Explain peer review honestly
reviews.zh: 如实讲讲同行评审

reviews.en: They follow the whole process, luck included. One says it sounds like grant review, only faster.
reviews.zh: 他们听懂了整个流程，连运气成分都懂了。其中一位说，听着跟基金评审差不多，就是快一点。

reviews.en: They follow along until "Reviewer 1 lowered the score after reading Reviewer 2", then look worried for you.
reviews.zh: 前面他们都听得懂，直到你讲到“1 号审稿人看了 2 号的意见后把分降了”，大家开始替你担心起来。

reviews.en: Share the kind parts of the reviews
reviews.zh: 只分享意见里的好话

reviews.en: Every reviewer praised the clinical setting. You read them those lines and keep the rest for the lab.
reviews.zh: 每位审稿人都夸了临床场景。你把这几句念给他们听，剩下的留着回组里吐槽。

reviews.en: Invite them to plan the resubmission
reviews.zh: 邀请他们一起规划重投

reviews.en: They bring a better scenario and two ideas you'd never have had. It costs a meeting a week, and the next version is stronger.
reviews.zh: 他们带来了一个更好的场景，还有两个你自己绝对想不到的点子。代价是每周多开一次会，但下一版确实更扎实了。

reviews.en: Cited, Rejected
reviews.zh: 被拒，被引

reviews.en: {paper} is rejected from {venue} on Tuesday. On Thursday, its arXiv version is cited twice. One of the citing papers calls it "seminal".
reviews.zh: 周二，{paper} 被 {venue} 拒了。周四，它的 arXiv 版本被引用了两次，其中一篇称它为“开创性工作”。

reviews.en: Let it make you feel better
reviews.zh: 拿这事安慰自己

reviews.en: Three reviewers said no, and two papers have cited it since. You decide the papers count more.
reviews.zh: 三位审稿人说不行，可转头就有两篇论文引用了它。你决定，论文说了算。

reviews.en: Update arXiv with the fixes
reviews.zh: 把修改更新到 arXiv

reviews.en: Version 2 goes up with the reviewers' fixes in it. It's the one people will cite from now on.
reviews.zh: 按审稿意见修改过的 v2 上线了。从今往后，大家引的就是这一版。

reviews.en: Screenshot it for {advisor}
reviews.zh: 截图发给 {advisor}

reviews.en: {advisor} replies with three exclamation marks, the most you've ever received.
reviews.zh: {advisor}回了三个感叹号，是你收到过最多的一次。

reviews.en: It's a Lottery Anyway
reviews.zh: 反正是买彩票

reviews.en: {labmate}, your co-author on {paper}, wants to resubmit it unchanged: "It's a lottery anyway. New reviewers, new numbers."
reviews.zh: {paper} 的合作者 {labmate} 想原样重投：“反正就是买彩票。换一批审稿人，换一组号码。”

reviews.en: Agree and buy another ticket
reviews.zh: 同意，再买一张彩票

reviews.en: You resubmit it with very little work. It is also exactly the paper three people just rejected.
reviews.zh: 你几乎没怎么改就重投了。只是，这也正是三个人刚刚拒掉的那篇论文。

reviews.en: Insist on fixing the concerns
reviews.zh: 坚持先改掉问题

reviews.en: {labmate} sighs and takes the related work. The new version is better, and you're both a bit tired of each other.
reviews.zh: {labmate} 叹了口气，接下了相关工作。新版本更好了，你俩也有点看对方不顺眼了。

reviews.en: Fix the two cheapest things
reviews.zh: 改两处最省事的

reviews.en: You fix Figure 2 and add one missing citation. It's slightly better than a lottery ticket.
reviews.zh: 你改了图 2，补了一条漏掉的引用。比一张彩票稍微强点。

reviews.en: Their First Rejection
reviews.zh: 人生第一次被拒

reviews.en: {paper} was {mentee}'s first paper; their name is second on it. They haven't seen the decision yet. You have to tell them.
reviews.zh: {paper} 是 {mentee} 的第一篇论文，署名排第二。审稿结果对方还没看到，得由你去说。

reviews.en: Tell them in person, with cookies
reviews.zh: 带上饼干当面说

reviews.en: {mentee} takes it well, eats three cookies and asks what to fix first.
reviews.zh: {mentee} 心态挺好，吃了三块饼干，就问先改哪里。

reviews.en: Forward the reviews with a long note
reviews.zh: 转发意见，附上长长的说明

reviews.en: Your note says which comments matter and which are noise. {mentee} saves it in a folder called "how this works".
reviews.zh: 你的说明写清了哪些意见要紧，哪些是噪声。{mentee} 把它存进了一个叫“原来是这么回事”的文件夹。

reviews.en: Ask {advisor} to tell them
reviews.zh: 请 {advisor}去说

reviews.en: {advisor} handles it kindly. {mentee} wonders, a little, why it wasn't you.
reviews.zh: {advisor}处理得很温和。{mentee} 心里有点纳闷，为什么不是你来说。

reviews.en: Add It. Now Remove It.
reviews.zh: 加上，再删掉

reviews.en: The new reviewers want Section 5 removed from {paper}. Last cycle's reviewers asked you to add Section 5. It took three weeks.
reviews.zh: 新一批审稿人要你删掉 {paper} 的第 5 节。可第 5 节正是上一轮审稿人要你加的，你为此花了三周。

reviews.en: Remove it
reviews.zh: 删掉

reviews.en: It took three weeks to write and three seconds to delete. The paper is tighter, and a little less convincing.
reviews.zh: 写了三周，删只要三秒。论文更紧凑了，说服力也差了一点。

reviews.en: Keep it and explain why
reviews.zh: 保留，并说明理由

reviews.en: Two sentences at the top of Section 5 say why it's there. Nobody will ask again, from either side.
reviews.zh: 你在第 5 节开头加了两句话，说明它为什么在这儿。之后哪边都没人再问了。

reviews.en: Your explanation ends up longer than the section. You trim both and lose an afternoon.
reviews.zh: 解释写得比这一节还长。你两边都删了删，搭进去一个下午。

reviews.en: Move it to the appendix
reviews.zh: 挪到附录

reviews.en: Section 5 lives on in Appendix C, where the people who want it can find it and nobody else has to.
reviews.zh: 第 5 节在附录 C 里继续活着。想看的人找得到，不想看的人不必看。

reviews.en: Too HCI, Too NLP
reviews.zh: 里外不是人

reviews.en: Last cycle, reviewers called {paper} "too HCI for this venue". This cycle, with nearly the same text, it's "too NLP for this venue".
reviews.zh: 上一轮，审稿人说 {paper}“对本会议来说太 HCI 了”。这一轮，内容几乎没变，评语变成了“对本会议来说太 NLP 了”。

reviews.en: Rewrite it for one community
reviews.zh: 只为一个圈子重写

reviews.en: You pick a side and cut what the other side loved. It hurts, and it reads better.
reviews.zh: 你选了一边，砍掉了另一边喜欢的内容。很痛，但读起来顺多了。

reviews.en: Aim for an interdisciplinary venue
reviews.zh: 改投交叉学科会议

reviews.en: You read a year of papers from a venue built for exactly this. Reviewers there might call it a bridge.
reviews.zh: 有个会议就是专门为这类工作办的，你把它近一年的论文读了一遍。那里的审稿人，也许会说你的论文是座桥梁。

reviews.en: Turn it into a position paper
reviews.zh: 改成立场论文

reviews.en: If nobody can tell which field it belongs to, maybe that's the argument. The paper gets bolder and easier to attack.
reviews.zh: 如果谁都说不清它属于哪个领域，也许这本身就是论点。论文更大胆了，也更容易挨批了。

reviews.en: Many Happy Returns
reviews.zh: 生日“快乐”

reviews.en: On your birthday, at 9 am and before the cake, {venue} rejects {paper}.
reviews.zh: 生日当天早上 9 点，蛋糕还没切，{venue} 拒了 {paper}。

reviews.en: Cake first, reviews tomorrow
reviews.zh: 先吃蛋糕，明天再看

reviews.en: You leave the laptop closed and have cake with your friends. The reviews will still be there tomorrow.
reviews.zh: 你没开电脑，和朋友们一起吃了蛋糕。反正审稿意见又不会跑，明天还在。

reviews.en: Read them now
reviews.zh: 现在就看

reviews.en: You read all three over breakfast. You know exactly what to fix, and exactly how to ruin a birthday.
reviews.zh: 你就着早饭读完了三份意见。现在你很清楚该改什么，也很清楚怎么毁掉一个生日。

reviews.en: Ask the lab never to mention it
reviews.zh: 让组里谁都别提

reviews.en: Nobody mentions it. {labmate} brings a cake that says "Happy Birthday" and, in very small letters, "R2 is wrong".
reviews.zh: 没人提。{labmate} 带来一个蛋糕，上面写着“生日快乐”，下面还有一行很小的字：“R2 错了”。

reviews.en: The New Reviewer
reviews.zh: 新来的审稿人

reviews.en: After a whole Revise and Resubmit, {paper} is rejected. The deciding review comes from someone who wasn't in the first round, with concerns nobody raised before.
reviews.zh: 熬完一整轮大修重投，{paper} 还是被拒了。起决定作用的那份意见，来自一位第一轮没参与的审稿人，提的问题以前谁都没提过。

reviews.en: Ask the chairs what happened
reviews.zh: 问程序主席怎么回事

reviews.en: The chairs explain that a first-round reviewer dropped out. They sound genuinely sorry, which helps a little.
reviews.zh: 程序主席解释说，第一轮有位审稿人退出了。他们听起来是真心抱歉，这多少有点安慰。

reviews.en: A polite reply says the process was followed. It was, and that's the problem.
reviews.zh: 一封客气的回复说，一切按流程办理。确实如此，问题就出在这儿。

reviews.en: Take it to a journal
reviews.zh: 转投期刊

reviews.en: A journal has room for the whole story, and reviewers who stay for every round. The paper gets longer, and calmer.
reviews.zh: 期刊有足够的篇幅讲完整个故事，审稿人也会陪你走完每一轮。论文变长了，也更从容了。

reviews.en: Revise once more for the next cycle
reviews.zh: 再改一版投下一轮

reviews.en: You answer the new concerns. The paper has now satisfied three sets of reviewers, at least on paper.
reviews.zh: 你回应了新的问题。这篇论文现在已经让三批审稿人满意了，至少纸面上是这样。

reviews.en: Emergency Reviewer Needed
reviews.zh: 急招审稿人

reviews.en: At 9 pm, an area chair writes: a reviewer dropped out, so could you possibly review one paper by noon tomorrow? "It's short," they add. It's 14 pages.
reviews.zh: 晚上 9 点，一位领域主席来信：有位审稿人退出了，能不能请你明天中午前审完一篇论文？还补了一句：“很短的。”论文有 14 页。

reviews.en: Say yes and do it properly
reviews.zh: 答应并认真审

reviews.en: You finish at 3 am. The area chair thanks you by name, which is the most an area chair can do.
reviews.zh: 你凌晨 3 点审完。领域主席点名感谢了你，这已经是领域主席能做的极限了。

reviews.en: Say yes, keep it short
reviews.zh: 答应，但写短点

reviews.en: You send a fair, short review at 11:58 am. Your best paragraph is about Figure 2.
reviews.zh: 你在上午 11:58 交了一份公道又简短的审稿意见，写得最好的一段是在说图 2。

reviews.en: Decline kindly
reviews.zh: 委婉拒绝

reviews.en: Someone else gets the email next. You sleep fine, mostly.
reviews.zh: 这封邮件转去找下一个人了。你睡得还算踏实，大概吧。

reviews.en: New Follower
reviews.zh: 新粉丝

reviews.en: A new follower on social media. Their latest post complains about "papers that ignore obvious baselines", in the exact words of the review that rejected your last paper.
reviews.zh: 社交媒体上多了一位新粉丝。对方最新一条帖子在吐槽“无视明显 baseline 的论文”，措辞和拒掉你上一篇论文的那份审稿意见一字不差。

reviews.en: Follow back
reviews.zh: 回关

reviews.en: They like your next paper thread within a minute. You wonder whether they know it's you.
reviews.zh: 你下一条论文宣传帖发出不到一分钟，对方就点了赞。你不禁琢磨，对方是不是知道是你。

reviews.en: Mute them
reviews.zh: 屏蔽对方

reviews.en: Your feed is calmer, and you stop reading their posts for clues.
reviews.zh: 时间线清静了，你也不再去对方的帖子里找线索了。

reviews.en: Post a thread about your baselines
reviews.zh: 发帖讲讲你的 baseline

reviews.en: The thread does well, and they like it. You will never know if they noticed.
reviews.zh: 帖子反响不错，对方也点了赞。对方到底有没有看出来，你永远不会知道。

reviews.en: The thread gets four likes. One is from them, which is somehow worse.
reviews.zh: 帖子只有四个赞，其中一个是对方点的。不知怎么的，这反而更难受了。

tasks.en: Every Author Reviews
tasks.zh: 投一送五

tasks.en: This cycle, {venue} asks every author to review too. Right after you submit {paper}, five papers land in your queue, due in three weeks.
tasks.zh: 这一轮 {venue} 规定每位作者都得审稿。你前脚刚投完 {paper}，后脚就有五篇论文进了你的待审列表，三周内交。

tasks.en: Do all five properly
tasks.zh: 认真审完五篇

tasks.en: Five careful reviews. You learn more about what makes a paper land than your own last three submissions taught you.
tasks.zh: 五篇都审得认认真真。论文怎样才能中，这五篇教你的比你自己投的前三篇还多。

tasks.en: Do them fast
tasks.zh: 火速审完

tasks.en: Five short reviews, on time. One is three sentences long. Somewhere, an area chair makes a note.
tasks.zh: 五篇短评，准时交差，其中一篇只有三句话。某位领域主席默默记在了小本本上。

tasks.en: Ask the chairs for a lighter load
tasks.zh: 请程序主席少分几篇

tasks.en: The chairs cut you to two, since you're a student. You do both properly and keep your evenings.
tasks.zh: 程序主席看你是学生，给你减到了两篇。你两篇都认真审完，晚上也没搭进去。

tasks.en: "Every author reviews five." Now you have five reviews and one slightly awkward email thread.
tasks.zh: “每位作者审五篇。”于是五篇照审，还多了一串略显尴尬的往来邮件。

tasks.en: Could You Take a First Pass?
tasks.zh: 你先帮我看看？

tasks.en: {advisor} forwards their own review assignment: "Could you take a first pass on these four?" The reviews are due in nine days.
tasks.zh: {advisor}把自己的审稿任务转给了你：“这四篇你先帮我看看？”九天后截止。

tasks.en: Write careful drafts
tasks.zh: 认真写好初稿

tasks.en: Four careful drafts. {advisor} submits them almost unchanged and says you have a good eye.
tasks.zh: 四份初稿写得扎扎实实。{advisor}几乎一字没改就交了，还夸你眼光毒。

tasks.en: Send short notes
tasks.zh: 只发几条要点

tasks.en: Four sets of bullet points, done in an evening. {advisor} writes the reviews from them, with a small sigh.
tasks.zh: 四份要点，一晚上就搞定了。{advisor}只好照着要点自己写完审稿意见，还轻轻叹了口气。

tasks.en: Ask to be listed as a sub-reviewer
tasks.zh: 请导师把你列为子审稿人

tasks.en: {advisor} adds your name. The conference thanks you by email, and two area chairs now know who you are.
tasks.zh: {advisor}把你的名字加上了。会议发来感谢邮件，两位领域主席从此也眼熟你了。

tasks.en: Bidding Season
tasks.zh: 审稿竞标季

tasks.en: Reviewer bidding is open: {roll:1600-2000} abstracts, bids due Thursday. The site shows 25 at a time and logs you out every hour.
tasks.zh: 审稿竞标开始了：{roll:1600-2000} 篇摘要，周四前标完。网站一页只显示 25 篇，还每小时把你踢下线一次，跟春运抢票有得一拼。

tasks.en: Read titles for an evening
tasks.zh: 花一晚上看标题

tasks.en: An evening of titles. You bid on eight papers you'd actually like to read, and spot two suspiciously close to yours.
tasks.zh: 看了一晚上标题。你标了八篇真心想读的，还发现两篇和你的工作疑似撞车。

tasks.en: Bid "eager" on everything in your topic
tasks.zh: 给本方向全标“非常想审”

tasks.en: Ten minutes of clicking. The system takes you at your word: you get your topic, and plenty of it.
tasks.zh: 点了十分钟。系统把你的话当了真：你分到的全是本方向的论文，而且管够。

tasks.en: Skip bidding and accept your fate
tasks.zh: 不标了，随缘吧

tasks.en: Your evening is free. Fate assigns you a 40-page theory paper and one about crop yields.
tasks.zh: 晚上倒是空出来了。缘分给你安排了一篇 40 页的理论论文，外加一篇研究水稻亩产的。

tasks.en: Too Short
tasks.zh: 太短了

tasks.en: The area chair writes: your review is "too short to help the authors". Could you expand it by Friday? It is four sentences. One is "The paper is fine."
tasks.zh: 领域主席来信说，你的审稿意见“太短，对作者没有帮助”，问能否在周五前补充一下。这份意见一共四句话，其中一句是“文章还行。”

tasks.en: Rewrite it properly
tasks.zh: 认真重写

tasks.en: You reread the paper and write a real review. The area chair thanks you by name in the discussion.
tasks.zh: 你重读了论文，写了一份像样的审稿意见。领域主席在讨论区点名表扬了你。

tasks.en: Add two paragraphs
tasks.zh: 硬凑两段

tasks.en: Two paragraphs of "the authors may wish to consider". It meets the length. The area chair replies "Thanks." with a period.
tasks.zh: 凑了两段“作者或可考虑”，字数达标。领域主席回了句“谢谢。”，带句号的那种。

tasks.en: Point out that the paper was short too
tasks.zh: 怼回去：论文也没多长

tasks.en: The area chair does not find this funny. You're left off next year's reviewer list, which you decide is a win.
tasks.zh: 领域主席并没有被逗笑。明年的审稿人名单上没你了，你寻思这波不亏。

tasks.en: Three Pings
tasks.zh: 连环催

tasks.en: Discussion period. The area chair has pinged you three times about the authors' response. It is 2,400 words long and has its own table of contents.
tasks.zh: 讨论期，领域主席已经第三次催你看作者回复了。回复 2400 词，还自带目录，妥妥的小作文。

tasks.en: Read it and engage
tasks.zh: 读完并参与讨论

tasks.en: The response is good, so you drop two of your three concerns. For once, the discussion goes somewhere.
tasks.zh: 回复写得不错，你撤回了三条意见里的两条。这次讨论总算讨论出了点东西。

tasks.en: Raise your score
tasks.zh: 直接加分了事

tasks.en: One click and the pings stop. You hope the response was as good as it was long.
tasks.zh: 点一下，世界清静了。但愿这份回复的质量配得上它的长度。

tasks.en: Reply "I maintain my score"
tasks.zh: 回复“维持原分”

tasks.en: Four words, sent. The area chair's next message to you is noticeably shorter than the first three.
tasks.zh: 四个字，发送。领域主席给你的下一条消息明显比前三条短。

tasks.en: Eight Months Later
tasks.zh: 八个月后

tasks.en: A journal sends the revised version of a paper you reviewed eight months ago, with a 30-page response to reviewers. You remember none of it.
tasks.zh: 八个月前你审过一篇期刊论文，现在修改稿来了，还附了 30 页的逐条回复。可这篇论文你已经忘得一干二净。

tasks.en: Reread both versions
tasks.zh: 重读两个版本

tasks.en: A full day with both PDFs side by side. The revision is much better, and your second review says so in detail.
tasks.zh: 你把两份 PDF 并排对着看了一整天。修改稿确实好了很多，你在第二轮意见里把好在哪儿一条条写清楚了。

tasks.en: Check only your old points
tasks.zh: 只核对自己当初的意见

tasks.en: All six of your points are answered, more or less. You recommend acceptance in an evening and feel only slightly guilty.
tasks.zh: 你提的六条意见，多多少少都回应了。你一晚上就给了接收建议，良心只痛了一下下。

tasks.en: Decline politely
tasks.zh: 礼貌婉拒

tasks.en: The editor replies within a minute. They'll find someone new, who will ask for everything you already asked for.
tasks.zh: 编辑秒回，说会另找一位审稿人。新来的审稿人会把你提过的要求从头再提一遍。

tasks.en: Question 3
tasks.zh: 第 3 题

tasks.en: Halfway through grading, you notice the answer key is wrong on question 3. You have already graded {roll:50-70} exams with it.
tasks.zh: 改卷改到一半，你发现第 3 题的标准答案是错的，而你已经照着它改了 {roll:50-70} 份试卷。人麻了。

tasks.en: Regrade everything
tasks.zh: 全部重改

tasks.en: You regrade every exam. Not one regrade request arrives, and the professor asks for you as TA next year.
tasks.zh: 你把每份试卷都重改了一遍。结果一份复核申请都没收到，任课教授还点名要你明年继续当助教。

tasks.en: Accept both answers
tasks.zh: 两种答案都算对

tasks.en: Everyone gets the points. The class average goes up, and so do the regrade requests on question 4.
tasks.zh: 人人都拿到了分。班级平均分涨了，第 4 题的复核申请也跟着涨了。

tasks.en: Tell the professor and let them decide
tasks.zh: 上报教授，让教授拍板

tasks.en: The professor thanks you and drops question 3 entirely. You spend a long evening redoing every total.
tasks.zh: 任课教授谢过你，直接把第 3 题作废了。于是你花了一整晚，把每份试卷的总分重算了一遍。

tasks.en: Everyone Did 40%
tasks.zh: 人人都干了 40%

tasks.en: Group peer evaluations are in. Every member of every group says they did 40% of the work. One group of four adds up to 160%.
tasks.zh: 小组互评交上来了。每组的每个人都说自己干了 40% 的活，有个四人小组加起来足足 160%。

tasks.en: Read the commit histories
tasks.zh: 翻 commit 记录

tasks.en: A day in the git logs. They tell a clearer story, including one 3 am commit titled "fixed everyone's stuff".
tasks.zh: 你在 git 日志里泡了一天。日志可比互评老实多了，比如凌晨 3 点有一条 commit：“把所有人的坑都填了”。

tasks.en: Give each group one grade
tasks.zh: 每组统一给分

tasks.en: Three students email to say it's unfair, and each of them is a little bit right.
tasks.zh: 三个学生发邮件喊不公平，而且每个人都有那么一点道理。

tasks.en: Meet the three most confusing groups
tasks.zh: 约谈最说不清的三个组

tasks.en: Three meetings, three versions of every story. By the third, you could referee anything.
tasks.zh: 三次面谈，每件事都有三个版本。谈到第三组时，你已经能去居委会调解纠纷了。

tasks.en: Hard but Fair
tasks.zh: 有难度，但要公平

tasks.en: The professor asks you to write the midterm. "Just two questions. Hard but fair." The exam is in nine days.
tasks.zh: 任课教授让你出期中考试题：“两道就行，有难度，但要公平。”九天后考试。

tasks.en: Write new questions
tasks.zh: 出新题

tasks.en: Two new questions, each solved three ways. You understand the material better than when you took the course.
tasks.zh: 两道新题，每道都用三种方法解了一遍。你对这门课的理解比当年自己上课时还透彻。

tasks.en: Adapt last year's
tasks.zh: 改改去年的题

tasks.en: You change the numbers and the variable names. One student finishes in twelve minutes; their roommate took the course last year.
tasks.zh: 你换了数字和变量名，换汤不换药。有个学生十二分钟就交了卷，原来这位同学的室友去年刚上过这门课。

tasks.en: Borrow from the textbook
tasks.zh: 从课本上搬题

tasks.en: Done in an hour. Eleven students recognize problem 4.7, the average is 96%, and the professor asks you to write a makeup.
tasks.zh: 一小时搞定。结果十一个学生认出了这是课本习题 4.7，平均分 96%，任课教授只好让你再出一份补考卷。

tasks.en: 8 am, Saturday
tasks.zh: 周六早八

tasks.en: You're proctoring the 8 am Saturday final: 140 students in a silent gym for three hours, under a wall clock that runs four minutes fast.
tasks.zh: 你负责周六早八的期末监考：140 个学生在鸦雀无声的体育馆里坐三个小时，墙上的钟还快了四分钟。

tasks.en: Proctor and grade in the room
tasks.zh: 边监考边改卷

tasks.en: You grade forty exams between whispered questions about question 2. That's a day of grading you won't have to do later.
tasks.zh: 学生一次次小声问第 2 题，你趁着间隙改完了四十份卷子，回头能少改一整天。

tasks.en: Swap with another TA
tasks.zh: 和别的助教换班

tasks.en: They take your Saturday. You take their Monday review session, and they've already told the students you're great.
tasks.zh: 对方替你监周六的考，你替对方上周一的复习课。对方还提前跟学生把你夸上了天。

tasks.en: Bring coffee for the whole room
tasks.zh: 给全场带咖啡

tasks.en: You wheel in 140 coffees, and it's the calmest final you've ever seen. Several students write "thanks for the coffee" on their exams.
tasks.zh: 你推着 140 杯咖啡进了场，这是你见过最平静的一场期末考。好几个学生在卷子上写了“谢谢你的咖啡”。

tasks.en: Moving Day
tasks.zh: 人肉搬运

tasks.en: The course switches to a new website mid-semester. Someone has to move fourteen weeks of slides, quizzes and due dates. You are someone.
tasks.zh: 学期过半，课程要换新网站。得有人把十四周的课件、小测和截止日期搬过去。这个“有人”就是你。

tasks.en: Do it carefully
tasks.zh: 仔细搬

tasks.en: It takes a full day of copying and checking. Every due date is right, and no student will ever notice.
tasks.zh: 复制、核对，花了整整一天。每个截止日期都对得上，只是不会有一个学生注意到。

tasks.en: Move only what's due this month
tasks.zh: 只搬本月要用的

tasks.en: Done by dinner. Next month you'll do it again, with less memory of how.
tasks.zh: 晚饭前搞定。下个月还得再搬一次，到时候你已经忘了怎么搬。

tasks.en: Write a script for it
tasks.zh: 写个脚本来搬

tasks.en: Your script moves everything in eleven minutes. You spend the rest of the day showing it to people.
tasks.zh: 脚本十一分钟就全搬完了。剩下的一整天，你逢人就炫这个脚本。

tasks.en: The script moves everything and sets every due date to January 1, 1970. You fix them by hand.
tasks.zh: 脚本把所有东西都搬了过去，顺便把每个截止日期都设成了 1970 年 1 月 1 日。你只好手动一个个改。

tasks.en: As an AI Language Model
tasks.zh: 作为一个 AI 语言模型

tasks.en: A student's essay begins with the words "As an AI language model". The rest is very confident and about a different book.
tasks.zh: 有个学生的作业开头就是“作为一个 AI 语言模型”。后面一本正经地胡说八道，讲的还是另一本书。

tasks.en: Fill in the six-page integrity form
tasks.zh: 填六页的学术诚信表

tasks.en: The form takes six pages and a flowchart. The professor is impressed, and the office asks you to redo it on a newer template.
tasks.zh: 这张表有六页，还附一张流程图。任课教授很佩服，诚信办公室却让你用新版模板重填一遍。

tasks.en: Talk to the student first
tasks.zh: 先找学生谈谈

tasks.en: They turn red and rewrite it by Friday. The new essay is messier, and clearly theirs.
tasks.zh: 学生的脸一下子红了，周五前就交了重写版。新作业乱是乱了点，但一看就是自己写的。

tasks.en: Forward it to the professor
tasks.zh: 转给任课老师

tasks.en: The professor takes it from here, with a sigh you can hear through email.
tasks.zh: 任课教授接手了，隔着邮件你都能听见那声叹气。

tasks.en: A Letter From Their TA
tasks.zh: 助教的推荐信

tasks.en: A student from your section asks you for a recommendation letter for a summer research program. It's due in a week. You remember their name, and that they sat by the window.
tasks.zh: 你带的讨论课上有个学生请你写推荐信，申请暑期科研项目，一周后截止。你只记得名字，还有这位同学总坐窗边的主角位。

tasks.en: Write a warm, specific letter
tasks.zh: 写一封具体又温暖的信

tasks.en: You dig up their assignments and office-hours questions. The letter is specific and kind, and in April they get in.
tasks.zh: 你翻出了这个学生的作业，还有在答疑时间问过的问题。信写得具体又真诚，四月份，对方被录取了。

tasks.en: Offer a short one
tasks.zh: 说只能写封短的

tasks.en: Three honest sentences. They thank you politely and ask the professor too, just in case.
tasks.zh: 三句实话。学生礼貌地道了谢，为保险起见又去找了任课教授。

tasks.en: Suggest they ask the professor
tasks.zh: 建议去找任课教授

tasks.en: They do. The professor agrees, then asks you for "a few notes on the student". You write the notes.
tasks.zh: 学生去了。任课教授答应了，转头找你要“几条关于这个学生的要点”。兜兜转转，还是你写。

tasks.en: You're Up in an Hour
tasks.zh: 一小时后救场

tasks.en: Today's lab meeting presenter cancels. {advisor} messages: "{player}, could you present instead?" Lab meeting is in an hour.
tasks.zh: 今天组会的报告人临时鸽了。{advisor}发来消息：“{player}，你能顶一下吗？”组会一小时后开始。

tasks.en: Show your messy results honestly
tasks.zh: 如实展示乱糟糟的结果

tasks.en: Half the plots have no axis labels. The lab spots a bug you'd have found in three weeks, and {advisor} likes the honesty.
tasks.zh: 一半的图连坐标轴标签都没有。但组里帮你揪出了一个你本来要三周后才会发现的 bug，{advisor}也很欣赏你的坦诚。

tasks.en: Present a paper you read last week
tasks.zh: 讲上周读的论文

tasks.en: You remember most of it. For the parts you don't, {labmate} jumps in, kindly.
tasks.zh: 大部分你还记得。忘了的部分，{labmate} 很贴心地帮你补上了。

tasks.en: Run a brainstorm instead
tasks.zh: 改成头脑风暴

tasks.en: A wall of sticky notes produces one good idea. Nobody notices you prepared nothing, except {advisor}.
tasks.zh: 便利贴贴满了一墙，最后憋出一个好想法。没人发现你根本没准备，除了 {advisor}。

tasks.en: One Slide, Two Hours
tasks.zh: 一页 PPT，两小时

tasks.en: The department open house for admitted students needs one slide about your research, in two hours. The required template is purple.
tasks.zh: 系里给录取生办访校日，要你做一页 PPT 介绍研究，两小时内交。指定模板还是紫色的。

tasks.en: Make one clean slide
tasks.zh: 做一页清爽的

tasks.en: You use one figure and one sentence. It's the best slide you've ever made, and it takes the whole afternoon.
tasks.zh: 一张图，一句话。这是你做过最好的一页 PPT，也花掉了你整整一下午。

tasks.en: Reuse your last title slide
tasks.zh: 拿上次的标题页凑数

tasks.en: It shows your name and last year's date. An admitted student asks what your research is about, and the slide does not say.
tasks.zh: 上面只有你的名字和去年的日期。有个录取生问你研究什么，这页 PPT 答不上来。

tasks.en: Use one striking figure, no words
tasks.zh: 只放一张抓眼球的图

tasks.en: Admitted students crowd around it, asking what it means. You explain it eleven times, happily.
tasks.zh: 录取生们围过来问这是什么意思。你兴高采烈地讲了十一遍。

tasks.en: Admitted students crowd around it, asking what it means. So does {advisor}.
tasks.zh: 录取生们围过来问这是什么意思。{advisor}也凑过来问了。

tasks.en: The Dean's Tour
tasks.zh: 院长视察

tasks.en: The dean tours the building tomorrow, and {advisor} has promised a live demo of {project}. It has not run since Tuesday.
tasks.zh: 院长明天来楼里视察，{advisor}已经答应现场演示 {project}。可 demo 从周二起就一次没跑通过。

tasks.en: Polish it tonight
tasks.zh: 今晚连夜修好

tasks.en: It runs, and the dean says "fascinating" twice. You got three hours of sleep.
tasks.zh: 跑起来了，院长连说两遍“太有意思了”。代价是你只睡了三个小时。

tasks.en: Record a backup video
tasks.zh: 录个备用视频

tasks.en: The live demo crashes in the first minute. The video plays perfectly, and the dean never knows.
tasks.zh: 现场演示第一分钟就翻车了。好在视频放得很顺，院长全程都没发现。

tasks.en: Show slides instead
tasks.zh: 改放 PPT

tasks.en: The dean nods politely and asks to see "the real thing" next time. {advisor} winces.
tasks.zh: 院长礼貌地点点头，说下次想看看“真东西”。{advisor}在一旁表情一僵。

tasks.en: Your Two Buddies
tasks.zh: 你的两个学伴

tasks.en: The department assigns you two first-year "buddies". They message you about the cluster every day, often at the same time, about different errors.
tasks.zh: 系里给你分了两个一年级“学伴”。他们每天都来问你集群的事，经常同时发来，报的还是不同的错。

tasks.en: Hold a weekly Q&A
tasks.zh: 每周开一次答疑会

tasks.en: Thursdays at 4, with snacks. By week three, first-years you've never met start showing up.
tasks.zh: 每周四下午 4 点，管零食。到第三周，连你没见过的一年级新生都来了。

tasks.en: Answer every message
tasks.zh: 秒回每条消息

tasks.en: You reply within minutes, every time, and they adore you. Your own jobs sit in the queue, untouched.
tasks.zh: 你每次都几分钟内回复，他们爱死你了。可你自己的任务还在队列里吃灰。

tasks.en: Point them to the docs
tasks.zh: 让他们去看文档

tasks.en: There are no docs. They find this out on their own, and stop asking you anything, including to lunch.
tasks.zh: 根本没有文档。他们自己发现了这一点，从此再也不找你了，饭也不约了。

tasks.en: The Eleventh Time
tasks.zh: 第十一次

tasks.en: Eleven people asked you the same cluster question this month. Three of them were the same person.
tasks.zh: 这个月已经有十一个人问过你同一个集群问题，其中三个是同一个人。

tasks.en: Write the onboarding doc
tasks.zh: 写一份入门文档

tasks.en: It takes a full day and twelve screenshots. The questions stop, and the lab treats you like a hero.
tasks.zh: 花了一整天，截了十二张图。再也没人来问了，组里把你奉为大神。

tasks.en: Record a ten-minute video
tasks.zh: 录一个十分钟的视频

tasks.en: Four takes. People watch it at double speed and still ask you, but less often.
tasks.zh: 录了四遍。大家开 2 倍速看完，还是会来问你，不过少多了。

tasks.en: Pin your best Slack answer
tasks.zh: 把最好的 Slack 回答置顶

tasks.en: Nobody reads pinned messages. Questions twelve through fifteen arrive by Friday.
tasks.zh: 没人看置顶消息。到周五，第十二到第十五次提问如期而至。

tasks.en: Only You Know
tasks.zh: 只有你知道

tasks.en: A new postdoc needs access to the data server, and only you know how the permissions work. You set them up two years ago, at night, and wrote nothing down.
tasks.zh: 新来的博士后要开数据服务器的权限，而只有你知道权限是怎么配的。那是你两年前某个深夜配的，什么也没记下来。

tasks.en: Walk them through it
tasks.zh: 手把手带着配

tasks.en: A day of user groups and one mysterious file called keys_old. They're in, and they owe you lunch.
tasks.zh: 你们折腾了一天用户组，还有一个叫 keys_old 的神秘文件。权限总算开通了，博士后欠你一顿饭。

tasks.en: Write it down this time
tasks.zh: 这次把步骤写下来

tasks.en: It takes longer than just doing it. But the next person won't need you, and neither will future you.
tasks.zh: 比直接配要花更久。但下一个人就不用找你了，未来的你也不用。

tasks.en: Send them to IT
tasks.zh: 让对方去找 IT

tasks.en: IT opens a ticket. The ticket opens another ticket. The postdoc gets access in three weeks and remembers who sent them.
tasks.zh: IT 开了一张工单，工单又开了一张工单，开始套娃。三周后博士后才拿到权限，也记住了是谁把自己推给 IT 的。

tasks.en: Three High Schoolers
tasks.zh: 三个高中生

tasks.en: A summer outreach program sends you three high schoolers for a week. They're thrilled to be here, and one of them has already read your paper.
tasks.zh: 暑期科普项目给你派来三个高中生，待一周。他们兴奋极了，其中一个甚至已经读过你的论文。

tasks.en: Give them a mini project
tasks.zh: 给他们一个小项目

tasks.en: By Friday they've built a tiny classifier and a slide deck with spinning transitions. You're prouder than you expected.
tasks.zh: 到周五，他们做出了一个迷你分类器，还有一份全是旋转转场的 PPT。你的嘴角压都压不住，没想到自己会这么骄傲。

tasks.en: Let them test your prototype
tasks.zh: 让他们测你的原型

tasks.en: They break it four new ways in one afternoon, which is free user testing.
tasks.zh: 一个下午，他们就用四种新方法把原型弄坏了，相当于免费做了一轮用户测试。

tasks.en: Show them lab life, snacks included
tasks.zh: 带他们体验实验室生活，零食管够

tasks.en: You give them a tour and a lot of snacks. One of them decides grad school looks "chill", and you don't correct them.
tasks.zh: 你带他们参观了一圈，又塞了一堆零食。其中一个觉得读博看起来挺“松弛”的，你没忍心纠正。

tasks.en: A Photo of a Receipt
tasks.zh: 报销渡劫

tasks.en: Your travel reimbursement is rejected. The receipt is a photo of a receipt, in another currency, partly covered by your thumb.
tasks.zh: 你的差旅报销被财务打回来了。你交的是一张收据的照片，外币的，还被你的大拇指挡住了一角。

tasks.en: Find the original
tasks.zh: 找原件

tasks.en: You empty every bag you own and find it folded inside your boarding pass. Approved in a week.
tasks.zh: 你把所有包都翻了个底朝天，最后发现原件折好夹在登机牌里。一周后报销批了。

tasks.en: Fill in the "missing receipt" form
tasks.zh: 填“收据遗失”申请表

tasks.en: The form is four pages long and includes a signed statement about a sandwich. Approved in six weeks.
tasks.zh: 表足足四页，还包括一份关于某个三明治的签字声明。六周后才批下来。

tasks.en: Let the $43 go
tasks.zh: 放弃那 43 刀

tasks.en: No more forms. It's instant noodles for the rest of the week.
tasks.zh: 不用再填表了，代价是这周剩下几天顿顿泡面。

tasks.en: Eight Modules by Friday
tasks.zh: 周五前学完八个模块

tasks.en: The annual research-ethics refresher is due Friday: eight modules with quizzes, or your study approval is paused.
tasks.zh: 年度科研伦理培训周五截止：八个模块，每个都带小测，没学完就暂停你的研究审批。

tasks.en: Do it properly
tasks.zh: 认真学完

tasks.en: You get the certificate and learn two things you probably should have known already.
tasks.zh: 你拿到了证书，还学到两件你早该知道的事。

tasks.en: Click through at double speed
tasks.zh: 开 2 倍速刷完

tasks.en: All eight quizzes passed at double speed. The narrator sounded like a chipmunk, but a well-informed one.
tasks.zh: 开着 2 倍速，八个小测全过了。旁白尖得像小黄人，不过是个很有学问的小黄人。

tasks.en: You fail the module 6 quiz three times, then rewatch it twice at normal speed.
tasks.zh: 第 6 个模块的小测你挂了三次，已老实，用 1 倍速又看了两遍。

tasks.en: Do it during lab meeting
tasks.zh: 组会上偷偷刷

tasks.en: You pass all eight modules. {advisor} asks you a question twice and gets no answer either time.
tasks.zh: 八个模块全过了。只是 {advisor}问了你两次问题，你两次都没吭声。

tasks.en: In Ink
tasks.zh: 必须手签

tasks.en: Your plan-of-study form needs {advisor}'s signature, in ink, by the 15th. {advisor} is traveling for the next two weeks.
tasks.zh: 你的培养计划表 15 号前要交，必须有 {advisor}用墨水笔亲手签的名。可 {advisor}接下来两周都在出差。

tasks.en: Mail it to their hotel
tasks.zh: 寄到导师住的酒店

tasks.en: It comes back signed, with a coffee ring and a doodle of the hotel pool. You refreshed the tracking page forty times.
tasks.zh: 表签好寄回来了，上面多了一圈咖啡渍，还有一幅酒店泳池的涂鸦。为了等它，物流页面你刷新了四十次。

tasks.en: Ask the grad office about e-signatures
tasks.zh: 问研究生院能否电子签名

tasks.en: The office says e-signatures have been fine for years. Nobody told the form, but it's done in an hour.
tasks.zh: 研究生院说电子签名早就可以了，只是没人告诉这张表。一小时就办完了。

tasks.en: Three emails later: e-signatures are accepted on every form except this one.
tasks.zh: 三封邮件之后得到答复：所有表格都接受电子签名，除了这一张。

tasks.en: Wait for them to come back
tasks.zh: 等导师回来

tasks.en: You file it two weeks late. The grad office sends a reminder with three exclamation marks and puts a hold on your registration.
tasks.zh: 你晚交了两周。研究生院发来一封带三个感叹号的提醒，还冻结了你的选课权限。

tasks.en: Nobody's Monitors
tasks.zh: 无主显示器

tasks.en: Equipment inventory: every monitor in the lab needs a tag. You find three that belong to nobody, according to every list you check.
tasks.zh: 设备盘点：实验室每台显示器都要贴资产标签。结果有三台，你查遍了所有清单都找不到主人。

tasks.en: Report them
tasks.zh: 上报

tasks.en: Two forms and a call with Facilities. The department thanks {advisor} for the lab's "exemplary" inventory.
tasks.zh: 两张表，外加一通和后勤处的电话。系里专门感谢了 {advisor}，说实验室的资产盘点“堪为表率”。

tasks.en: Adopt one as your second screen
tasks.zh: 领养一台当副屏

tasks.en: Papers on the left, code on the right. {labmate} had been eyeing that monitor for a year.
tasks.zh: 左边看论文，右边写代码。只是 {labmate} 已经惦记这台显示器一整年了。

tasks.en: Tag them to the lab and move on
tasks.zh: 全挂到实验室名下，翻篇

tasks.en: Three stickers later, the lab officially owns three monitors nobody can explain.
tasks.zh: 贴了三张标签，实验室正式喜提三台来历不明的显示器。

tasks.en: Your Plan Expires Friday
tasks.zh: 你的套餐周五到期

tasks.en: Your survey tool's subscription ends on Friday, in the middle of the study for {project}. The renewal email says "Act now!" in three colors.
tasks.zh: 你用的问卷工具订阅周五到期，而 {project} 的研究正做到一半。续费邮件用三种颜色写着“立即续费！”

tasks.en: Pay out of pocket
tasks.zh: 自掏腰包

tasks.en: $240, and the study runs on. You file for reimbursement and try not to think about how that will go.
tasks.zh: 240 刀，研究继续。你提交了报销，尽量不去想它能不能报下来。

tasks.en: Move to the university's free tool
tasks.zh: 换成学校的免费工具

tasks.en: A day rebuilding every question in an interface from another decade. The data comes out in a slightly different format.
tasks.zh: 你花了一天，在一个画风停在十几年前的界面里把每道题重建了一遍。导出的数据格式还跟原来有点不一样。

tasks.en: Ask the department for funds
tasks.zh: 向系里申请经费

tasks.en: The department covers it from a fund nobody knew existed. You make a note of the fund.
tasks.zh: 系里从一笔谁都不知道的经费里出了这笔钱。你默默把这笔经费记了下来。

tasks.en: The reply arrives after the subscription ends. The study pauses for two weeks.
tasks.zh: 等回复来的时候，订阅已经过期了，研究只好停了两周。

tasks.en: Forty Signatures
tasks.zh: 四十个签名

tasks.en: Finance needs a signed receipt for each of the 40 gift cards you gave participants in {project}. The participants are now all over the country.
tasks.zh: 你在 {project} 里给参与者发了 40 张礼品卡，财务处要每张都有签收单。可这些参与者现在散落在全国各地。

tasks.en: Email all 40
tasks.zh: 给 40 个人挨个发邮件

tasks.en: Forty emails, then forty reminders. By Friday you have 34 signatures and six people who think it's a scam.
tasks.zh: 四十封邮件，再加四十封催促。到周五，你收回了 34 个签名，还有六个人认定这是诈骗，反诈意识拉满。

tasks.en: Build a sign-off form
tasks.zh: 做一个在线签收表

tasks.en: You build a two-minute form with a signature box, and 38 people sign within a day. You will reuse it forever.
tasks.zh: 你做了一个两分钟就能填完、带签名框的表单，一天之内就有 38 个人签了。这个表单你会用一辈子。

tasks.en: The form works, but its emails go straight to spam. You find out a week later.
tasks.zh: 表单能用，可它发出的邮件全进了垃圾箱。你一周后才发现。

tasks.en: Ask for an exception
tasks.zh: 申请特殊处理

tasks.en: Finance approves it, after a two-page memo and a meeting {advisor} has to attend. {advisor} is not thrilled.
tasks.zh: 财务处批了，代价是一份两页的说明，外加一场 {advisor}必须出席的会。{advisor}不太高兴。

tasks.en: Numbers You Never Tracked
tasks.zh: 你从没记过的数字

tasks.en: The IRB's annual check-in for {project} is due in a week. It asks how many people you enrolled each month. You never tracked that.
tasks.zh: {project} 的伦理审查（IRB）年度复查一周后截止。表上要填每个月招募了多少人，可你从来没记过。

tasks.en: Rebuild them from your calendar
tasks.zh: 翻日历还原数字

tasks.en: A day with your calendar and old emails. The numbers are exact, and you find two sessions you forgot to analyze.
tasks.zh: 对着日历和旧邮件折腾了一天。数字分毫不差，你还发现了两场忘了分析的实验。

tasks.en: Estimate honestly and say so
tasks.zh: 如实估算并注明

tasks.en: "About 30, exact months unclear." The IRB accepts it, with a polite request to keep a log from now on.
tasks.zh: “约 30 人，具体月份不详。”伦理审查委员会接受了，还礼貌地提醒你今后记好台账。

tasks.en: Ask for a week's extension
tasks.zh: 申请延期一周

tasks.en: Granted. The new due date lands in your busiest week, and the numbers are still untracked.
tasks.zh: 批了。新的截止日期正好落在你最忙的那周，而那些数字还是一笔糊涂账。

tasks.en: Approved Servers Only
tasks.zh: 仅限指定服务器

tasks.en: A new data policy: all study data must move to the approved server by Friday. Yours lives on four machines, two drives and a laptop you stopped using.
tasks.zh: 新数据政策：所有研究数据必须在周五前迁到指定服务器。你的数据分散在四台机器、两块硬盘，还有一台你早就不用的笔记本上。

tasks.en: Move it carefully
tasks.zh: 小心迁移

tasks.en: A day of copying and checking. For the first time since Year 1, all your data is in one place.
tasks.zh: 复制加核对，花了一天。自博一以来，你的数据第一次全家团圆。

tasks.en: Move it and hope the paths still work
tasks.zh: 直接迁，祈祷路径别坏

tasks.en: Moved by noon, and every path still works. You don't trust it, but it works.
tasks.zh: 中午前就迁完了，所有路径居然都还能用。你心里不踏实，但它就是能用。

tasks.en: Moved by noon. By Wednesday, every script you own fails with "file not found".
tasks.zh: 中午前就迁完了。可到了周三，你所有的脚本都报“file not found”。

tasks.en: Ask for an extension
tasks.zh: 申请延期

tasks.en: Granted, until the end of the month. The data office copies {advisor} on its reply.
tasks.zh: 批了，延到月底。数据办公室回复时抄送了 {advisor}。

tasks.en: You Know Your Work Best
tasks.zh: 你最了解自己的工作

tasks.en: {advisor} asks you to draft your own recommendation letter. "You know your work best." You have never once called yourself "exceptional".
tasks.zh: {advisor}让你自己起草推荐信。“你最了解自己的工作。”你这辈子还从没说过自己“出类拔萃”。

tasks.en: Write it honestly
tasks.zh: 实事求是地写

tasks.en: Your draft is accurate and a bit modest. {advisor} adds two sentences that make you blush.
tasks.zh: 你的草稿写得很准确，就是有点谦虚。{advisor}添了两句，看得你脸都红了。

tasks.en: Write it boldly
tasks.zh: 大胆夸自己

tasks.en: "Among the top 1% of students I have known." {advisor} tones it down to 5%, still the nicest thing anyone has said about you.
tasks.zh: “在我认识的学生中位列前 1%。”{advisor}改成了前 5%，这依然是你听过最好听的一句夸奖。

tasks.en: Swap drafting duty with {labmate}
tasks.zh: 和 {labmate} 互写

tasks.en: You write theirs; they write yours. Both letters glow, and {advisor} notices they share every adjective.
tasks.zh: 你写对方的，对方写你的，商业互吹。两封信都夸得天花乱坠，{advisor}发现两封信的形容词一模一样。

tasks.en: A Supporting Note
tasks.zh: 一份补充说明

tasks.en: {mentee} is applying to grad school and asks you for a "supporting note" that {advisor} can use in their letter. It's due in five days.
tasks.zh: {mentee} 在申请读研，请你写一份“补充说明”，好让 {advisor}写推荐信时参考。五天后要。

tasks.en: Write a detailed note
tasks.zh: 写份详细的

tasks.en: Two pages on everything {mentee} did. {advisor} uses half of it word for word.
tasks.zh: 两页纸，写满了 {mentee} 做过的所有事。{advisor}原封不动地用了一半。

tasks.en: Send bullet points
tasks.zh: 列几条要点

tasks.en: Five bullet points. {advisor} follows up with three questions, each in its own email.
tasks.zh: 五条要点。{advisor}又追问了三个问题，一个问题一封邮件。

tasks.en: Help them ask {advisor} directly
tasks.zh: 鼓励对方直接找 {advisor}

tasks.en: {mentee} asks {advisor} themselves, nervously. It's good practice, and you can tell they hoped you'd do it.
tasks.zh: {mentee} 紧张兮兮地自己去找了 {advisor}。这是很好的锻炼，不过看得出来，对方本来希望你出面。

tasks.en: Three Signatures
tasks.zh: 集齐三个签名

tasks.en: The annual progress report needs a committee meeting and three signatures by the end of the month. Your committee has three calendars and no overlap.
tasks.zh: 年度进展报告要求月底前开一次委员会会议，再拿到三个签名。你的委员会有三份日程表，交集为空。

tasks.en: Get everyone in one room
tasks.zh: 把所有人凑到一起

tasks.en: It takes eleven emails and a 7:30 am slot. The meeting turns out to be useful, and {committee} has a great idea for your next project.
tasks.zh: 来回十一封邮件，才约到早上 7:30 的一个时段。会开得出奇地有用，{committee}还为你的下个项目出了个好主意。

tasks.en: Collect signatures by email
tasks.zh: 发邮件收签名

tasks.en: Three signatures in three weeks, plus one reply that just says "signed (where?)".
tasks.zh: 三周收齐三个签名，外加一封只写着“已签（签哪儿？）”的回复。

tasks.en: Ask the grad office for more time
tasks.zh: 找研究生院延期

tasks.en: They give you another month. The report moves onto next month's to-do list, and so does the dread.
tasks.zh: 研究生院又给了你一个月。这份报告挪进了下个月的待办清单，那份焦虑也跟着挪了过去。

tasks.en: Nine Goals
tasks.zh: 九个 flag

tasks.en: The progress report asks you to compare last year's goals with what happened. You set nine goals. You met two, and did seven other things.
tasks.zh: 进展报告要你对比去年定的目标和实际情况。去年你立了九个 flag，实现了两个，另外还干了七件别的事。

tasks.en: Report it straight
tasks.zh: 如实汇报

tasks.en: Two met, seven changed, each with a reason. {advisor} appreciates the honesty and suggests fewer goals, chosen better.
tasks.zh: 完成两个，调整七个，每个都附上原因。{advisor}欣赏你的坦诚，建议你以后少立几个，但要挑得准一点。

tasks.en: Turn the seven into a story
tasks.zh: 把那七件事编成故事

tasks.en: Read in order, the seven other things look like a plan. You almost believe it yourself.
tasks.zh: 按顺序读下来，那七件事简直像是早有规划。连你自己都快信了。

tasks.en: {committee} asks how goal 4 led to project 7. It didn't, and now everyone knows.
tasks.zh: {committee}问目标 4 是怎么引出项目 7 的。答案是没有，这下大家都知道了。

tasks.en: Edit last year's goals to match
tasks.zh: 改去年的目标来对上号

tasks.en: Last year's goals now describe this year perfectly. {advisor} still has the original and says nothing.
tasks.zh: 去年的目标现在和今年的情况完美吻合。{advisor}手里还留着原版，只是什么都没说。

tasks.en: Expected Graduation
tasks.zh: 预计毕业时间

tasks.en: A form asks for your expected graduation date. You and {advisor} fill in your parts separately, and write different years.
tasks.zh: 一张表要填预计毕业时间。你和 {advisor}各填各的，结果写的年份不一样。

tasks.en: Talk it through
tasks.zh: 好好谈一谈
