tasks.en: After an hour on the next two years, you leave with a plan and a date. Your heart beats a little faster.
tasks.zh: 你们聊了一小时接下来两年的安排，你带着一份计划和一个日期走出办公室，心跳有点快。

tasks.en: Use your advisor's year
tasks.zh: 填导师写的年份

tasks.en: You write the later year. Now it's on an official form, which makes it feel very real.
tasks.zh: 你写了更晚的那一年。这个年份白纸黑字地进了正式表格，一下子变得特别真实。

tasks.en: Write a range
tasks.zh: 写一个范围

tasks.en: "Spring or fall, this year or next." The grad office accepts it. {advisor} raises an eyebrow.
tasks.zh: “春季或秋季，今年或明年。”研究生院收下了。{advisor}挑了挑眉。

tasks.en: Just a Few Calls
tasks.zh: 就开几次会

tasks.en: A friend from another lab asks you to co-organize a workshop at next year's conference. "It'll be fun! Just a few calls."
tasks.zh: 别的实验室的朋友邀你一起在明年的会议上办一个 workshop。“会很好玩的！就开几次线上会。”

tasks.en: Say yes
tasks.zh: 答应

tasks.en: It is many calls, plus a call for papers and a keynote speaker who replies once a month. Everyone learns your name.
tasks.zh: 说好的几次会，开了一次又一次。还得发征稿通知，请来的特邀讲者一个月才回一封邮件。好在大家都记住了你的名字。

tasks.en: Offer to run just the website
tasks.zh: 只负责网站

tasks.en: The site takes one evening. Your name goes on the organizer list anyway.
tasks.zh: 网站一个晚上就搭好了。你的名字照样进了组织者名单。

tasks.en: Decline kindly
tasks.zh: 委婉拒绝

tasks.en: Your friend understands and asks someone else. Next year you see the workshop on the program, a little wistfully.
tasks.zh: 朋友表示理解，去找了别人。第二年你在会议日程上看到这个 workshop，心里有点怅然。

tasks.en: By 5 pm
tasks.zh: 下午 5 点前

tasks.en: The university press office needs a quote about chatbots in hospitals by 5 pm. It's 3:40. They found you by searching the website for "chatbot".
tasks.zh: 学校宣传部 5 点前要一段关于聊天机器人进医院的专家点评。现在 3:40。他们是在学校官网搜“聊天机器人”搜到你的。

tasks.en: Write a careful two-sentence quote
tasks.zh: 认真写两句话

tasks.en: Forty minutes for two sentences. They print it with your name spelled right, and your aunt shares it with everyone.
tasks.zh: 两句话写了四十分钟。登出来时你的名字拼对了，你姑妈把它转进了每一个家族群。

tasks.en: Pass it to {advisor}
tasks.zh: 转给 {advisor}

tasks.en: {advisor} gives the quote from a hallway at 4:55, slightly out of breath, and mentions "my student's work".
tasks.zh: 4:55，{advisor}在走廊里微微喘着气给出了点评，还提了一句“我学生的工作”。

tasks.en: Send them your abstract
tasks.zh: 直接发论文摘要

tasks.en: They print one sentence of it: "We leverage a novel multi-stage framework." Nobody learns what you do.
tasks.zh: 他们只登了其中一句：“我们利用了一种新颖的多阶段框架。”没人看懂你是做什么的。

tasks.en: For Readability
tasks.zh: 为了可读性

tasks.en: A stranger opens a pull request on your paper's code. It rewrites everything "for readability": 212 files changed, every variable renamed.
tasks.zh: 有个陌生人给你论文的代码提了个 PR，说是“为了可读性”，把代码全重写了：改动 212 个文件，每个变量都换了名。

tasks.en: Review it line by line
tasks.zh: 逐行审查

tasks.en: A day of diffs. Two of their changes really are better, so you keep those. They star the repo anyway.
tasks.zh: 看了一天 diff。其中两处确实改得更好，你就留下了。对方倒是照样给仓库点了个 star。

tasks.en: Merge it and hope
tasks.zh: 直接合并，祈祷没事

tasks.en: Everything still runs, a little faster. You feel lucky and slightly uneasy.
tasks.zh: 一切照常运行，还快了一点。你觉得自己运气不错，心里又有点发毛。

tasks.en: Everything breaks. Three issues titled "nothing works" arrive before lunch.
tasks.zh: 全崩了。午饭前就来了三个 issue，标题都是“什么都跑不起来”。

tasks.en: Thank them and close it
tasks.zh: 道谢后关掉

tasks.en: A polite note and one click. They reply with a long essay on code style. You don't read it.
tasks.zh: 一句客气话，点一下关闭。对方回了一篇讲代码风格的小作文。你没点开。

tasks.en: The Reproducibility Badge
tasks.zh: 可复现徽章

tasks.en: {venue} offers a reproducibility badge for {paper} if its code runs in a container by next week. Right now it runs on your laptop, on a good day.
tasks.zh: {venue} 表示，只要 {paper} 的代码下周前能在容器里跑通，就能拿到可复现徽章。目前它只在你的笔记本上能跑，还得挑黄道吉日。

tasks.en: Containerize it
tasks.zh: 打包成容器

tasks.en: After three days of dependency fights, it builds. The badge is small and orange, and you love it.
tasks.zh: 和依赖库斗智斗勇了三天，终于构建成功。徽章小小的，橙色的，你爱死它了。

tasks.en: Skip the badge
tasks.zh: 放弃徽章

tasks.en: No badge, and the week is yours. Months later, someone emails to ask whether the code runs. It does not.
tasks.zh: 没拿徽章，这一周归你了。几个月后，有人发邮件问代码能不能跑。不能。

tasks.en: Ask {labmate} for help
tasks.zh: 找 {labmate} 帮忙

tasks.en: {labmate} knows containers and has it working in an afternoon. You owe them, and they've already named the favor.
tasks.zh: {labmate} 懂容器，一个下午就搞定了。你欠了个人情，而对方已经想好要你怎么还了。

tasks.en: In Plain Words
tasks.zh: 说人话

tasks.en: The proceedings want a 150-word plain-language summary of {paper}. Your first draft says "leverage" four times and "novel" twice.
tasks.zh: 论文集要给 {paper} 配一段 150 词的通俗摘要。你的初稿里有四个“leverage”和两个“novel”。

tasks.en: Write it properly
tasks.zh: 好好写

tasks.en: Three drafts later, it says what you did and why it matters, with no leveraging at all. It may be the best paragraph you write this year.
tasks.zh: 改了三稿，这段摘要终于说清了你做了什么、为什么重要，一个 leverage 都没有。这可能是你今年写得最好的一段话。

tasks.en: Ask a non-academic friend to read it
tasks.zh: 请圈外朋友读一读

tasks.en: Your friend reads it twice and asks, "So it's a chatbot?" You rewrite it around that question, and it's much better.
tasks.zh: 朋友读了两遍，问：“所以就是个聊天机器人？”你顺着这个问题重写了一遍，好多了。

tasks.en: Simplify the abstract and send it
tasks.zh: 把摘要简化一下交差

tasks.en: You delete every third word of the abstract. It's 150 words, and still only your reviewers could follow it.
tasks.zh: 你把摘要里每三个词删掉一个。刚好 150 词，可还是只有你的审稿人看得懂。

tasks.en: Take 14
tasks.zh: 第 14 遍

tasks.en: {venue} accepts an optional video figure for {project}. Your narration is on take 14. On take 13, the radiator joined in.
tasks.zh: {venue} 允许 {project} 附一段可选的演示视频。你的旁白已经录到第 14 遍。第 13 遍时，暖气片也来了段伴奏。

tasks.en: Finish it properly
tasks.zh: 认真录完

tasks.en: Take 22 is the one, and it's under three minutes. Your work has never sounded this good.
tasks.zh: 第 22 遍终于成了，不到三分钟。你的研究从来没听起来这么厉害过。

tasks.en: Record the screen, add captions
tasks.zh: 录屏加字幕

tasks.en: The video is all captions and a slow, confident cursor. It's clear and only slightly eerie.
tasks.zh: 整个视频只有字幕，和一个缓慢而笃定的光标。很清楚，只是有一点点诡异。

tasks.en: Skip it
tasks.zh: 跳过

tasks.en: It's optional. You close the recorder and go to sleep. Most papers don't have one either.
tasks.zh: 反正是可选的。你关掉录音软件睡觉去了，大多数论文也都没交视频。

teaching.en: 120 Midterms
teaching.zh: 120 份期中试卷

teaching.en: You have 120 midterms to grade by Monday. The stack on your desk is taller than your monitor.
teaching.zh: 周一前你要改完 120 份期中试卷。桌上那摞卷子比显示器还高。

teaching.en: The midterm stack arrives: 120 exams of six questions each, due back Monday morning.
teaching.zh: 期中卷子送来了：120 份，每份六道题，周一早上就得交回去。

teaching.en: Grade all weekend
teaching.zh: 周末全拿来改卷

teaching.en: You finish at midnight on Sunday, and now you dream about partial credit.
teaching.zh: 你周日半夜才改完，现在做梦都在给步骤分。

teaching.en: Write a rubric first, then batch it
teaching.zh: 先定评分标准，再流水线批改

teaching.en: The rubric takes an hour and saves ten. Question by question, you finish Saturday night.
teaching.zh: 定标准花了一小时，省下了十小时。一题一题流水线改下来，周六晚上就收工了。

teaching.en: Halfway through, an answer breaks your rubric. You regrade 60 exams.
teaching.zh: 改到一半，有个答案完全不按套路出牌，标准当场失效。你只好重改 60 份。

teaching.en: Spread it across the week
teaching.zh: 分到一周里慢慢改

teaching.en: You grade for two hours every evening. Grades go in Wednesday, and the professor sends one pointed email.
teaching.zh: 你每天晚上改两个小时，结果周三才交上成绩，任课老师发来一封话里有话的邮件。

teaching.en: Half a Point
teaching.zh: 半分之争

teaching.en: A student requests a regrade on a half-point question. The request is 900 words long and cites the syllabus, two lecture slides and the student handbook.
teaching.zh: 有个学生为半分申请复核，写了 900 字的小作文，引用了教学大纲、两页课件和学生手册。

teaching.en: Give them the half point
teaching.zh: 给那半分

teaching.en: The student is thrilled. By evening, four more requests arrive, each citing "precedent".
teaching.zh: 那位同学高兴坏了。结果当晚又来了四份复核申请，个个援引“先例”。

teaching.en: Write a clear, kind explanation
teaching.zh: 写封清楚又客气的回信

teaching.en: They reply, "Fair enough, thanks!"
teaching.zh: 对方回复：“有道理，谢谢！”

teaching.en: They escalate to the professor, with your email attached and highlighted.
teaching.zh: 对方一状告到了任课老师那儿，附上你的邮件，重点还标了黄。

teaching.en: Forward it to the professor
teaching.zh: 转给任课老师

teaching.en: The professor gives them the half point and CCs you.
teaching.zh: 任课老师直接给了那半分，回邮件时还抄送了你。

teaching.en: The Line Goes Out the Door
teaching.zh: 队排到了门外

teaching.en: It's office hours the day before the assignment is due, and the line goes out the door. Everyone has the same bug.
teaching.zh: 作业截止前一天的答疑时间，队一直排到了门外。每个人卡的都是同一个 bug。

teaching.en: Stay until everyone is helped
teaching.zh: 留到所有人都问完

teaching.en: You leave at 9 pm, after thirty-one students with the same off-by-one error. You could fix it in your sleep, and soon will.
teaching.zh: 你一连帮三十一个学生改了同一个 off-by-one 错误，晚上 9 点才走。这个 bug 你闭着眼都能修，今晚做梦估计也在修。

teaching.en: Explain the bug once, to everyone
teaching.zh: 给所有人统一讲一遍

teaching.en: One explanation at the whiteboard sends thirty students away happy.
teaching.zh: 你在白板前讲了一遍，三十个学生心满意足地走了。

teaching.en: Half the room follows. The other half lines up again, now with two bugs.
teaching.zh: 一半人听懂了。另一半又排回了队，喜提两个 bug。

teaching.en: Post a fix on the forum, end on time
teaching.zh: 论坛发个修复帖，准点下班

teaching.en: Your forum post gets 40 thank-yous and one complaint that you posted it too late.
teaching.zh: 帖子收获 40 条感谢，外加一条抱怨你发得太晚。

teaching.en: A Very Good Question
teaching.zh: 这个问题问得好

teaching.en: At office hours, a student asks why the chatbot from lecture sounds so sure when it is wrong. Nobody has a good answer, which might make it a paper.
teaching.zh: 答疑时有学生问：课上那个聊天机器人，为什么能一本正经地胡说八道？没人答得上来，说不定能写成论文。

teaching.en: Write the idea down right away
teaching.zh: 马上记下这个想法

teaching.en: It goes into your ideas file, with the student's question word for word.
teaching.zh: 想法清单里多了一条，学生的原话一字没改。

teaching.en: Talk it through with the student
teaching.zh: 跟这位同学好好聊聊

teaching.en: Forty minutes later you have a whiteboard full of ideas, and office hours have run over.
teaching.zh: 四十分钟后，白板写满了，答疑也超时了。

teaching.en: Bring it to {advisor}
teaching.zh: 拿去找 {advisor}聊聊

teaching.en: {advisor} lights up: "That's a real gap." It goes on the list for next semester.
teaching.zh: {advisor}眼睛一亮：“这确实是个研究空白。”当场写进了下学期的计划。

teaching.en: {advisor} points you to three papers that already did it. At least now you've read them.
teaching.zh: {advisor}给你找出了三篇早就做过这个的论文。好歹你现在都读过了。

teaching.en: You're Teaching Tomorrow
teaching.zh: 明天你来上课

teaching.en: The professor has a cold and emails at 8 pm: "Could you give tomorrow's lecture? Slides attached." There are 74 slides. You have seen about ten of them.
teaching.zh: 任课老师感冒了，晚上 8 点发来邮件：“明天的课你能帮我上吗？课件在附件里。”课件一共 74 页，你大概看过十页。

teaching.en: Present their slides as they are
teaching.zh: 照着 PPT 念

teaching.en: You get through it. On slide 52 you learn something new, live, along with everyone else.
teaching.zh: 你撑下来了。讲到第 52 页时，你和全班同学一起现场学到了新知识。

teaching.en: Stay up and make the slides your own
teaching.zh: 熬夜把课件改成自己的

teaching.en: You cut it to 40 slides and add two examples from your research. Three students stay after to ask about it.
teaching.zh: 你把课件删到 40 页，还加了两个自己研究里的例子。下课后有三个学生留下来问你的研究。

teaching.en: Turn it into a discussion class
teaching.zh: 改成讨论课

teaching.en: You give each small group one question and walk the room. Students call it the best class of the semester.
teaching.zh: 你给每个小组发一个问题，然后在教室里来回转。学生们说这是本学期最好的一节课。

teaching.en: "Discuss in groups" becomes 70 students on their phones. You present the slides after all.
teaching.zh: “分组讨论”变成了 70 个人集体刷手机。最后你还是念了 PPT。

teaching.en: The Autograder Is Down
teaching.zh: 自动评测崩了

teaching.en: The night before the assignment is due, the autograder starts failing every submission, including the reference solution. The forum has 63 new posts.
teaching.zh: 截止前一晚，自动评测开始把所有提交都判错，连参考答案都没放过。论坛炸了，多了 63 条新帖。

teaching.en: Debug it tonight
teaching.zh: 今晚就修

teaching.en: A dependency updated itself. You pin the version at 1 am and the forum calms down.
teaching.zh: 原来是某个依赖自己更新了。你凌晨 1 点锁定了版本号，论坛终于安静下来。

teaching.en: By 4 am it passes the reference solution and fails everything else. You go to bed anyway.
teaching.zh: 折腾到凌晨 4 点，参考答案总算过了，其他提交全挂。你决定先睡为敬。

teaching.en: Ask the professor for an extension
teaching.zh: 找任课老师申请延期

teaching.en: The deadline moves 48 hours. The forum celebrates as if you personally saved them.
teaching.zh: 截止推迟了 48 小时。论坛一片欢腾，好像是你一个人救了全班。

teaching.en: Grade by hand next week
teaching.zh: 下周手动评分

teaching.en: Everyone submits on time. Next week, you run 90 programs one by one.
teaching.zh: 大家倒是都按时交了，只是下周你得把 90 份程序挨个跑一遍。

teaching.en: Is the Deadline Tonight?
teaching.zh: DDL 是今晚吗？

teaching.en: A student email arrives at 3:04 am: "Is the deadline tonight?" The deadline was at midnight. You know the email arrived at 3:04 because you are awake too.
teaching.zh: 凌晨 3:04，学生来信：“DDL 是今晚吗？”作业昨晚 12 点就截止了。你知道是 3:04，因为你也还醒着。

teaching.en: Reply right now
teaching.zh: 秒回

teaching.en: "It was at midnight, but submit now and I'll ask the professor." They submit at 3:09, and you're asleep by 4.
teaching.zh: “昨晚 12 点就截止了，不过你现在交，我去问问老师。”对方 3:09 交了，你 4 点前睡着了。

teaching.en: Reply kindly in the morning
teaching.zh: 早上再好好回复

teaching.en: You close the laptop and reply at 9 am. The student had already submitted at 3:10.
teaching.zh: 你合上电脑，早上 9 点才回。其实那位同学 3:10 就已经交了。

teaching.en: Ask yourself why you're awake at 3 am
teaching.zh: 问问自己凌晨 3 点为什么还醒着

teaching.en: You go to bed, and your sleep schedule thanks you, a little.
teaching.zh: 你去睡了，生物钟对你略表感谢。

teaching.en: Reply, then keep writing until 5
teaching.zh: 回完邮件，接着写到 5 点

teaching.en: Night Owl
teaching.zh: 夜猫子

teaching.en: Since you're up anyway, you also finish a section of your paper.
teaching.zh: 反正也醒着，你顺手把论文的一节写完了。

teaching.en: Very Patient, Talks Too Fast
teaching.zh: 很有耐心，语速太快

teaching.en: Your TA evaluations are in. Nearly every comment says the same thing: "Very patient, talks too fast." One student just wrote "fast".
teaching.zh: 助教评教结果出来了。几乎每条评论都一个意思：“很有耐心，语速太快。”有个学生只写了一个字：“快”。

teaching.en: Practice talking slower
teaching.zh: 练习放慢语速

teaching.en: You record yourself and time it. It's painful to watch, and your next practice talk goes better.
teaching.zh: 你把自己讲课录下来，还掐了表。回放看得脚趾抠地，但下次试讲顺多了。

teaching.en: Focus on the "very patient" part
teaching.zh: 只看“很有耐心”那部分

teaching.en: You print it and stick it above your desk.
teaching.zh: 你把这句打印出来，贴在了工位上。

teaching.en: Ask {labmate} to time your next talk
teaching.zh: 请 {labmate} 给你下次报告计时

teaching.en: {labmate} raises a hand every time you speed up. By the end you're both laughing, and you're slower.
teaching.zh: 你一加速，{labmate} 就举手。到最后你俩都笑场了，语速也慢下来了。

teaching.en: {labmate} forgets to show up. You talk fast to an empty room.
teaching.zh: {labmate} 忘了来。你对着空教室照样讲得飞快。

teaching.en: Old Nemesis
teaching.zh: 冤家路窄

teaching.en: You are assigned to TA the course you barely passed as an undergrad, the one with the proof-heavy final. This time, you grade that final.
teaching.zh: 你被分去给本科差点挂科的那门课当助教，就是期末全是证明题的那门。这一次，轮到你改那份期末卷了。

teaching.en: Relearn it properly this time
teaching.zh: 这次好好重学一遍

teaching.en: On your second pass through the textbook, it finally clicks. Your undergrad self would be stunned.
teaching.zh: 第二遍啃课本时，你终于开窍了。本科时的你要是知道，肯定会惊掉下巴。

teaching.en: Stay one lecture ahead
teaching.zh: 只比学生早学一节课

teaching.en: You learn each topic the night before you teach it. It works, mostly, and nobody notices.
teaching.zh: 每个知识点都是前一晚现学现卖。基本没翻车，也没人发现。

teaching.en: Tell students you struggled too
teaching.zh: 告诉学生你当年也学得很吃力

teaching.en: Office hours fill up. Students say you explain it best, because you remember why it's hard.
teaching.zh: 答疑时间人满为患。学生说你讲得最好，因为你还记得这门课难在哪。

teaching.en: A student asks, "So... should we trust your grading?"
teaching.zh: 有个学生问：“所以……你改的分靠谱吗？”

teaching.en: Years Later
teaching.zh: 多年以后

teaching.en: An email from a student you TA'd years ago: they are an engineer now, and your office hours are why they stayed in computer science. They remember your name. You remember their bug.
teaching.zh: 多年前你带过的一个学生发来邮件：对方如今是工程师了，说正是因为你的答疑，自己才没转出计算机专业。对方记得你的名字，你记得对方的 bug。

teaching.en: Write back properly
teaching.zh: 认真回一封

teaching.en: You write a long, warm reply. It's the best thing you've written all month, and nobody will review it.
teaching.zh: 你写了一封长长的暖心回信。这是你这个月写得最好的东西，而且没有 2 号审稿人。

teaching.en: Invite them to talk to your students
teaching.zh: 请对方来给你的学生讲讲

teaching.en: They give a guest talk to this year's class. Two students ask them for internship referrals.
teaching.zh: 对方给今年的学生做了一场客座讲座。有两个学生当场找对方求内推。

teaching.en: Save it in a "good days" folder
teaching.zh: 存进“好日子”文件夹

teaching.en: You start a folder for emails like this. The next rejection stings a little less.
teaching.zh: 你专门建了一个文件夹存这样的邮件。下次再被拒，就没那么疼了。

teaching.en: The Grading Pile
teaching.zh: 改不完的作业

teaching.en: The midterms are in: 140 of them, due back by Monday. The professor is at a conference.
teaching.zh: 期中试卷交上来了：140 份，周一前要改完。任课老师还在外地开会。

teaching.en: All 38 final projects arrive at 11:59 pm, and some have videos.
teaching.zh: 38 份期末项目全是晚上 11:59 卡点交的，有些还带视频。

teaching.en: Grade them all carefully
teaching.zh: 每份都认真改

teaching.en: Every one gets fair, detailed feedback. Two students email to say thank you, which almost never happens.
teaching.zh: 每份你都给了公正又详细的反馈。有两个学生发邮件来道谢，这可是稀罕事。

teaching.en: Make a rubric and move fast
teaching.zh: 定好评分标准，快速改完

teaching.en: The rubric is a work of art. The grading goes fast, and nobody complains.
teaching.zh: 评分标准写得像件艺术品。改起来飞快，也没人抱怨。

teaching.en: Ask the other TA to split it
teaching.zh: 找另一位助教分担

teaching.en: They say yes, and you owe them one.
teaching.zh: 对方答应了，你欠了人家一个人情。

travel.en: After the Conference
travel.zh: 签证：会后见

travel.en: You finally get a visa appointment for your conference trip. It's nine days after the conference ends.
travel.zh: 你终于约上了签证面签，日期是会议结束后的第九天。

travel.en: The consulate's earliest open slot is the week after your conference. The booking site suggests you "plan ahead".
travel.zh: 领事馆最早的空位，排在会议结束后的那一周。预约网站还贴心地建议你“提前规划”。

travel.en: Refresh the booking site every hour
travel.zh: 每小时刷一次预约网站

travel.en: At 2:47 am a cancellation appears. You book it before anyone else wakes up.
travel.zh: 凌晨 2:47 有人退号。你拿出抢春运车票的手速，赶在所有人醒来前拿下了。

travel.en: No earlier slot opens in time. You'll give your talk over video, from your desk.
travel.zh: 到最后也没刷出更早的位置。你只能坐在工位上，远程做报告了。

travel.en: Ask {advisor} for a support letter
travel.zh: 请 {advisor}写封支持信

travel.en: The letter works. The consulate moves your appointment up by three weeks.
travel.zh: 信管用了，领事馆把你的面签提前了三周。

travel.en: The consulate thanks your advisor for the letter and changes nothing. The talk goes remote.
travel.zh: 领事馆感谢了导师的来信，然后什么也没改。报告只好改成线上。

travel.en: Plan a remote talk now
travel.zh: 直接准备线上报告

travel.en: You record a clean talk and keep your week. The hallway chats will have to wait.
travel.zh: 你录了一版干净利落的报告，这周的时间也保住了。只是会场走廊里的闲聊，只能等下次了。

travel.en: Lost Luggage
travel.zh: 行李丢了

travel.en: Your suitcase is somewhere between two airports. Your talk at {venue} is tomorrow morning, and you're wearing the hoodie you slept in on the plane.
travel.zh: 你的行李箱还在两个机场之间漂着。明早就要在 {venue} 做报告，你身上却只有那件在飞机上睡了一路的卫衣。

travel.en: Present in the hoodie
travel.zh: 穿着卫衣上台

travel.en: Nobody looks at your clothes. They look at your results, and two people ask for your slides.
travel.zh: 没人看你穿什么。大家看的是你的结果，还有两个人找你要了 PPT。

travel.en: You spend the first minute apologizing for the hoodie. The talk recovers, mostly.
travel.zh: 你开场先花了一分钟为卫衣道歉，好在后面基本救回来了。

travel.en: Buy an outfit in {city} tonight
travel.zh: 今晚在{city}买身衣服

travel.en: The only open store sells souvenir shirts. Everyone remembers the talk in the I LOVE {city} shirt.
travel.zh: 唯一还开着的店只卖纪念 T 恤。于是大家都记住了那个穿着“我爱{city}”T 恤做报告的人。

travel.en: Wait at the airport for the bag
travel.zh: 在机场等行李

travel.en: The bag arrives at 11 pm. You get four hours of sleep and a clean shirt.
travel.zh: 行李晚上 11 点才到。你换来了四个小时的睡眠和一件干净衬衫。

travel.en: The Keynote Nap
travel.zh: 主旨报告助眠

travel.en: Jet lag hits during the keynote. You wake up to applause and a slide that just says "Thank you!"
travel.zh: 主旨报告讲到一半，时差袭来。你醒来时满场掌声，屏幕上只剩一句“Thank you!”

travel.en: You close your eyes for one second during the keynote. When you open them, it's the Q&A.
travel.zh: 主旨报告时你只闭了一秒眼，再睁开已经到提问环节了。

travel.en: Ask your neighbor for a summary
travel.zh: 请邻座总结一下

travel.en: They sum it up in two sentences. You trade emails, and it turns out you only needed the two sentences.
travel.zh: 对方两句话就概括完了，你们还互留了邮箱。后来发现，你需要的也就这两句话。

travel.en: Go back to the hotel and sleep
travel.zh: 回酒店睡觉

travel.en: You sleep 14 hours. You miss the afternoon sessions and wake up a person again.
travel.zh: 你一觉睡了 14 个小时，错过了下午的报告，但醒来总算又像个人了。

travel.en: Drink a third coffee
travel.zh: 来第三杯咖啡续命

travel.en: You make it through the poster session wide awake. At 3 am you are still wide awake.
travel.zh: 你精神抖擞地撑过了海报环节。凌晨 3 点，你依然精神抖擞。

travel.en: Behind the Pillar
travel.zh: 柱子后面

travel.en: Your poster board for {paper} is behind a concrete pillar. In the first half hour, one person stops by, and they are looking for the restroom.
travel.zh: {paper} 的海报板被分到了一根水泥柱后面。头半个小时只来了一个人，还是来找厕所的。

travel.en: Stand in the aisle and wave people in
travel.zh: 站到过道上揽客

travel.en: You pull in a steady stream. Someone says it's the best poster they've ever seen behind a pillar.
travel.zh: 你把人一拨接一拨地拉了过来。有人说，这是自己见过最好的柱子后面的海报。

travel.en: People nod politely and keep walking. Your arm gets a good workout.
travel.zh: 大家礼貌地点点头，继续往前走。你的胳膊倒是练得不错。

travel.en: Ask the organizers to move you
travel.zh: 请组委会给你换位置

travel.en: They move you next to the coffee urn, the best spot in the hall.
travel.zh: 组委会把你挪到了咖啡台旁边，全场 C 位。

travel.en: "All boards are final." The pillar and you will spend the afternoon together.
travel.zh: “展板位置一律不予调整。”这个下午，你只能和柱子相依为命了。

travel.en: Tape a QR code to the pillar
travel.zh: 在柱子上贴个二维码

travel.en: Almost nobody visits, but your paper gets a few dozen downloads that afternoon.
travel.zh: 几乎没人过来，但那天下午你的论文被下载了几十次。

travel.en: Your Hero, at Your Poster
travel.zh: 偶像来看你的海报了

travel.en: Your research hero walks up to your poster for {paper}, reads it for a full minute, and asks the one question you hoped nobody would ask.
travel.zh: 你的学术偶像走到 {paper} 的海报前，认真看了整整一分钟，然后问了那个你最希望没人问的问题。

travel.en: Admit the limitation, say what's next
travel.zh: 承认局限，讲讲下一步

travel.en: They nod. "That's the right next step." You will replay this moment for years.
travel.zh: 对方点点头：“下一步就该这么做。”这一幕你会回味好多年。

travel.en: Defend the result with confidence
travel.zh: 自信地为结果辩护

travel.en: They smile. "Fair point. Send me the paper." You send it before they reach the next poster.
travel.zh: 对方笑了：“有道理，把论文发我。”人还没走到下一张海报，你就已经发过去了。

travel.en: They say "Hm," and move on. You're still glad they stopped.
travel.zh: 对方“嗯”了一声，走了。不过人家停下来看过，你还是挺开心。

travel.en: Freeze, then ask for a selfie
travel.zh: 大脑宕机，然后求合影

travel.en: The question goes unanswered, but the selfie is excellent.
travel.zh: 问题没答上来，但合影很出片。

travel.en: Your Poster, Explained
travel.zh: 给你讲讲你的海报

travel.en: A visitor stops at your poster and explains {paper} to you, confidently and incorrectly, for six minutes.
travel.zh: 一位访客停在你的海报前，自信满满、错误百出地给你讲了六分钟 {paper}。

travel.en: Correct them politely
travel.zh: 礼貌地纠正对方

travel.en: They pause, then say, "Oh, that's even better." You trade emails.
travel.zh: 对方愣了一下：“哦，那更厉害了。”你们互留了邮箱。

travel.en: They nod, then repeat their version a little louder.
travel.zh: 对方点点头，然后把自己那套又大声讲了一遍。

travel.en: Nod and take notes
travel.zh: 点头做笔记

travel.en: Half of what they said is wrong. The other half is a decent idea for future work.
travel.zh: 对方说的一半是错的。另一半倒是个不错的未来工作方向。

travel.en: Hand them a printed copy
travel.zh: 递上一份打印版

travel.en: They take the paper and keep explaining it, now while pointing at it.
travel.zh: 对方接过论文接着讲，这下还能指着讲了。

travel.en: The Seat Next to Yours
travel.zh: 饭局邻座

travel.en: At the networking dinner in {city}, the name card next to yours belongs to the author of your favorite paper.
travel.zh: {city}的交流晚宴上，你一看旁边的桌签：竟然是你最喜欢的那篇论文的作者。

travel.en: Ask about their paper
travel.zh: 聊聊对方的论文

travel.en: They light up. Nobody has asked about that paper in years, and you get the story behind Table 3.
travel.zh: 对方眼睛一亮。那篇论文已经好多年没人问起了，于是你听到了表 3 背后的故事。

travel.en: Talk about anything but work
travel.zh: 聊什么都行，就是不聊工作

travel.en: You bond over terrible hotel coffee. They invite you to their lab's reading group.
travel.zh: 你们一起吐槽酒店咖啡难喝，一见如故。对方还邀请你来参加自己组里的读书会。

travel.en: The small talk runs out after the bread basket. Still, they know your face now.
travel.zh: 面包篮还没吃完，寒暄就聊干了。好歹对方记住你这张脸了。

travel.en: Pitch your next project
travel.zh: 推销你的下一个项目

travel.en: They push back hard on one detail, and they're right. You leave with a better project.
travel.zh: 对方在一个细节上狠狠反驳了你，而且说得在理。这顿饭吃完，你的项目也变好了。

travel.en: They politely turn to the person on their other side for dessert.
travel.zh: 上甜点时，对方礼貌地转向了另一边的人。

travel.en: Last Talk, Last Day
travel.zh: 最后一天，最后一场

travel.en: Your talk on {paper} is the last one on the last day of {venue}. The room seats 300. Eleven people came, and four are packing their bags.
travel.zh: 你讲 {paper} 的报告排在 {venue} 最后一天的最后一场。会场能坐 300 人，来了十一个，其中四个在收拾行李。

travel.en: Give it everything anyway
travel.zh: 照样全力以赴

travel.en: The eleven ask great questions. One of them turns out to be next year's program chair.
travel.zh: 这十一个人的问题都问得很好，其中一位竟然是明年的程序委员会主席。

travel.en: Cut it to ten minutes
travel.zh: 压缩到十分钟

travel.en: You finish early. Everyone makes their flight, and they like you for it.
travel.zh: 你提前讲完，大家都赶上了飞机，对你好感倍增。

travel.en: Pull the chairs into a circle
travel.zh: 把椅子围成一圈

travel.en: The talk turns into a discussion. Half an hour later, nobody has left.
travel.zh: 报告变成了讨论。半个小时过去，一个人都没走。

travel.en: Two more people leave while you move chairs. The remaining nine have a lovely chat.
travel.zh: 你搬椅子的工夫又走了两个人。剩下的九个人倒是聊得很愉快。

travel.en: Minute Twelve
travel.zh: 第 12 分钟

travel.en: Your talk on {paper} is at minute 12 of 15 when the session chair stands up and starts thanking you. Your two best slides are still ahead.
travel.zh: 你讲 {paper} 的 15 分钟报告才到第 12 分钟，主持人就站起来开始感谢你了。可你最精彩的两页 PPT 还没放呢。

travel.en: Jump to the conclusion
travel.zh: 直接跳到结论

travel.en: You land the last slide in twenty seconds. It's the cleanest summary you've ever given.
travel.zh: 你二十秒讲完了最后一页。这是你讲过的最干净利落的总结。

travel.en: Talk faster
travel.zh: 开两倍速讲

travel.en: You fit both slides in at double speed. Someone in the front row claps.
travel.zh: 你用两倍速塞完了两页。前排有人鼓起了掌。

travel.en: Nobody follows the last two slides, including you.
travel.zh: 最后两页没人跟得上，包括你自己。

travel.en: Say "Find me at the break"
travel.zh: 说“茶歇时来找我”

travel.en: Three people do. The coffee break goes better than the talk.
travel.zh: 真有三个人来了。茶歇比报告还成功。

travel.en: Free Socks, One Interview
travel.zh: 领袜子，送面试

travel.en: An industry booth is giving away very nice socks. The recruiter behind it asks if you'd like a quick interview while you're there.
travel.zh: 有家公司的展台在送很好看的袜子。展台后的招聘官问你，既然来了，要不要顺便面个试。

travel.en: Do the interview right there
travel.zh: 当场面试

travel.en: Twenty minutes later you have socks and a second-round slot.
travel.zh: 二十分钟后，你拿到了袜子和二面机会。

travel.en: You blank on a coding question you'd solve in your sleep. You keep the socks.
travel.zh: 一道你闭着眼都能做的编程题，你当场卡壳了。不过袜子照拿不误。

travel.en: Take the socks and a business card
travel.zh: 拿上袜子和一张名片

travel.en: You leave with good socks and no interview questions.
travel.zh: 你薅到一双好袜子，一道面试题都没碰。

travel.en: Skip the booth for a talk
travel.zh: 不去展台，去听报告

travel.en: The talk is about evaluation design, and it's exactly what you needed.
travel.zh: 那场报告讲的是评测设计，正是你需要的。

travel.en: Seeing the City
travel.zh: City Walk 未遂

travel.en: You always wanted to see {city}. So far, you have seen the convention center, the hotel, and the hallway between them.
travel.zh: 你一直想来{city}看看。结果到现在为止，你只见过会议中心、酒店，还有连着两者的那条走廊。

travel.en: Skip a session to explore
travel.zh: 翘一场报告去逛逛

travel.en: You find a market and eat something wonderful. The talk you missed is online anyway.
travel.zh: 你找到一个市集，吃到了特别好吃的东西。反正错过的报告网上有回放。

travel.en: Stay for every session
travel.zh: 场场不落

travel.en: You see every talk and meet a lot of people. {city} remains a view from the hotel window.
travel.zh: 你听了每一场报告，认识了很多人，但{city}始终只是酒店窗外的风景。

travel.en: Stay one extra day
travel.zh: 多留一天

travel.en: You stay one more day and finally see {city}. The inbox can wait.
travel.zh: 你多留了一天，终于好好逛了逛{city}。邮件嘛，晚点再回。

travel.en: Four Minutes
travel.zh: 四分钟光盘

travel.en: The welcome reception opens at 7 pm. By 7:04, the food is gone. You were in line for the coat check.
travel.zh: 欢迎酒会晚上 7 点开始。7:04，吃的就没了。你当时还在排队存外套。

travel.en: Network on an empty stomach
travel.zh: 空着肚子社交

travel.en: You meet five people and remember two of their names. You are very hungry.
travel.zh: 你认识了五个人，记住了其中两个的名字，还饿得前胸贴后背。

travel.en: Find food with other hungry students
travel.zh: 约上其他饿肚子的学生觅食

travel.en: Six hungry PhD students find a noodle place nearby. You now have a group chat for the rest of the week.
travel.zh: 六个饿肚子的博士生在附近找到一家面馆。你们拉了个群，这周剩下几天都是饭搭子了。

travel.en: Go back to the hotel
travel.zh: 回酒店

travel.en: You eat room service in bed and fall asleep by nine.
travel.zh: 你回酒店泡了碗自带的泡面，九点不到就睡着了。

travel.en: The Keynote Spark
travel.zh: 灵光一闪

travel.en: A keynote at {venue} reframes a problem you've been stuck on. By the end, you have a page of notes and a new project idea.
travel.zh: {venue} 的一场主旨报告让你换了个角度看那个卡了很久的问题。报告结束时，你记满了一页笔记，还冒出了一个新项目的想法。

travel.en: Find the speaker afterward
travel.zh: 会后去找讲者

travel.en: They like the idea and suggest a dataset. You promise to follow up, and you mean it.
travel.zh: 讲者很喜欢这个想法，还推荐了一个数据集。你说会跟进，而且是认真的。

travel.en: The line to talk to them is forty people deep. You keep your notes.
travel.zh: 想找讲者聊的人排了四十个。你揣好笔记，默默撤了。

travel.en: Write it up on the flight home
travel.zh: 在回程航班上写下来

travel.en: You have four pages by landing, and your seatmate now knows more about your research than your family does.
travel.zh: 落地时你写了四页，邻座对你研究的了解已经超过你家人了。

travel.en: Let it sit in your notes app
travel.zh: 先存在备忘录里

travel.en: It joins 140 other ideas in your notes app, some of which are probably good.
travel.zh: 它跟备忘录里另外 140 个想法躺在了一起，其中说不定真有几个是好的。

travel.en: The Flight Home
travel.zh: 回程航班

travel.en: On the flight home, the passenger next to you coughs for six hours straight. By landing, your throat feels like sandpaper.
travel.zh: 回程航班上，邻座乘客连续咳了六个小时。落地时，你的嗓子像吞了砂纸。

travel.en: Take two days off to recover
travel.zh: 休息两天养病

travel.en: You live on soup and sleep for two days. By Wednesday you're back, mostly human.
travel.zh: 你严格执行“多喝热水”，睡了两天。到周三回来时，基本恢复人形。

travel.en: Push through the week
travel.zh: 硬撑过这一周

travel.en: The cold never quite arrives, though the week leaves you tired.
travel.zh: 感冒最终没找上门，不过这周还是把你累得够呛。

travel.en: It arrives in full. You spend the week on the couch with tissues and a stack of papers you don't read.
travel.zh: 感冒来势汹汹。你一整周窝在沙发上，身边堆着纸巾，还有一摞始终没翻开的论文。

travel.en: Work from home in a blanket
travel.zh: 裹着毯子在家办公

travel.en: Your labmates thank you for not bringing it to the lab.
travel.zh: 同门感谢你没把病毒带进实验室。

travel.en: The Live Demo
travel.zh: 现场演示

travel.en: Your live demo for {paper} begins. The conference Wi-Fi does not. Forty people watch a loading spinner on the big screen.
travel.zh: 你的 {paper} 现场演示开始了，会场 Wi-Fi 却当场躺平。四十个人盯着大屏幕上转圈的加载图标。

travel.en: Run it off your phone's hotspot
travel.zh: 开手机热点跑

travel.en: The demo runs on two bars of signal. The audience applauds, mostly for the hotspot.
travel.zh: 演示靠两格信号跑起来了。观众鼓掌，主要是给热点鼓的。

travel.en: Your phone connects, then dies at 4%. You finish with screenshots.
travel.zh: 手机是连上了，可电量到 4% 就关机了。你只好用截图讲完。

travel.en: Narrate screenshots like a cooking show
travel.zh: 像美食博主一样讲截图

travel.en: "Here's one I prepared earlier." People laugh, then ask good questions.
travel.zh: “这一份是我提前做好的。”大家笑了，接着问了几个好问题。

travel.en: Invite people to try it later
travel.zh: 邀请大家稍后来试

travel.en: Six people find you at the break and try it on a wired connection. Two of them stay for an hour.
travel.zh: 茶歇时有六个人来找你，插上网线试了试，其中两个一待就是一个小时。

travel.en: Student Volunteer
travel.zh: 学生志愿者

travel.en: Volunteering got you free registration at {venue}. It also got you a STAFF lanyard and a week of carrying microphones to people whose question is "more of a comment".
travel.zh: 当志愿者让你免费参加了 {venue}，代价是挂上 STAFF 挂绳，给那些“我不是提问，就是想说两句”的人递了一整周话筒。

travel.en: Run microphones in the main hall
travel.zh: 在主会场递话筒

travel.en: You hand the mic to three famous people. One of them thanks you by name, reading it off your badge.
travel.zh: 你给三位大佬递了话筒。其中一位瞄了眼你的胸牌，叫着你的名字道了谢。

travel.en: Swap for the registration desk
travel.zh: 换去注册台

travel.en: Everyone passes through. You meet 400 people for eight seconds each, and point 300 of them to the restroom.
travel.zh: 所有人都要经过这里。你见了 400 个人，每人八秒，给其中 300 个指了厕所的方向。

travel.en: Skip a shift to see a talk
travel.zh: 翘一班去听报告

travel.en: Another volunteer covers for you. The talk is great, and you owe them a coffee.
travel.zh: 另一位志愿者替你顶了班。报告很精彩，你欠人家一杯咖啡。

travel.en: The coordinator notices. Your next shift is the 7 am coffee setup.
travel.zh: 结果被志愿者负责人发现了，你的下一班改成了早上 7 点摆咖啡。

travel.en: Almost the Same Paper
travel.zh: 差点撞车

travel.en: At the poster session, you meet a student from another lab working on almost exactly your problem. You use the same data with different methods, and you both have the same look of mild panic.
travel.zh: 海报环节上，你遇到一个别的组的学生，做的问题和你几乎一模一样。你们用同样的数据、不同的方法，脸上挂着同款轻微惊慌。

travel.en: Propose working together
travel.zh: 提议合作

travel.en: You swap emails and sketch a plan on a napkin. It's either the start of something or a very nice napkin.
travel.zh: 你们互留邮箱，在餐巾纸上画了个计划。这要么是一段合作的开始，要么就是一张很好看的餐巾纸。

travel.en: Race them to the next deadline
travel.zh: 赶在对方之前投出去

travel.en: You both smile and walk away fast. You learned a lot about their method, and your next month got more urgent.
travel.zh: 你们相视一笑，各自快步离开。你摸清了对方的方法，接下来这个月也更赶了。

travel.en: Compare notes and stay friendly
travel.zh: 交流心得，保持友好

travel.en: Two of your dead ends were theirs too. You both save a month and stay in touch, loosely.
travel.zh: 你踩过的两个坑，对方也踩过。这一聊两人都省下了一个月，之后也有一搭没一搭地保持着联系。

travel.en: The Joint Paper
travel.zh: 合作论文

travel.en: Your collaborator from the conference sends a draft that runs their method on your data, and the results beat both of yours. Whose name goes first?
travel.zh: 会上认识的合作者发来一份初稿：用对方的方法跑你的数据，结果比你们俩各自的都好。那谁当一作？

travel.en: Offer them first author
travel.zh: 把一作让给对方

travel.en: They're delighted. The paper goes out, and their lab invites you to visit next spring.
travel.zh: 对方喜出望外。论文顺利发了出去，对方组里还邀请你明年春天去访问。

travel.en: Propose co-first authorship
travel.zh: 提议共同一作

travel.en: You agree on co-first authorship with a footnote, and both advisors sign off.
travel.zh: 你们商定共一，加个脚注说明，两边导师都点了头。

travel.en: Three weeks of polite emails go into one footnote. The paper still goes out, a little late.
travel.zh: 为了一个脚注，你们客客气气地来回发了三周邮件。论文最后还是发出去了，只是晚了一点。

travel.en: Take first author, write most of it
travel.zh: 拿一作，大部分自己写

travel.en: You write it over two weekends. It's your best draft yet, and you are very tired.
travel.zh: 你花了两个周末写完。这是你写过最好的一版初稿，人也累瘫了。

travel.en: Silent Film
travel.zh: 默片

travel.en: {venue} plays pre-recorded talks in your session. Yours, for {paper}, starts with no audio. You're in the third row, and every head slowly turns toward you.
travel.zh: {venue} 在你的分会场放的是预录报告。轮到你的 {paper}，一开头就没声音。你坐在第三排，全场的头慢慢转向了你。

travel.en: Narrate it live from your seat
travel.zh: 坐在座位上现场配音

travel.en: You talk over your own silent video, perfectly in sync. It's the most memorable talk of the session.
travel.zh: 你给自己的无声视频现场配音，严丝合缝。这成了整个分会场最让人印象深刻的报告。

travel.en: You fall two slides behind your own video and never catch up.
travel.zh: 你比自己的视频慢了两页，就再也没追上。

travel.en: Ask the AV team to fix it
travel.zh: 找技术人员来修

travel.en: Ten minutes later, the sound works. Your talk plays to a smaller, very patient room.
travel.zh: 十分钟后声音修好了。报告终于放完，台下人少了些，但都非常有耐心。

travel.en: Skip straight to the Q&A
travel.zh: 直接进入问答

travel.en: You take questions instead. There are only three, because nobody heard the talk.
travel.zh: 你改成直接答疑。只收到三个问题，毕竟没人听到报告讲了什么。

travel.en: Chair of Session 7B
travel.zh: 7B 分会场主持人

travel.en: The conference app lists you as chair of Session 7B: "Speech Recognition for Farm Equipment". You have never chaired a session. You are not in this session.
travel.zh: 会议 App 上写着你是 7B 分会场的主持人，主题是“农机设备语音识别”。你从没主持过分会场，这个分会场也跟你毫无关系。

travel.en: Chair it anyway
travel.zh: 硬着头皮主持

travel.en: You keep time, ask one question per talk and learn a lot about tractors.
travel.zh: 你掐着时间，每场报告问一个问题，喜提一堆拖拉机冷知识。

travel.en: Email the organizers
travel.zh: 给组委会发邮件

travel.en: They fix it within the hour and apologize with a drink voucher.
travel.zh: 组委会一小时内就改好了，还送你一张饮品券赔罪。

travel.en: They reply after the session. Nobody chaired it, so the speakers timed each other.
travel.zh: 组委会等分会场结束了才回复。那场没人主持，讲者们只好互相掐表。

travel.en: Find the real chair
travel.zh: 找到真正的主持人

travel.en: You find them at the coffee urn. They had no idea either, so you chair it together.
travel.zh: 你在咖啡台旁找到了那位主持人。对方也不知情，于是你们一起主持。

travel.en: 300 Views
travel.zh: 300 次播放

travel.en: The recording of your talk on {paper} is online. It has 300 views. According to the analytics, about 200 of them come from your parents' town.
travel.zh: 你讲 {paper} 的报告录像上线了，播放量 300。后台数据显示，其中大约 200 次来自你老家。

travel.en: Share it more widely
travel.zh: 多转发一下

travel.en: Views climb to 900. A few comments ask good questions, and one asks about your microphone.
travel.zh: 播放量涨到了 900。几条评论问了好问题，还有一条在求麦克风链接。

travel.en: Call your parents to say thanks
travel.zh: 打电话谢谢爸妈

travel.en: They have watched it eleven times, and one of them has a question about slide 9.
travel.zh: 爸妈已经看了十一遍，还有个关于第 9 页的问题想问你。

travel.en: Watch it yourself, once
travel.zh: 自己看一遍，就一遍

travel.en: You count 47 "um"s. It's painful, but your next talk will have fewer.
travel.zh: 你数出了 47 个“呃”，看得脚趾抠地。不过下次报告会少一些。

wellbeing.en: Six Weeks
wellbeing.zh: 六周无休

wellbeing.en: You try to remember your last real day off. It was six weeks ago, and you spent it doing laundry.
wellbeing.zh: 你掰着指头算上次真正休息是哪天。答案是六周前，而且那天全用来洗衣服了。

wellbeing.en: Take a real day off tomorrow
wellbeing.zh: 明天彻底休息一天

wellbeing.en: You go for a long walk and never open your email. The work is still there on Monday, and so are you.
wellbeing.zh: 你出门散了很久的步，邮箱一眼都没看。周一回来，活儿还在，人也还在。

wellbeing.en: Plan a long weekend next turn
wellbeing.zh: 下回合放个长周末

wellbeing.en: You block it on your calendar and tell three people, so you can't back out.
wellbeing.zh: 你在日历上占好这几天，还告诉了三个人，这下想鸽都鸽不了。

wellbeing.en: Keep going, it's almost done
wellbeing.zh: 接着干，马上就好

wellbeing.en: It is not almost done. It never is, but you do get a lot done this week.
wellbeing.zh: “马上就好”从来不会马上好。不过这周你确实干了不少活。

wellbeing.en: The Cabin
wellbeing.zh: 湖边小屋

wellbeing.en: Your friends rent a cabin by a lake for a week, with no Wi-Fi and one spare bed with your name on it.
wellbeing.zh: 朋友们在湖边租了一周小木屋，没有 Wi-Fi，还专门给你留了一张床。

wellbeing.en: Go, and leave the laptop home
wellbeing.zh: 去，电脑留在家里

wellbeing.en: You swim and play cards for seven days. By day four, you've forgotten your own password.
wellbeing.zh: 你游了七天泳，斗了七天地主。到第四天，你连开机密码都想不起来了。

wellbeing.en: Go, but bring the laptop
wellbeing.zh: 去，但带上电脑

wellbeing.en: You work mornings on the porch and swim in the afternoons.
wellbeing.zh: 你上午在露台上干活，下午下湖游泳。

wellbeing.en: Stay and work
wellbeing.zh: 留下来干活

wellbeing.en: The photos in the group chat look wonderful.
wellbeing.zh: 你只能在群里云度假，照片看着真不错。

wellbeing.en: The Inbox
wellbeing.zh: 收件箱

wellbeing.en: You open your laptop after the lake: {roll:100-140} unread emails and nine messages from {advisor}. The last one says "Never mind, figured it out."
wellbeing.zh: 从湖边回来，你打开电脑：{roll:100-140} 封未读邮件，还有 {advisor}发来的九条消息。最后一条写着：“没事了，我自己搞定了。”

wellbeing.en: Answer every single one today
wellbeing.zh: 今天全部回完

wellbeing.en: You reach inbox zero by midnight. The lake already feels like a dream.
wellbeing.zh: 赶在零点前，你把收件箱清零了。湖边那一周恍如隔世。

wellbeing.en: Read only your advisor's
wellbeing.zh: 只看老板的

wellbeing.en: Most of them answered each other. You reply to the last one with a thumbs-up.
wellbeing.zh: 那九条基本是自问自答。你给最后一条回了个“收到”。

wellbeing.en: Mark all as read
wellbeing.zh: 全部标为已读

wellbeing.en: It feels wonderful. One of them was an invitation to give a talk.
wellbeing.zh: 爽是真的爽。只是其中一封是请你去做报告的。

wellbeing.en: Fresh Eyes
wellbeing.zh: 重启大法

wellbeing.en: Back from a week with no laptop, you open {project}. The problem you were stuck on for a month is obvious in ten minutes.
wellbeing.zh: 一周没碰电脑，回来一打开 {project}，卡了你一个月的问题，十分钟就看出毛病了。

wellbeing.en: Fix it right now
wellbeing.zh: 马上修好

wellbeing.en: Two hours of work and it's solved. You wonder what else a week off could fix.
wellbeing.zh: 两个小时就搞定了。你开始怀疑，休假才是最强的 debug 工具。

wellbeing.en: Write down why it was hard to see
wellbeing.zh: 记下之前为什么没看出来

wellbeing.en: You write a page on what you missed and why, so you'll spot it next time.
wellbeing.zh: 你写了一页复盘：漏了什么，为什么会漏。下次就能一眼看出来了。

wellbeing.en: It's Going Around
wellbeing.zh: 感冒季

wellbeing.en: A cold is going around the lab. {labmate} sneezes, apologizes, and sneezes again. By Thursday, it's your turn.
wellbeing.zh: 组里最近在闹感冒。{labmate} 打了个喷嚏，说声抱歉，又打了一个。到了周四，你也光荣中招。

wellbeing.en: Stay home and rest
wellbeing.zh: 在家休息

wellbeing.en: Two days of soup and sleep. You come back mostly human.
wellbeing.zh: 多喝热水，多睡觉。两天后你基本恢复了人样。

wellbeing.en: Work from home in a blanket
wellbeing.zh: 裹着毯子在家办公

wellbeing.en: You answer emails under a blanket. Productivity is low, and so is the risk to everyone else.
wellbeing.zh: 你裹在毯子里回邮件。效率很低，传染别人的风险也很低。

wellbeing.en: Come in anyway
wellbeing.zh: 照样去实验室

wellbeing.en: You shake it off in a day. Nobody else catches it.
wellbeing.zh: 一天就扛过去了，也没传给别人。

wellbeing.en: It hits harder than expected. Also, {labmate2} now has it.
wellbeing.zh: 这次感冒比你想的凶。而且现在 {labmate2} 也中招了。

wellbeing.en: Fully Nocturnal
wellbeing.zh: 昼伏夜出

wellbeing.en: Your sleep schedule is now fully nocturnal. You eat breakfast at 3 pm and do your best work at 2 am.
wellbeing.zh: 你已经彻底进入修仙作息：下午 3 点吃早饭，凌晨 2 点状态最好。

wellbeing.en: Reset with a 7 am alarm
wellbeing.zh: 定个早上 7 点的闹钟

wellbeing.en: Three groggy days later, you see the sun on purpose.
wellbeing.zh: 迷迷糊糊熬了三天，你终于不是因为通宵才看见太阳了。

wellbeing.en: Shift an hour earlier each day
wellbeing.zh: 每天提前一小时

wellbeing.en: By next week, you're eating breakfast at breakfast time.
wellbeing.zh: 到下周，你已经能在早饭时间吃早饭了。

wellbeing.en: Keep the night shift
wellbeing.zh: 继续上夜班

wellbeing.en: The cluster is empty at 2 am and your jobs fly. Your labmates forget what you look like.
wellbeing.zh: 凌晨 2 点集群没人抢卡，你的任务跑得飞快。同门已经忘了你长什么样。

wellbeing.en: Own it
wellbeing.zh: 拥抱黑夜

wellbeing.en: Night Owl
wellbeing.zh: 夜猫子

wellbeing.en: This is your natural habitat. You do the best work of your month by moonlight.
wellbeing.zh: 这才是你的天然栖息地。你借着月光干出了这个月最好的活。

wellbeing.en: A Good Meeting
wellbeing.zh: 难得开了个好会

wellbeing.en: Your meeting with {advisor} about {project} goes unexpectedly well. Thirty minutes in, you remember why you wanted to do this project.
wellbeing.zh: 你和 {advisor}聊 {project}，聊得出奇顺利。聊到半小时，你想起了当初为什么想做这个项目。

wellbeing.en: Ride the momentum all weekend
wellbeing.zh: 趁热打铁干一整个周末

wellbeing.en: You put in two long, focused days. You're tired, and the project is moving again.
wellbeing.zh: 你专心干了整整两天。人是累了，但项目总算又动起来了。

wellbeing.en: Write down the next three steps
wellbeing.zh: 写下接下来的三步

wellbeing.en: Three clear steps go on a sticky note on your monitor, where Monday-you will find them.
wellbeing.zh: 你把三步计划写在便利贴上，贴在显示器上，留给周一的自己。

wellbeing.en: Celebrate with bubble tea
wellbeing.zh: 喝杯奶茶庆祝

wellbeing.en: {labmate} joins you. You both agree it's been a good day.
wellbeing.zh: {labmate} 也来了。你们一致同意：今天值得全糖。

wellbeing.en: Just a Small One
wellbeing.zh: 就一个小项目

wellbeing.en: {labmate} asks you to join a side project. It would be your fourth. "It's small," they say. They always say that.
wellbeing.zh: {labmate} 拉你入伙一个副项目，这会是你手上的第四个。“很小的。”对方每次都这么说。

wellbeing.en: Say no, kindly
wellbeing.zh: 客气地拒绝

wellbeing.en: They understand right away. You feel lighter than you expected.
wellbeing.zh: 对方秒懂。你没想到，拒绝完浑身这么轻松。

wellbeing.en: Say yes
wellbeing.zh: 答应

wellbeing.en: Your calendar now has a different color for each project, and you're running out of colors.
wellbeing.zh: 日历上一个项目一个颜色，颜色都快不够用了。

wellbeing.en: Offer an hour of feedback instead
wellbeing.zh: 改成帮忙提一小时意见

wellbeing.en: You give one hour of careful comments. It turns out that's exactly what they needed.
wellbeing.zh: 你花一小时认真提了意见，结果对方要的正是这个。

wellbeing.en: The Chair
wellbeing.zh: 祖传工位椅

wellbeing.en: Your lower back has started filing complaints about your office chair. The chair is older than you are.
wellbeing.zh: 你的腰开始投诉这把办公椅了。椅子的岁数比你还大。

wellbeing.en: Ask the department for a real chair
wellbeing.zh: 找系里要把像样的椅子

wellbeing.en: It takes three emails and a form, but the new chair arrives. Your back sends a thank-you note.
wellbeing.zh: 三封邮件加一张表，新椅子终于到了。你的腰发来一封感谢信。

wellbeing.en: Stack books under the monitor
wellbeing.zh: 拿书垫高显示器

wellbeing.en: Two volumes of an old statistics textbook finally earn their place on your desk.
wellbeing.zh: 两本旧统计学教材终于在你桌上找到了存在的意义。

wellbeing.en: Ignore it
wellbeing.zh: 不管它

wellbeing.en: Your back does not ignore you.
wellbeing.zh: 你不理它，它可不会放过你。

wellbeing.en: Twenty-Twenty-Twenty
After eleven hours of screens, the text on your monitor starts to swim, and blinking doesn't help.
wellbeing.zh: 盯了十一个小时屏幕，字都开始飘了，眨眼也没用。

wellbeing.en: Look away every twenty minutes, like the poster says
wellbeing.zh: 照海报说的，每二十分钟看看远处

wellbeing.en: Every twenty minutes, twenty feet, twenty seconds. You get to know the tree outside the window very well.
wellbeing.zh: 每二十分钟，看二十英尺外，看二十秒。你跟窗外那棵树处成了护眼搭子。

wellbeing.en: Turn the brightness down and keep going
wellbeing.zh: 调暗屏幕，继续干

wellbeing.en: The headache arrives on schedule.
wellbeing.zh: 头疼准时打卡。

wellbeing.en: Get your eyes checked
wellbeing.zh: 去查查视力

wellbeing.en: You get new glasses. The world is sharper, and so are your figures.
wellbeing.zh: 你配了新眼镜。世界清晰了，你画的图也清晰了。

wellbeing.en: Half the lab is coughing. The other half is pretending not to hear it.
wellbeing.zh: 组里一半人在咳嗽，另一半人假装没听见。

wellbeing.en: Work from home for a while
wellbeing.zh: 在家办公一阵子

wellbeing.en: You miss two lab meetings and zero viruses.
wellbeing.zh: 你错过了两次组会，也错过了所有病毒。

wellbeing.en: Your immune system holds. You feel invincible, which is a mistake.
wellbeing.zh: 你的免疫系统顶住了。你觉得自己百毒不侵，这个 flag 立得有点早。

wellbeing.en: Day three: you have it too.
wellbeing.zh: 第三天：你也中招了。

wellbeing.en: Get the flu shot today
wellbeing.zh: 今天就去打流感疫苗

wellbeing.en: A sore arm and a smug feeling for a week.
wellbeing.zh: 胳膊酸了一周，也得意了一周。

wellbeing.en: Lunch Is a Suggestion
wellbeing.zh: 午饭随缘

wellbeing.en: You realize that for three weeks, lunch has been crackers from the vending machine, eaten over your keyboard.
wellbeing.zh: 你突然意识到，这三周的午饭都是售货机里的饼干，还是对着键盘吃的。

wellbeing.en: Meal prep this Sunday
wellbeing.zh: 周日备好一周的饭

wellbeing.en: You make five containers of something green and feel like an adult.
wellbeing.zh: 你做了五盒绿油油的东西，感觉自己像个大人了。

wellbeing.en: Join the lab for lunch
wellbeing.zh: 跟组里一起吃午饭

wellbeing.en: Real food, and gossip about which professor is moving to industry.
wellbeing.zh: 吃到了正经饭，还吃到了哪位教授要去业界的瓜。

wellbeing.en: The crackers are fine
wellbeing.zh: 饼干挺好的

wellbeing.en: The crackers are not fine.
wellbeing.zh: 饼干一点都不好。

wellbeing.en: The Morning After
wellbeing.zh: 通宵之后

wellbeing.en: You hit submit at 4:12 am. At 9:00 there's lab meeting. Your body has questions.
wellbeing.zh: 你凌晨 4:12 按下提交，早上 9 点还有组会。你的身体想找你好好谈谈。

wellbeing.en: Sleep through lab meeting
wellbeing.zh: 一觉睡过组会

wellbeing.en: You sleep until noon and apologize on the lab chat. Your advisor replies with a thumbs-up.
wellbeing.zh: 你一觉睡到中午，在组群里道了歉。导师回了个大拇指，意味深长。

wellbeing.en: Go anyway, with three coffees
wellbeing.zh: 灌三杯咖啡照样去

wellbeing.en: You present your results with great energy and little sense.
wellbeing.zh: 你汇报结果时精神十足，逻辑全无。

wellbeing.en: The Fifth Coffee
wellbeing.zh: 第五杯咖啡

wellbeing.en: It's 2 pm and you're holding your fifth coffee. Your hands are doing a small, steady dance.
wellbeing.zh: 下午 2 点，你端着今天的第五杯咖啡，手已经自带震动模式了。

wellbeing.en: Switch to decaf for a while
wellbeing.zh: 先换成低因咖啡

wellbeing.en: The first two days are rough. Then you sleep through the night for the first time since September.
wellbeing.zh: 头两天很难熬，但之后你九月以来第一次一觉睡到了天亮。

wellbeing.en: Make it a sixth
wellbeing.zh: 再来第六杯

wellbeing.en: You've never written code this fast. Most of it is wrong.
wellbeing.zh: 你写代码从没这么快过，bug 也从没这么多过。

wellbeing.en: The Wrist
wellbeing.zh: 鼠标手

wellbeing.en: Your right wrist aches every time you reach for the mouse. It started as a twinge. It's now a whole opinion.
wellbeing.zh: 每次伸手拿鼠标，右手腕都会疼。一开始只是隐隐作痛，现在手腕已经有一肚子意见了。

wellbeing.en: Get a split keyboard and a better mouse
wellbeing.zh: 换分体键盘和好点的鼠标

wellbeing.en: For a week you type like a toddler. Then the ache is gone.
wellbeing.zh: 头一周你打字退化成了一指禅，但之后手腕就不疼了。

wellbeing.en: Push through
wellbeing.zh: 硬扛

wellbeing.en: The ache moves up your arm, as if exploring.
wellbeing.zh: 疼痛顺着胳膊一路往上，像在打卡新景点。

wellbeing.en: Try dictating your related work
wellbeing.zh: 试试语音输入写相关工作

wellbeing.en: Your laptop transcribes "transformer" as "trans former" forty times. Your wrist gets a rest.
wellbeing.zh: 电脑把 transformer 听写成“变形金刚”，足足四十次。手腕倒是歇着了。

wellbeing.en: The Front Row
wellbeing.zh: 第一排打瞌睡

wellbeing.en: You fall asleep in a department talk, in the front row, and the speaker notices.
wellbeing.zh: 你坐在系里讲座的第一排睡着了，讲者看得一清二楚。大型社死现场。

wellbeing.en: Go to bed at ten for the next two weeks
wellbeing.zh: 接下来两周每天十点睡

wellbeing.en: It feels like a vacation you didn't have to book.
wellbeing.zh: 感觉像休了个不用订机票的假。

wellbeing.en: Buy the large coffee from now on
wellbeing.zh: 以后都买大杯咖啡

wellbeing.en: You stay awake in talks. You also stay awake at 2 am.
wellbeing.zh: 讲座上你不打瞌睡了，凌晨 2 点也睡不着了。

wellbeing.en: The Ankle
wellbeing.zh: 崴脚

wellbeing.en: One bad landing in a pick-up basketball game, and your ankle turns a color you didn't know ankles could be.
wellbeing.zh: 打野球时落地没站稳，脚踝肿出了一种你从没见过的颜色。恭喜你，成为脆皮博士生。

wellbeing.en: Rest it properly
wellbeing.zh: 好好养着

wellbeing.en: You keep it iced and up on the couch, and read a lot.
wellbeing.zh: 你把脚架在沙发上冰敷，趁机读了不少东西。

wellbeing.en: Limp to the lab
wellbeing.zh: 一瘸一拐去实验室

wellbeing.en: Everyone asks what happened. You tell the story eleven times; it gets better each time.
wellbeing.zh: 每个人都问你怎么了。这故事你讲了十一遍，越讲越像武侠片。

wellbeing.en: The Three-Day Headache
wellbeing.zh: 头疼三日游

wellbeing.en: A headache moves in on Monday and is still there on Wednesday, like a labmate who never goes home.
wellbeing.zh: 头疼周一住了进来，周三还没走，像个从不回家的同门。

wellbeing.en: Close the laptop at six for a week
wellbeing.zh: 这周每天六点合上电脑

wellbeing.en: It leaves on Friday. So does some of the stress.
wellbeing.zh: 周五头疼总算走了，还顺手带走了一部分压力。

wellbeing.en: Painkillers and keep going
wellbeing.zh: 吃片止疼药继续干

wellbeing.en: It leaves eventually. It leaves a forwarding address.
wellbeing.zh: 头疼最后总算走了，临走还留了句“回头见”。

wellbeing.en: Pollen Season
wellbeing.zh: 花粉季

wellbeing.en: The trees outside the lab are blooming beautifully, and your sinuses have declared war on all of them.
wellbeing.zh: 实验室外的树开花开得正好，你的鼻子却向它们全体宣战了。

wellbeing.en: Antihistamines
wellbeing.zh: 吃抗过敏药

wellbeing.en: You can breathe. You can also barely keep your eyes open.
wellbeing.zh: 终于能喘气了，就是眼睛也快睁不开了。

wellbeing.en: Tough it out
wellbeing.zh: 忍着

wellbeing.en: You go through a box of tissues a day. People keep asking if the code is that bad.
wellbeing.zh: 你一天用掉一盒纸巾。路过的人都问你：代码有这么让人想哭吗？

wellbeing.en: The Lab Fridge
wellbeing.zh: 实验室冰箱

wellbeing.en: You eat a yogurt from the lab fridge. It had your name on it. It did not have a date on it.
wellbeing.zh: 你吃了实验室冰箱里的一盒酸奶。上面写着你的名字，但没写日期。

wellbeing.en: Stay home until it passes
wellbeing.zh: 在家躺到好为止

wellbeing.en: Two days on the bathroom floor, contemplating your choices.
wellbeing.zh: 你在卫生间地板上待了两天，反思人生。

wellbeing.en: Clean out the lab fridge, for everyone's sake
wellbeing.zh: 为了大家，清空实验室冰箱

wellbeing.en: You find things that predate your advisor. The lab is grateful, and slightly scared.
wellbeing.zh: 你从冰箱里挖出几件比导师入职还早的出土文物。组里很感激，也有点害怕。

wellbeing.en: Dragged to Dinner
wellbeing.zh: 被拽去吃饭

wellbeing.en: At 8 pm, a friend from outside the lab appears at your desk holding your coat. "You said 'next week' three weeks ago. It's next week."
wellbeing.zh: 晚上 8 点，一个组外的朋友拎着你的外套出现在你工位前：“你三周前就说‘下周’，现在就是下周。”

wellbeing.en: Go, and leave the laptop behind
wellbeing.zh: 去，电脑别带

wellbeing.en: Three hours of dumplings and stories that have nothing to do with research. You sleep in the next morning and don't regret it.
wellbeing.zh: 吃了三个小时火锅，聊的全是跟科研无关的事。第二天你睡了个懒觉，一点也不后悔。

wellbeing.en: Go, but only for an hour
wellbeing.zh: 去，但只待一小时

wellbeing.en: You have one quick bowl of noodles and go back to the lab feeling a bit better.
wellbeing.zh: 你匆匆嗦了碗面，回实验室时心情好了一点。

wellbeing.en: "Ten more minutes"
wellbeing.zh: “再给我十分钟”

wellbeing.en: You finish the section. They leave a takeout box on your desk with a sticky note: "Next week. Really."
wellbeing.zh: 你写完了这一节，朋友早走了，桌上留着一盒外卖，便利贴上写着：“下周。这次是真的。”

wellbeing.en: Somebody Else's Best Paper
wellbeing.zh: 别人家的最佳论文

wellbeing.en: {labmate} wins a best-paper award. You're truly happy for them. Then, around 11 pm, a small voice asks what exactly you've been doing all year.
wellbeing.zh: {labmate} 拿了最佳论文奖。你是真心替对方高兴。可到了晚上 11 点，心里有个小小的声音问你：这一年你都干了啥？

wellbeing.en: Ask {labmate} how they did it
wellbeing.zh: 问问 {labmate} 是怎么做到的

wellbeing.en: Over coffee, {labmate} admits the project failed twice before it worked, and their first draft was worse than yours.
wellbeing.zh: {labmate} 边喝咖啡边坦白：这个项目失败了两次才做成，初稿写得比你的还烂。

wellbeing.en: Work twice as hard this month
wellbeing.zh: 这个月加倍努力

wellbeing.en: You out-work the small voice for two weeks. It's still there, and now you're both tired.
wellbeing.zh: 你卷了两周，想把那个声音卷没。结果它还在，现在你俩都累了。

wellbeing.en: List three things you did this year
wellbeing.zh: 列出今年做成的三件事

wellbeing.en: The list runs well past three. You read it twice, then go to bed.
wellbeing.zh: 清单远远不止三条。你读了两遍，安心睡觉去了。

wellbeing.en: Read their paper to find the trick
wellbeing.zh: 读那篇论文，找找窍门

wellbeing.en: Imposter Syndrome
wellbeing.zh: 冒名顶替综合征

wellbeing.en: There's no trick, just a careful, good paper, and somehow that helps.
wellbeing.zh: 没什么窍门，就是一篇扎实的好论文。不知为何，这反而让你好受了些。

wellbeing.en: Ten in a Row
wellbeing.zh: 打卡十连

wellbeing.en: Ten gym sessions in a row. The front desk nods at you now, and you've started saying "leg day" without irony.
wellbeing.zh: 你连续去了十次健身房。前台现在会冲你点头了，你也开始一本正经地说“今天练腿”。

wellbeing.en: Keep the streak going
wellbeing.zh: 继续保持

wellbeing.en: You keep going to thirteen. Your back stops complaining about the chair, and your calendar starts instead.
wellbeing.zh: 你一路坚持到了第十三次。腰不再抱怨椅子了，倒是日历开始抱怨了。

wellbeing.en: Bring {labmate} next time
wellbeing.zh: 下次带上 {labmate}

wellbeing.en: {labmate} lasts twenty minutes and is sore for three days. They want to go again, which surprises you both.
wellbeing.zh: {labmate} 撑了二十分钟，酸痛了三天，居然还想再去，你俩都没想到。

wellbeing.en: Reward yourself with a week off
wellbeing.zh: 奖励自己歇一周

wellbeing.en: You spend a week on the couch. The streak ends at ten, which is still ten.
wellbeing.zh: 你在沙发上躺平了一周。连续记录停在了十次，但十次也是十次。

wellbeing.en: Go for twenty
wellbeing.zh: 冲二十次

wellbeing.en: Gym Rat
wellbeing.zh: 健身狂人

wellbeing.en: You make it to twenty and feel unstoppable, except around 3 pm.
wellbeing.zh: 你冲到了二十次，感觉自己势不可挡，只是下午 3 点前后除外。

wellbeing.en: Thrilled to Share
wellbeing.zh: 满屏喜报

wellbeing.en: Decisions are out for a big conference, and your feed is a wall of "Thrilled to share..." posts. You've been scrolling for forty minutes and stopped reading the titles a while ago.
wellbeing.zh: 某个大会放榜了，时间线上全是“很高兴地宣布……”。你已经刷了四十分钟，标题早就不看了。

wellbeing.en: Close the app and go for a walk
wellbeing.zh: 关掉 App 出去走走

wellbeing.en: The trees outside haven't had a paper accepted either, and they seem fine.
wellbeing.zh: 外面的树也没中过论文，看起来活得挺好。

wellbeing.en: Like every single one
wellbeing.zh: 每条都点赞

wellbeing.en: Two hundred likes later, you're a supportive member of the community, and slightly hollow.
wellbeing.zh: 两百个赞点下来，你成了社区里的头号捧场王，心里却空落落的。

wellbeing.en: Mute the word "thrilled"
wellbeing.zh: 屏蔽“很高兴”这个词

wellbeing.en: Your feed goes quiet and slightly confusing. You miss a friend's real news and hear about it a week late.
wellbeing.zh: 时间线清静了，就是有点看不懂了。有个朋友真有喜讯，你晚了一周才知道。

wellbeing.en: The Extra Hour
wellbeing.zh: 多出来的一小时

wellbeing.en: Daylight saving ends and the clocks go back, which gives you one free hour.
wellbeing.zh: 夏令时结束，时钟往回拨，你白捡了一个小时。

wellbeing.en: Spend the hour asleep
wellbeing.zh: 拿这一小时睡觉

wellbeing.en: The best hour of sleep you've had all semester. You wake up almost rested.
wellbeing.zh: 这是你这学期睡得最香的一小时。醒来时，血条差不多回满了。

wellbeing.en: Spend it on one more experiment
wellbeing.zh: 拿来多跑一个实验

wellbeing.en: The extra hour goes to one more run, which takes three hours. You end up two hours behind.
wellbeing.zh: 多出的一小时拿去多跑一组，结果这组跑了三小时。算下来你倒欠两小时。

wellbeing.en: Book a 7 am meeting; it "feels like 8"
wellbeing.zh: 约个 7 点的会，反正“感觉像 8 点”

wellbeing.en: It does feel like 8, for about a week. Then it feels like 7 again, and the meeting is now recurring.
wellbeing.zh: 头一周确实感觉像 8 点。之后又变回了 7 点的感觉，可这个会已经成了例会。

wellbeing.en: 5 Hours 12 Minutes
wellbeing.zh: 5 小时 12 分

wellbeing.en: {labmate} lends you their sleep tracker. After a week, it reports your average: 5 hours 12 minutes. It has also awarded you a badge called "Night Explorer".
wellbeing.zh: {labmate} 把睡眠手环借给你。一周下来，手环显示你平均每晚睡 5 小时 12 分，还给你颁了一枚“暗夜探险家”徽章。

wellbeing.en: Set a bedtime alarm and obey it
wellbeing.zh: 定个睡觉闹钟，说到做到

wellbeing.en: Lights out at 11:30. You lose your late-night hours and find your mornings.
wellbeing.zh: 晚上 11:30 准时熄灯。你失去了深夜，但找回了早晨。

wellbeing.en: Keep wearing it, stop looking at it
wellbeing.zh: 照戴，但不再看数据

wellbeing.en: The data is still collected. It just isn't anyone's problem now.
wellbeing.zh: 数据照样在记，只是眼不见心不烦了。

wellbeing.en: Return it with a note: "broken"
wellbeing.zh: 还回去，附张纸条：“坏了”

wellbeing.en: {labmate} checks it, finds nothing wrong and gives you a long look.
wellbeing.zh: {labmate} 检查了一遍，什么毛病都没有，然后意味深长地看了你一眼。

wellbeing.en: The Lab Couch
wellbeing.zh: 实验室沙发

wellbeing.en: You nap on the lab couch between runs. Forty minutes later you wake up with your neck stuck at a jaunty angle.
wellbeing.zh: 等实验跑的时候，你在实验室沙发上眯了一会儿。四十分钟后醒来，你落枕了，脖子卡在一个很俏皮的角度。

wellbeing.en: Heat pack and slow stretches
wellbeing.zh: 热敷，再慢慢拉伸

wellbeing.en: A slow, careful afternoon. By evening you can check your blind spot again.
wellbeing.zh: 你小心翼翼地熬过了一个下午。到傍晚，脖子总算又能转过来了。

wellbeing.en: Work with your head tilted
wellbeing.zh: 歪着头干活

wellbeing.en: Your monitor looks a bit crooked all day. {labmate} tilts their head in solidarity.
wellbeing.zh: 一整天你都觉得显示器有点歪。{labmate} 也歪着头陪你，以示团结。

wellbeing.en: Go home and sleep in a real bed
wellbeing.zh: 回家好好睡一觉

wellbeing.en: Twelve hours later your neck is straight, and your runs have finished without you.
wellbeing.zh: 十二个小时后，脖子直了，实验也自己跑完了。

wellbeing.en: The Radiator
wellbeing.zh: 暖气片

wellbeing.en: The radiator in your apartment clanks from 2 to 4 am, every night, like someone is trapped inside with a wrench.
wellbeing.zh: 公寓的暖气片每天凌晨 2 点到 4 点哐哐作响，像有人被困在里面拿扳手敲。

wellbeing.en: Buy earplugs
wellbeing.zh: 买耳塞

wellbeing.en: Silence at last. You also sleep through your alarm, twice.
wellbeing.zh: 终于安静了。就是你也睡过了两次闹钟。

wellbeing.en: Write a polite note to the landlord
wellbeing.zh: 给房东写封客气的信

wellbeing.en: Your note is so well argued that someone comes out the same week. The radiator now hums, gently.
wellbeing.zh: 你这封信写得比论文还有说服力，当周就有人上门来修。现在暖气片只会轻轻地哼哼了。

wellbeing.en: The landlord replies that this is normal for an old building, which is true and doesn't help.
wellbeing.zh: 房东回复说老房子都这样。说得没错，但没用。

wellbeing.en: Use the hours to write
wellbeing.zh: 趁这两小时写论文

wellbeing.en: You write two hours a night, typing in time with the clanks. The draft grows, and your eyes stop fully opening.
wellbeing.zh: 你每晚写两小时，键盘声跟着哐哐声打拍子。草稿越写越长，眼睛却再也没完全睁开过。

wellbeing.en: Forty Tabs
wellbeing.zh: 四十个标签页

wellbeing.en: It's 1 am. You're in bed, and your phone has forty arXiv tabs open. Each one is "just the abstract".
wellbeing.zh: 凌晨 1 点，你躺在床上，手机里开着四十个 arXiv 标签页，每个都是抱着“就看个摘要”点开的。

wellbeing.en: Leave the phone outside the bedroom
wellbeing.zh: 把手机放在卧室外面

wellbeing.en: You buy an old-school alarm clock. The first three nights feel strange. Then you sleep like you used to.
wellbeing.zh: 你买了个老式闹钟。头三晚有点不习惯，之后终于又睡得像从前一样香了。

wellbeing.en: Save them for the morning
wellbeing.zh: 留到早上再看

wellbeing.en: You bookmark all forty. In the morning you read two, properly. The other 38 join the folder of good intentions.
wellbeing.zh: 你把四十个全收藏了。早上认真读了两篇，剩下 38 篇在收藏夹里吃灰。

wellbeing.en: Just one more abstract
wellbeing.zh: 就再看一个摘要

wellbeing.en: By 2:40 am you understand a whole new subfield, sadly not yours.
wellbeing.zh: 到凌晨 2:40，你搞懂了一个全新的子领域。可惜不是你的方向。

wellbeing.en: Fourteen Hours
wellbeing.zh: 报复性补觉

wellbeing.en: The weekend after you submit {paper}, you go to bed at 9 pm and wake up at 11 am.
wellbeing.zh: 投完 {paper} 的那个周末，你晚上 9 点上床，第二天上午 11 点才醒。

wellbeing.en: Do it again on Sunday
wellbeing.zh: 周日再来一次

wellbeing.en: Another long night. On Monday you feel like someone just back from vacation.
wellbeing.zh: 又睡了一个长觉。周一你感觉像刚度假回来。

wellbeing.en: Get up and clean the apartment
wellbeing.zh: 起床大扫除

wellbeing.en: You find three mugs you thought you'd lost and one you wish you hadn't. The apartment is clean; you are tired.
wellbeing.zh: 你找到了三个以为丢了的杯子，还有一个你宁愿没找到。公寓是干净了，人也累趴了。

wellbeing.en: Start planning the next paper
wellbeing.zh: 开始规划下一篇论文

wellbeing.en: By Sunday night you have an outline and a mild headache.
wellbeing.zh: 到周日晚上，你收获了一份大纲和轻微的头疼。

wellbeing.en: For Training Purposes
wellbeing.zh: 仅供培训使用

wellbeing.en: The university offers free ergonomic assessments. The assessor frowns at your desk and photographs your setup "for training purposes".
wellbeing.zh: 学校提供免费的人体工学评估。评估员对着你的工位皱了皱眉，把你的桌面拍了下来，说是“用于培训”。

wellbeing.en: Follow every recommendation
wellbeing.zh: 每条建议都照做

wellbeing.en: It takes a full day and a lumbar pillow shaped like a burrito. Your back feels better by evening.
wellbeing.zh: 花了一整天，外加一个春卷形状的腰垫。到晚上，你的腰舒服多了。

wellbeing.en: Fix only the monitor height
wellbeing.zh: 只调显示器高度

wellbeing.en: You raise the monitor on the conference proceedings you never read, which finally have a use.
wellbeing.zh: 你用从没读过的会议论文集垫高了显示器，这些书总算派上了用场。

wellbeing.en: Ask them to blur your face
wellbeing.zh: 请对方给你打码

wellbeing.en: They agree. Your posture, unchanged, becomes an anonymous warning in next year's training slides.
wellbeing.zh: 对方同意了。你那毫无改变的坐姿，成了明年培训幻灯片里的匿名反面教材。

wellbeing.en: The Standing Desk
wellbeing.zh: 升降桌

wellbeing.en: Your standing desk arrives. On day one you stand for two hours. On day two it becomes a regular desk, slightly taller.
wellbeing.zh: 升降桌到了。第一天你站了两个小时，第二天它就成了一张普通桌子，只是高了一点。

wellbeing.en: Alternate on a timer
wellbeing.zh: 定时站坐交替

wellbeing.en: You switch every thirty minutes. Your legs complain for a week, then stop.
wellbeing.zh: 你每三十分钟换一次。腿抱怨了一周，然后就不吭声了。

wellbeing.en: Use it as a shelf for printed papers
wellbeing.zh: 拿来堆打印的论文

wellbeing.en: It holds 300 pages you'll read someday. It's the most useful furniture you own.
wellbeing.zh: 上面堆着 300 页你总有一天会读的论文。你所有家具里就数它最有用。

wellbeing.en: Stand through lab meeting to make a point
wellbeing.zh: 整场组会站着，以示态度

wellbeing.en: Nobody is sure what the point is. Then {labmate} stands too, and by spring lab meeting is twenty minutes shorter.
wellbeing.zh: 没人看懂你想表达什么。后来 {labmate} 也站了起来，到了春天，组会足足缩短了二十分钟。

wellbeing.en: Sixth Floor
wellbeing.zh: 六楼

wellbeing.en: The elevator is out for a month. The sign says "We apologize for the inconvenience." The lab is on the sixth floor.
wellbeing.zh: 电梯要停一个月。告示上写着：“给大家带来不便，敬请谅解。”实验室偏偏在六楼。

wellbeing.en: Take the stairs, every time
wellbeing.zh: 每次都爬楼梯

wellbeing.en: Six floors, four times a day. By week three you arrive only slightly out of breath.
wellbeing.zh: 六层楼，一天四趟。到第三周，你上楼时只是微微有点喘。

wellbeing.en: Work from the ground-floor library
wellbeing.zh: 去一楼图书馆办公

wellbeing.en: The library is quiet and warm. You get a lot done and miss all the lab gossip.
wellbeing.zh: 图书馆又安静又暖和。你干了不少活，也错过了组里所有的瓜。

wellbeing.en: Wait for the freight elevator
wellbeing.zh: 等货梯

wellbeing.en: It comes every twenty minutes. You get to know the custodians, and a lot of podcasts.
wellbeing.zh: 货梯二十分钟来一趟。你跟保洁师傅混熟了，还听完了一堆播客。

wellbeing.en: Daylight
wellbeing.zh: 不见天日

wellbeing.en: You haven't seen daylight on a weekday in two weeks. You arrive and leave in the dark, and the lab has no windows.
wellbeing.zh: 两周了，你工作日就没见过太阳：来时天没亮，走时天已黑，实验室还没窗户。

wellbeing.en: Hold your next one-on-one outside
wellbeing.zh: 下次单独会面改在户外

wellbeing.en: {advisor} agrees to a walking meeting. It's cold and short, and the best meeting you've had this month.
wellbeing.zh: {advisor}同意边走边聊。天冷，会也短，却是你这个月开得最好的一次。

wellbeing.en: {advisor} agrees, and then it rains sideways. You take notes on a wet napkin.
wellbeing.zh: {advisor}同意了，结果雨下得横着飘。你只能在一张湿餐巾纸上记笔记。

wellbeing.en: Trade desks with {labmate} for the window
wellbeing.zh: 跟 {labmate} 换个靠窗的座位

wellbeing.en: {labmate} agrees, for a week of coffee and a little sighing. The window faces a parking lot, but it's daylight.
wellbeing.zh: {labmate} 答应了，代价是一周的咖啡，外加几声叹气。窗外是停车场，但总归有阳光。

wellbeing.en: Buy a daylight lamp
wellbeing.zh: 买一盏仿日光灯

wellbeing.en: It is very bright and very blue. Your desk looks like a dentist's office, and you feel noticeably more awake.
wellbeing.zh: 灯又亮又蓝，你的工位看起来像牙科诊所，但你明显精神多了。

wellbeing.en: The Stretch Timer
wellbeing.zh: 拉伸提醒

wellbeing.en: {labmate} sets up an hourly stretch timer for the whole lab. It goes off in the middle of your practice talk, right on the slide with the main result.
wellbeing.zh: {labmate} 给全组设了个每小时一次的拉伸提醒。结果你试讲时它响了，偏偏就在讲主要结果那一页。

wellbeing.en: Stretch with everyone
wellbeing.zh: 跟大家一起拉伸

wellbeing.en: The whole room stretches. You lose your place and never quite find it again, but everyone's shoulders thank you.
wellbeing.zh: 全屋人一起拉伸。你忘了讲到哪儿，之后一直没完全找回状态，不过大家的肩膀都很感谢你。

wellbeing.en: Mute it
wellbeing.zh: 关掉提醒

wellbeing.en: You finish the talk on time. The timer stays muted for the rest of the month, for everyone.
wellbeing.zh: 你准时讲完了。只是这个月剩下的日子里，全组的提醒都没再响过。

wellbeing.en: Lead the stretches from now on
wellbeing.zh: 以后你来带大家拉伸

wellbeing.en: You become the lab's stretch captain. It costs five minutes an hour and earns you a lot of goodwill.
wellbeing.zh: 你成了组里的领操员。每小时花五分钟，换来了大家不少好感。

wellbeing.en: New Glasses
wellbeing.zh: 新眼镜

wellbeing.en: Your new glasses arrive. It turns out the slides at department talks were never blurry, and trees have individual leaves.
wellbeing.zh: 新眼镜到了。原来系里讲座的幻灯片从来都不糊，而且树上的叶子是一片一片的。

wellbeing.en: Wear them everywhere
wellbeing.zh: 走到哪儿戴到哪儿

wellbeing.en: After two days of headaches, the world gets sharper. You can now read the fine print on the reimbursement form, and you wish you couldn't.
wellbeing.zh: 头疼了两天，世界终于清晰了。报销单上的小字你现在都看得清，但你宁愿看不清。

wellbeing.en: Keep them for screens only
wellbeing.zh: 只在看屏幕时戴

wellbeing.en: You still squint at the whiteboard, but your eyes stop aching by 6 pm.
wellbeing.zh: 看白板还得眯着眼，但眼睛不会一到傍晚 6 点就酸了。

wellbeing.en: Reread your favorite paper, properly
wellbeing.zh: 认真重读最喜欢的那篇论文

wellbeing.en: Figure 3 had error bars all along. The paper is even better than you remembered.
wellbeing.zh: 原来图 3 一直都有误差棒。这篇论文比你记忆里还要好。

wellbeing.en: Day Two Without Coffee
wellbeing.zh: 戒咖啡第二天

wellbeing.en: You try quitting coffee for a week. Day two brings a headache with opinions and a personal grudge against the coffee machine.
wellbeing.zh: 你试着戒一周咖啡。第二天，头疼找上门来，脾气还不小，你也莫名跟咖啡机结了仇。

wellbeing.en: Push through to day seven
wellbeing.zh: 硬撑到第七天

wellbeing.en: A rough week, then a surprise: you sleep through the night and wake up before the alarm.
wellbeing.zh: 难熬的一周过后，惊喜来了：你一觉睡到天亮，还在闹钟响之前就醒了。

wellbeing.en: Switch to tea
wellbeing.zh: 改喝茶

wellbeing.en: You drink three cups of green tea a day and start describing it as "grassy".
wellbeing.zh: 你每天三杯绿茶，已经开始用“回甘”来形容它了。

wellbeing.en: Give up at 10:02 am
wellbeing.zh: 上午 10:02 放弃

wellbeing.en: The coffee tastes like victory and defeat at the same time.
wellbeing.zh: 这杯咖啡喝起来既像胜利，又像失败。

wellbeing.en: Regular Customer
wellbeing.zh: 老顾客

wellbeing.en: The late-night delivery driver greets you by name. Last week they asked how the paper is going.
wellbeing.zh: 深夜的外卖骑手已经能叫出你的名字，上周还问你论文写得怎么样。

wellbeing.en: Order the salad this time
wellbeing.zh: 这次点沙拉

wellbeing.en: The driver looks worried about you. The salad is fine, and you're hungry again by midnight.
wellbeing.zh: 骑手看起来有点担心你。沙拉还行，就是到半夜你又饿了。

wellbeing.en: Order the usual, extra fries
wellbeing.zh: 点老样子，薯条加量

wellbeing.en: The fries are perfect, and for ten minutes nothing else matters.
wellbeing.zh: 薯条炸得刚刚好。这十分钟里，人间值得。

wellbeing.en: Make it your last delivery this month
wellbeing.zh: 把这单当本月最后一单

wellbeing.en: You cook rice in bulk and eat it with whatever's in the fridge. The driver probably misses you.
wellbeing.zh: 你一次煮一大锅米饭，配冰箱里有啥吃啥。骑手大概会想你的。

wellbeing.en: Lunch Rotation
wellbeing.zh: 午饭轮值

wellbeing.en: {labmate} starts a lab lunch rotation: each week, one person cooks for everyone. Your week is coming up.
wellbeing.zh: {labmate} 在组里搞了个午饭轮值：每周一个人给大家做饭。快轮到你了。

wellbeing.en: Cook something real
wellbeing.zh: 认真做顿饭

wellbeing.en: A big pot of curry for nine people. It takes a whole day, and everyone has seconds.
wellbeing.zh: 你花一整天煮了一大锅咖喱，九个人吃，每个人都添了第二碗。

wellbeing.en: Bring store-bought dumplings
wellbeing.zh: 带速冻饺子

wellbeing.en: Nobody minds. Two people ask where they're from. You let them believe it took effort.
wellbeing.zh: 没人介意，还有两个人问是哪儿来的。你笑而不语，让他们以为是你亲手包的。

wellbeing.en: Keep eating at your desk
wellbeing.zh: 继续在工位吃

wellbeing.en: You opt out and get a quiet hour every day. Through the door, you hear the lab laughing over lunch.
wellbeing.zh: 你退出了轮值，每天多了一个安静的小时。隔着门，你听见大家边吃边笑。

wellbeing.en: Leftovers in the Kitchen
wellbeing.zh: 茶水间有吃的

wellbeing.en: The department's "leftovers in the kitchen" emails have fed you for a week, mostly pizza and one mysterious tray of wraps.
wellbeing.zh: 系里那些“茶水间有剩余餐食”的邮件已经养活了你一周，大多是披萨，还有一盘来历不明的卷饼。

wellbeing.en: Keep it up
wellbeing.zh: 继续蹭

wellbeing.en: Your wallet is happy. You haven't eaten a vegetable since Tuesday.
wellbeing.zh: 钱包很开心，只是你从周二起就没吃过蔬菜了。

wellbeing.en: Buy actual groceries
wellbeing.zh: 去买点正经食材

wellbeing.en: Vegetables! You'd forgotten how they crunch.
wellbeing.zh: 蔬菜！你都忘了它们嚼起来是脆的。

wellbeing.en: Turn on notifications for the list
wellbeing.zh: 打开邮件列表通知

wellbeing.en: You can now reach any kitchen in the building in 90 seconds, and you've met half the department over cold pizza.
wellbeing.zh: 你现在 90 秒内能赶到楼里任何一个茶水间，还靠冷披萨认识了半个系的人。

wellbeing.en: The Checkup
wellbeing.zh: 体检

wellbeing.en: Your student health plan includes a free checkup. The nurse asks how many hours a day you sit. You do the math out loud, which is a mistake.
wellbeing.zh: 学生医保包含一次免费体检。护士问你一天坐几个小时，你当场掰着指头算出了声，这一算就坏了。

wellbeing.en: Answer honestly and take the advice
wellbeing.zh: 如实回答，听取建议

wellbeing.en: Walk after lunch, stand up every hour, sleep seven hours. The first two turn out to be easy.
wellbeing.zh: 午饭后散步，每小时站起来一次，每天睡七个小时。前两条倒是挺容易做到的。

wellbeing.en: Round down
wellbeing.zh: 往少了说

wellbeing.en: "About six," you say. The nurse writes down "twelve" and hands you a pamphlet anyway.
wellbeing.zh: “大概六个小时吧。”你说。护士写下“十二”，照样递给你一本小册子。

wellbeing.en: Laugh nervously
wellbeing.zh: 尴尬地笑笑

wellbeing.en: The nurse laughs too, then books you a follow-up that you will probably go to.
wellbeing.zh: 护士也笑了，然后给你约了次复查，这次你大概真会去。

wellbeing.en: Fever on the Big Day
wellbeing.zh: 偏偏这天发烧

wellbeing.en: You wake up with a fever on the morning of your committee meeting. {committee} moved a flight to be there.
wellbeing.zh: 委员会开会那天早上，你一醒来就发烧了。{committee}为了到场，还特意改了航班。

wellbeing.en: Reschedule
wellbeing.zh: 改期

wellbeing.en: Everyone is kind about it. The next time all four of you are free is five weeks away. You spend two days in bed.
wellbeing.zh: 大家都很体谅，但四个人下次都有空要等到五周以后。你在床上躺了两天。

wellbeing.en: Join by video from bed
wellbeing.zh: 躺在床上视频参会

wellbeing.en: You present in a hoodie with a blanket on your shoulders. {committee} calls it the most relaxed meeting they've had all year.
wellbeing.zh: 你穿着连帽衫、披着毯子做汇报。{committee}说这是今年开过最轻松的一次会。

wellbeing.en: Go in person, sit far from everyone
wellbeing.zh: 亲自到场，离大家远点坐

wellbeing.en: You present from the far end of the table. It goes well, and nobody catches anything.
wellbeing.zh: 你坐在会议桌最远那头汇报。一切顺利，也没人被传染。

wellbeing.en: Halfway through, you sneeze on the projector remote. {committee} is very gracious. You go straight to bed.
wellbeing.zh: 讲到一半，你对着翻页笔打了个喷嚏。{committee}非常大度。会一开完，你就直接回家躺下了。

wellbeing.en: No Colds in the Clinic
wellbeing.zh: 感冒不进诊室

wellbeing.en: You wake up with a cold the day before your {project} sessions with clinicians. Nobody brings a cold into a hospital.
wellbeing.zh: 约好跟临床医生做 {project} 研究的前一天，你感冒了。带着感冒进医院可不行。

wellbeing.en: Reschedule the sessions
wellbeing.zh: 把研究改期

wellbeing.en: The clinicians are understanding. Their next free slots are two weeks out. You spend the wait in bed with tea.
wellbeing.zh: 医生们都很理解，只是下次有空要到两周后。你就躺在床上喝着茶等。

wellbeing.en: Ask {labmate} to run them from your script
wellbeing.zh: 请 {labmate} 照你的脚本代劳

wellbeing.en: {labmate} follows your script to the letter and adds one great follow-up question. You owe them dinner.
wellbeing.zh: {labmate} 一字不差地照着脚本来，还加了一个很好的追问。你欠人家一顿饭。

wellbeing.en: {labmate} is glad to help but skips the warm-up questions. The sessions happen; the data is thinner.
wellbeing.zh: {labmate} 很乐意帮忙，但跳过了热身问题。研究是做完了，只是数据单薄了些。

wellbeing.en: Switch to video sessions
wellbeing.zh: 改成线上视频进行

wellbeing.en: Most of the clinicians prefer it anyway. You run them from your couch, muted between coughs.
wellbeing.zh: 大部分医生本来就更喜欢这样。你在沙发上主持，每次咳嗽前先静音。

wellbeing.en: No Voice
wellbeing.zh: 失声

wellbeing.en: It's the morning you teach section, and your voice is gone. What comes out is a small, hopeful squeak.
wellbeing.zh: 今天早上你要上讨论课，嗓子却哑了。一张嘴，只发出一声弱小、可怜又无助的“吱”。

wellbeing.en: Teach from slides and the whiteboard
wellbeing.zh: 全靠幻灯片和白板上课

wellbeing.en: You write everything down. It's the clearest section you've ever taught.
wellbeing.zh: 你把要讲的全写了出来，结果这成了你上过最清楚的一节讨论课。

wellbeing.en: Swap with another TA
wellbeing.zh: 和别的助教换班

wellbeing.en: They cover for you and say you owe them one. They will collect, during finals.
wellbeing.zh: 对方帮你代了课，说你欠个人情，到期末周再来讨。

wellbeing.en: Whisper; the students lean in
wellbeing.zh: 用气声讲，让学生凑近听

wellbeing.en: Thirty students lean in and go very quiet. It's the most attentive section all semester, and by evening your throat feels like sandpaper.
wellbeing.zh: 三十个学生全都凑过来，安静得出奇。这是整学期大家最专心的一节课，只是到了晚上，你的嗓子跟砂纸一样。

wellbeing.en: Soup at the Door
wellbeing.zh: 门口的汤

wellbeing.en: You're home with a cold. There's a knock, and outside your door is a container of soup and a sticky note from {labmate}: "Get well. Don't answer the lab chat."
wellbeing.zh: 你感冒在家躺着。听到敲门声，开门一看，门口放着一盒汤，还贴着 {labmate} 的便利贴：“好好养病，别回组群消息。”

wellbeing.en: Rest properly, like the note says
wellbeing.zh: 照纸条说的好好休息

wellbeing.en: You eat the soup and sleep. By Friday you're back, and so is your sense of smell.
wellbeing.zh: 你喝了汤，蒙头大睡。到周五，人回来了，嗅觉也回来了。

wellbeing.en: Thank them, then work from bed
wellbeing.zh: 道个谢，然后在床上干活

wellbeing.en: You send a heart emoji and a pull request. The soup goes cold next to your laptop.
wellbeing.zh: 你发了一个爱心表情和一个 pull request。汤在电脑旁边慢慢凉了。

wellbeing.en: Return the favor next week
wellbeing.zh: 下周还这个人情

wellbeing.en: Once you're better, you bring {labmate} homemade dumplings. The lab now runs on a soup-and-dumplings economy.
wellbeing.zh: 病好之后，你给 {labmate} 带了自己包的饺子。从此组里形成了一套“汤换饺子”的经济体系。

wellbeing.en: Snow Day
wellbeing.zh: 雪天停课

wellbeing.en: Snow day: the university closes campus and locks the building. The whole city is quiet.
wellbeing.zh: 下大雪了，学校停课，楼也锁了。整座城市都安静下来。

wellbeing.en: Actually rest
wellbeing.zh: 真正休息一天

wellbeing.en: You read a novel with no citations under a blanket, which feels almost illegal.
wellbeing.zh: 你裹着毯子看了本小说，一条参考文献都没有，爽得像在犯法。

wellbeing.en: Write from home all day
wellbeing.zh: 在家写一整天

wellbeing.en: With no meetings and no seminar, you write more than you have all month.
wellbeing.zh: 没有会，没有讨论班，你这一天写的比这个月加起来都多。

wellbeing.en: Have a snowball fight, then write
wellbeing.zh: 先打雪仗，再写论文

wellbeing.en: {labmate} turns out to have a terrifying arm. Afterward, you write slowly over hot chocolate.
wellbeing.zh: 没想到 {labmate} 扔雪球的臂力这么吓人。打完回来，你捧着热巧克力慢慢写。

wellbeing.en: Black Ice
wellbeing.zh: 暗冰

wellbeing.en: You slip on the ice outside the building and land on your hand. A sprained wrist: one-handed typing for a week.
wellbeing.zh: 你在楼外的冰上滑了一跤，用手撑了地。手腕扭了，接下来一周只能单手打字。

wellbeing.en: Rest it and dictate your writing
wellbeing.zh: 养着手，用语音输入写论文

wellbeing.en: Your laptop hears "in this paper" as "in this pepper" all week. Your wrist heals. Your draft is now well seasoned.
wellbeing.zh: 整整一周，电脑都把“in this paper”听成“in this pepper”。手腕好了，你的草稿也入味了。

wellbeing.en: Type one-handed, grimly
wellbeing.zh: 咬着牙单手打字

wellbeing.en: Forty words a minute becomes nine. You discover how many of your sentences were optional.
wellbeing.zh: 打字速度从每分钟四十个词掉到了九个。你这才发现，自己有那么多句子是可有可无的。

wellbeing.en: Pair-program with {labmate} at the keyboard
wellbeing.zh: 让 {labmate} 打字，结对编程

wellbeing.en: You talk, they type. They fix two of your bugs out of pure impatience.
wellbeing.zh: 你动嘴，对方动手。对方实在看不下去，顺手修了你两个 bug。

wellbeing.en: The Sneeze
wellbeing.zh: 一个喷嚏

wellbeing.en: You sneeze, hard, and something in your lower back says "no". You now walk like someone twice your age.
wellbeing.zh: 你狠狠打了个喷嚏，腰上某个地方“咯噔”一下，宣布罢工。现在你走起路来像老了三十岁。

wellbeing.en: Ice it and spend a day on the floor
wellbeing.zh: 冰敷，在地板上躺一天

wellbeing.en: A whole day on the living-room floor with an ice pack and a podcast. There's a crack in the ceiling you'd never noticed.
wellbeing.zh: 你在客厅地板上躺了一整天，身边一个冰袋，耳边一档播客，还发现天花板上有条以前从没注意过的裂缝。

wellbeing.en: Work standing very still
wellbeing.zh: 站着一动不动地干活

wellbeing.en: You stand at your desk like a heron for three days. It mostly works, until you drop a pen.
wellbeing.zh: 你像只鹭鸶一样在桌前站了三天，基本管用，直到有支笔掉在了地上。

wellbeing.en: Tell everyone it was a sports injury
wellbeing.zh: 跟大家说是运动受伤

wellbeing.en: Nobody believes you. Everyone respects the commitment to the story.
wellbeing.zh: 没人信，但大家都很佩服你把戏演到底的精神。

wellbeing.en: Faculty vs. Students
wellbeing.zh: 师生足球赛

wellbeing.en: It's the annual faculty-vs-students soccer match, and {advisor} is on the other team, wearing shin guards and the look they usually save for deadlines.
wellbeing.zh: 一年一度的师生足球赛到了。{advisor}在对面，戴着护腿板，脸上是平时截稿前才有的表情。

wellbeing.en: Play hard
wellbeing.zh: 全力以赴

wellbeing.en: You score past {advisor}, who shakes your hand and brings it up at lab meeting for a month. You're sore all week.
wellbeing.zh: 你突破 {advisor}进了一球。导师赛后跟你握手，之后一个月的组会上都在提这事。你浑身酸了一周。

wellbeing.en: One big tackle and a pulled hamstring. The students win anyway, and you watch the second half with an ice pack.
wellbeing.zh: 一次大力铲球，你拉伤了大腿后侧。好在学生队还是赢了，你敷着冰袋看完了下半场。

wellbeing.en: Go easy whenever your advisor has the ball
wellbeing.zh: 导师拿球时放放水

wellbeing.en: {advisor} scores twice and is in a wonderful mood all week. Your teammates have noticed.
wellbeing.zh: {advisor}进了两个球，一整周心情都特别好。你的队友们都看在眼里。

wellbeing.en: Cheer from the sideline with snacks
wellbeing.zh: 带零食在场边加油

wellbeing.en: You bring orange slices and the loudest voice on the field. The students lose by one, but the snacks are a hit.
wellbeing.zh: 你带去了橙子，还贡献了全场最大的嗓门。学生队一球惜败，但零食大受欢迎。

wellbeing.en: The Climbing Gym
wellbeing.zh: 攀岩馆

wellbeing.en: {labmate} drags you to the climbing gym. You make it up two walls. The next morning, your forearms are too sore to hold a coffee, let alone type.
wellbeing.zh: {labmate} 拉你去攀岩，你爬完了两面墙。第二天早上，小臂酸得连咖啡都端不住，更别说打字了。

wellbeing.en: Go again next week
wellbeing.zh: 下周再去

wellbeing.en: Week two: three walls, less shaking. {labmate} has a climbing buddy now.
wellbeing.zh: 第二周：三面墙，手抖得少了。{labmate} 终于有攀岩搭子了。

wellbeing.en: Stick to the easy wall
wellbeing.zh: 只爬新手墙
