wellbeing.en: The beginner wall is full of eight-year-olds who are better than you. It's good exercise anyway.
wellbeing.zh: 新手墙上全是比你爬得好的八岁小孩。不过运动量还是够的。

wellbeing.en: Rest your hands and read papers instead
wellbeing.zh: 让手歇着，改读论文

wellbeing.en: You spend two days reading with your arms propped on pillows. Your forearms recover, and your reading list gets shorter.
wellbeing.zh: 你把胳膊架在枕头上读了两天论文。小臂恢复了，待读清单也短了。

wellbeing.en: Last Row
wellbeing.zh: 最后一排

wellbeing.en: Fourteen hours on the plane to {city}: last row, next to the restroom, in a seat that reclines one inch, in theory.
wellbeing.zh: 飞往{city}的十四个小时：最后一排，挨着厕所，座椅理论上能往后放一英寸。

wellbeing.en: Walk the aisle every hour
wellbeing.zh: 每小时在过道走一圈

wellbeing.en: You do laps with a retired dentist and land with working legs.
wellbeing.zh: 你和一位退休牙医结伴在过道里绕圈，落地时腿还是自己的。

wellbeing.en: Put on an eye mask and sleep
wellbeing.zh: 戴上眼罩睡觉

wellbeing.en: You sleep six of the fourteen hours, in eleven pieces.
wellbeing.zh: 十四个小时里你睡了六个，分成了十一段。

wellbeing.en: Finish your slides on the tray table
wellbeing.zh: 在小桌板上做完幻灯片

wellbeing.en: The slides are done by landing. Your neck stays at tray-table angle for two days.
wellbeing.zh: 落地前幻灯片做完了，可你的脖子保持着低头看小桌板的角度，整整两天。

wellbeing.en: Wide Awake at 4 am
wellbeing.zh: 凌晨 4 点，精神抖擞

wellbeing.en: Jet lag wakes you at 4 am in {city}, wide awake and starving. The hotel gym opens at 5.
wellbeing.zh: 人在{city}，时差让你凌晨 4 点就醒了，又精神又饿。可酒店健身房 5 点才开门。

wellbeing.en: Work out the minute it opens
wellbeing.zh: 一开门就去健身

wellbeing.en: Forty minutes on a treadmill facing a mirror. By breakfast, your body has picked a time zone.
wellbeing.zh: 对着镜子跑了四十分钟跑步机。到早饭时，你的身体总算选定了一个时区。

wellbeing.en: Rehearse your talk in the empty lobby
wellbeing.zh: 在空荡荡的大堂排练报告

wellbeing.en: The night clerk hears your talk four times and has one very good question.
wellbeing.zh: 值夜班的前台听了四遍你的报告，还提了一个很好的问题。

wellbeing.en: Lie in the dark reading arXiv
wellbeing.zh: 摸黑躺着刷 arXiv

wellbeing.en: By sunrise you've read nine abstracts and remember none. You fall asleep at 7:50, ten minutes before your alarm.
wellbeing.zh: 天亮时你读了九篇摘要，一篇都没记住。7:50 你睡着了，离闹钟响还有十分钟。

wellbeing.en: 23,000 Steps
wellbeing.zh: 2.3 万步

wellbeing.en: Your phone says you're walking 23,000 steps a day at {venue}. Your feet say more. Your conference shoes were chosen for looks.
wellbeing.zh: 微信运动显示你在 {venue} 每天走 2.3 万步，你的脚坚称不止。参会这双鞋，当初是冲着好看买的。

wellbeing.en: Buy comfortable shoes in {city}
wellbeing.zh: 在{city}买双舒服的鞋

wellbeing.en: The ugliest, softest shoes in {city}. You miss a morning session finding them, then walk the rest of the week in bliss.
wellbeing.zh: 你买到了{city}最丑、最软的一双鞋。为了找它错过了一上午的报告，但剩下几天走得无比幸福。

wellbeing.en: Sit through the afternoon sessions
wellbeing.zh: 整个下午坐着听报告

wellbeing.en: Three hours in a dark room with your feet up on your bag. You learn a lot and meet nobody.
wellbeing.zh: 在昏暗的会场里坐了三个小时，脚搭在包上。学到了很多，一个人也没认识。

wellbeing.en: Keep walking the poster hall
wellbeing.zh: 继续逛海报厅

wellbeing.en: Forty posters and twelve good conversations later, you have two blisters.
wellbeing.zh: 看了四十张海报，跟人好好聊了十二回，脚上也磨出了两个泡。

wellbeing.en: Forty Percent Croissant
wellbeing.zh: 可颂含量 40%

wellbeing.en: Day three at {venue}. Since landing, you've eaten nothing but coffee-break pastries. You are now about 40% croissant.
wellbeing.zh: {venue} 第三天。落地以来你只吃过茶歇的点心，现在身体成分大约 40% 是可颂。

wellbeing.en: Find a grocery store
wellbeing.zh: 找家超市

wellbeing.en: You eat yogurt and a bag of carrots on a bench in {city}. You miss a session and don't regret it.
wellbeing.zh: 你坐在{city}的长椅上，吃了酸奶，啃了一袋胡萝卜。错过了一场报告，一点也不后悔。

wellbeing.en: Embrace it
wellbeing.zh: 坦然接受

wellbeing.en: There's a cinnamon one today. Life is good, and slightly sticky.
wellbeing.zh: 今天有肉桂卷。生活很美好，就是有点黏手。

wellbeing.en: Save room for the reception
wellbeing.zh: 留着肚子等招待会

wellbeing.en: You skip lunch to save room. The reception food is gone in four minutes. You eat a breadstick and talk to everyone.
wellbeing.zh: 你为此连午饭都没吃，结果招待会的吃的四分钟就被抢光了。你只好啃着一根面包棍，跟所有人聊了个遍。

wellbeing.en: Find the bakery the locals line up for
wellbeing.zh: 找本地人排队的面包店

wellbeing.en: Foodie
wellbeing.zh: 吃货

wellbeing.en: A tiny bakery with a line around the block. You bring a box back to your session and become very popular.
wellbeing.zh: 一家小小的面包店，队排了一整条街。你带了一盒回会场，瞬间成了红人。

wellbeing.en: The Fun Run
wellbeing.zh: 趣味跑

wellbeing.en: The {venue} fun run starts at 6:30 am. Two authors whose papers you've cited many times have signed up.
wellbeing.zh: {venue} 的趣味跑早上 6:30 开跑。两位你引用过很多次的作者也报了名。

wellbeing.en: Run it
wellbeing.zh: 去跑

wellbeing.en: You keep pace with them for five kilometers and talk the whole way. One of them asks for your paper.
wellbeing.zh: 你跟着他们跑了五公里，一路聊个不停。其中一位还问起了你的论文。

wellbeing.en: You last two kilometers, then walk. They wave as they pass. At the finish you say hi, very red in the face.
wellbeing.zh: 你撑了两公里就改成走了。两人超过你时还冲你挥手。到了终点，你满脸通红地跟他们打了招呼。

wellbeing.en: Sleep in
wellbeing.zh: 睡个懒觉

wellbeing.en: You sleep until 8 and see the finish-line photos at breakfast. Everyone looks happy and very sweaty.
wellbeing.zh: 你睡到 8 点，早饭时看到了终点的照片。每个人都很开心，也都汗流浃背。

wellbeing.en: Walk it with a coffee, meet them at the end
wellbeing.zh: 端着咖啡走完，在终点等他们

wellbeing.en: You arrive last, with coffee. They are delighted, mostly by the coffee, and you talk for twenty minutes.
wellbeing.zh: 你端着咖啡最后一个到。他们很高兴，主要是因为咖啡，然后你们聊了二十分钟。

wellbeing.en: Canceled
wellbeing.zh: 航班取消

wellbeing.en: Your flight home from {city} is canceled overnight. The line for hotel vouchers is two hours long and not moving.
wellbeing.zh: 你从{city}回家的航班连夜取消了。领酒店券的队伍长到要排两个小时，还纹丝不动。

wellbeing.en: Wait for the voucher
wellbeing.zh: 排队等酒店券

wellbeing.en: Two hours later you have a voucher for a hotel by the highway. You sleep five hours and fly home grumpy.
wellbeing.zh: 两小时后，你拿到了一张高速路边酒店的券。睡了五个小时，带着一肚子气飞回家。

wellbeing.en: Sleep on the floor by the gate
wellbeing.zh: 在登机口打地铺

wellbeing.en: You build a bed out of a conference tote and your poster tube. You wake up first in line, with a crick in your neck.
wellbeing.zh: 你用会议帆布袋和海报筒搭了张床。醒来时你排在了第一个，只是脖子落枕了。

wellbeing.en: Work through the night on revisions
wellbeing.zh: 通宵改论文

wellbeing.en: At an empty gate at 3 am, you revise more than you have all month. You land looking like a ghost.
wellbeing.zh: 凌晨 3 点，在空无一人的登机口，你改的比这个月加起来都多。落地时整个人像个游魂。

world.en: Everyone Pivots
world.zh: 风向变了

world.en: {biglab} releases {model}. Within a week, every reading group and half of arXiv is about it.
world.zh: {biglab} 发布了 {model}，不到一周，所有读书会和半个 arXiv 都在聊它。

world.en: {biglab} releases {model}, and the field changes its plans overnight. Three talks at this week's seminar are rewritten the morning of.
world.zh: {biglab} 发布了 {model}，整个领域连夜改计划。这周的讨论班上，有三个报告是当天早上临时重写的。

world.en: Spend the weekend trying it
world.zh: 花一个周末上手试试

world.en: You find two things it does brilliantly and one it gets hilariously wrong. You keep notes on all three.
world.zh: 你发现它有两件事做得惊艳，还有一件翻车翻得离谱。三件你都记了下来。

world.en: Stay on your own path
world.zh: 继续走自己的路

world.en: While everyone chases {model}, you have your corner of the field to yourself.
world.zh: 大家都去追 {model} 了，你那一亩三分地终于清净了。

world.en: At lab meeting, three people ask why you're not using {model}. You don't have a great answer yet.
world.zh: 组会上，三个人问你为什么不用 {model}。你一时还真答不上来。

world.en: Start a quick evaluation of it
world.zh: 先快速评测一下

world.en: Your two-day evaluation finds where {model} breaks. People start emailing you about it.
world.zh: 你花两天做了个评测，摸清了 {model} 会在哪儿翻车。于是开始有人发邮件来找你了。

world.en: Solved, Apparently
world.zh: 据说已经解决了

world.en: {biglab}'s announcement for {model} says it "solves" {project.topic}. You read the fine print. It was tested on forty easy examples.
world.zh: {biglab} 发布 {model}，宣称已经“解决了”{project.topic}，遥遥领先。你仔细看了小字：只在四十个简单样例上测过。

world.en: Test {model} on your data
world.zh: 在你的数据上测测 {model}

world.en: On your data, it gets 61%. Your paper now has a strong new baseline and a sharper story.
world.zh: 在你的数据上，它只有 61%。你的论文多了一个强 baseline，故事也更有说服力了。

world.en: Write a careful thread about it
world.zh: 写个长帖认真分析

world.en: Your thread is shared widely. Researchers send you their own failure cases.
world.zh: 你的长帖被疯狂转发，不少研究者给你发来了自己遇到的翻车案例。

world.en: The thread gets four likes, two of them from labmates.
world.zh: 长帖收获了四个赞，其中两个来自同门。

world.en: Ignore it and keep working
world.zh: 不理它，接着干

world.en: A month later nobody remembers the claim, except maybe your reviewers.
world.zh: 一个月后，这个说法就没人记得了。你的审稿人可能是例外。

world.en: Suddenly Popular
world.zh: 突然爆火

world.en: Your topic, {project.topic}, is suddenly the hottest thing in the field: {roll:38-45} new papers this month alone.
world.zh: 你做的{project.topic}突然成了顶流：光这个月就有 {roll:38-45} 篇新论文。

world.en: Rush to get yours out first
world.zh: 抢在别人前面发出去

world.en: You work three weekends straight. The draft moves fast, and a few corners get cut.
world.zh: 你连干了三个周末。草稿推进得飞快，只是有几处偷了工。

world.en: Read every one of them
world.zh: 每一篇都读一遍

world.en: Two overlap with yours. Now you know exactly what makes your work different.
world.zh: 有两篇跟你撞了，不过这下你很清楚自己的工作不同在哪了。

world.en: Find the angle nobody's taking
world.zh: 找一个没人做的角度

world.en: Everyone is building systems, so you study the users instead.
world.zh: 大家都扎堆做系统，你转头去研究用户。

world.en: Every angle you find is already taken, sometimes twice.
world.zh: 你想到的每个角度都已经有人做了，有的还被做了两遍。

world.en: Is It an Agent?
world.zh: 这算 Agent 吗？

world.en: Suddenly every paper needs "agents", and the word is on every lab meeting slide. {labmate} asks whether {project} is an agent.
world.zh: 突然之间万物皆可 Agent，组会上每页幻灯片都有这个词。{labmate} 问你：{project} 算不算 Agent？

world.en: Rebrand it as an agent
world.zh: 包装成 Agent

world.en: Your slides say "agentic" eleven times. People seem more interested, and somewhat more confused.
world.zh: 你的幻灯片里出现了十一次“agentic”。大家好像更感兴趣了，也更糊涂了。

world.en: Explain that it's a pipeline
world.zh: 解释说这就是个 pipeline

world.en: "It's a pipeline." A few people nod. One of them is a reviewer, and they appreciate it.
world.zh: “这就是个 pipeline。”几个人点了点头。其中一位恰好是审稿人，挺欣赏这份坦诚。

world.en: Build a real agent version
world.zh: 做个真正的 Agent 版本

world.en: You spend a week on it. It works, and it's more interesting than the buzzword.
world.zh: 你花了一周做出来，还真能用，而且比这个热词本身有意思多了。

world.en: Does It Mean Anything?
world.zh: 这测的是啥？

world.en: A field-wide online debate breaks out: does the benchmark behind {project} measure anything at all? The top post has {roll:900-3000} replies.
world.zh: 网上爆发了一场全领域大讨论：{project} 用的那个基准到底测出了什么？最热的帖子盖了 {roll:900-3000} 层楼。

world.en: Add a second evaluation
world.zh: 再加一组评估

world.en: A small human evaluation backs up your numbers. It costs a week and makes the paper much harder to attack.
world.zh: 你做了个小规模人工评估，结果撑住了你的数字。虽然花了一周，但论文难挑刺多了。

world.en: Join the debate
world.zh: 加入讨论

world.en: You post a careful take and spend two days answering replies. Some of them are useful.
world.zh: 你认真写了篇观点帖，又花两天回评论。有些评论还挺有用。

world.en: Write an honest limitations paragraph
world.zh: 老实写一段局限性

world.en: You write one clear paragraph on what the benchmark can and can't tell you. Reviewers tend to like that.
world.zh: 你用一段话讲清楚了这个基准能说明什么、不能说明什么。审稿人一般都吃这一套。

world.en: A Famous Post
world.zh: 大佬发帖

world.en: A famous researcher posts about {paper}: "This is the kind of work the field needs." Your phone does not stop buzzing for an hour.
world.zh: 一位大佬发帖提到 {paper}：“这正是这个领域需要的工作。”你的手机震了整整一个小时。

world.en: Reply with a short thank-you
world.zh: 回一句简短的感谢

world.en: You keep it short and gracious. A few hundred people read your paper this week.
world.zh: 你的回复简短得体。这周有几百人读了你的论文。

world.en: Post a thread explaining the paper
world.zh: 发个长帖讲解论文

world.en: The thread takes off. Three labs email you about follow-up work.
world.zh: 长帖火了。三个实验室发邮件找你谈后续合作。

world.en: The replies turn into an argument about your figure's font. Some people read the paper anyway.
world.zh: 评论区歪楼了，开始争论你图表用的字体。好在还是有人读了论文。

world.en: Send a screenshot to your parents
world.zh: 截图发给爸妈

world.en: Your parents don't fully get it, but they print it out and put it on the fridge.
world.zh: 爸妈没太看懂，但截图当天就被转进了家族群。

world.en: Pioneering Work
world.zh: 开创性工作

world.en: A new survey paper calls {paper} "pioneering work". You read the sentence three times to make sure it's yours.
world.zh: 一篇新综述把 {paper} 称为“开创性工作”。你把这句话读了三遍，确认说的真是你的论文。

world.en: Email the authors a thank-you
world.zh: 给作者发邮件道谢

world.en: They reply warmly and ask whether you'd review their next draft.
world.zh: 对方热情回复，还问你愿不愿意帮忙看看他们的下一稿。

world.en: Add it to your research statement
world.zh: 写进研究陈述

world.en: "Described as pioneering by a recent survey." It reads well in the statement.
world.zh: “被近期综述评为开创性工作。”写在研究陈述里挺好看。

world.en: Read how they describe it
world.zh: 看看他们怎么描述的

world.en: They get it mostly right, which is more than most citations do.
world.zh: 大体都说对了，比大多数引了不读的强多了。

world.en: The Freeze
world.zh: 招聘冻结

world.en: Three companies on your list announce hiring freezes in the same week. One recruiter writes to "keep in touch for next year".
world.zh: 你海投名单上的三家公司在同一周宣布冻结招聘。有个 HR 发来邮件：“明年有机会再联系。”

world.en: Widen your search
world.zh: 扩大海投范围

world.en: You add twelve more places and a few you'd never considered. It's a long weekend of cover letters.
world.zh: 你又加了十二家，有几家以前想都没想过。整个周末都在写求职信。

world.en: Ask {advisor} about a postdoc
world.zh: 问问 {advisor}有没有博士后机会

world.en: Your advisor has a few ideas and a few names. Suddenly the year ahead looks less frozen.
world.zh: 导师给了几个思路，还推荐了几个人。明年一下子看起来没那么冷了。

world.en: Lean on your network
world.zh: 动用人脉

world.en: A former labmate's team still has one open position. They forward your CV that afternoon.
world.zh: 一位已毕业的同门那边还有一个空缺，当天下午就帮你内推了。

world.en: Everyone you ask is frozen too. A few promise to let you know when things thaw.
world.zh: 你问了一圈，大家那边也都冻着。有几个人答应，等解冻了就告诉你。

world.en: Offers, Unasked
world.zh: 机会找上门

world.en: Hiring is booming. Two recruiters you've never met email you about summer internships, and one even spells your name right.
world.zh: 招聘市场火热。两个素未谋面的 HR 发邮件问你暑期实习的事，其中一个甚至把你的名字拼对了。

world.en: Take both calls
world.zh: 两个电话都接

world.en: Both recruiters are friendly, and both calls end with a next step.
world.zh: 两个 HR 都很友好，两通电话都约好了下一步。

world.en: Ask {advisor} which one fits
world.zh: 问 {advisor}哪个更合适

world.en: Your advisor knows someone on one of the teams. Your reply now sounds much better informed.
world.zh: 导师正好在其中一个团队有熟人，这下你回信都显得内行多了。

world.en: Archive them, you're busy
world.zh: 归档，没空

world.en: Your research gets the week. In this market, the recruiters will write again.
world.zh: 这周还是留给科研。行情这么好，HR 还会再来信的。

world.en: Back in Fashion
world.zh: 文艺复兴

world.en: A method from the 2010s is suddenly back in fashion. Half of today's new papers cite something older than your undergrad degree.
world.zh: 一个 2010 年代的老方法突然翻红了。今天的新论文里，有一半引用的东西比你上本科还早。

world.en: Read the original paper
world.zh: 读原始论文

world.en: It's surprisingly good, and it has a section everyone forgot about.
world.zh: 原论文写得出奇地好，还有一节早被所有人忘了。

world.en: Ask {senior} what it was like
world.zh: 问问 {senior} 当年什么样

world.en: {senior} talks for an hour. You learn more than the papers taught you.
world.zh: {senior} 一讲就是一个小时，你学到的比那些论文加起来还多。

world.en: Post "we had this in 2014"
world.zh: 发帖：“我们 2014 年就玩过了”

world.en: It gets a lot of likes from people who were there, and a lot of replies from people who weren't.
world.zh: 经历过那段时间的人纷纷点赞，没经历过的人纷纷回复。

world.en: The Daily Listing
world.zh: 今日份 arXiv

world.en: Today's arXiv listing in your area is {roll:380-460} papers long.
world.zh: 今天你这个方向的 arXiv 更新，足足有 {roll:380-460} 篇。

world.en: You open today's arXiv listing. It is {roll:380-460} papers long, and it's only Tuesday.
world.zh: 你打开今天的 arXiv 列表：{roll:380-460} 篇论文，而今天才周二。

world.en: Skim every title
world.zh: 每个标题都扫一眼

world.en: An hour later, you have seven open tabs and a mild headache.
world.zh: 一小时后，你开了七个标签页，头也有点疼。

world.en: Search for anything like yours
world.zh: 搜搜有没有撞车的

world.en: Nothing overlaps with your work, and you relax a little.
world.zh: 没有和你撞车的，你稍微松了口气。

world.en: One paper looks close. After an hour of reading, you decide it probably isn't.
world.zh: 有一篇看着很像。你读了一个小时，觉得应该不算撞车。

world.en: Close the tab
world.zh: 关掉标签页

world.en: If a paper matters, someone in the lab chat will post it.
world.zh: 真重要的论文，组群里自然会有人转。

world.en: Is This Still Relevant?
world.zh: 这还有人关心吗？

world.en: Your topic, {project.topic}, has gone quiet. After your seminar talk on {project}, someone asks, kindly: "Is this still relevant?"
world.zh: 你做的{project.topic}已经凉了。你在讨论班上讲完 {project}，有人很客气地问：“这个现在还有人关心吗？”

world.en: Reframe it around today's questions
world.zh: 结合当下热点重新包装

world.en: You connect it to the question everyone is asking now. Suddenly it's the angle nobody else has.
world.zh: 你把它和眼下大家都在问的问题挂上了钩，一下子成了别人都没有的角度。

world.en: The new framing confuses everyone, including your own abstract.
world.zh: 新的叙事把所有人都绕晕了，包括你自己的摘要。

world.en: Show who still needs it
world.zh: 找出还有谁需要它

world.en: You find three real deployments with exactly this problem. Your introduction gets a new first paragraph.
world.zh: 你找到了三个真实部署场景，正好都有这个问题，于是引言有了新的第一段。

world.en: Keep going: less hype, less competition
world.zh: 继续做：热度低，竞争也少

world.en: With fewer people to race, you make steady progress. A few doubts creep in at night.
world.zh: 没人跟你卷，你稳步推进。只是夜里偶尔会冒出几丝怀疑。

world.en: Twice the Papers
world.zh: 投稿量翻倍

world.en: The flagship conference got {roll:18000-24000} submissions this cycle, double last year. The reviewer pool did not double. An email asks if you can take "a few" extra reviews.
world.zh: 领域顶会这一轮收到了 {roll:18000-24000} 篇投稿，是去年的两倍，审稿人可没翻倍。于是你收到一封邮件，问能不能多审“几篇”。

world.en: Volunteer for six extra reviews
world.zh: 主动多审六篇

world.en: You review six papers in a week. Now you know what everyone else is working on, and you're tired.
world.zh: 你一周审了六篇，现在知道别人都在做什么了，人也累坏了。

world.en: Make {project} readable in five minutes
world.zh: 让 {project} 五分钟就能读懂

world.en: You rewrite the abstract, Figure 1 and every first sentence for a reviewer who only skims.
world.zh: 你为只会扫一眼的审稿人重写了摘要、图 1 和每段的第一句。

world.en: Decline. It's a lottery anyway
world.zh: 婉拒，反正都是玄学

world.en: You turn down the extra reviews and keep your week. The deadline still feels like a lottery.
world.zh: 你推掉了额外的审稿，保住了这一周。中不中，依然看玄学。

world.en: A Brand-New Venue
world.zh: 全新的会议

world.en: A new conference launches. It has no track record yet, but it has a very nice logo. {advisor} calls submitting there "a gamble, but a fun one".
world.zh: 新办了一个会议，还没什么口碑，但 logo 非常好看。{advisor}说投那儿“是场赌博，不过挺好玩的”。

world.en: Volunteer to review for it
world.zh: 主动去当审稿人

world.en: You review four papers for the first edition. The organizers remember who showed up early.
world.zh: 你为第一届审了四篇论文。组委会记住了谁最早来捧场。

world.en: Put its deadline in your calendar
world.zh: 把它的截稿日期记进日历

world.en: It goes next to the big ones, in a slightly smaller font. You read the call twice and like it.
world.zh: 它排在那些大会旁边，字号稍微小一点。你读了两遍征稿通知，挺喜欢的。

world.en: Wait and see if it lasts
world.zh: 观望一下能不能办下去

world.en: Most new venues fade. You'll keep an eye on it from a safe distance.
world.zh: 大多数新会议办着办着就没了。你决定先站远点观望。

world.en: The Gamble Paid Off
world.zh: 赌对了

world.en: The brand-new conference from two years ago is now where everyone wants to publish. Its acceptance rate is 19%, and people call it "basically top-tier" in hushed voices.
world.zh: 两年前那个新会议，现在成了大家都想投的地方。录用率 19%，大家压低声音说它“基本算顶会了”。

world.en: Mention you were there at the start
world.zh: 提一句你从第一届就在

world.en: Early
world.zh: 元老

world.en: The first-edition crowd has a group chat now. You're in it, and so are two of this year's program chairs.
world.zh: 第一届那批人拉了个元老群。你在群里，今年的两位程序委员会主席也在。

world.en: Read its best papers
world.zh: 读读它的最佳论文

world.en: The bar is high and the papers are good. Its deadline goes in your calendar, in full-size font.
world.zh: 门槛很高，论文也很好。它的截稿日期进了你的日历，用的是正常字号。

world.en: Remember everyone calling it a gamble
world.zh: 想起当初大家都说是赌博

world.en: You keep that memory to yourself, mostly. Prestige, it turns out, takes about two years.
world.zh: 这事你基本没跟人提过。原来所谓声望，大概只需要两年。

world.en: The New Checklist
world.zh: 新的检查清单

world.en: Your target venues adopt a new reproducibility checklist: random seeds, compute hours, code links and the exact prompts you used. For {project}, you can answer about half.
world.zh: 你要投的会议推出了新的可复现性检查清单：随机种子、算力时长、代码链接，还有你用过的完整提示词。拿 {project} 一对照，你大概只能答上一半。

world.en: Answer honestly, gaps and all
world.zh: 如实作答，缺的就写缺

world.en: Half the answers say "not recorded". It stings, but reviewers tend to respect that.
world.zh: 一半答案写着“未记录”。有点扎心，但审稿人通常尊重这种诚实。

world.en: Rerun things until every answer is yes
world.zh: 重跑到每项都能打勾

world.en: After a week of reruns with every seed logged, every box is a confident yes. You feel slightly less confident in general.
world.zh: 你重新炼了一周丹，每个种子都记录在案，每一项都能自信地打勾了。只是你整个人没那么自信了。

world.en: Write a logging script for the future
world.zh: 写个日志脚本，留给以后

world.en: Your script records every seed and GPU hour automatically. Half the lab asks for a copy.
world.zh: 你的脚本自动记录每个种子和每个 GPU 小时。组里一半人找你要了一份。

world.en: The script logs everything, including 40 GB of things nobody needs.
world.zh: 脚本什么都记，连带记下了 40 GB 没人需要的东西。

writing.en: The Bug After the Deadline
writing.zh: 截稿后的 bug

writing.en: Three days after submitting {paper}, you find a bug in your evaluation script: it counted some test examples twice. Fixed, your gain over the best baseline drops from 4.1 points to 1.9.
writing.zh: 投完 {paper} 三天后，你在评测脚本里发现一个 bug：有些测试样本被算了两次。修好之后，你相对最强 baseline 的提升从 4.1 个点缩水到 1.9。

writing.en: Rerunning one table for fun, you find a bug in your analysis script. The corrected numbers still support {paper}, but the headline gain is half of what the submission says.
writing.zh: 你一时兴起重跑了一张表，结果在分析脚本里发现一个 bug。修正后的数字仍然支持 {paper} 的结论，但主打的提升只有投稿里写的一半。

writing.en: Email the program chairs tonight
writing.zh: 今晚就给程序主席写信

writing.en: The chairs thank you and pass the correction to the reviewers. Your advisor replies: "This is exactly right. Thank you." It stings less than you expected.
writing.zh: 程序主席向你道谢，把更正转给了审稿人。导师回复：“这么做就对了，谢谢你。”心里倒没你想的那么难受。

writing.en: Disclose it in the author response
writing.zh: 在作者回复里主动说明

writing.en: You open the response with the correction and the new numbers. Reviewer 1 thanks you for the transparency, and the smaller gain still holds.
writing.zh: 你在回复开头就写明了更正和新数字。1 号审稿人感谢你的坦诚，缩水后的提升依然站得住。

writing.en: The correction ends up in paragraph four. Reviewer 2 finds it there and now doubts every number in the paper.
writing.zh: 结果更正被埋在了第四段。2 号审稿人还是翻到了，从此开始怀疑论文里的每一个数字。

writing.en: Fix it in the camera-ready, tell nobody
writing.zh: 等终稿再悄悄改，谁也不说

writing.en: You add "update Table 2" to your to-do list and tell nobody. It sits there like a pebble in your shoe.
writing.zh: 你在待办清单里加了一条“更新 Table 2”，谁也没告诉。这条待办就一直挂在那儿，让你如鲠在喉。

writing.en: "It's only two points." Let it go
writing.zh: “才两个点而已。”算了

writing.en: You close the script. The paper is under review, and the numbers are what they are. Something about that sentence keeps bothering you.
writing.zh: 你关掉了脚本。论文在审，数字就是这样了。可这句话总有哪里让你不踏实。

writing.en: Spot the Difference
writing.zh: 大家来找茬

writing.en: A careful reader emails you. The numbers in Table 2 of your latest version differ from the ones reviewers saw, and nothing in the paper says why.
writing.zh: 一位细心的读者给你发来邮件：你最新版本 Table 2 里的数字和审稿人看到的不一样，论文里却没有任何解释。

writing.en: Add a correction note today
writing.zh: 今天就加更正说明

writing.en: Two sentences and a footnote explain the fix. It costs you a little pride and earns you some respect.
writing.zh: 两句话加一个脚注，讲清了这次修正。你丢了一点面子，换回了一些尊重。

writing.en: Reply privately and explain
writing.zh: 私下回信解释

writing.en: They accept your explanation and thank you. You wonder how many readers noticed and didn't write.
writing.zh: 对方接受了你的解释，还谢了你。你忍不住想，还有多少读者发现了却没吭声。

writing.en: Leave the email unanswered
writing.zh: 不回这封邮件

writing.en: Their second email copies your advisor. Your advisor's note to you afterwards is very short.
writing.zh: 对方的第二封邮件抄送了你导师。事后导师发给你的消息非常短。

writing.en: The Polite Email
writing.zh: 一封客气的邮件

writing.en: A student at another university ran your released code and got numbers two points below your paper. Their email is very polite, and they attached their logs.
writing.zh: 另一所大学的一个学生跑了你开源的代码，复现结果比论文里低两个点。邮件写得非常客气，还附上了运行日志。

writing.en: Thank them and post a correction
writing.zh: 道谢并发布更正

writing.en: The correction goes up, late, with their name in it. They cite you anyway.
writing.zh: 更正发出来了，虽然晚了点，里面专门写上了对方的名字。对方后来照样引用了你。

writing.en: Tell your advisor first
writing.zh: 先告诉导师

writing.en: Your advisor is quiet for a moment, then helps you write the correction. "Next time, tell me the day you find it."
writing.zh: 导师沉默了一会儿，然后帮你一起写了更正。“下次发现的当天就告诉我。”

writing.en: Blame the random seeds
writing.zh: 甩锅给随机种子

writing.en: They run ten seeds and send you a plot. Their paper cites yours, in a footnote about reproducibility.
writing.zh: 对方跑了十个种子，给你发来一张图。后来对方的论文也引用了你，只不过是在一个讲可复现性的脚注里。

writing.en: Christmas in the Lab
writing.zh: 实验室里过圣诞

writing.en: Winter break. The building is empty, and for once so is the GPU queue. {project} still needs two experiments and half a rewrite.
writing.zh: 寒假，人去楼空，难得 GPU 队列也空了。{project} 还差两个实验，外加重写一半。

writing.en: Your family asks when you're coming home for the holidays. You look at {project}, then at the empty GPU queue, then back at the message.
writing.zh: 家里问你放假什么时候回来。你看看 {project}，又看看空荡荡的 GPU 队列，再看回那条消息。

writing.en: Spend the whole break on it
writing.zh: 搭上整个假期

writing.en: You run experiments by day and rewrite by night, with family calls on mute. By New Year the paper is much better, and you are much more tired.
writing.zh: 你白天跑实验，晚上改论文，和家里视频时都开着静音。到元旦，论文好了不少，人也累得够呛。

writing.en: Work mornings, family evenings
writing.zh: 上午干活，晚上陪家人

writing.en: The experiments run while you eat dinner. Progress is slower, but you will remember that the holidays happened.
writing.zh: 你吃晚饭的时候，实验就在跑着。进度慢了点，但这个假期你是真真切切过了。

writing.en: Take the whole break off
writing.zh: 彻底休假

writing.en: You leave the laptop closed for two weeks and eat too much. You come back rested, with the same paper and a clearer idea of what it needs.
writing.zh: 你两周没碰电脑，亲身验证了每逢佳节胖三斤。回来时精神饱满，论文还是那篇，但你更清楚它缺什么了。

writing.en: Run jobs while everyone sleeps
writing.zh: 趁大家睡觉时跑任务

writing.en: Night Owl
writing.zh: 夜猫子

writing.en: Jobs launch at 1 am and finish by breakfast. Your family thinks you're on vacation. The cluster knows better.
writing.zh: 任务凌晨 1 点提交，早饭前跑完。家里以为你在度假，只有集群知道真相。

writing.en: Twelve Into Eight
writing.zh: 12 页塞进 8 页

writing.en: The draft of {project} is 12 pages. {venue} allows 8. The deadline is tomorrow night.
writing.zh: {project} 的草稿有 12 页，可 {venue} 只给 8 页。明晚就截稿。

writing.en: You compile the final draft and scroll to the end: page 12. The limit is 8.
writing.zh: 你编译好最终稿，拉到最后：第 12 页。可上限是 8 页。

writing.en: Cut it sentence by sentence
writing.zh: 一句一句地删

writing.en: Eight pages, and somehow clearer than twelve. Half the cuts were sentences that said the same thing twice.
writing.zh: 8 页，不知怎么反而比 12 页更清楚。删掉的句子里，有一半是把同一件事说了两遍。

writing.en: It fits in eight pages, but Section 4 lost the sentences that explained it. Now nobody, including you, can follow it.
writing.zh: 塞进了 8 页，但 Section 4 用来解释的句子全被删了。现在没人看得懂，包括你自己。

writing.en: Move everything to the appendix
writing.zh: 全扔进附录

writing.en: The main paper fits. Reviewers don't have to read the appendix, and they won't.
writing.zh: 正文塞下了。审稿人不必看附录，他们也不会看。

writing.en: Shrink the fonts and the spacing
writing.zh: 缩字号，压行距

writing.en: It fits. Table 2 is now in 7-point type, and Figure 3 needs a magnifying glass.
writing.zh: 塞下了。只是 Table 2 的字号缩到了 7pt，Figure 3 得拿放大镜看。

writing.en: Rewrite it in half the words
writing.zh: 用一半的字数重写

writing.en: Wordsmith
writing.zh: 笔杆子

writing.en: You cut every paragraph in half, and it reads better than the long version ever did.
writing.zh: 你把每一段都砍掉一半，反而比长版本读起来顺多了。

writing.en: Overleaf Is Down
writing.zh: Overleaf 挂了

writing.en: Two hours before the {venue} deadline, Overleaf stops loading. The status page says "investigating". So does everyone in your lab chat.
writing.zh: 离 {venue} 截稿还有两小时，Overleaf 打不开了。状态页写着“正在调查”。你们组群里的每个人也都在“调查”。

writing.en: You click Recompile and nothing happens, so you refresh. Overleaf is down, and the {venue} deadline is in two hours.
writing.zh: 你点了 Recompile，没反应，于是刷新页面。Overleaf 挂了，而 {venue} 两小时后截稿。

writing.en: Compile locally from your last sync
writing.zh: 用上次同步的版本本地编译

writing.en: Your last sync was 20 minutes ago. You finish in a local editor and submit with time to spare.
writing.zh: 上次同步是 20 分钟前。你在本地编辑器里改完，从容提交。

writing.en: Your local copy is from last Tuesday. You redo a week of edits from memory and submit at 11:58 pm.
writing.zh: 本地的版本还是上周二的。你凭记忆把一周的修改重做了一遍，晚上 11:58 极限交稿。

writing.en: Wait and keep refreshing
writing.zh: 等着，不停刷新

writing.en: It comes back after 50 minutes. You spend the last hour fixing only what matters, which turns out to be a skill.
writing.zh: 50 分钟后恢复了。最后一小时你只改真正要紧的地方，原来这也是一种本事。

writing.en: Submit this morning's PDF
writing.zh: 交今天早上的 PDF

writing.en: Submitted at 10:02 pm, minus tonight's fixes. You go to bed while everyone else refreshes.
writing.zh: 晚上 10:02 交了，只是少了今晚的修改。别人还在疯狂 F5，你已经睡下了。

writing.en: Build it from your own git mirror
writing.zh: 用自己的 git 镜像编译

writing.en: Code Wizard
writing.zh: 代码大神

writing.en: The mirror you set up two years ago, for exactly this night, is five minutes behind. You submit calmly.
writing.zh: 两年前你就为这样的夜晚搭好了镜像，现在它只落后五分钟。你淡定交稿，深藏功与名。

writing.en: At 11:45 pm, {labmate} pushes a big change to {project}: a rewritten Section 4 and a new results table. The deadline is midnight.
writing.zh: 晚上 11:45，{labmate} 给 {project} 推了一大坨修改：重写了 Section 4，还加了一张新的结果表。午夜截稿。

writing.en: Fifteen minutes before the deadline, the edit history lights up. {labmate} is rewriting your related work, live.
writing.zh: 离截稿还有十五分钟，修改记录突然开始刷屏：{labmate} 正在现场重写你的相关工作。

writing.en: Keep every change
writing.zh: 保留所有改动

writing.en: It compiles, and the new version is honestly better than yours.
writing.zh: 编译通过了，而且说实话，新版比你写的好。

writing.en: It compiles with 14 undefined references. Every cell of the new table reads "??".
writing.zh: 编译倒是过了，但有 14 个未定义引用。新表格的每一格都是“??”，你脸上也是。

writing.en: Revert to your version
writing.zh: 回退到你的版本

writing.en: You submit your version at 11:57. {labmate} says "no worries" in a tone that suggests worries.
writing.zh: 你在 11:57 交了自己的版本。{labmate} 说了句“没事”，但语气听起来很有事。

writing.en: Merge only what you can check
writing.zh: 只合并能核对的部分

writing.en: You read each change once and keep about half. You submit at 11:59:40, heart racing.
writing.zh: 每处修改你都过了一遍，留下大约一半。你在 11:59:40 交了稿，心跳快得要命。

writing.en: 48 More Hours
writing.zh: 续命 48 小时

writing.en: At 9 pm, the chairs extend the {venue} deadline by 48 hours. {project} was nearly done, and now it doesn't have to be.
writing.zh: 晚上 9 点，程序主席宣布 {venue} 截稿延期 48 小时。{project} 本来都快写完了，现在倒不急着写完了。

writing.en: Use all 48 hours
writing.zh: 用满 48 小时

writing.en: You use all 48 hours. The paper gets better and you get worse.
writing.zh: 你用满了 48 小时。论文越改越好，人越熬越差。

writing.en: Polish for one day, then sleep
writing.zh: 打磨一天，然后睡觉

writing.en: After a day of fixes and a full night's sleep, you submit with 20 hours to spare. Nobody in your lab believes you.
writing.zh: 改了一天，又睡了个整觉，你提前 20 小时交了稿。组里没一个人信。

writing.en: Submit now and go to bed
writing.zh: 现在就交，然后睡觉

writing.en: You submit at 9:15 pm and sleep for eleven hours. Everyone else uses all 48.
writing.zh: 你晚上 9:15 交了稿，睡了十一个小时。其他人则熬满了 48 小时。

writing.en: Start the real work at hour 40
writing.zh: 第 40 小时再正式开工

writing.en: Procrastinator
writing.zh: 拖延大师

writing.en: Forty hours of feeling that you have time, then eight hours of doing more than you did all month.
writing.zh: 前四十个小时都觉得时间还多，最后八个小时干的活比整个月都多。DDL 果然是第一生产力。

writing.en: Comments, Six Hours Out
writing.zh: 截稿前六小时的批注

writing.en: Six hours before the deadline, {advisor}'s comments on {project} arrive: {roll:30-60} of them, three starting with "Big question:".
writing.zh: 截稿前六小时，{advisor}对 {project} 的批注来了：一共 {roll:30-60} 条，其中三条以“大问题：”开头。

writing.en: Address every comment
writing.zh: 改完每条批注

writing.en: You get through all of them with ten minutes to spare. The big questions were the right questions.
writing.zh: 你在截稿前十分钟改完了所有批注。那几个大问题，问得都对。

writing.en: Fix the big questions only
writing.zh: 只改大问题

writing.en: You fix the three that matter and leave the commas for the camera-ready. Your advisor agrees with your triage.
writing.zh: 你改了最要紧的三条，逗号之类的留到终稿再说。导师认同你的取舍。

writing.en: You fix three comments carefully. Comment 17, which you skipped, was the important one.
writing.zh: 你仔细改了三条批注。可被你跳过的第 17 条，才是真正重要的那条。

writing.en: "Will fix in the camera-ready!"
writing.zh: “终稿再改！”

writing.en: You submit as is. Your advisor replies "ok." Just "ok."
writing.zh: 你原样交了。导师回了个“嗯。”就一个“嗯。”

writing.en: What If the Title Were a Question?
writing.zh: 标题改成问句怎么样？

writing.en: An hour before the deadline, {advisor} sends a message: "What if the title were a question?"
writing.zh: 截稿前一小时，{advisor}发来消息：“标题改成问句怎么样？”

writing.en: Fifty minutes to go. {advisor} writes: "New title idea. Hear me out." It has a colon and a pun.
writing.zh: 还剩五十分钟。{advisor}写道：“想到个新标题，你先听我说完。”这个标题带冒号，还玩了个双关。

writing.en: Take it and fix every mention
writing.zh: 采纳，改掉每一处

writing.en: The new title is catchier. You change it in six places, then find a seventh.
writing.zh: 新标题更抓人。你改了六处，结果又冒出来第七处。

writing.en: "Can we keep the current one?"
writing.zh: “能不能还用现在这个？”

writing.en: "Fair. It's your paper." You keep your title, and your advisor seems to respect you a little more for asking.
writing.zh: “有道理，论文是你的。”你保住了原标题，导师似乎还因为你敢开口，对你多了一分尊重。

writing.en: "Ok." The period does a lot of work.
writing.zh: “行。”这个句号，懂的都懂。

writing.en: Promise to revisit it later
writing.zh: 答应以后再议

writing.en: You agree to change it for the camera-ready. You both know nobody changes the title for the camera-ready.
writing.zh: 你答应终稿时再改。你们俩都知道，没人会在终稿里改标题。

writing.en: Service Unavailable
writing.zh: 服务不可用

writing.en: At 11:58 pm you click Submit. The {venue} submission system shows a spinning wheel, then "503 Service Unavailable".
writing.zh: 晚上 11:58，你点了 Submit。{venue} 的投稿系统转了一会儿圈，然后显示“503 Service Unavailable”。

writing.en: Refresh and submit again
writing.zh: 刷新，再交一次

writing.en: It goes through at 12:00:41 and counts anyway, because the server's clock was down too.
writing.zh: 12:00:41 交上去了，而且照样算数，因为服务器的时钟也一起挂了。

writing.en: It goes through at 12:03, with final_v2.pdf instead of final_v3.pdf. Your hands were shaking.
writing.zh: 12:03 交上去了。可你手一抖，传的是 final_v2.pdf，而不是 final_v3.pdf。

writing.en: Email your PDF to the chairs
writing.zh: 把 PDF 发邮件给程序主席

writing.en: A form reply at 12:20 am: everything submitted during the outage will be accepted. Hundreds of people got the same reply.
writing.zh: 凌晨 12:20 收到一封统一回复：宕机期间提交的稿件都会受理。几百个人收到了同样的回复。

writing.en: Post the error screenshot online
writing.zh: 把报错截图发网上吐槽

writing.en: Two thousand people post the same screenshot. The chairs add an hour, and you spend most of it reading the replies.
writing.zh: 两千个人晒出了同一张截图。程序主席只好延长一小时，而你大半时间都在刷评论区。

writing.en: Limitations, 3 am
writing.zh: 凌晨 3 点的 Limitations

writing.en: It's 3 am. {venue} requires a Limitations section, and yours is a heading with nothing under it.
writing.zh: 凌晨 3 点。{venue} 要求写一节 Limitations，而你的只有一个标题，下面空空如也。

writing.en: Write honest, specific limitations
writing.zh: 老实写具体的局限

writing.en: You list them plainly: small sample, one language, one site. The paper is more convincing for it.
writing.zh: 你直白地列了出来：样本小，只有一种语言，只在一个地点。论文反而因此更有说服力。

writing.en: It's honest and slightly unhinged. One sentence starts with "Frankly,", which you'll fix in the camera-ready.
writing.zh: 写得很诚实，也有点放飞自我。有一句以“Frankly,”开头，终稿时你得改掉。

writing.en: Paste the generic version
writing.zh: 贴上万能模板

writing.en: "Our method may not generalize to all settings." Reviewers have read that sentence four hundred times.
writing.zh: “我们的方法可能无法推广到所有场景。”这句话审稿人已经读过四百遍了。

writing.en: Turn each limitation into future work
writing.zh: 把每条局限都改成未来工作

writing.en: Every weakness is now an "exciting direction". Reviewers have seen that trick before, too.
writing.zh: 每个缺点现在都成了“令人兴奋的研究方向”。这套话术审稿人也见多了。

writing.en: Sleep four hours, write it at 7 am
writing.zh: 先睡四小时，早上 7 点再写

writing.en: After four hours of sleep, the section takes 40 minutes, and it's the clearest page in the paper.
writing.zh: 睡了四个小时再动笔，这一节只花了 40 分钟，还成了全文最清楚的一页。

writing.en: You sleep through two alarms and write the whole section in 12 minutes, mostly as bullet points.
writing.zh: 结果你睡过了两个闹钟，只好用 12 分钟赶完整节，大半还是列表。

writing.en: Name Already Taken
writing.zh: 缩写撞车

writing.en: An hour before submitting {project}, you finally search your method's acronym. Four papers already use it, and so does a robot vacuum.
writing.zh: 投 {project} 前一小时，你终于搜了一下自己方法的缩写。已经有四篇论文用过了，还有一款扫地机器人。

writing.en: Invent a new acronym, fast
writing.zh: 赶紧想个新缩写

writing.en: Twenty minutes of backronyms later, you have a name nobody has used. It almost spells a word.
writing.zh: 硬凑了二十分钟全称，你终于有了一个没人用过的名字。拼出来差不多算个单词。

writing.en: The best you can manage has a hyphen and the number 2 in it. It is unique, at least.
writing.zh: 你能想到最好的一个，又带连字符又带数字 2。好歹是独一无二的。

writing.en: Keep it and hope nobody checks
writing.zh: 照用，祈祷没人去查

writing.en: Somebody will check. A reviewer will write: "Not to be confused with the four other methods of the same name."
writing.zh: 总会有人查的。某位审稿人会写：“请勿与另外四个同名方法混淆。”

writing.en: Drop it and say "our method"
writing.zh: 不要缩写，就叫“我们的方法”

writing.en: Without the acronym, the paper reads a little plainer and a little clearer.
writing.zh: 没了缩写，论文读起来朴素了一点，也清楚了一点。

writing.en: Anonymous, Mostly
writing.zh: 薛定谔的匿名

writing.en: Rereading the submitted PDF, you click the code link. It opens your personal GitHub page, with your photo and a README thanking your advisor.
writing.zh: 重读投稿的 PDF 时，你点开了代码链接。跳出来的是你的个人 GitHub 主页，有你的照片，还有一个感谢导师的 README。大型社死现场。

writing.en: An hour after submitting {paper}, you realize the footnote with the code link was never anonymized. It points straight to your GitHub account.
writing.zh: 投完 {paper} 一小时后，你发现放代码链接的那个脚注根本没匿名，链接直接指向你的 GitHub 账号。

writing.en: Take the repo down tonight
writing.zh: 今晚就把仓库撤下来

writing.en: The link now leads to a 404. One reviewer will write "code not available", which is fair.
writing.zh: 链接现在打开是 404。会有审稿人写“代码不可用”，这也说得过去。

writing.en: Scrub the repo and rename the account
writing.zh: 清理仓库，账号改名

writing.en: You rename the account and wipe its history, down to a README that thanks nobody. The link now belongs to a stranger.
writing.zh: 你给账号改了名，清空了历史记录，只剩一个谁都不感谢的 README。现在这个链接看起来属于一个陌生人。

writing.en: A search engine had already cached the old page, and the program chairs find it before any reviewer does. Desk rejected.
writing.zh: 可搜索引擎早就缓存了旧页面，程序主席抢在所有审稿人之前发现了它。直接拒稿。

writing.en: Email the program chairs
writing.zh: 给程序主席写信

writing.en: The chairs reply within a day: send an anonymous link, and they'll pass it on to the reviewers.
writing.zh: 程序主席一天内就回了信：发一个匿名链接过来，他们会转给审稿人。

writing.en: The chairs thank you for flagging it, then apply the policy. Desk rejected, very politely.
writing.zh: 程序主席感谢你主动报告，然后照章办事。直接拒稿，拒得非常客气。

writing.en: Wrong Track
writing.zh: 投错 track

writing.en: The confirmation email arrives, and you read the track name twice. You picked the one just above the one you meant.
writing.zh: 确认邮件到了，你把 track 名称读了两遍。手滑了，选中的是目标 track 正上方那个。

writing.en: Rereading the confirmation, you notice that {paper} went to the theory track. It contains no theorems.
writing.zh: 重读确认邮件时，你发现 {paper} 投到了理论 track。可论文里一个定理都没有。

writing.en: Email the chairs to move it
writing.zh: 写信请程序主席改过来

writing.en: Moved within a day, with a smiley face. The chairs see this every cycle.
writing.zh: 一天内就改好了，还附了个笑脸。程序主席每一轮都会遇到这种事。

writing.en: Reviewers were already assigned, and the chairs are sorry. The reviewers will be sorry too.
writing.zh: 审稿人已经分配好了，程序主席深表遗憾。审稿人们很快也会深表遗憾。

writing.en: Leave it there for fresh eyes
writing.zh: 就放那儿，换个视角

writing.en: The out-of-area reviewers find the paper refreshing. One calls it "a welcome change of pace".
writing.zh: 领域外的审稿人觉得这篇论文很新鲜。其中一位评价说：“换换口味也不错。”

writing.en: Reviewer 1 writes: "This does not belong in this track." Reviewer 1 is correct.
writing.zh: 1 号审稿人写道：“本文不属于这个 track。”1 号审稿人说得对。

writing.en: Is That How You Spell It?
writing.zh: 名字是这么拼的吗？

writing.en: The camera-ready is in. Then {labmate}, your co-author, messages: "Small thing. My name is spelled wrong." It is, in the proceedings metadata.
writing.zh: 终稿交了之后，合作者 {labmate} 发来消息：“有个小事，我的名字拼错了。”一查，论文集的元数据里确实拼错了。

writing.en: Email the publication chairs
writing.zh: 给出版主席写信

writing.en: Fixed within a day. The chairs say they get this email a lot, which helps a little.
writing.zh: 一天内就改好了。出版主席说经常收到这种邮件，这让你好受了一点。

writing.en: The PDF gets fixed, but the metadata doesn't. Search engines will remember both spellings forever.
writing.zh: PDF 改过来了，元数据却没改。互联网是有记忆的，两种拼法它都会永远记得。

writing.en: Apologize over lunch, then email
writing.zh: 请顿午饭道歉，再写邮件

writing.en: The chairs fix it eventually. The lunch, slightly awkward, fixes the friendship right away.
writing.zh: 出版主席最后还是改了。那顿午饭虽然有点尴尬，却当场修好了你们的交情。

writing.en: Fix the preprint and move on
writing.zh: 改好预印本，翻篇

writing.en: The preprint is right, and the official version is wrong forever. {labmate} says it's fine, twice.
writing.zh: 预印本是对的，正式版永远是错的。{labmate} 说了两遍“没关系”。

writing.en: Langauge
writing.zh: Langauge

writing.en: The camera-ready is submitted. You open the PDF to admire it, and the first sentence of the abstract says "langauge".
writing.zh: 终稿交了。你打开 PDF 准备欣赏一下自己的大作，摘要第一句就写着“langauge”。

writing.en: Final version, uploaded. You flip through it once more and find "Tabel 3" on page 6, in a sentence you've read forty times.
writing.zh: 最终版，已上传。你又翻了一遍，在第 6 页发现了“Tabel 3”，就在一句你读过四十遍的话里。

writing.en: Email the publication chair
writing.zh: 联系出版主席

writing.en: The chair lets you upload a fixed PDF, with a gentle note that the window closes tomorrow.
writing.zh: 出版主席允许你重新上传修好的 PDF，还温和地提醒你，通道明天关闭。

writing.en: The proceedings are final. The typo is now part of the permanent scientific record.
writing.zh: 论文集已经定稿。这个拼写错误从此载入科学史册。

writing.en: Fix the preprint and let it go
writing.zh: 改好预印本，随它去吧

writing.en: The preprint is perfect. The official version has character.
writing.zh: 预印本完美无缺。正式版则很有个性。

writing.en: Fix it, and every orphan word too
writing.zh: 改掉，顺便消灭所有孤词

writing.en: One typo and 23 orphan words later, not a single paragraph ends on a lonely word. You print page 1 just to look at it.
writing.zh: 改了一个拼写错误和 23 个孤词，再没有一段以孤零零的一个词结尾。你把第 1 页打印出来，就为了欣赏它。

writing.en: You fix 31 orphan words. Each fix creates a new one somewhere else. At 2 am, you stop.
writing.zh: 你改掉了 31 个孤词，可按下葫芦浮起瓢，别处总会冒出新的。凌晨 2 点，你停手了。

writing.en: Figure 1, Day 3
writing.zh: Figure 1，第 3 天

writing.en: Figure 1 for {project} is on its third day. It has been a pipeline diagram, a comic strip, and a pipeline diagram again.
writing.zh: {project} 的 Figure 1 已经画到第三天了。它当过流程图，当过四格漫画，现在又变回了流程图。

writing.en: You've spent three days on Figure 1. It's two boxes and an arrow, and it's still not right.
writing.zh: Figure 1 你已经画了三天。就两个框加一个箭头，可怎么看都不对劲。

writing.en: Give it one more day
writing.zh: 再给它一天

writing.en: On day four it clicks: one picture that explains the whole paper. Reviewers will look at it before they read a word.
writing.zh: 第四天终于开窍了：一张图讲清了整篇论文。审稿人读正文之前，第一眼看的就是它。

writing.en: Ship the version from day one
writing.zh: 就用第一天那版

writing.en: Nobody has ever rejected a paper over a fine Figure 1, probably.
writing.zh: 应该没人会因为 Figure 1 只是还行就拒稿吧，大概。

writing.en: Ask {labmate} for a design eye
writing.zh: 请 {labmate} 帮忙看看设计

writing.en: {labmate} moves one arrow and deletes two boxes, and suddenly the figure makes sense.
writing.zh: {labmate} 挪了一个箭头，删了两个框，这张图一下子就讲通了。

writing.en: {labmate} suggests making it 3D. You thank them and lose another afternoon talking them out of it.
writing.zh: {labmate} 建议改成 3D 的。你道了谢，又搭进去一个下午才把对方劝住。

writing.en: Introduction, Version 7
writing.zh: 引言，第 7 版

writing.en: You open intro_v7.tex, then, out of curiosity, intro_v1.tex. Version one was better.
writing.zh: 你打开 intro_v7.tex，又好奇地点开了 intro_v1.tex。结果还是第一版好。

writing.en: The seventh rewrite of the introduction to {project} is done. You reread the first one, and it was better.
writing.zh: {project} 的引言终于第七次重写完了。你回头一看第一版，还是第一版好。

writing.en: Go back to version one
writing.zh: 回到第一版

writing.en: Seven drafts to learn that the first one was right. At least now you know why it's right.
writing.zh: 经典结局：改了七版，最后用回第一版。至少现在你知道它为什么对了。

writing.en: Merge the best of all seven
writing.zh: 集七版之所长

writing.en: Version one's argument, version five's opening line, version seven's citations. It's the best one yet.
writing.zh: 第一版的论证，第五版的开头，第七版的引用。这是迄今最好的一版。

writing.en: Version eight reads like seven people wrote it, which, in a way, they did.
writing.zh: 第八版读起来像是七个人写的。某种意义上，确实如此。

writing.en: Start version eight
writing.zh: 开写第八版

writing.en: Version eight is slightly better than version one. It took another week.
writing.zh: 第八版总算比第一版好了一点点，只是又搭进去一周。

writing.en: Abstract Due First
writing.zh: 摘要要先交

writing.en: Surprise: the abstract for {project} is due a week before the paper. The experiments aren't finished, so neither is the story.
writing.zh: 没想到吧：{project} 的摘要要比论文早一周交。实验还没做完，故事自然也还没讲圆。

writing.en: The submission site wants a title and abstract for {project} by Friday, a week before the full paper. You have a title.
writing.zh: 投稿系统要求周五前提交 {project} 的标题和摘要，比全文早一周。标题你倒是有。

writing.en: Submit a placeholder abstract
writing.zh: 先交个占位摘要

writing.en: "We study an important problem and find interesting results." Everyone does this, and you can rewrite it on deadline night.
writing.zh: “我们研究了一个重要问题，并得到了有趣的结果。”大家都这么干，截稿那晚再重写就行。

writing.en: Write the real abstract now
writing.zh: 现在就写正式摘要

writing.en: Two hundred words take a whole day and force you to say what's actually new. Now you know what the paper is about.
writing.zh: 两百个词写了一整天，逼得你把到底新在哪里想清楚。这下你终于知道这篇论文在讲什么了。

writing.en: Write the abstract you hope is true
writing.zh: 写一份你希望成真的摘要

writing.en: The results come in and match it almost word for word. You decide you planned it that way.
writing.zh: 结果出来了，和摘要几乎一字不差。你决定对外宣称一切尽在掌握。

writing.en: The results come in and disagree with paragraph two. You rewrite the abstract, then the paper around it.
writing.zh: 结果出来了，和摘要第二段对不上。你只好重写摘要，再顺着摘要把论文也重写一遍。

writing.en: Related Work, Page Two
writing.zh: 相关工作，第二页

writing.en: The related work section of {project} is now two pages long. It cites {roll:80-110} papers, including one you've only read the title of.
writing.zh: {project} 的相关工作已经写到两页了，引用了 {roll:80-110} 篇论文，其中一篇你只读过标题。

writing.en: You meant to write one paragraph of related work for {project}. It's two pages now, with subsections.
writing.zh: 你本来只想给 {project} 写一段相关工作，结果现在写了两页，还分了小节。

writing.en: Cut it to half a page
writing.zh: 砍到半页

writing.en: You sort it into three themes, one paragraph each, and end on what nobody has done yet. Now the gap is obvious.
writing.zh: 你把它归成三个主题，每个一段，最后落到还没人做过的事上。研究空白一目了然。

writing.en: Half a page, and you cut the one paper most likely to be your reviewer's.
writing.zh: 砍到了半页，可你删掉的那篇，恰恰最可能是你审稿人写的。

writing.en: Keep all two pages
writing.zh: 保留全部两页

writing.en: Every reviewer will find their own paper in there. The method now starts on page five.
writing.zh: 每位审稿人都能在里面找到自己的论文，人人有份。只是方法部分要到第五页才开始。

writing.en: Turn it into a comparison table
writing.zh: 改成对比表格

writing.en: The table takes a day. Of thirteen rows, yours is the only one with every checkmark.
writing.zh: 表格做了一天。十三行里，只有你那一行全是勾，遥遥领先。

writing.en: Anywhere on Earth
writing.zh: AoE 时间

writing.en: At 11:40 pm, {labmate} reminds you that the {venue} deadline is Anywhere on Earth, which you had converted wrong. You have four more hours than you thought.
writing.zh: 晚上 11:40，{labmate} 提醒你，{venue} 的截稿时间是 AoE（Anywhere on Earth），你之前换算错了。你比自己以为的多出四个小时。

writing.en: Use all four hours
writing.zh: 用满四小时

writing.en: You fix a table and sharpen the introduction. Then you watch a 4 am sunrise you didn't ask for.
writing.zh: 你改好一张表，又把引言打磨得更利落。然后被迫见识了凌晨 4 点的日出。

writing.en: You submit at 11:45 pm, as planned, and sleep while the rest of your lab finds new typos.
writing.zh: 你按原计划在晚上 11:45 交了稿，睡觉去了。组里其他人还在找新的拼写错误。

writing.en: Fix Figure 1, then stop
writing.zh: 改完 Figure 1 就收手

writing.en: You spend one hour on the figure everyone looks at first, then submit while you're ahead.
writing.zh: 你花一小时改了大家第一眼会看的那张图，然后见好就收，交了稿。

writing.en: Question 14
writing.zh: 第 14 题

writing.en: Question 14 of the {venue} responsible-research checklist: "Did you report the total compute used, in GPU hours?" You did not. You have no idea.
writing.zh: {venue} 负责任研究清单第 14 题：“你是否报告了总算力消耗（以 GPU 小时计）？”你没报告，也完全不知道用了多少。

writing.en: The {venue} checklist asks how many hours of annotation went into your data. You did most of it yourself, at night, without a stopwatch.
writing.zh: {venue} 的清单问你的数据花了多少小时标注。大部分是你自己晚上标的，没掐表。

writing.en: Dig through the logs and find out
writing.zh: 翻日志查清楚

writing.en: An hour of digging gives you a real number and a new appendix table. Reviewers love a real number.
writing.zh: 翻了一小时，你得到一个真实的数字，还多了一张附录表。审稿人最爱真实的数字。

writing.en: Half the logs were deleted to save disk space. You report an estimate, with a footnote that apologizes.
writing.zh: 为了省硬盘空间，一半日志早就删了。你报了个估计值，外加一个道歉的脚注。

writing.en: Answer "No" and explain why
writing.zh: 答“否”并说明原因

writing.en: "No, but here is roughly what it would be." It costs one paragraph, and nobody can say you hid anything.
writing.zh: “否，但大致数字如下。”多写了一段，但谁也不能说你藏了什么。

writing.en: Answer "N/A"
writing.zh: 答“N/A”

writing.en: It is applicable. You both know it is applicable. You click Submit anyway.
writing.zh: 这题明明适用。你知道，清单也知道。你还是点了 Submit。

writing.en: New Template, New Errors
writing.zh: 新模板，新报错

writing.en: This year's conference template is out. You paste in the draft of {project}, and nothing compiles: {roll:40-90} errors, all about a package you've never heard of.
writing.zh: 今年的会议模板出来了。你把 {project} 的草稿贴进去，结果完全编译不了：{roll:40-90} 个报错，全都跟一个你从没听说过的宏包有关。

writing.en: Debug it line by line
writing.zh: 逐行排错

writing.en: Two hours and one deleted package later, it compiles. You post the fix in the lab chat and are briefly famous.
writing.zh: 两小时后，删掉一个宏包，终于编译通过。你把解决办法发到组群里，小火了一把。

writing.en: It compiles by evening. Every table is now in a slightly different font, and you can't unsee it.
writing.zh: 傍晚终于编译通过了。可每张表的字体都变得有点不一样，一旦注意到，就再也没法假装没看见。

writing.en: Ask {senior}, who fixed it last year
writing.zh: 问去年修过的 {senior}

writing.en: {senior} replies in two minutes with a one-line fix and a sigh you can hear through the chat.
writing.zh: {senior} 两分钟就回了，给了一行修复代码，隔着聊天框你都能听到那声叹气。

writing.en: {senior} is away, and the auto-reply points to the lab wiki. The wiki page was last edited four templates ago.
writing.zh: {senior} 不在，自动回复让你去看实验室 wiki。那个 wiki 页面上次更新，还是四版模板之前。

writing.en: Stay on last year's template for now
writing.zh: 暂时先用去年的模板

writing.en: Everything compiles today. The switch will happen later, at the least convenient moment possible.
writing.zh: 今天一切都能编译。按照墨菲定律，换模板这事会挑最不方便的时候来。
